nga / /8//bas/ shaṃpa grub pa/'i dbang pyug chen kro rdo grub chen shājigs re/da bstan nga/'i nyi ma dpasnyiya bzang ngo/ nge gsung 'bum legs bshad nor bu'i bang mdzod bzhugs/si /bron 3/ rngegs dpe skrun /bang /
ra / /mkhas shaṃng grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rdo grub chen 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang po'i gsung 'bum legs bshad nor bu'i bang mdzod bsdoms/si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

pod 7— bar /bsngon 'gro'i gtam/gna' rtsom ni mi rigs srol rgyun rig sanas kyi grub cha gal chen zhig yin cing / krung hwa mi rigs kyi 'od stong 'bar ba'i ris gnas shul bzhag khrod kyi rin chen nor bu zhib yin/ de 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig tho 'god/ par skrun bcas byed rgyu ni rang re'i tang dang rgyal khab kyis mi ribs phul byung rig gnas rgyun 'dzin byed pa'i bya ba rlabs chen zhig yin pas/ rang rgyal mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong bca' khrims sobs bca' khrims dang srid jus su gsal bor gtan la phab yod cing / rim pa khag gi mi dmangs srid gzhung nas 'di phyogs kyi bya ba 'bor chen bsgrubs shing / grub 'bras g.yur du za ba blangs/ nye ba'i lo shas ring / rgyal srid spyi khyab khang nas grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom nang du 'dus pa'i rang rgyal mi rigs gna' rtsom 'tshol snyud dang /dag sgrig tho 'god sogs byed pa'i thad ched du yib/ cha phud de gtan phab gsar ba mdzad cing / blang bya gsar ba bton/ spyi khyab hru'u ci nas kyang‘6gna' rtsom dag sgrig par skrun sgos mes rgyal gyi phul byung rig gnas shul bzhag rgyun 'dzin byas te/ krung go'i 1

pod 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ /sto shāka /sgo byed(ri ba'in la ba srung sa/ gas phul byung ga gnas dar spel dang / mi rigs mthun sgril dang rig gnas brje res la shugs sgon byed pa dmigs 'dun du byas te/ bden 'tshol lam/ tshan rig dang mthun pa'i spyod stangs la brten nas sa gnas mi rigs ba/na' rtsom sngog 'don myur skyob byas thog mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshobs ring lugs dpal yon 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu de yin/bya ba'i rtsa don ni chab srid 'du shes shugs dam zhing / spid jus dbye mtshams gsal bor byas te/ lo rgyus dang rtsod sgrub kyi lha ba spyad nas snyigs dor bcud len byed pa'i dus mtshungs su rig gnas kyi ngos nas snga ma'i rnam pa ji bzhin cha tshang du mtshon ci nus byed cing / spyir btang du brtsams chos la dpyad brjod ci yang byed rgyu min/ gzhan yang byed sgo'i shes byar slob sbyong dang / ched las shes byar gcigs 'dzin byas te/ nan tan zhib tshags kyi bya ba'i spyod stangs la brten nas gnad sgo stangs 'dzin byas thob rgyun shes sam ched las rang bzhin gyi 'gal 'khrul sa/yol ci nus byed rgyu'ang spros ma dgos/de dang mnyam du spus legs 'du shes chags par byas te/ ma 1

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 7dngul gyi mthun rkyen cung 'byor ba'i gnas tshul 'og〈dpe tshogs〉/de jus 'god dang / mdun shog deb tshad/ shog spus/ ye be'i dag tshad sogs gang rung nas de sngon las spus tshad bzang bar byas te/mig snga'i rgyal nang sa gnas bod yig dpe deb cung legs po'i gras su tshud par byed pa dmigs 'ben du byas yod/'dir cis kyang gleng dgos pa zhig ni de ring nga tshor bya ba 'di spel ba'i go skabs byung tshe/ nga tshor 'di 'dra'i rig gnas shul bzhag rgya che zhing rngams mthug pa zhig myur skyob bya ru yod cing / mang po zhig da dung med brlag tu ma song bar 'tshol du yod pa dang de tsho'i rig banas rin thang gi sgor yin te/ de yang de sngon gyi lo rgyus su rang re gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir 'gro ba mi yi sha tshugs su skyes pa ni sus kyang bgrang du med mod/ legs par bsam na mi rigs dang mi'i rigs la 'phral yun du phan pa'i mdzad pa bzang po bskrun pa dang nyams pa med pa'i legs skyes shul du bzhag yod mkhan ni shin tu nyung ngu zhig las med na/ khong tsho ni mi yi khya mchog dang / phul byung skyes bur bgrang ba don dang ༄jildan te/ skad du6‘mkhas pa rnams ni med na blo gros rnams nyams mi rnams 'tsho ba don yod min 3ces gsungs paXshin tu mad de/ khong tsho yod cing / khong tshos rang byung khams dang spyi 6

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 7rjes su yi rang zhing snying nas bka' drin zhu 'os la/ sngon 'gro'i rtsom thung 'di yang khong rnam par dad sadung mos gus kyi yid rlabs g.yo bzhin bris pa lags/dus mtshungs su rang re gangs can pa dab la gna' bo'i dus nas bzung mkhas pa la gong bkur dang shes rig la gces thang che ba'i srol rgyun bzang po zhig yod la/ yul mgo log 'dir mtshon na'ang dgon sde dang dge 'dun pa dag gis bshad sgrub kyi ngos nas so so'i mkhas pa dang de'i brtsams chos la gcigs su 'dzin pa tsam du ma zad/ yul khams spyi nas kyang66mkhas pa yon tan ldan pa dang / skra dkar yang tsha mthong ba ste sogs kyis mtshon te mkhas pa dag phu dud bya ba'i yul gsum gyi gtso bo'i go gnas sa bgrang ba'i srol 'dus/ cing / khong tsho ni legs bshad kyi ༄'byung gnas dang / legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba/ yi rang dang mig ltos kyi mtshon dpe zhig tu brtsi ba dang / khong tshos brtsams pa'i gsung chos dag ni bslab bya'i gnas shig dang / lugs sanyis blang dor gyi tshad gzhi zhig tu brtsi bar byed/ khyem rgyud dang rus rgyud dag la mtshon na rang gi khyem rgyud du 'khrungs pa'i mkhas pa dang de'i gsung chos de tsho so so rang rang gi khyim rgyud kyi khyad nor du byas tebu rabs tsha rgyud du bsrel bar byed pa'i dar srol yod pas/ dus 7

za da 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstad nyi'i gsung 'dum/yod/de sngon gyi srid jus legs po'i go skabs ma shor bar byas te/cha rkyen zhan cing dka' tshegs che ba la ma ltos par mthun rkyen sasar gtod sgos 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig myur skyob kyi las la rang rtogs ngang zhugs nas sa gnas rig gnas shul bzhag rtsa chen dag chud zos su mi 'gro ba'i ched du 'bad pa yun ring bsten pa'i ched las don gnyer mi sna dag sgas don mthun gyi bya ba mang po bsgrubs song bas/ ngas 'dir khong tshor dka' las myang song zhes zhu zhing / kho bo rang ngos kyis bya ba de la rgyab skyor dang mthun rkyen sbyor ba'ang ldog med kyi 'os 'gan zhib tu brtsis yod/ 'on kyang rang khul gyi gna' rtsom ma lus par yongs su myur skyob byed rgyu ni da dung dus yun ring zhing dka' khag che ba'i bya ba zhig yin pas/ grub 'bras kyi rmang gzhi'i steng mru 'thud nas rgyun 'khyongs lhod med kyi bya ba 'bor chen zhig bsgrub pa la rag las yod/mjug mthar mgo log gna' rtsom bya ba legs 'grub yong zhing / grub 'bras gzengs su thon pa'i smon 'dun zhu//zhes pad ma rnam rgyal nas2003 1༷ 1la bris/10

pod 7྾ ྾r+yā rtsom ba po za sprod mdor basprus/rdo grub chen kun bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang po ni/ bod kyi rus chen bzhi las a lcags 'bri yi rigs las mched pa gnubs lcags mo'i rgyud du/yab rtsod bral dus babs kyi sprul ba'i gter chen khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa spis li gter ston zhes yongs su grags pa de dang / yum mtshan ldan ḍā ki'i rigs gyur bsod nams mtsho gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i shing mo gling lor(spyi lo1866)ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas 'bros sgang zhes grags pa'i ri zhol da lta'i mgo log pad ma rdzong gi rdzong grong gi nye 'dabs su sku bltams/ snga ma'i bag chags sad pas sku chung ngu'i dus nas yi ge dang brda sprod sogs gzigs pa tsam gyis thogs med du mapho/ rdzogs sprul bzhi ba mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje'i lung bstan ltar/ grub pa'i khyu mchog chen po rdo grub kun bzang 1

pod 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ gzhan phan 'jikas med phrin las 'od zer gyi sku phreng gsum par ngos bzung ste rdo grub chen gyi gdan sar 'khod na'ang / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po ches brtag pa mdzad tshe gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i yang srid du grub pas/ khri chen gung thang pa'i sku skyer yang grags so//rdza stod du phebs nas 'jam dbyangs ngur smrib 'chang ba'i rnam rol chen po rdza dpal dge sprul sku o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po'i zhabs la gtugs nas chos kyi bdud rtsi bzhes pas/lhag pa'i lhas rjes sa bzang zhing byin gyis brlabs te dgongs pa ༄ ༄ye shes kyi klong rdol/ dgung lo brgyad du son pa chu pho sprel lor dpal sprul rin po ches da lo rdo grub sprul sbus spyod 'jug gi bka' khrid gnang dgos zhes phyogs kyi slob bu mang du bsdus tshe/nye gnas 'khor dang bcas pas sprul sku khong sku na chung drasas pas re zhig 'khor de lta bu la bka' khrid mi 'ong zhes nan gyis zhus pa bka' bkyon gyis tshar bcad par brten/ bka' nan bzlog ma nus par rdza rgyal dgon du 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i 'khor la spyod 'jug chen mo'i bka' khrid gnang ba na/ 'khor slob kun gyi lus kyi spu long dbang med g.yo zhing / dad pa'i mchi ma sham sham 'bab pa'i tshod du chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor bas/ dpal sprul rin po 2

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/—྾ r+yā ྾ba4༄/ /rten snying 'grel ba/ye rnyaṅgā'i zin bris n+ya gro rnya'i sa bon/ na ma shākya mu ne ye/ /stobs bcu'i rtsal gyis rnam bsgyings shing / /'khor gyi nang na bsnyeng dang bral//rten 'byung seng ge'i sgra sgrog pa/ /skyes bu'i khyu mchog de la 'dud/ /rten 'brel snying po'i tshigs bcad 'di ni 'phas/sa pa rta thul gyis shā ri'i du la bshad pa'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i bkar yongs su grags/ de kho nar yang ma nges te/ ston pa ri rab kyi rtse mor bzhugs dus mchod rten byed par 'dod pa'i lha mang po'i don du 'phabs pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gis zhus nas gsungs pa gzungs chen sde lnga'i ya gyal du bzhusas shing / spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang las kyang gsungs/ bya ba'i rgyud dpung bzang du yang / gtsang zhing dben pa'i sa yi phyosas su ni/ /'jim pa'am ni bye ma las byas pa'i/ /bde gshegs mchod rten rten 'brel snying po can/ sdig pa sbyang ba'i phyir ni rtag tu gdab/ /ces gsungs shing / de'i 'grel bar rten 'brel snying bo ni rnam snang mngon byang las gsungs par bshad/ dus 'khor 'grel chen dri med 'od las kyang / lha thams cad la phyag rgyas 'debs pa ni rdo rjeXsems dpa' dang / chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong la phyag rgyas 'debs pa ni ye rnyarmā'o/ /zhes 2

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7gsungs la/ grub chen nag po spyod pas/ dpyid thig tu yang drangs pa sogs bla med kyi chos skor nas kyang mang du bshad do/ /shā ri'i bus tshigs bcad 'di lan gcig thos pa kho nas don khong du chud pa dang /tshigs bcad gcig po 'dis don mang bo la zhugs pa dang / shin tu phra ba'i don rnyed pa dang / 'di thos pa'i mod la zag pa med pa'i shes rab skyes pa dang / 'di kho na las brtsams te yun ring bor dris lan byas kyang zad mi shes pas na go rim bzhin du/ shes rab myur ba/ shes rab malhogs pa/ shes rab rno ba nges par 'byung ba'i shes rab can/shes rab yangs pa zhes mdo sde las bshad par rnam bshad rig pa nas gsungs/ 'di bod skad du bsgyur ba'i 'gyur la mi 'dra ba bcu skor tsam 'byung yang bzang shos/ /chos gang rgyus byung de dag dang / /rgyu dang de 'gog gang yin pa'ang / /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' basprul te/ /de skad gsungs pa dge sbyong che/ /zhes dpung bzang gi 'grel ba na snang ba 'dul ba lung gi shā ri'i bu'i thad na/ chos rnams gang dka rgyu las byung ba dang / /de yi rgyu dang de 'bog gang yin pa'ang / /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis bka' bstsal te/ /de skad gsungs pa'i tshul can dge sbyong che/ /zhes 'byung ba dang shin tu mthun no/ /chos bang rgyus byung /zhes yar bcad/ de dag ces mar bcad pa'i dbang du btang na/ /chos gang rgyus byung de dag gi/ /rgyu dang zhes pa'ang go bde'o/ /mdo 'di'i 3

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7྾ ྾྾4 bo nying 'tshams sbyor ba yod/ /ma 'pho bar yang mkhas rtogs bya/ /zhes dpe brgyad sasungs pa ltar rgyu med par de dab mi 'byung la/ rgyu nyid de dab tu 'pho ba'ang ma yin gyi/ rgyu la brten nas 'byung ba'i rten 'brel tsam mo/ /rgyu 'bras su 'gyur tshul ni/ ma rig pa dang 'du byed gnyis 'phen byed kyi rgyu/ sred len srid pa gsum 'grub byed kyi rgyu/ rnam shes nas tshor ba'i bar 'phang 'bras/ skye ba rga shi gnyis grub pa'i 'bras bu ste/ ma rig pa'i dbang gis yang srid mngon par 'du byed pa'i 'du byed kyi las bsags te/ rnam shes nas tshor ba'i bar lnga 'grub rung du 'phang ba sred len gyis gsos btab pas 'du byed kyi bag chags srid pa'i rten 'brel du go 'phos te skye ba 'grub cing / de'i nyes dmigs su rga shi 'khor bcas 'byung ba yin no/ /bdag nyid chen po nye rgyal lta bu'i tshe rabs gzhan du rten 'byung stong ba'i don du 'gro tshul la blo shin tu byang ba rnams la 'di ltar brten nas 'byung ba'i rten 'byung gi chos bstan pa nyid mtha' bral dbu ma'i de kho na nyid kyi chos yongs rdzogs bstan par yang 'gyur te/ brten nas skyes pa nyid kyis gtan ma skyes pa dang rang dbang ba'i skye ba'am ngo bo nyid kyis skye ba gnyis char gyi sgro 'dogs gcod nus pa'i phyir ro/ /mngon rtogs rgyan las/byang chub dang ni rten mchod nyid/ /ces pa'i thad kyi brgyad stong 'grel chen du tshigs bcad 'dis gang zag gi bdag med tsam bstan par 6

rten snying skor/ ngo da/ 7gye spyo rdzezhesprezhebazhed kyang 'phags pa klu sgrub be+e/ de kho na nyid kyi khyad par lam dang rigs pa'i dag/ga bya gnyis bcad pas rab tu phye ba la bzhed do// //rgyus byung bdun po 'gag pa rgyu 'gag pa kho na'i stobs kyis yin nga ra thes pa na/ rgyu 'bog byed kyi lam de rgyus byung 'gas pa'i 'bog bden 'thob byed du mthong bar 'gyur la/ rgyu lnga'i nang nas kyang nyon mongs pa'i lam ni rtsa ba gcig bcad pas las dang khyon mongs thams cad rang log tu 'gro bar byar yod cing las la tshul de med pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i rtsa ba yang ma rig pa gcig/ ru/ra bong du brjod zin pas mdor na ma rig pa zlos/ byed de thar ba'i lam kyi dngos bzhir ngos zin no/ /de'ang ma rig pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi bzlog phyogs su 'jug pa'i bdag med rnam can kyi lam kho na dbos kyi ma rig pa tsher ma dbyung ba bzhin byar med la/ bdag med gtan la 'be+ebs tshul yang rten 'byung stong ba'i don dang stong brten 'byung gi don du 'char ba tshigs bcad phyed 'dis bstan pa nyid las lhas pa gzhan med pas lam sgom tshul la nges pa rnyed do/ /'das lam bar chad med lam dang rnam grol lam gyi dbye ba thams cad kyang gtso bor nyon mongs dang de las kyang bdag 'dzin spong ba dang spangs pa'i lam gyi steng nas bzhag pa las sdug bsngal spong ba dang spangs pa'i rim/ pas bzhag pa sked do/ /rten snying gzungs chog las/ las dang nyon mongs med na 'khor la 7

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ r+yā྾ —44 ྾pa mtshungs pa med par bstan pa ste/ don 'di la dgongs nas rtsa ba shes rab las kyang / gang gis rten cing 'brel bar 'byung / /zhes pa nas/ spros pa nyer zhi zhi bstan pa/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spru rnams kyi/ /dam pa/ zhes dang / /'jig rten las 'das par bstod pa las/ rten cing 'brel bar gang 'byung ba/ /de nyid lo kyis stong bar bajed/ / dngos po rang dbang yod min zhes/ /mnyam med lo kyi seng ge'i sgra/ /zhes sogs ches mang du gsungs so/ /nam zhig 'phags lam thob dus sa ngas rgyas la shes nas dad pa rnyed de bdud dang phas kyi rgol bas bkrir mi btub pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog ces pa'i grangs su 'gro ba'ang rten 'byung gi de nyid mthong ba'i sgo nas ston pa la yid ches rnyed pa 'dir thub pas tshe rabs kun tu ston pa sazhan la mi bsten pa'i dam pa'i gral du sdod par 'dod na 'di la gces spras chen po bya ste/ don tshul bzhin bsam na lta ci smos/ tshig tsam bzlas pa la yang phan yon tshad med pa 'byung ba'i phyir te/ gzungs chog las/ rtag tu bzlas brjod byas gyur na/ /dam pa'i chos kyang bzung bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / mdo sde las/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba rnyed par dka'o/ /chos thos pa rnyed par dka'o/ /tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab dang / rnam par grol ba dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba dpag tu med pas yongs su bsgos pa'i gsang sngags kyi tshika 'di dag kyang rnyed 10

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7par dka'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bka' 'gyur gyi grar 'di'i gzungs chos tshigs bcad ma zhig bzhugs shing / rten snying gi cho ga zhib mo zhes pa tshigs lhug tu mdzad pa zhig bstan 'gyur khrod du bzhugs te/ phyi ma 'di nerban rak+ṣi tas rang bi/ bla ma las rten snying gi las kyi cho ga brgya thos pa las phyis su phal cher brjed de lhag ma rnams kyi brjed byang du btab pa yin par gzhung rang gi mjug tu gsal la/de gnyis tshigs bcad lhug tsam las khyad par mi snang zhing / tshigs bcad ma'i mthar yang / dge slong nerban rak+ṣi tas/ /tho gar yul nas rnyed pa ste//zhes 'byung bas sa/nyis ka bstan bcos yin no/ /rten 'brel snying po'i sngags thems zhib mor bkod pa zhes bya ba jo bo rje dang nag tshos bsgyur ba zhig dang / rten snying gi srung ba rje btsun berba pa nas sa skya ba chen po la brgyud pa'i gdams skor dang / rten snying gi zin bris 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyi gsung sgros ltar 'phabs1 pa rin po ches bkod pa dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi snying po'i rnam bshad ces klu sgrub zhabs kyis mdzad pa dang / rtab pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 'grel ba dang /lcang skya ngab dbang blo bzang chos ldan gyis mdzad pa'i rten snying bi rnam bshad bde gathegs dgongs rgyan zhes bya ba sogs yod pas don du gnyer ba rnams kyis de dag las kyang btsal bar bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang rnga chen nag zla'i dga' ba bzhi ba la'o// ///1

rten snying skor/ po da/ 7྾ ྾ —4༄/ /rten 'aprel snying bo la brten te bsod nams bya ba'i cho ga mchod sbyin gter gyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bathugs so/ /bla ma shākya seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de'ang gzungs sngags kyi tshul rgya maza nang nas chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi bstan don stong dang rten 'byung zung 'jug gi don du bzum pa rten 'brel snying bo'i gzungs la brten te mchod sbyin gyi cho ga nyeXbar sgrub pa la/ sbyor dngos gnyis las dang po ni/ gong du mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal blum po ba byung dang dri bzang gis byug pa'i dkyil du ston pa'i sku byin can bzhugs/ de'i g.yas su kazungs bum bzang bo drug dngaXghi haṃ dang tsan+dan dkar dmar la sogs pa'i chus balhams shing 'bras du can gyi shing gi kha rgyan dang bcas te ba'ag la/ mtha' bskor du mchod yon dang me tog dang spos dang mar me dang lha bshos la sogs pa mchod pa bzang la mang ba brgya mchod dam stong mchod lta bu ci 'byor bstar legs su bsham/ mchod dkyil kyi mdun ngos dma'/ bar stebs bu gru bzhi po yangs pa la dbus bu ri rab dang / phyobs mtshams su gling gtso dang / gling phran/ mtha' bskor du khor yug lcags ri dang bcas pa'i bkod pa rags pa re byas la tshon gyis bsgyur/ ri rab kyi steng du tshonaXsna'i sbud pa las khang bzang gru bzhi ba'i rnam par phub ste de'i nang giXphyogs bzhi dbus dang lngar rin po che'i snod bzang por dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi btor ma zlum po katsang zhing gya nom pa dang / mchod yon rnyog med/ 'o phud mngar dang sbags pa rnams tshang ba re bshams/dbus kyi gtor ma'i mdun phyogs su dmar gtor bajid bag can zan dang sha dum sogs kyis bskor ba dang / bar mar+ṣas su dkar gtor gang rigs bzhag /gling bzhi gling phran brgyad la so sor ngar glud dang nam rgyang mda' 'phang shing ris rnams tshang ba re dang / de dag gi mthar sha chang la phug sgog tsong sran chan sogs 'byung po'i zas sna dang / gos dar 'bru sna rin po che sogs dkor cha/ mtha'aX'akhor du ri dwabs dang g.yung dwagasaXsogs srog chags kyi 15

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7— 4྾'beb pa dang / /smra byed gnyid las gnon pa yi/ /gdug pa gnod sbyin gdon rnams kun/ /phyogs skyong lo kyi mnga' ris dang //'bangs su ma chud 'ga' med pas/ /de dag phyi nas mi 'tshe bar/ /brjid pa'i bka' nan dbab tu gsol/ /steng phyogs lhun po'i yang rtse na/ /mchod sbyin grags pa brgyas mtho zhing / /sa steng 'jig rten skyong ba'i gadzu/ /brgya byin dbang dang ldan pa po/ /nye dbang lha rnams bdag po ste/ /srid na che btsan dbang phyug che/ /dkar phyogs dadugs 'byin byed pa yin/ /de ring rnal 'byor bdaka cag gis/ /mchod dang bsnyen bkur bgyi ba'i phyir/ /sum rtsen lha rnams mang por bcas/ /rgyud mangs bye ba'i sgra dang bcas/ /gshegs nas gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol/ /btsang ma chab kyi mchod yon 'dis/ /dag pa khrus kyi las mdzad de/ /bdud rtsi phud kyi btung ba dang / /dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /deng gi rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi/ /tshe srog byad du 'bebs pa dang / /'gugs byed bla la snyob pa yi/ /lha srin drag shul chen po rnams/ /phyogs skyong lo kyi mnga' ris dang / /'bangs dang bka' 'khor la gnas pas/ /de dag phyi nas mi 'tshe bar/ /brjid pa'i bka' nan dbab tu gsol/ /'dod pa'i khams na che ba'i lha/ /gzhan 'phrul bdud kyang 'jigs mdzad ma/ /drag mo bdud kyi bdud chen mo/ /dud sol ma hā re ma ti/ /'jigs pa ma mo'iXtshobs dang bcas/ /de ring mdos la spyan 'dren na/ /gshegs 21

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7྾ —྾ ྾ ྾྾rgya chen tsho du gsol/ /zhes 'dod don gsol/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis brgya phrag thalab dang / /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ /kyi bar brjod/ de ltar grub nas sadon phal ba gtsang spra las nyams shing mdangs la rgyu ba rnams la rngan 'gyed bya ba ni/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdzas rnams srid pa'i 'dod yon rgya mtsho zad mi shes pa'i rang bzhin nam mkha' mdzod kyi sprin phung dwangs shing thogs pa med pa sgyu ma mkhan po'i mig 'phrul ltar cir yang 'char ba'i tshogs su gyur/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan bdun gyi byin gyis brlabs/ mgron 'bod pa ni/ kye/ ston pa phan bzhed bla na med/ /kun mapho mi yi seng ge ste/ /spros kun nyer zhi'i rten 'brel ni/ /thugs rje kho nas gdam par mdzad/ /bden tshig 'di ni bden pa'i mchog /bden pa dus kun mi bslu'i tshig /bden pa'i tshig la mi nyan med/ /de ring bden pa'i sayar dam sgrog /gling bzhi srid pa'i 'jig rten 'dir/ /las kyi rdzu 'phrul chen po'i gdon/ /gnod sbyin srin po mi'am ci/ /'byung po ro lang sha za dang / /bya gdon srul po tsher ma 'don/ /smyo rjed rmongs rengs byed pa dang / /skem byed rdul khrod ma mo'i tshogs/ /grib gnon rdon po re lde 'don/ /byad stem pha rol rbad 'dre sogs/ /sha lan 'khon du chags pa yi/ /lha 'dre sdis pa'i sems lda na dag /kun kyang yas la mgron du gnyer/ /bying 'thibs rmugs pa lkugs rengs dang / /spyo 'bogs mig ser gzer tham mdze/ /thi na dang 23

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsunga'agum/—ba ba pa ba — —b.rab ba ba ra ྾ma ba ——bab —ba ba ba —— ——dmu chu lhan skyes rma/ /kha med sur+ya la sogs brgya/ /'bab pa thog ltar rdo ba dang / /gdug pa hur thum che ba'i ribs/ /mdor na bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad/ /rkyen ngan nyi khri chig stong dang / /dus min 'chi ba rnam dgu sogs/ 'chi rkyen rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /tshe dang srog la bsdo ba'i gdon//kun kyang mdos la spyan 'dren na/ /mdos khang 'di ru brtan par bzhugs/ /ma bstab sason sha dron mo/ dang / /ma bsngos mi khrag tshan mo yang / /ldad kyi mche ba gang rno dang / /rngub pa hub la bang che ru/ /glal bas gnam sa kha gdangs na/ /de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag gis/ /mdos bskangs brtan kayo kun khyab 'dir/ /bos pa'i mgron la cis mi 'byon/ /ma thosas skad cig nyid la gshegs/ /sarba bhu ta saṃ ku sha ya dzaḥ zhes brjod/ de nas dz+rel glud che ba dang mdos dkyil du bshams pa 'i yas rnams bsngo ba ni/ /ser sna'i kun sbyor smin pa'i gzugs/ /phung po thal ba lta bu'i mdos/yi dwags me ru 'bar ba'i kha/ /ngal gso'i dadusas 'byin la sbyar ba/ /rib/ pa mchog gi bdud rtsi ni/ /'od zer rnam rgyal chen po'i shugs/ /thub chen gang gis 'di gsung ba'i/ /rgyal ba phan mdzad des srungs shig /na maḥsarba sogs rgya chen shugs ldan lan bdun gyimathar/ mtshan bzhi brjod/ de 'dra lan gsum bskyar bas sngags nyer gcig mtshan ba'i lan gsum rdzogs pa na gyer bya ste/'dre lnga bdud gcod kyi phyogs su dmar gsur gtong zhing / kye snang ba rten 'brel chen mo ste/ /sgyu ma las kyi cho 'phrul nyid/ /sna tshogs srid pa'i 'jig rten 24

rten snying slor/ pod/ 74 ྾྾4ni/ /sgra brnyan bzhin du snang bar zad/ /khams dang 'gro ba tha dad dang / /zas bzhi kanas ris longs spyod kun/ /lam gsum rten 'brel 'khor lo ste/ /ma rig rgyu las shin tu byung / /bdag nyid chen po sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub snying bor 'di gzigs te/ /'dod pa'i khams ni kha zas la/ /brten pa med par yongs mi gnas/ /de phyir 'tsho ba zas la brten/ /sros dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten ni/ /rgyags dang brngan la mi chags med/ /dkor dang nor la mi sems med/ /brgya byin bdud rtsi 'thung ba nas/ /srin po rkang mar za ba yan/ /kun kyang 'tsho ba'i 'du byed ni/ /zas kyi rgyud la brten pa can/ /gdug pa gathin rje'i 'jig rten ni/ /rten 'brel lam la mi mkhas shing / /bo/mas pa'i gzhan dbang kho na yis/ /zas phyir sdig la nan gyis 'jug /gzhan gyi 'tsho ba mi sems par /dmod pa dug gi kha phru yis/ /'dre srin dmyal thag sacod pa rnams/ /phan bzhed thub pa mchog gis smad/ /de slad stong phrag brgyad cu'i gdon/ /mi bzad sdig las bskyab pa dang / /sbyin bdab/ 'jigs pa bsal slad du/ /byams chen sbyin pa'i sgo 'phar dbye/ /gshin rje lag pa dmar ba dang / /srog bdud las kyi bshan pa dang / /ma mo dal nad rims bdag dang / /dmyu thel sred pa dbugs sdud dang / /yi dwags mi sha za ba dang / /rkang dang klad pa tshil bu 'dod/ mchin pa nang khrol za ba'i tshogs/ /khrag dang mdangs la dga' ba rnams1 /deng gi rgyu sbyor 25

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigasamed bstan nyi'i gsud da / 'dis/ /gdon rigs 'dod pa skong gyur cig /tshe rabs lan chags 'khor gyur cig /sha rjen dmar gyi dwangs ma dang / /'bru bcud chang gi zhal skyems 'dis/ /'byung po sha la dga' ba dang / /chang skyems 'dod rnams dgyes pa bskang / /la phug lan tshwa sbyar ba dang / /kun dong tsong gi tshod ma yis/ /'byung po sngo ngad za ba dang / /mi kha bdud du 'bab pa bskang / /sran chan 'bru snas sbags pa dang / /phye zan 'bras bus brgyan pa 'dis/ /'byung po gtor ma za ba dang / /ro bda' 'dod rnams dgyes pa bskang / /lha rkang zhun gyi mar me dang / /tshil chen dmar gyi gsur dud 'dis/ /gshin rje zhun la rngam pa dang / /'byung po dri la za rnams bskang / /rdol mo nas la tshad 'dzugs na/ /'bru dar bang ba gang zer te/ /de ring mgron la byin drab/sa pas/ /stong ba'i nam mkha' brnang gis dogs/ /mang ba mi la tshad 'dzugs na/ /mi dar go kha sa/nga zer te/ /de ring gdon la 'jal ches pas/ /glud kyis bar snang ral du nye/ /bsags pa nor la tshad 'dzugs na/ /dbyis dar mdzod mig sang zer te/ /de ring bgegs la brngan drabs pas/ /brtan pa snod kyang dog por thal/ /ma bsad stongs su phab pa dang / /ma brkus 'jal du brdzangs pa yi/ /gya nom dkor cha sna tshogs 'dis/ /gtso bo'i gdon chen bco brgyad dang / /byis pa'i kashed chen bco lnga sogs/ /bgegs rigs brgya phrag brgyad brgya bskang / /so so'i re 'dod bskangs nas 28

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7'dod dang sdang sogs nyes rnams ni//gti mug kho nar brten nas skye/ /skye ba'i nya rgya 'dral ba dang / /rga shi'i khyim nas 'thon pa dag /dngos po yul la ma mthong bas/ /gti mug shin tu zhi ba 'thob/ /su zhig sngon dang phyi ma yi/ /mthar lta mi bzad la gnas pa/ /de nyid de yi 'ching ba ste/ /zab mo'i rten 'brel yongs mi shes/ /gang rnams bdag gzhan las min zhing / /gnyis ka'am rgyu med ma yin pa'i/ /srid 'di brten nas skyer shes pa/ /de dag shin tu mi rmongs 'gyur/ /sems can kun la sman slad du/ /'di don brnyes nas gsung ba yi/ /sangs rgyas rnam 'dren zla med pa/ /go'u tam chos ni de ltar zab/ /sdib pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /sogs/gzhan yang bya khye sprang gsum la sbyin 'gyed sogs ston mo'i 'du ba rgya chen po gces shingaphangs pa'i nor rdzas las blangs te ser sna dang phangs sems kyis ma sbags par bya/ de nas lam bstan bya ste khang bzang dang lha gtor rnams blang la mchod dkyilaXgyi nye logs su ba'ag mdos las gzhanarnams phyokas gcika tu 'khyer sla bar bsdu zhing ting lo rnams bltamal btegs te//kye snang ba kun byed sems kyi 'phrul/ /shes bya gshis la ma grub kyang / /rtog pa 'char sgo 'gags med las/ /rten 'aprel sgyu ma chen por shar/ /bsam gtan rnal 'byor ldan pa dang / /grub pa rig sngags 'chang rnams kyis/ /snang ba sprul bsgyur nus pa yang / /rig pa rang byan tshud pa'i mthu/ /de phyir de ring rnal 'byor ngas/ /stong gsum srid pa'i lha 'dre dang / /sbyin bdag 'gras pa bsdum sbad du/ /gsang sngags bden 3

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum /྾ 4྾ ྾pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /longs spyod dkor nor rgya mapho sprin/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i 'dod yon ches/ /gtan pa med par brngan zin na/ /da ni dkor la ngo zhig 'tshal/ /byams pa'i drin la rlung yang gzo/ /bden pa'i tshig la mi yang nyan/ /rib pa mchog la lha yang dad/ /gshin rje'i 'jig rten smos ci 'tshal/ /phyogs kyi chu gter chen po bzhi/ /rin chen dbyig gi bang mdzod de/ /de ru o la lam bstan gyis/ /da ni gshegs shig sha ra ra/ /da ni bzhud cig si li li/ /stong ba nam mkha'i rum du bzhud/ /ting lo'i lam sgron 'di thogs la/ /dgu tshig zhas/sa pa bzhin du bsdogs/ /'bab pa chu bo'i gzhung du bzhud/ /snang gsal me sgron 'di thogs la/ /chu chen gru gu bzhin du sdus/ /'tshubs ma rlung gi bang la bzhud/ /sgron chen 'od 'bar 'di thobs la/ /rlung nag gru bo bzhin du skyod/ /bsgo ba'i bka' la mi nyan na/ /gdon gyi sde dpon chen po bcur/ /chad pa las kyi bka' nan gsol/ /dbang phyug che rnams rig sngags dang / /'bar ba'i phyag rgya rnon po yis/ /bsdis dang brlag par gdon mi za/ /de bas da lta nyid du dengs/ sarba bhu ta sats+tsha/ 'esashā las byung ba'i rlung gis gtor snad btegs par bsamal/ o badz+ra kro ta ma hā ba la ha na da ha pa tsa bi rnyan sa ya dza ṭi lam sto rnya ra u tsusma kro ta hūṃ phaṭaḥ swā hā/ zhes bzla zhing yungs kar 'thor/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug mdosarnams chu bo chen po'idaba' rgal la bskyon/ rlung bra brtag la/ bsrung 'khor bsgom zhing / bsnyub bya de bzhin gshegs 32

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7pa la yid phyogs pas sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar thal mo sbyar te 'dug pa la tshe 'gug tshe gzungs dang rten snying bzla zhing bum chu blud lus bkru shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gis dbugs dbyung /rjes la lha gtor rnams gshekas/ khang bzang mdzod khang gi phug lta bur bzhag ste mtha' bsdu'o/ /rgyab chos suXsats+tsha lo grangs dang lam 'phrang bcos pa sorgas bya zhing / khyad par du srog bslu gang mang gtong / deXltar byas pas mtho ris kyi yon ten rnam pa bdun char bas brlan pa'i ljon shing ltar 'phel zhing rgyas pa la brten nas phun sum tshogs pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo mang po zhig rnam par bye bar 'gyur ba ni je chos med pa'i gnas so/ /'es pa'ang mdos chog gto'i rig pa la ring nas dga' ba'i 'du 'dzi can sprang bo/ 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan du 'bod pas chu stod zla ba'i nyi ring 'phul ba dang 'ga' zhig la phan par 'gyur ba'i bsam pas yar lung pad+ma bkod sngags rig grub pa'i slob dpon bgrang bar dka' ba'i zhabs kyis bcags thing lha dang rig 'dzin gyi 'du ba sprin ltar 'khrigs pa'i banas su sbyar ba dge zhing shis par gyur cig/ //maṅgalo// //༄/ /rten snying sngags kyi mde'u thung ni/na mo mdzi shri ye/ rten 'brel snying bo'i sngags kyi sham bu bden tshig gi mde'u thang mi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum/ chos kyi ma dang / — 1 / — da sgrib pa med pa'i phyag rgya/ dus gsum gyi 'phags pa rnams kyis dgongs pa/ brtul zhugs grub pa rnams kyi bsam pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bden pa'i tshib 'di dag sgas bdab dang sems can thams cad la srung ba gyis shig tshe dang gzi brjid dang longs spyod dang 'khor dang chos dang grags pa la sogs pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad sbyin pa dang / yongs su 33

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/྾ ྾—r+yā4 bzung ba dang / phyir zhing rgyas par spel ba sgrubs shib gang yang bdag cag/ la 'tshe zhing rnam par sdang ba'i dgra dang / dbul phongs dang /gdon dang / nad dang / rims nad dang / bcan gzan khro bo dang /dug dang / me dang / chu dang / mtshon cha dang / rmi ltas ngan pa dang /gza' dang / rgyu skar dang / phyogs ngan dang / sri kegs dang / byad stem dang / grib mnol dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad rig sngags kyi ral gris gcad pa dang / phur bus gdab pa dang /'khrul 'khor gyis gzhom pa dang / go chas mtshams bcing bar gyis shib swā hā/ nam mkha' med par sogs zhes gdab bo/ /nags kyi mthongs 'chi med dasa' ba'i tshal du/ a bh+yas bris/ /༄/ /rten 'brel snying bo la brten pa'i mdos kyi cho ga nyung dra 'jig rten gsum gyi rna rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo buka ya/ rnal 'byor ba kang zhika gis rten 'brel snying po'i cho ba la brten nas rang gzhan gyi 'chi ba bslu zhing nad gdon zhi bar byed pa mdos glud yas kyi rim pa gtong bar 'dod pas/ thog mar mdun du stegs bu'i khar sa'am zan gtsang rin chen bye ma dang sres pa la ri rabaXgling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa'i gzugs bya/ ri rab kyi steng nam mkha' kha dos lnga pa dang / gling bzhi shar dkar/ lho sdo/ nub dmar/ byang seraba'i kha dog can gyi nam mkha' so sor bran/ gling che chung bcu gnyis ri rab dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ bla glud bzang po/ mda' 'phang / shing ris/ rgyang bu/ thebs sgyu dang lan chags gang mang bcas bsag ri rabaXkyi bang rim sogs mtha' bskor kun tu rin chen sna tshogs dang / dar sna/ ras sna/ ja phud/'o phud/ 'o phud/ chang phud/ chu phud/ ci 'byor dang / de dag lasaXcung zad ring ba'i nye 'khor ci rigs 3‘1

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7ba ma ma ba par dmaragasur gyi snad dang / sha tshil kyang bsags/ de ltar mdos chas rnams sta gon byas nas/ gong du bum pa bcud ldan shing giXkha rgyan dang bcas pa'ang bsham la/ dngos gzhi'i dang por skyabs sems ni/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /dkon mchos gsum la skyabs mchi zhing / /'gro kun byang chub mchog thob phyir//gzhan phan rlabs chen basprub par bgyi/ lan gsum/ de nas 'jug tshig rten 'brel snying po'i gzhungalas byung ba tshig sna bsdus te/ /las dang nyon mongs yod gyur na/ /sems can 'khor bar 'gro 'gyur la/ /las nyon med na srid las ldog /bden des bdag gi bsam 'grub shog /denas lha rjes su dran pa ni/chos gang rgyus byung de dag dang / /de la 'gob pa gang yin pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' bstsal te/ /tshul bzhin gsungs pa dge sbyong che//drang srong yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /skyes bu chen po'i mtshan gyis brgyan/ /dpe byad bzang bo brgyad bcus spras/ /'od kyi gzi byin mtshungs med sku/ /me yi khams la rab gnas pa/ /bdag nyid kyi ni lag mthil du/ /gser gyi ri bo 'bar ba bzhin/ /skyil krung zhabs kyis bzhugs par gyur/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo//chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dab par rdzobs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅga'i klung gi bye ma snyed bzhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo rang sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgra bcom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyir mi 'ong ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lan gcig phyir 'ong ba la phya ga 'tshal 35

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba la ma ba ba lo/ /rgyun du zhugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtul zhugs grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can gyi sman pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor bu grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /denas/ na mo rat+na tra yāya/ oṃye rnyarmā sogs ci 'grub bzla/ de nas mdos byin rlabs ni/ gzungs de nyid slar yang lan bdun brjod nas/ chos gang rgyus byung de das ni/ /de la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /de bzhin sashegs pas bka' bstsal te/ /de skad gsungs pa dge sbyong che/ /chos kun rten 'byung zab mo ru/ /mkhyen pa bla na med brnyes pa'i/ /mthu dang stobs dang dbang phyug gis/ /stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten 'di/ /ngo mtshar rin chen bkod pa'i zhing / /yid 'ong lta na rab mdzes par/ /longs spyod mi zad nam mkha' mdzod/ /'dod dgu'i sprin phung chen por gyur/ /zhes brjod cing bsam/ de nas mgron 'bod pa ni/ kye/ de ring sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor ngas/ /sems can yongs la phan gdags phyir/ /'dzad med sbyin pa'i sgo 'byed kyis/ /lan chags mgron rnams da gshegs shig /ma rig sred len gzhan dbang gis/ /sna tshogs srid pa'i lus blang zhing / /las kyi rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan pa'i/ /gdon risas stong phrag brgyad cu'i sde/ /mdos glud yas kyi ston mor gshegs/ /sa 'og sa steng sa bla ste/ /'jig rten gsum la rab rgyu ba'i/ /babe/gas chen ma rung gshin rje'i rgyal/ /bdud btsan gnod sbyin gza' klu'i tshogs/ /rjed 36

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7byed grib gnon srul po'i gdon/ /skem byed spyo byed sha za'i sde/ /the'u rang srin po ma mo sogs/ /log 'dren mgron rnams da gshegs shig /khyad par deng gi bsrung bya 'di'i/ /srog dbugs drod dang mdangs 'phrog pa'i/ /steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar dang / /'os gdon klu dang sa bdab/ dang / /bar gdon btsan dang ma srin sogs/ /mtho ba rje dpon rgyal rigs nas/ /dma' ba rdul khrod sha za'i bar/ /de ring ston chen mgron la gshegs/ /'tsho ba'i zas la lha yang 'du/ /bden pa'i tshig la mi yang nyan/ /de phyir rnal 'byor sngags 'chang gi/ /dkor nor sbyin pa'i mgron la 'dus/ /phan byed bden pa'i ngag la nyon/ /thogs med skad cig yud tsam la/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis da gshegs shig /sarba bhu ta saṃ gu sha ya dzaḥ zhes brjod pas mgron rigs de das thams cad kha bdang bu yug 'tshub pa ltar 'dus par bsam mo/ /de nas mdos gyer ba ni/ kye/ chos dbyings phyogs dus mnyam pa nyid/ /gzod nas zhi zhing rnam dab/ kyang / /chos kyi rang bzhin ma rtogs te/ /ma rig bdag tu lta ba las/ /srid pa rmi lam bzhin du snang / /bgegs rgyal chen po khyed rnams kyang / /'du byed mi dbe/'i las bsags shing / /sngon gyi srid pas mtshams sbyar nas/ /mi bzad gshin rje'i 'jig rten du/ /'khrul snang sdug bsngal sna tshos/sa myong / /rgyu 'bras tshul la rnam rmongs te/ /gzhan la sanod pa lhur len zhing / /sha khrab/ drod dang dbugs la rngam/ /mi brdzu dgu brdzu'i cho 'phral gyis/ /skye ༄37

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7blugs so/ /de ci nus su bskyar/ 'di kho nas kyang yi dwags mang bo tshims shing / sbyin pa bo'i bsod nams 'phel ba dang / mdangs dang stobs 'phel ba dang / bgegs rnamasakyis 'tshe mi nus pa sogs phan yod bsam gyisami khyab par mdo las bshad do/ /mthar/ kye /stong gsum srid pa'i 'jig rten na/ /lha 'dre yid kyi rdzu 'phrul can/ /sa'am 'on te bar snang gnas/ /chen po'am chung ngu bang yang rung / /ston chen mgron la spyan drangs nas/ /longs spyod 'dod dgu'i char phab ste/ /bza' dang bca' dang btung dang bgo/ /yid bzhin nam mkha' gang bar 'bul/ /brtan g.yo phyi nang snang ba 'di/ /gdod nas rang bzhin ma skyes te/ /rten 'byung sgyu ma'i snang cha ru/ /'phags dang 'phags pa ma yin pa'i/ /blo yis ji ltar bzhag pa bzhin/ /dag dang ma dag so sor snang / /sgro dang skrur ba zhi ba yi/ /don 'di su zhig rtogs gyur pa/ /de dag zab mo ye shes kyis/ /mkha' dang lab mthil rab mnyam pa'i/ /cho 'phrul sgyu ma bzhin du ston/ /de phyir rnal 'byor dbang phyug ngas/ /chos nyid rtosas pa'i lta ba dang / /ting 'dzin sgyu ma'i 'phrul chen gyis/ /'dzad med dkor nor nam mkha'i gter/ /de ring byed la dngos sa ༄'bul/ /dgyes shing tshim par bzhes nas kyang / /sadug rtsub gnod sems zhi ba dang / /rtag tu bde la gnas gyur cig /ces brjod cing bsam/ de nas chos sbyin dang bden tshig bsgrags pa ni/ chos gang rgyus byung de dag ni/ /de la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' basprul te/ /de 1/

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/44 4྾rnams/ /ye shes chags pa med brnyes pa'i/ /mthu dang stobs dang dbang phyug gis/ /bgegs rnams gnod sems zhi ba dang / /sbyin bdag 'jigs pa kun bral nas/ /rang gzhan bde la gnas gyur cis /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin dang / /dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin dang — /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin sogs/ /ting 'dzin gzi brjid chen po yi/ mthu dang sto bas dang dbang phyug gis/ /sogs 'gre/ rgyun zhubs lan cig phyir 'ong sogs/ /gang dag nyan thos rang sangs rgyas/ /slob dang mi slob lam gnas shing / /kun sbyor rgyu ba rnams zad pa'i/ /mthu dang stobs dang dbang phyug gis/ /bgekas rnams gnod sems zhi ba dang / /sbyin bdag 'jigs pa kun bral nas/ /rang gzhan bde la sanas gyur cig /yangaye bhaṅgā gcigagam gsum brjod/ de lhar sbyin 'gyedardzogs nas/ mgron lam bstan pa ni/ mdos btegs 'a / kyi/ chos gang rgyus byung de dag ni//de la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' batsho te/ /de skad gsungs pa dge sbyong che/ /rten 'brel nus pa bsam mi khyab/ /sangs rgyas spyod yul bsam mi khyab/ /rig sngasas bden pa bsam mi khyab/ bsam gyis mi khyab 'di das gi/ /stobs nus bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /'jis rten khams rnams rgya mapho lo/ /'dod yon sprin gyis rab bkang ste/ /de ring lo la phul zin gyis/ /da ni gshesas shig sha ra ra/ /bgegs rgyal da ni sashes/sa re ran/ /lha 'dre yid kyi rdzu 'phrul can/ /phyogs bcu dag nas ba/nga lhag ‘1 4

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7dang / /sbyin bdag 'gras pa bsdum pa'i phyir/ /mchod dang bsnyen bkur bgyis zin gyis/ /byams pa'i drin la ngo zhig 'tshal/ /bden pa'i chad tho don yod mdzod/ /mtho ba ri rab rtse mo nas/ /dma' ba gshin rje'i 'jig rten yan/ /lha dang lha min yi dwags gdon/ /srid pa las kyis bskos pa bzhin/ /rang rang so so'i gnas su deng / /bsgo ba'i dam la mi nyan na/ /rig sngags zhags pa mi bzad pas/ /'ching dang gzir dang pham byas nas/ /sdug bsngal mi bzad myong bar 'gyur/ /de bas rnal 'byor sngags 'chang gis/ /ji ltar rjes su bstan pa bzhin/ /rang rang gnas su slar gshegs nas/ /byang chub sems dang ldan par byos/ /sarba bhu ta gats+tsha/ /zhes brjod nas mdos yas rnams phyogs gtsang sar bskyal/ rten snying gi sngags kyis btab pa'i gu gul bdug cing / bsrung gur bsgom pa ni/ chos gang rgyus byung de dag ni/ /de la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' bstsal te/ /de skad gsungs pa dge sbyong che/ /'dren pa shākya seṅge yi/ /ye shes chen po'i byin rlabs las/ /mi shisas gzhom med rdo rje'i gur/ /'bar ba'i me 'od rab 'phro bas/ /phyi rol phyogs rnams kun khyab ste/ /log 'dren rgyu ba'i skabs med gyur/ /ye rnyarmā sobs lan gsum/ de nas bsrung bya'i lus thams cad bum zus bkru zhing byug gal te de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzubs yod na/de nyid kyi ngogs su chu rgyun dreng bas khrus gsol zhing / khrus chus bsrung bya bkru ba'ang byal/'dir tshe 'gugs spro na/ tshe 'gugs kyi cho ga rgyas bsdus ci rigs bya zhing / shin tu bsdu na ‘16

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7—— ྾ ྾po ches/ /de ring rgyu sbyor bsrung bya 'di dka gi/ yon bdag gi/ /dgos 'dod 'grub pa'i bkra shis s+dzawī/ /nad gdon 'jigs brgyad zhi ba dang / /tshe bsod yar zla ltar 'phel te/ /mtho ris legs pa'i yon tan bdun/ /'phel zhing rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces brjod cing nas 'thor ro//sngon byung skye bo mkhas rnams kyis/ /skye rgu bdebar gnas bya'i phyir/ /cho ga 'di 'dra bkod mthong nas/ /ngas kyang de 'dra'i lad mo byas/ /gto bla mgo 'dzong bzhugs so cog /gto nag 'di yis thugs dam bskang / gto pod ba za mtsho nang nas/ /don zab nor bu rnyed kyang srid/ /'khrul dang nongs pa ci yod pa/ /de kun gto mkhan rgyal la bshasas/ /legs tshogs ji snyed mchis pa yis /'bro ba yongs la phan byed shog /ces pa'ang sprang spyon 'jigs med pas bris pa dge/ /༄/ /rten 'brel mdos kyi bca' thabs/rang sga mdun stegs bu'i khar ram/ cung zad 'phags pa'i steng snod gtsang gi nang sa blugs nas chag chag gdab la/ de'i steng khams sa'am bag zan gyi nang rin chen phye ma bsres la ri rab bang rim bzhi'i steng ri rab kha khyer la bla glud bzang po zhwa mo dang gzan sham can dang / nam mkha' kha dog lnga ba rgyang du shing ris mda' 'phang bcas/ ri rab kyi shar du gdan zlum po dbus che ba g.yas g.yon chung ba/ lho phyogs gdan sog kha dbus che ba sa/yas g.yon chung ba/ nub phyogs gdan zla gam yang gong lhar/ byang gru bzhi gong ltar byas pa'i gling bzhi gling phran bcu gnyis steng bla glud bzang po re re dang / shar nam mkha' dkar bo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / de bzhin du re re 47

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7pa — go/ /rnam par bskrad do/ /yongs su gzhig go/ /rig sngags kyi ral gris gcod do/ /phur dus gdab bo/ /mtshams chen po bcad do/ /rika sngab/sa bden ba 'i byin rlabs 'di/ /stobs ldan bdud kyi stobs 'joms pa'i/ /ral gri ngar ma phyung brdeg ste/ /ngo mtsharaXphan bde'i nyi ma'ang yin/ /byad bzlog dmigs bsal can lha bu yin na/bden tshig gi mjug tu/ oṃ trī badz+ra dz+wa la sarba karma sogs nas/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā'i bar lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa las rgyal bar byed pa'i bzungs gang mang bskyar/ mig sbyong ba la/ rten snying gi mthar mig rnam par sbyong ba'i rig sngags dz+rel zhing / tshul khrims kyi bden pa dang sogs bden stobs brjod pas 'thus/ de'i rigs pas las gang la'ang rigs 'gre sbyar ro/ /de yang mig 'byed la dper brjod na/ dus gnyan rnams su mig la bsgril ba'i zan gyi 'theb sgyu brgya rtsa brgyad phyogs su bsngo ba lta dus mtshon te/ nad sadon byad grib sogs gang la'ang skabs su ngo lon gyi glud mang du 'jal/ spyab chos su 'phags pa sa lu ljang ba dang / mdo sdud pa klog sgrog bya zhing rgya chen shugs ldan la brten pa'i drang srong mchod pa sogs bya'o/ /rten 'brel zab mo'i gnad ji lta bar shes nas gzung sngakas kyi sbyor ba 'di the tshom med pa'i yid kyis brtsams na rikas sngakas grub pa'i drang srong gi dmod pa rnams kyang zha nye pha lam gyi brag la babs pa ltar bya bar nus na gzhan lta ci smos te/ mdor na bram ze zhi 'dzin mchog gi rnam par thar ba'i yul gyi rjes su song ba yin no/ /nags tshal dril bu'i sgra can du/ /brjod pa ku hu'i mgrin ldan glu/ /dpal ldan pad+ma'i 'dab stegs su/ /slar yang nyung ngur rjes bzlas byas//zhes pa'ang sprang po 'jigs med bstan rgyal gyis spyar ba maṅgalo/ /ra / /glud bsngo thabs nyung la 'don bde ba bzhugs so/ /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /glud dang chang buXbargya rtsa bsngo na/ spyir glud kyi khungs ni/ skyes ༷rabs las/ ngang ba'i rgyal po'i srog glud du/ /bdag nyid mchid kyis 'tshal bar babyi/ /zhes glud kyi brda chad mdzad pa dang / sha lnga ma snyed na zan las byas pa'i gzugs brnyan gyis kyang rung bar rgya gar paṇa chen kyi gzhung nas 'byung ba ltaraXrigs pa mtshungs pa yin zhes mkhas pa 49

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum pa rnams/ /sred dang chags dang zhen pa dang / /dran dang bzung dang bsam dang reg /glod dang zhi dang grol bar mdzod/ /de 'dra ba lnga'am bdun so gas skabs dang bstun no/ /de la'ang sngags kyis rdzas rnams spel ba dang yi dwags kyi sde tshan sum cu rtsa gnyis sogs mgron rigs thams cad dab/'a bar byed/ mtshan ba'is go rim bzhin du gdon rnams kyi sgrib pa sbyang ba dang / gzubs bzang 'thob pa dang / zas kyis chog shes shing ngoms pa dang / 'jigs pa'i 'tsho ba thams cad nye bar zhi bar byed do/ /mjug tu/mchod sbyin 'dod yon gyi dga' ston rgya chen po 'di nyid bsngo zhing 'bul ba'i yul du gyur pa ni/ rnal 'byor ba bdag cab/ dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe dpal chos 'byor la bar du bcod cing / byur dang mi shis pa'i sna 'dren pa rmi lam rtags mtshan ngan pa/ glo bur bdud dang ye 'drog rkyen ngan dang 'chi rkyen rbab rgod ltar gtong ba'i srog bdud las kyi gshin rje rgyal bsen dam sre the'u rang / gdon rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ gtso bo'i gdon chen bco brgyad/ gdon phal ba bcu bzhi la sogs pa skye 'gro yongs la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bsam sbyor can/ bla la hab len byed pa/ srog la rgyug 'gyel gtong ba/ dbugs la rkan sgra rdeb pa/ gza' skar dang dus sbyor ngan pa/ dar rgud sper sme la dbang ba/ lo'i mtshams na gnas pa/ zla ba'i mal na sdod pa/ zhag gi lam 'phrang sgug pa/ dus tshod rtsis grangs la 'debs pa/ sha lan dang rus lan chags pa/ mkhon bu lon bzhin du 6 2

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7'ded pa/ tshe rabs kyi lan chags zho ltar stol ba/ rlung lhar 'tshubs pa/dpang rgya ltar gnas pa rnams kyi spyan sngar bla tshe srog dakhugs phywa mdangs me drod kyi glud du bsngo'o/ /gtong ngo/ /ster ro/ /sha'i rin du 'jal lo/ /khrag gi gta' mar bzhag go/ /bdag cag dpon slob mi phyugs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gshin rje'i gtad khram zug pa/bdud kyi za skal bab pa/ ma mo'i dal kha phebs pa/ rbe'u rang gi sho sna rdol ba/ sde brgyad kyi zor lam thod pa/ mi kha dang dgra sna ldang ba la sogs pa chags che ba dang nyam nga ba thams cad yongs su zhi zhing /sngon rabs kyi srid pa kun tu byas shing bsags pa'i sha mkhon rnams byang / lan chags thams cad 'khor te/ nad gdon byad grib mtha' dag las rnam par grol ba la brten nas/ gnas skabs su srog sga ka ba brtan zhing / bla'i sku mkhar sra ba/ rlung rta'i ba dan mtho ste/ phyogs thams cad las rdam par rgyal ba'i dpa' bor sa gsum na grags shing /mthar thug bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang rin po che dka' ba med par myur du 'grub par gyur cig smrang dang bcas bsngos nas/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya sogs dang / 'byung po gang dag sogs kyi chos sbyin dang smon lam bya/ yas rnams 'dre lnga bdud gcod lhar skyol/ de'i tshul ni g.yang sman srog lus dbal bdud 'dre gdon ste brgyad las/ phyi ma'i phyogs su mdos rdzong bar dge zhes bshad pas/ spar kha li thog na yod pa rnams kyi byang shar/ des mtshon khon la shar/ dwa la byang / khen la shar lho/ khams la 63

ngo da/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i bsung 'bum/ba —ba ba ma ba ba ba —ra ba —ba ba ba ba —— ba —4—ba ba ba ———— ——nub/ gen la lho/ zin la lho nubasnye zon la nub byang rnams su yod do/ /bsgrub bya'i gdon phyogs slob dpon gyi sros phyogs song ba lta bu yin na chu bo chen ngo 'i gzhung la bskyal/ bsur dud kyis sdun bsu/ gang ltar yang / sarba bhu ta gats+tsha/ yi yig 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i 'deg byed rlung bi dkyil 'khor/ bskal pa 'jib pa'i rlung nag ltar drag la rngams pa'i shusas kyis gtor snod rdzas dang bcas pa rnams ras bal gyi 'dab ma rlung la phyar ba bzhin du bskyo da de phyosas kyi rgya mtsho'i pha mthar dor bas bges/sa rigs 'byung po thams cad skad cig nyid la hab sgra di ri ri song bar bsam/ gā te nyer bcis yi mthar/ yum the/sa rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i bden pas/ nad gdon bgegs rigs chags che nyam nga / sri gesas byad phur la sogs pa 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad phyir bzlos par gyur cib 'a na bsum/ thal mo brdab/ gang mtshan lan gcig yid la dran pas kyang / /'chi med tshe dang ye shes mchog sprul ba/ /yon tan dpag med zhing gi mgon po mchog / sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brngod nas tshe bsnyen dang tshe gzungs bzla/ dge ba 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /'chi bdag la sogs bdud bzhi rnam bcom ste/ /skye rga na 'chi'i mtsho chen las brgal ba/ /mgon po tshe mtha' yas pa thob par shog /zhes pa bsngo smo na shis brjod bya'o//zhes pa'ang 'jigs med pas snga sor bris pa'i yi ge nyung ngu la phri snon cung zad byas te 'don bde bar bkod pa dge zhing bkra shis/ /sarba maṅga lo/ /ma / /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten snying gi mdos chog 'di'i khribs ni/ bca' shom la/61

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7྾྾ ྾sgyug paslar la za ba dang / grong pho gyigator ma len pa'i sprang rgan gdol ba rnams kyi kun spyod kho nar snang ngo / /mdos rma ba ni/ gsur dud dang gser skyems kyis sna drangs/ mdos chog pa rnams nas sher snying dang gra te ci mang gi mthar bdud bzlob gsum bdun nyer gcig sogs gdab/ chos gang sogs srung 'khor bsgom/ tshe gzungs dang rten snying sbrel la brgya rtsa sogs bzla zhing / dkyus nas bshad pa'i sku khrus kyi chu nyid bum par snal ba la byin rlabs brtan par bya bsgrub bya la tshe 'gugs gang mang gis tshe bkug ste/mjug tu tshe chu blud/ rgya cher na tshe mdo klob sgrogs dang tshe sgrub tshedabang sogs skabs 'dir bya/ 'di'i rgyab chos su/ dkon mchob mchod pa dang / ngan slong la sbyin 'gyed/ lam 'phrang bcos pa/ tshe mdo sobs gsung rabaklog 'don/ sdig pa bshags sbyangs rnam sa la nan tan brtson 'grus bskyed pas shin tu legs par 'gyur ro/ /mdos gzhung 'di ni/ nged rang nas de mo'i bu lnga zhis gso bskyangs byas skabs/ gnyis btsasanyin nas shi/ gcig btsas nas zhagadrug cu rtsa lnga na thi bas klad chung byis pa'i snang shes kyi snying rje sad de sud deb zhig gis sna drangasate bris pa las sri can gyi byaphrug lhag ma gnyis kyang dus min gyi 'chi ba las rnam par grol ba sogs rten 'brel gyi ltas bzang po 'ga' zhig byung ba yin pas skye bo mdzangs pa rnams kyis dang du blang byar ma zad/spyir yang rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di'i che ba'i yon tan rgyas par dbu ma rtsa ba thes rab/ rigs pa drus cu ba/ dbu ma la 'jug pa/ dbu ma rten snying / spyo da 'jub shes rab kyi le'u/ de dag gi 'grel ba 'grel bshad rnams dang / 'phags pa sa lu'i ljang ba'i mdo 'grel gnyis/ dbyig gnyen dang / shākya red kyi rten 'grel mdo 'grel sogs shing rta chen po'i gzhung lugs mtha' yas pa zhig rgyab chosaka sbyarate thos pa dang bsam pa'i shes rab khyadapar can gyis legs parakatan la phab pas rtogs pa nyid do/ /zhes pa'ang yon nu kun bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas skad cig gis bris pa dge zhing bkra shis/ /༄ /sa gar song du/ spyodapa gang 'ar+ṣas dgos zer te/ de bden/ lha 'dre drag po gnas pa'i sar zla re'am/ zla phyedarer sdod kyang de'i ring la sanas bdag dang bstun gang nus dgos te/ jo bo'i slob ma lha rje bsam gtan gyi lo rgyus po to bas gsungs pa lta bu yin/67

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7ma ba ma ba ma ba ma ba 4 ba —྾gzhan yang sems kyi rgyud sdig pas bsres cing / sdus bsngal sna tshogs kyis nyam thag pa dang / rang bzhin du gnas pa'i 'byung po gang su yang rung ste/ thams cad dkon mchog sasum gyi bden pa dang / chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis shin tu zhi zhing byams pa dang dul ba'i yid dang ldan par gyur te/ skad cig nyid la 'dir mchis par gyur cig sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes 'gug 'dren yid ches par byas la/ smrang 'donapa ni/ gsur mchod 'dod yon mi zad pa'i sprin phung / gdon rigs so so'i mos pa bzhin 'char bar sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin dang bden tshig gis byin gyis brlabs pa 'di nyid/ dze bu'i gling spyi dang / bye brag yul phyogs 'di'i la klung nyin srib/ lung ba phu mda'/ sa rdo chu shing / khang khyim phyi nang / rta bres phyugs lhas/ lam phran dang srang po che sogs na gnyug mar gnas pa dang / glo bur du lhags pa'i gdon bgesas/ lha dang klu dang yi dwags kyi 'gro bas bsdus pa/ bdag cag dang 'gras shing sha 'khon chags pa/ gnod pa'i bsam ngan 'chang zhing glags 'tshol ba/ bkra mi shis pa'i ltas ston cing / byur dang sdug bsngal gyi sna 'dren pa/ rang bzhin gyis 'tshe ba/'phral rkyen gyis bskul ba/ pho rgyud mo rgyud ma ning gi rigs su gtogs pa thams cad dang / khyad par du yang rdo stod rtsang chen gyi sa cha 'di nyid na gnas pa'i brag srin mor grags pa/ sna 'khrid sdong zla rgyab 6(

nga / ba rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'ang ma/ dpung dang bcas pa gtso bor byas te/ ji ltar mgron du bos pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs la gzhi'i longs spyod dang / byes kyi lam rgyags/'phral du bde ba'i 'tshog chas dang / yun du phan pa'i gsos sman dam par bsngo zhing 'bul lo/ /bdag cag la sha 'khon dang bu lon chags pa thams cad byang zhing 'apo ba dang / so so'i lus sems kyi sdug bsngal mtha' dag nye bar zhi ste/ nyams pa med pa'i bde ba'i dpal la rol bar gyur cig phyogs 'dir sa g.yo dang me dgra/ thog ser dang lo nyes sogs 'byung bzhi'i 'jigs pa ma btang / mi la na tsha dang grir thi// rta phyugs la bod kha dang stor brlag bya ba la blo nyes dang mgo skor/ yul du yams nad dang dbul phongs/ spyi sgos su ltas ngan dang chag sgo'i rigs ma btang / phyi dgra dang nang 'khrugs ma slong / mi kha dang kha smras ma g.yob/ lha mi'i bar du dbyen ma sbyor/ dpon slob nang du sel ma 'jug g.yos sbyor nang du dug ma 'debs/ tshogs su rkun bu ltar ma 'jab/ dben par jag pa ltar ma 'phyo/ rnal 'byor ba'i tshogs khang ma nyul/ bang mdzod kyi sris la ma rku/ sho rde ma 'grem/ za lam ma gtod/'dre tshang ma bca'/ gros ngan ma shoms/ mi mi yul na skyid pa/ lha 'dre rang yul na bde ba/ gzhi mgron bar du byams pa'i gser zam gyis sbrel ba/ yangs pa'i 'jig rten rgya mo'i dar gos ltar 'jam pa/ chos srid shing rta'i 'gro lam lha yul gyi lam srang ltar bde zhing bar chad 60

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7med par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ tshar grangs gsog na/ slar yang gsur mchod kha gsos te/ byin rlabs kyi sngags brjod nas/ khams gsum dag pa'i zhing / sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bsngo ba la grangs gzung / mthar/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /sogs dang / sdig pa ci yang mi bya sogs/ chos sbyin btang / 'byung po gang dag sogs kyis smon lam gdab/ gats+tsha gats+tsha/ mgron rnams so so'i gnas sa gshegs la chos smod par mdzod cig ces se gol brdab/ shis brjod kyi tshigs da — — — da 1 1 1bcad kyang brjod do/ /g.yu 'brug nam mkha' stong ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /ha ha'i gad rgyangs ri klung 'geng bar sgrog /bdag kyang thang stong rgyal po'i pho brang nas/ /kun rtog dgod pa'i ༷rang sgra 'di lhar phyung / ha ha/ nyi nyi// //ba / /na ma shākya myu na ye/ rten snying la brten nas glud gtor bsngo chog 'di nyid gsung rab kyi khungs la brten nas 'chad du yod med sogs spro rgyu mang yang gzhan btang snyoms su byas nas/ shom dang 'don 'grigs tsam gsal bar brjod na/ bla gab med pa'i gnas sogs gtsang zhing byi dor byas pa'i phyogasaXsu/ gzungs chog gi shom dkyus su gsal ba ltar dang /de'i 'og ci bder ba byung gis byug pa'i gzhi 'khyer bde bar rgyas pa byed na 'jim pa'am zan sogs las khang bzang lcags ris bskor ba bcos/ bsdu na tshon phye dang chu tshon gang rung gis re kha gru bzhi nyis rim phyi ma la rgya phibs kyi ri mo/ phyogs bzhi ga'am shar du sgo khang gi rnam pa dang bcas pa/ dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ rtsig pa sngo/ rgya phibs ser/ pad+ma dkar/ lte ba ljang /nang gi khyams dang sgo khang gi nang / phyi rol gyi gzhi rnams ljang gu/ mthar re kha dkar bo dang bcas pa bya/ pad+ma'i lte bar mardzi lta bu'i khar rin po che'i za maXtog dar dang me tog gis brgyan par rten snying gi sats+tsha bzhugs/ gtsang spra la dga' ba dang dme ba spyod pa'i gdon che phra rnams kyi don du nang gi phyogs bzhir kham phor bzhir/ sgrum khur dang / dkar gsum/ mngar gsum/ 'o thug /'ams chan/ sran chan/ zho/ 'bras yos sogs gtsang ma'i zas rnams lo ma lta 61

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7pa cang spros pa la dga' naXphyi'i ra ba'i khar/ bya rigs sna tshogs dang / 'dod yon lnga'i gzugs brnyan mang po/ de'i phyi rol du ljon shing gi phreng ba dar thag gis sprel ba/ bar bar du ri dwags kyi gzugs mang po bkod pa yang rung zhing / dbus kyi rtenaXsnying gi sats+tsha'i steng du dar gyi bla bre yang bre bar bya'o/ /ra / /'don 'grigs dngos laXgazungs chog 'don tshul dkyus gsal las ga'an med/sator chog gi skabs su dul zhing zhi ba'i sems la gnas pa shin tu gal che bas byams pa ci nus suXsgom/ gang yang 'byung po'i dkyil 'khor na/ sogs kyi tshe spos gsur gyi dud pa gtong zhes par/ spos la gu gul dang gla rtsi sogs med pa dgos te/ 'diXni gong du nyer spyod nang gi spos la'ang 'dra'o/ /nang du dkar gsur tsam gtong zhing / dmaraXgasur rigs phyi rol thag ring por gtong ba legs/ grud gtor kha gso byed pa dkyus su ma smos kyang / byed na shom gyi skabs glud dang chang du zas sna dar sna sogs slad nas bsnan rgyu zur du bzhaka la/ zhi zhing byams pa'i sems su mdzod/ ces pa'i 'phror rten snying lan gsum dang / de bzhin gshegs pa bla na med pa'i dge sbyong chen po'i bden pas mchod sbyin gyi yo byad 'di dag nam mkha' gang ba'i longs spyod mgron rigs so so'i dbang po'i spyod yul du ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig /ces byin rlabs byas nas sde tshan re re bzhin bso/ 'on kyang srin po dang sha za sogs kyi skabs ma gtogs spyi khyab tu sha chang sogs mi blugs/ byung dgu da da ba 'pho ba dang / zhes pa 'di nad spo gdon sgo zhes 'dul ba lung gi drang srong dung dang / bres pa'i sngon rabs thad kyi lung khungs dang 'grel ba'i gnad chen yin pas dmigs gnad nan tan bya/ bden stobs kyis gso ba'i mjug tu srung skud 'dogs na gzungs sgrubaXkyi dus nas sngags skud legs par bsngags la skabs der sbyin par bya ste 'dul ba lung las sngabs skud 63

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7dpung dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs kyis bdag cas 'khor dang cas pa la dngos dang brgyud nas gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i steng gdon gza'/ 'og gdon klu/ bar gdon rgyal bsen thel 'gong so so'i sna khrid sdong zla rgyab rten dang bcas pa lan chags grud kyi gtor ma len pa'i slad du spur ma rlung gis ded pa ltar skad cig nyid la 'dir mchis par gyur cig /sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ lan gsum sobs brjod/ de nas saṃ bha ra bdun dang / mtshan bzhi tshar gcig/se gol lan bsum brdab cing /nyi zla kha sbyor las gsungs pa'i/ khyer cig khyer cib stobs ldan rnams/ /sred dang chas/sa dang zhen pa dang / /dran dang gzung dang bsam dang reg /klod dang zhi dang grol bar mdzod/ /tshar sacig de 'dra ba lan grangs ci ribs kyis chang bu rnams bsngo/ de nas glud gzugs sogs la dmibs te/ bsang sbyang / stong ba'i ngang las ngar phye'i mi gzugs phung khams tshang ba/ bzhin mdzes la skye mched dwangs pa/ nga long gi phyag rgya can/ gos 'phyor rgyan bkrag shigs se ba/ lha 'dre'i mig sngar bu bzhin sdug pa/ 'dod yon longs spyod kyi dkor nor bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas par gyur/ nam mkha' mdzodaXsngabs gsum brjod/ 'dod yon lnga ldan glud gtor bzang po 'di/ /'byung ba sa chu me rlung brag dang shing / /nam mkha' la brten lha srin 'byung po'i tshogs/ /snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre'i tshogs la bsngo/ /sha khrag drod dadugs rtsa rgyus pags pa dang / /lus ngag yid gsum glud du 'di khyer 66

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7ba ngan pa bkra mi shis pa thams cad glud la 'pho bar gyur cig glud kyis khyer bar gyur cig /phyir ma ldog cig /gsum mamagacig gi mthar/ gtor glud rnams kha phyir bsgyur te btegs la/ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gang lhags pa'i/ /'byung po sa 'og rgyu ba dang / /gang yang sa steng 'khod pa dang / /sa blar rgyu ba gang yin pa/ /mgu bar gyis la rang gnas su/ /thams cad tha dad 'gro bar gyis/ /sarba bhu ta gats+tsha/ zhes 'dre lnga gnasapa'i sa phyogs rang gnas mi mthong bar bskyal/ sher snyingasogs srung ba 'don/ bsngo smon shis brjod bya'o/ /chang bu la glud kyi tha snyad sbyor ba mi 'thad snyam na/ glud kyi don ma go ba yin te/ mdo sde las brgya ba las glud blu rin gyi don du bshad cing / mi'i blu rin la mi gzugs cig dgos pa'i nges pa med pa'i phyir sogs spros/ hoho/ba / /rten 'brel snying bo la brten nas khram dbyi'i cho ba 'chi ba'i 'jibs sgrol bzhugs so/ /dpal shākya seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten 'grel snying po la brten nas khram dbyi'i cho ga sems can 'chi bas skrag parnams la phan gdags par 'dod pas/ dang po la sangs rgyas rjes su dran zhing dad pa chen po bskyed/ de nas/ 'di yod pas 'di 'byung / 'di skyes pa'i phyir 'di skye ste 'di ltar ma rib pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed/ 'du byed kyi rkyen gyis rnam shes/ rnam shes kyi rkyen gyis ming dang gzugs/ ming dang gzugs kyi rkyen gyis skye mched drug /skye mched drug gi rkyen gyis reg pa/ reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba tshor ba'i rkyen gyis sred pa/ sred pa'i rkyen gyis len pa/ len pa'i rkyen gyis srid pa/srid pa'i rkyen gyis skye ba/ skye ba'i rkyen gyis rga shi dang / mya ngan dang / smre 67

pod/ 7 no grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang 'khrugs pa rnams rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de ltar na sdug bsngal gyi phung po 'ba' zhig po 'di 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi mdo'i don yid la dran bzhin par/ 'di ltar las dang nyon mongs yod gyur na/ /sems can rnams ni 'khor bar 'gro 'gyur la/ /las dang nyon mongs med na 'khor ba las kyang ldog /bden pa de yis bdag gi bsam pa 'grub gyur cig /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun la phyag 'tsha la lo/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed bzhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgra bcom pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyir mi 'ong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyun du zhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo /'phags pa byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtul zhugs grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can gyi sman pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor bu grung pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas/ mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshigs su bcad pa lan bdun bklags/ de nas/ bdag gam bdag gi 'khor la ming 'di zhes bya ba la 'chi bdag gi mtshan ma btab pa dang / de las byung ba'i ltas dang /rmi lam sdig pa dang / nad dang / yams nad dang / nye bar 'tshe ba'i 68

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7rnam pa ci mchis pa thams cad/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bden pa'i zhags pas rang dbang med par drangs te/ ched du mngon par bsam pa'i rten 'brel gyi glegs bu 'di la ri mo'i gzugs su dbab bo/ /mtshan ma btab bo/ /zhes brjod cing pho'i donadu byed na pho'i ming can dang / mo'i don du byed na mo'i ming can gyi shing bu la dbyug gu bsnol ba lha gu'i ri mo'i mtshan ma bya/ de 'dra ba skyes du'i lo grangs song ba dang / 'di med pas 'di mi 'byung la/ 'di 'gaṭa pa'i phyir 'di 'gaṭa ste/ 'di ltar ma rig pa 'gag pas 'du byed 'gag /'du byed 'gaṭa pas rnam shes 'gag /rnam shes 'gaṭa pas ming dang gzugs 'gag /ming dang gzugs 'gaṭa pas skye mched drug 'gag /skye mched drug 'gaṭa pas reg pa 'gab /reg pa 'baṭa pas tshor ba ྅gag /tshor ba 'gaṭa pas sred pa 'gag /sred pa 'gaṭa pas len pa 'gag /len pa 'gaṭa pas srid pa 'gag /srid pa 'gaṭa pas skye ba 'gag /skye ba 'gaṭa pas rga shi dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang 'khrugs pa rnams rab tu 'gag par 'gyur te/ de ltar na sdug balngal gyi pūng po 'ba' zhig po 'di 'gag par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i bar du yid labyed cing / yang / 'di ltar las dang nyon mongs yod gyur na/ /sems can rnams ni 'khor bar 'gro 'gyur la/ /las dang nyon mongs med na 'khor ba las kyang ldog /bden pa de yis bdag gi bsam pa 'grub 69

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7de las bsdus pa byed na/ thog mar/ 'di ltar las dang sosas lan gsum dang /sangs rgyas la phyag 'azadal lo sogs lan gsum bton la/ rten snying nyer gcig bzla/de nas sngar bzhin bden stobs brjod bzhin par khram ris lo grangs dkyus gcigaXkho nar btab/ dbyi tshul yang des 'gres te shes par bya'o/ /'di la sngon du rten 'brel snying po srog ldan gyi sats+tsha lo grangs las mi nyung ba btab ste/ de'iXspyan sngar mchod pa ji ltar 'byoraXb dbul bar bya ba ni gal shin tu che'o/ /zhes pa'ang sprang rgan bstan nyisaXsngar rang nyid na tshod chung ngu'i dus rten snying khram mdos zer ba'i ban min bon min zhig rtsed mo'i tshul du bris pa 'khos chung 'ga' zhig de phyag len du 'debs pa'ang thos nas shin tu yid phyung ste/ de las 'di 'dra byas na cung zad dga' 'am snyam nas/ rgyal ba'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen la sbyar ba mchog tu dge bar gyur cig /maṅga lo/ /71

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ /rten snying gtor chogan mo shākya mu ni ye/ rten snying gi gzungs zlo ba'i cho ga'i ngag 'don mdor bsdus ni/ gang dag gis ni chos bstan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la sangs rgyas gus mdzad pa'i/ /dam chos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang 'a phul na don che ba'i/ /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la sogs pa/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su bdud rtsi'i rnga chen po brdung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom lda na 'das rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa rta thul la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi rgyal ngo 'i gsung las skyes pa'i sras nyan thos kyi dge 'dun rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal tshab byams pa dang / spyan ras sazigs dbang phyug dang / phyag na rdo rje 'a sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen ngo yon tan rin po che dpag du med pas brgyan pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs pa dang /sred med kyi bu dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / dri za'i rgyal po gtsug phud lnga pa la sogs pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa la mngon par dga' ba'i lha rdzu 'phrul chen po rnams la 7 2

྾ rtenasnyingaskor/ ྾ 4/ phyag 'tshal lo/ /de rnams la phyag 'tshal nas 'phags pa chos kyi dbyings kyi snying bo byang chub sems dpa'i zhu ba lung bstan pa lha dang mi rnams kyis mchod rten gyi za ma tog tu bkur ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di brjod par bgyi ste/ sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i slad du bdag gis kazungs sngags kyitshig 'di 'grub par gyur cib/ swā hā/ tar+ya thā oṃ ye dharmā sogs gzungs bzla/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba chos kyi dbyings kyi snying bo 'di ni ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas sgo sna tshogs nas byin gyis brlabs shing dpal gyi mgul nas/ 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chos kyi sku ste sus 'di mthong ba des/ de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ngo / /zhes bsngas/sa pa gsangs pa yin te bdud rtsi'i mdo sde de lta ba brjod pa'i byin rlabs ༄ ༄kyis bdag cag rnams kyis tshe rabs brgya stong mang bo nas bsasas pa'i las kyi sgrib pa ci dang ci mchis pa thams cad yongs su byang ba dang zad pa'i mthar thug par gyur cig /phyi phyir tshe yang rnam par 'phel bar gyur cig /nad thams cad dang / rims thams cad dang /gdon thams cad dang / gdug pa'i rigs sngags thams cad dang /ltas ngan pa thams cad dang /sdug bsngal thams cad dang / gzhan yang 'jigs pa'i phyogs gang ci yang rung ba de dag thams cad nye bar zhi zhing phyis kyang mi 'byung bar gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar 73

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ ྾྾྾4r+yā4྾྾du/ dbang po gsal zhing rnam par dag pa dang / 'khor dang yo byad mthun pa dang / snying rje chen po dang / shes rab kyi rtsal thogs pa med pa la sogs pa 'jig rten dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpal thams cad rtas/ tu nye bar gnas par gyur cig /thams cad ma.o pa'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi 'di nyid la brten nas sems can phongs thing sdug bsngal ba mang po skyob pa'i slad du bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs rnam pa sna tshobs kyang bde blag kho nar yang dag par 'byor bar gyur cig /de dag gi tshe sngon bcom ldan 'das las chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos pa'i lha rnams kyang dgos pa mtha' dag grub pa'i sbad du brtson par gyur cig/ces pa'ang chos 'di la lhab par mos pa'iXsprang rgan bsta na pa'i nyi mas so//༄/ /bla ma rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten 'asbol snying bo la brten nas rnyed sla'i gtor ma bsngo ba'i cho ga ji lhar bgyi ba'i tsho la gnyis/ rdzas 'du bya ba dang / bsngo chog dngos/ dang po la/ rdzas bshams pa dang / byin gyis brlabs pa gnyis/dang po snod gtsang mar zan ril me tog la sogs pa'i rdzas dang sbyar ba dang / chu dang dri dang me tog phreng ba dang / mon sran la sogs pa'i sa bon dang / mar dang sprang rtsi la du sogs gdon rigs spyi la mthun par gsung ba rnams ji lhar rnyed pabashams1 gnyis pa/ ye dharmā—dge sbyong chen po'i bden mthu dang / /mdo sde dkon mchog byin rlabs kyis/ /gnas 'dir mchod sbyin don slad du/ /bshams pa'i gtor ma 'di dag rnams/ /nyes skyon thams cad yongs byang nas/ /mgron rnams 'dod pa ltar 'char zhing / /sdug bsngal mtha' dab sel byed pa'i/ /7‘1

rten snying skor/ pod/ 74 ྾longs spyod nam mkha' gang bar shog /lan gsum/ gnyis pa la/ mgron 'gugs pa/mchod sbyin dngos/ bden stobs kyis rang gzhan gso ba/ rjes la lam bstan pa ste bzhi/ dang po ni/ ye rnyarmā— dge sbyong chen po'i bden mthu dang / /mdo sde dkon mchog byin rlabs kyis/ /sa 'og rnams dang sa steng dang / /de bzhin sa bla'i 'jib rten du/ /gzhan gnod bgyid cing rgyu ba yi/ /lha dang klu dang lha min dang / /dri za grul bum gsang ba pa/ /'dab bzang mi'am ci dang ni/ /lto 'phye che dang smyo brjed dang //mtshun dang tshangs pa'i srin po dang / /grib gnon gnon po'i gdon rnams dang / /sha za zhes bya'i gdon la sogs/ /dgos su bdag cag la gnod pa'i/ /'byung po gang dang su mchis pa/ /thams cad gtor ma len slad du/ /mngon par dga' nas 'du gyur cig /lan gsum/ gnyis pa la/ gtam gyis mar+ṣas sbyar bdang / mchod sbyin dngosal 'jug pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bdag sga bde ba la ltos pas/ /'byung po thams cad srog la sdug /'gro nga zas kyis gnas pa'i phyir/ /gdon yang de la sems pa ste/ /nye 'khon med pa'i byams pa yis/ /bdag 'dir sbyin la yang dag 'jug /de phyir rab tu dga' ba yi/ /sems su gyis la legs par 'khod/ gnyis pa la/ zangazing dang / chos kyi sbyin pa gnyis las/ dang po la rnams grangs nyer gnyis kyi/ dang po/ 'byung bo mang po'i dkyil 'khor na/ /gang dag lha las gyur ba'i gdon/ /chen po'am chung ngu su 'khod pa/ /deng 'dir bdag gam yon sbyor gyi/ /rdzas las dngos su bstabs pa yi/76

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigasamed bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gtor ma kha dog dam pa dang / dri dang ro bda' phun sum tshogs/ /bzang po'i btung ba rnams su bcas/ /sbyangs shing bsgyur nas rab spel te/ /mchod kyis ci bder longs sa spyod/ /dbe/ sbyong chen po'i ༄bden mthu dang / /mdo sde dkon mchog byin rlabs kyis/ /lha rnams bgo skal dman mchog gi/ /rnam dbye med par tshim pa dang / /rtag tu srog chags thams cad la/ /bde ba 'ba' zhig byed gyur cig /ye dharmā—sanyis pa/ 'byung po mang po'i— gang dag klu las— chen po'am chung du—deng 'dir bdag gam rdzas las dngos su gtor ma kha dog— dri dang ro bda' bzang po'i btung ba sbyangs shing— mchod kyis ci bder— dge sbyong chen po'i— mdo sde dkon— klu rnams skal ba dman mchog gi/ rnam dbye med par— rtag tu srog chags— bde ba 'ba' zhig— ye dharmā— gsumapa/ 'byung po mang po'i— gang dag lha min las gyur gdon/ /chen po'am chung— deng 'dir bdag gam rdzas las dngos— gtor ma kha dog— dri dang ro bda'— bzang po'i btung— sbyangs shing mchod kyis ci— dge sbyong chen— mdo sde dkonatshe lha min bko skal dman mchog gi/ /rnam dbye med par— rtag tu srog chas/sa— bde ba 'ba'aḥ ye dharmā bzhibar/ 'byung po mang po'itshe gang dag rlung lha las gyur gdon/ /chen po'am chung— deng 'diratsho rdzas las dngos— gtor ma kha— dri dang ro bda'— bzang po'i btung —76

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7ma yabaskal ba dman mchog gi/ /rnam dbye med par tshim pa dang / /rtag tu srog chags thams cad la/ /bde ba 'ba' zhig byed gyur cib/ /ye rnyarmātsho nyer gnyis par/ 'byung bo mang po'i dkyil 'khor na/ /ba/nga dag mdangs dang mngal la za/ /srog 'phrog gtor ma za ba dang / /sha za ba dang khrag 'thung dang/ /zhab dang tshil bu za rnams dang / de bzhin rkang dang btsas pa za/ /dri dang me tog 'bras bu dang / /lo tog sbyin sreg za ba dang / /rnag dang phyi sa'i zas can dang / /sacin dang mchil ma ngar snabs za/ /snabs dang lhag ma za ba dang / /sgyugs pa rnams dang mi gtsang za/ /stor khung nas 'bab 'thung ba'i gdon/ /chen po'am chung ngu su 'khod pa/ /der 'dir bdag gam yon sbyor gyi/ /rdzas las dngos su bstabs pa yi/ /gtor ma kha dog dam pa dang / /dri dang ro bda' phun sum tshogs/ /bzang po'i btung ba rnams su bcas/ /sbyangs shing bsgyur nas rab spel te/ /mchod kyis ci bder longs su spyod/ /dge sbyong chen po'i bden mthu dang/ /mdo sde dkon mchoka byin brlabs kyis/ /gdon noms bko skal dman mchog gi/ /rnam dbye med par tshim pa dang / /rtag tu srog chags thams cad la/ /bde ba 'ba' zhig byed gyur cig /ye rnyarmā/ gnyisapa ni/ chos gang rgyus byung de dag gi/ /rgyud dang de 'bog gang yin pa'ang / /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' basprul te/ /de skad gsung ba dge sbyong che/ /sdig pa ci yang sogs/ spro na gtor chog rgyas pa'i chos 81

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7ma bzang pos dul ba'i sems/ /phan tshun rtsod pa ma mchis shing / /kun tu gzhan gnod med par song / /su dag zhi ba'i yid can dang / /phan par 'dod pas gnas pa ni/ /ci bde bar ni spyod cing 'khod/ /de kun don yang 'grub par shog /'byung po gang dag gdam na yang / /byams pa'i drin la mi sems shing / /bden pa'i tshig la mi brtsi na/ /de dag mdo sde'i zhags pas brlag /gang dag mchod sbyin gyi cho gas legs par brngan zhing riṭa pa'i tshig gis bgo yang mi 'gro zhing slar la mi phan par sems pa de das legs par gsung pa'i kazi brjid kyis nyams nas rab tu pham par gyur cig /ye rnyarmā bzla/ shis brjod kyi mdo sde klog pa sogs kyang bya'o/ /rten 'brel snying bo la brten nas rnyed sla'i gtor ma bsdo ba'i cho ba rtsi sman ljon pa zhes bya ba 'di'ang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas gtor chog rgyas pa nas bsdus te bris pa dge b.ragyur cika/ //83

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa ma / /rten 'azel snying po la brten nas glud gtor bsngo ba'i cho ga byams chen sprun gyi za sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo mdzi shrī ye/ zab mo chos kyi dbyings gsungs pa'i/ /rgyal ba de la phyag 'tshal nas/ /rnam dag mdo sde'i rjes 'jug pa'i/ /yid 'ong gtor ma'i cho ga bri/ /'dir rten 'grel snying bo laXbarten nas glud gtor gtong ba'i cho ga ji ltar bgyi ba'i tshul la gnyis/ sbyor ba yo byad kyi shom dang / cho ga dngos kyi rim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ byamasaXpa'i sems dang satsang spra'i kun spyod la gnas nas/ dben pa'i phyogs su ba byung gis byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal mda' gang ba la sogs pa ji ltar 'tshams pa byas la tshon bye las khang bzang gi rnam pa bri/ de'i dbus su gzhung nasaX'abyung ba'i gtor ma rnams gos dang sadugs la sogs pas brgyan te bkod/ mtha' bskor me toka la sogs pa'i nyer spyod bshams/ rgyas par byed na bsgrub bya'i glud gzugs gtso 'khor khang khyim rta phyugs zhing mtha' 'khor dang bcas pa'i gzugs brnyan dang / ma grub na ji lhar rigasaXpa shar nas brtsams te bsgrigs1 phyiXrol du mu khyud kyi rwa ba bya/ gong du mchodaXpa'i maṇ+ḍal la rten snying nang gzungs su bzhugs pa'i mchod rten/ mchod pa'i yo byad/ khrus bumaXrnams bsham mo/ /gnyis pa la/ gtor chog gi sngon du bya ba/ dngos gzhi gtor chog /de'i rjes la bya ba'i rim pa dang gsum/ dang poXni/ gzungs bzla ba'i choXb la brten nas mthu bsam byis mi khyab pa'i tshigs su bcad pa lan mang du bklag /mchod pa'i zhing rnams gshesas grub nas 'di la 'jug go/ /gnyis pa la'ang / glud gtor byin gyis rlob pa/ mgron 'gug pa/brngan sbyin gyis 'khon pa sbya nga ba/ bden stobs kyis gdon dang nad pa saso ba/ lam bstan nas phyi mtshams bcad pa dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ ye rnyarmā te tu bra bha wā te turnye ṣān+ta thā ga to t+ya ba data/ te ṣāñca yo ni ro rnya e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ chos 84

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7nga dbyings shin tu rnam dag pa/ /thugs su chud nas 'di gsungs dang / /gang gis ye shes mig sbyangs pa'i/ /tshad med bsod nams phung po de'i//bden pas dkyil 'khor khang ba dang / /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di dag dang / /me tog la sogs yo byad rnams/ /mi mthun rdzas dang spyod lam gyis/ /sbags pa'i nyes skyon yongs dag nas/ /mgron rnams dbang po'i spyod yul du/ /ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin 'byung zhing / /sbug bsngal thams cad sel byed pa'i/ /longs spyod nam mkha' gang bar shog /lan kasum brjod/ gnyis pa la/ mgron 'bod dngos dang / bag phab nas 'khod du gzhug pa ste kanyis kyi/dang po ni sngar bzhin/ ye rnyarmāsogs/ thugs rje chen pos chos 'di yi/ /bsdu bas tshogs rnams drangs mdzad pa/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /bsdu ba rnams kyi mchog yin pa'i/ /bden pa'i tshig ni de yi mthus/ /gang dag gzhan gnod bgyid pa yi/ /'byung bo sa 'os rgyu ba dang / /sa steng ri dang nags tshal dang / /kun dga' ra dang skyed mos tshal/ /rgyal po'i pho brang grong khyer dang / /tshong khang rnams dang rta yi bres/ /gnag lhas sho gam gnas rnams dang / /'brog dang khang stong sogs gnas dang / /de bzhin sa blar rgyu ba yi/ /lha klu lha ma yin pa dang / /dri za grul bum gsang ba pa/ /'dab bzang mi'am ci dang ni/ /lto 'phye che dang sbyo brjed dang / /mtshun dang tshangs pa'i prin po dang / /grib gnon gnon po'i gdon rnams dang / /sha za zhes bya'i gdon la sobs/ /'jig rten 85

por/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsunga'abum/ba ba ba 4ma ba —ma ma ma ba ba ba ba ma ba ba 4ba —ba ba —ma 4 ba ba ba skyong ba nom bzhi dang / /chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje yi/ /sde dang ris su gtos/sa dgu cog /sgos su bdag dang sbyin bdag gi/ /lus srog 'byor ba la sdang ba'i/ /'byung bo che phra ci mchis pa/ /phyogs 'dir sbyin pa'i mgron la 'dus/ /gang das mchod sbyin 'di yi sgra/ /g.yeng bas ma tshor srid na yang / /phan tshun gcig la sacig sbran nas/ /ma tshang med par 'du stsar cig /lanasasum/ gnyis pa ni/ bdag gi bde ba la ltos pas/ /'byung po thams cad srog la sdug /'gro ba zas kyis gnas pa'i phyir/ /sadon yang de la sems pa ste/ /nye 'khon med pa'i byams pa yis1/ /bdas 'dir sbyin la yang dag 'jug /de phyir rab hu dba' ba yi/ /sems su gyis la legs par 'khod/ /gsu ma pa la zangazing gi sbyin pa dang / chos kyi sbyin pa bya ba kanyis/ dang po la'ang/ bsngo tshig this rgya cher bkrol ba dang / so sor tshims pa'i bden stobs brjod pa gnyis/ dang ngo ni/ spos gsur gyi dud pa gtong bzhin pa sa/ gang yang 'byung bo'i dkyil 'khor na/ /rang rang las kyi rdzu 'phrul can/ /lus che bzhin yang rnam par 'gyur/ /yan las mang la khrag gis babo/sa/ /sna tshogs mdog 'chang gnod sbyin dang / /bya dang gcan gzan rnam pa sogs/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs ni sna tshogs can/ /mi rnams 'brog dang bas mtha' dang / /dur khrod rnams dang khang stong sogs/ /gcig pur gnas sam rgyu ba na/ /mdun du lus mngon snang bar byed/ /de nas mi snang lam 'dug dang / /shas cher mtshan mo sgra sgrogs shing / /bu ga dag 86

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7ra nas se gol gtogs/ /nyal ba rnams la phyis gnon byed/ /sdug pa'i dud med gzugs kyis ni/ /lhan cig 'dod la bsten par bgyid/ /rmi lam sdig pa mang po dang / /gzhan yang bkra mi shis pa ston/ /'jigs dang sdig las spyod pa dang / /sngon gyi las yongs smin pa dang / /mchod par 'os rnams spangs pa dang / /gtsang sbra tshul bzhin mi byed sogs/ /sros chags rnams kyi kun spyod la/ /glags skabs rnam pa sna tshogs 'tshol/ /rigs sngags drag shul can dag gis/ /dpag tshad stong nas rab tu 'dren/ /de dag ba spu'i sgo sogs nas/ /'jug bzod phra ba'i lus can te/ /gsod 'dod gtor ma 'dod pa dang / /kha cig rtsed mo'i phyir du yang / /glakas dang bcas pa'i mi rnams kyi/ /lus la 'jug cing kun tu spyod/ /de dag lus la bab pa na//khro dang dkod dang glu la dga'//rtag par mang du smra byed cing //ngu zhing phyogs su 'phyan par bgyid/ /lha dang lha min gnod sbyin sogs/ /de dang de yi spyod pa ston/ /nyin bzhi rtag pa'i rims la sogs/ /rims dang nad rigs mang po gtong / /skyes pa bud med byis rnams dang / /phyugs dang rta rnams la yang 'tshe /nad dngaXnd kyi mtshan ma yang / /phyin ci log tu snang bar 'gyid/ /dmag dang 'thab mo rtsod pa 'byin/ /me dang chu yi 'jigs pa dang / /sa g.yo skar mda' ltung ba dang / /gza' skar 'jigs pa sna tshosas ston/ / grong dang yul 'khor khang khyim 'jig /dug dang bcas pa'i rlung gtong 87
