rten snying skor/ pod/ 7ring zhing mdog mi sbug /ba spu ring la gzing ba'i nang / /sbrang bu sha sbrang mchu rnon sogs/ /zhugs nas khab ltar 'bigs shing za/ /lus kun 'bar ba'i phreng bas dkrigs/ /lhag par bkres shing smre sngags 'don/ /skom pas nyen nas phyogs bcur rgyug /chu med ri brag 'brog rnams su/ /ngu skad 'don cing rkang lag rdol/ /de das skyabs yod ma yin zhing / /dpung gnyen gyur pa 'ga' yang med/ /brgya lam zhig na tshegs chen pos/ /rnyed kyang tshims par mi 'thob cing / /cung zad de yang mod la skyubs/ /drod dus tsha ba brgya 'gyur dang / /grang tshe lha gas pa brgya 'gyur du//brnag dka'i tshor ba skyed par byed/ /de dag chu la 'thung na yang / /gshin rje'i skyes bu mig dmar zhing / /mchu dang lto ba rab 'phyang la/ /ha ha'i sgra sgrogs mtshon cha thogs/ /cha byad bsgyur ba 'chang rnams kyis/ /spyo zhing shin tu rdeg par byed / /de bzhin klu rnams kha cig ni/ /mkha' lding khro bo'i 'jigs pa dang / /me dang rig sngags bye tshan sobs/ /'jigs pa mang pos kun tu khebs/ /de sobs 'byung po thams cad la//lhan cig skyes dang glo bur gyi/ /'jigs dang sdug bsngal ci ngadog pa/ /thams cad thams cad nyer zhi nas/ /rtag tu bde ba 'thob bya'i phyir/ /tshogs chas sman dgu basbus nas 'bul/ /lus dang skye ba sna tshogs ltar//bsam pa'i khyad par sna tshogs pas/ /so so'i bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /mthun pa'i rdzas rnams ci bder bzhes/ /de yang bdag dang yon sbyor 89

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba 4ba ba ba ma ma ba ྾4 ྾—ba—ba ྾4ba —ba —ba —gyi/ /nor las dngos su bshams pa dang / /bden pa'i stobs dang mos pa'i mthus/ /sbyangs shing bsgyur nas spel ba yi/ /khrus dang dril phyis spyad pa dang / /me tog phreng ba sna tshogs dang / /byugs pa dri zhim mang po dang / /a ka ru sogs bdug pa'i spos/ /bza' ba snum khur sasar ba dang / /mar dang bu ram laXsosas su/ /bcas dang ma bcas 'bras chan dang / /de bzhin sran ma nud ga dang / /mon sran las bgyis tshod ma dang / /nas chan mar dang me tog bcud/ /bu ram shing gi bca' ba dang //shing tog rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /la phug lan tshwa til gyi phye/ /til gyi tshig ma'i zas dag dang / /rjen dang badzus pa'i sha rnams dang / /'o thug zho dang mngar ba'i khu/ /khrag dang chang dang chu'i btung ba/ 1la sogs thun mong mthun rdzas dang / /so sor sgos su 'tshams pa yi/ /gtor ma bzang la mang ba rnams/ /gser sogs bzhu dang mi bzhu ba'i/ /rin po che yi bye brag dang / /de dag rgyan du bgyis pa dang / /gos kyi khyad par du ma dang / /bdugs sogs gang la gang mthun du/ /sbyar nas ji ltar 'byor ba dang / /ci ltar nus bzhin yang dag 'bul/ /bdas gam sbyin pa'i bdag po yi/ /gnas sam lus dang longs spyod la/ /lhag par zhen zhing mi gtong na/ /dngos las bzo bkod bzang ba yi/ /khang khyim yul 'khor bcas pa dang / /ba/zugs byad mi las lhag pa yi/ /glud bzugs rgyan dang ldan pa dang / /rta phyugs dbyig la sogs pa rnams/ /ji lta ba 90

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7spyi sgos sogs/ ye rnyarmā sogs/ bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthus/ /yi dwags pho dang mo dag dang / /yi dwags bu pho bu mo dang / /yi dwags rgas po rgas mo dang / /yi dwags mngag gzhug pho mo rnams/ /spyi sgos sogs/ ye rnyarmā sogs/ bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthus/ /sha za pho dang sha za mo/ /sha za'i bu pho bu mo dang / /sha za rgas po rgas mo dang / /sha za'i g.yog 'khor pho mo rnams/ /spyi sgos sogs/ ye rnyarmā sogs/ bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthus//'byung po pho dang mo dag dang / /'byung po'i bu pho bu mo dang / /'byung po rgas po rgas mo dang //'byung po'i g.yog 'khor pho mo rnams/ /spyi sgos sogs/ ye rnya rmā sogs/ bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthus/ grul bum pho dang mo dag dang / /grul bum bu pho bu mo dang / /grul bum rgas po rgas mo dang / /grul dum mngag gzhug pho mo rnams/ /spyi sgos sogs/ ye dha rmā sogs/ bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthus/ /srul po pho dang mo dag dang / /srul po'i bu pho khu mo dang / /srul po rgas po rgas mo dang / /srul po'i g.yog 'khor pho mo dang / /spyi sgos sogs/ ye rnyarmā sogs/bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthus/ /lus srul pho dang mo dag dang / /lus srul bu pho bu mo dang / /93

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7r+yā྾ ྾ ྾dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthus/ /mdangs 'phrog pa dang mngal la za//srog 'phrog gtor ma za ba dang / /sha za ba dang khrag 'thung dang //zhag dang tshil bu za rnams dang //de bzhin rkang dang btsas pa za//dri dang me tog 'bras du dang / /lo tog sbyin bsreg za ba dang / /rnag dang phyi sa'i zas can dang / /gcin dang mchil ma ngar snabs za/ /snabs dang lhab/ ma za ba dang / /sgyugs pa rnams dang mi gtsang za/ /stor khung nas 'bab 'thung ba rnams/ /spyi sgos mthun pa'i rdzas 'di dag /bzhes nas tshims shing rangs par shob /bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la/ /bsam dang sbyor ba log pa'i dug / /byung dgu glud la 'pho ba dang / /slad kyang 'byung ba med par mdzod/ /gnyis pa ni/ yernyarmā sogs/chos gang rgyus byung de dag dang / /rgyu dang de 'bog gang yin pa'ang / /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' batsho te/ /de skad ba/sungs pa dge sbyong che/ /'jib rten bde sdug mi mnyam pa/ /'di kun rgyu med ngo bo dang / /dus dang rang bzhin las skyes min/ /sna tshogs las kyi bzo bos byas/ /sa bon rtsub mo btab pa las/ /'bras bu rtsub mo rnam par smin/ /de bzhin sa bon dge ba las/ /rgyu dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu 'byung / /rmongs pa sdig la dga' ba noms/ /sdug bsngal nyid dus sdug bsngal rgyu//phan tshun 'khor lo bskor ba bzhin/ /rgyun mi 'chad du rjes su 'jug /o kyang bsod nams ma yin pa'i/ /sngon byas las kyis 'dir skyes te//96

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ ma nga ba ma da dung gzhan la gnod bgyid na/ /shi 'phos 'gro ba ji ltar 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi 'tsho ba phrogs nas su/ /bdag nyid 'tsho ba lhur len rnams/ /zas kyi dgos pa tsam gyi ched/ /ngan 'gro'i gnas su yun ring brlag/ /ji ltar bdag la srog phangs pa/ /de ltar kun la srog phangs pas/ /rnam kun gzhan la mi 'tshe ba'i/ /tshul khrims mang du goms par mdzod/ /spro na/yan lag bye brag bcu gnyis gang / /thub pas rten 'byung bsungs de dag sogs/ dbu ma rten 'grel snying bo'i gzhung bklag /sdib pa ci yang mi bya sogs/bstan pa yin/ bzhi ba la/ dkon mchog bsum gyi bden stobs dang/ gdon rnams kyi bdag po'i bden stobs brjod pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ ye rnyarmā sogs/ de phyir rkang gnyis 'jig rten na/ /sangs rgyas mchog yin bden pa'i tshig /de bstan kho nar chos kyi mchog /'dod chags bral yod bden pa'i tshig /chos de mngon sum bgyis pa rnams/ /tshogs kyi mchog yin bden pa'i tshig /dkon mchog bden mthu bsache/ mi khyab/ /mdo sde'i nus pa bsam mi khyab/ /bden las mthu stobs che ba gzhan/ /'jig rten kun na ma mchis te/ /bden pas me dang chu gter dang / /sprin yang 'dod pa bzhin du byed/ /'jig rten dka' thub grub rnams kyi/ /dmod pa'i mtshon yang mi bzad na/ /bla med ye shes brnyes rnams kyi/ /gsung gi nus pa smos ci 'tshal/ /de ltar bden pa 'di dag dang / /bden pa'i tshig ni de dag gis/ /rlung dang mkhris pa las gyur dang / /bad kan 96

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7'dus las gyur ba yi/ /nad rnams thams cad zad pa dang / /zhi zhing rab tu zhi bar shog /mthong dang reg dang kha rlangs dang / /dmod pa rig sngags las gyur sogs/ /dug rnams thams cad nges par bcom/ /gdon kun byams dang ldan par shog /chu dang me dang gnam lcags dang / /bshes bral rnams dang dadul phongs dang / /g.yul dang rgyal po'i chad pa dang / /sdig pa'i mtshan ma sna tshogs sogs/ /mi dang mi min las byung ba'i/ /'jigs pa'i rang bzhin ji snyed pa/ /lesas gsang mdo ༄sde'i gzi brjid kyis/ /bcom nas ldog tu med par shog /bdag dang gzhan gyi bzi byin dang / /stobs dang g.yang la brkus pa rnams/ /mdo sde'i nus pas slar phrogs nas/ /zhi dang bde legs 'gyur bar shog /sadon rnams rang rang las rjes su/ /'brel ba'i sdug bsngal ci mchis kyang / /mdo sde'i bdud rtsi 'di nyid kyis//nye bar zhi nas bde gyur cig /yul 'khor 'di dang grong 'di dang / /nad pa 'di zhes bya la sogs/ /ji ltar dmigs bzhin bsrung ba dang / /bskyab dang gzung ba 'grub gyur cig /ces brjod de gzungs chab dang / ston pa'i sku gzugs la khrus gsol ba'i khrus chab kyis baspub bya bkru zhing / 'byung po'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su'ang 'thor/ de 'dra ba lan ci nus bskyar/ gnyis pa ni/ ye rnyarmā sogs mthar/ rgyal ba nyid las mngon sum du/ /mdo 'di sngon chad thos pa yi/ /tshangs dang legs ldan sred med bu/ /dbang phyug che dang rdo rje 'chang / /dri za gtsug phud lnga pa sogs/ /mthu 97

pod/ 7 rdo gruba'ajigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma ma nyams nas rab tu pham par gyur cig /ye rnyarmā te tu pra bha wā te tudhe ṣān+ta thā ga to t+ya ba data/ te ṣāñca yo ni ro rnya e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥsogs ci rigs bzla/ glud gtor rnams srang mdo dang chu klung la sogs pa 'byung po 'duba'i phyogs su skyel bar bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gser la sogs pas bris pa'i rten 'brel snying bo'i glegs bam rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te spos rol dang ba dan la sogs pa mchod sprin chen po dang bcas pas grong khyer ram khyim mam yul 'khor gang bsrung bar 'dodaXpa de skoraXzhing / de dang de'i dbus su mchod ston rgya cher bshams pa'i dkyil du btsugs la dge 'dun rnams mdun du 'khod de yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa nas gsungs pa sogs bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa bklag /rgyal mtshan bkur ste chen poXdang bcas pas rang gnas su spyan drangs par bya'o/ /de ltar ma grub na'ang shis brjod kyi mdo sde klog pa sogs bya'o/ /'gro mang sdug bsngal las skyob phyir/ /gso chog bzang bo 'di sbyar bas/ /sems can thams cad byang chub kyi/ /bde ba mi zad la reg shog /rten 'brel snying bo la brten nas glud gtor bsdo ba'i cho ga byams chen sprin gyi rnga sgra zhes bya ba 'di'ang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas ༷rang nyid bgrang bya nyer drug tu son pa lcags stag rgyal gyi nya ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa phyi ma la legs par grub paraXbagyis pa'iXdage bas sems can thams cad bde legs kyi dpal la longs spyod par gyur cig /sarba dā maṅga lo/ /100

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7ba ༄ / /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba chos kyi dbyings kyi snying po'i gzungs bzla ba'i cho ga sprun chen rnam par rol ba'i ja sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /bla ma dang thub dbang shākya seṅge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /cho ga 'di'i thog mtha' bar gsum kunaXtu bsam pa hon mongs pa dang ma 'dres shing / sbyor ba gtsang spra dang ldan pa'i sgo nas dus bzang bo chu stod zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bzhi lha bur/ gnas khang bye dor bya zhing chag chag gdab/ spos kyi maṇ+ḍal chen po'i dbus su tshon nam bye ma'am me tog gis gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi 'gram loṭa med pa'i sgo khyud can rtsig pa'i steng naXgre phul gyis btegs pa'i rgya phes bzang bos mdzes pa/ phyi rol skyed mos tshal tha gru yangs pa la khrus rdzing dang / nags tshal/ me tog brdal ba sogs bkod pa mang bos spras pa/ pha gu sgo khang bzhi bas mtha' brtsigs pa/ pho brang gi dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pas mtshan pa zhig bri/ pad+ma'i lte bar gzungs bum bzang po drug dang tsan+dan dang ka bur la sogs pa dri bzang gi chab kyis gtams par 'bras bu can gyi shing gi kha rgyan btsug pa bkod/ de'i steng du malha'i khar rin po che'i yol go'i nang du skabs 'dir rten snying slos bzhin par btab pa'i sats+tsha gzungs ldan lnga la sogs pa gser gyis byugs te bzhag /'dab ma rnams su'ang re re/ de'i mdun ngos su gzungs bum 'jog /gang ltar yang phyogs bzhir bum pa gang ba bzhi dang / gra bzhir poka phor bzhi 'god/ gzhan yang mchod yon dang me tog sogs mchod pa bzang la mang bas mtha' bskor/ steng du 'phan gdugs bla re sogs kyis brgyan par bya'o/ /bar 'dir rgyal ba'i yum drug po gang rung dang / zla ba sgron me dang / rten 'grel gyi mdo la sogs pa gsung rab khyad ༷par can mang bo klog cing gzhan la yang klog tu 'jug /de nas chos thams cad rang bzhin 101

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7zung bzhi dang / /tshogs na spyod dang bse ru lta bu yi/ /'phags pa rang rgyal rnams la sku khrus ba/sol/ /zhes shā lo ka phyi ma bzhi bo'i mtshams su khrus chab bzed zhal du phul/ de dag skru la— sku phyi'o/ /zhes me long la ras kyis phyi/ de nas de la kha dog— rgyan mchog brgya phrag dag kyang dbul bar bgyi/ /zhes na bza' phul/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i sogs/ bzhugs su gsol/ /stong gsum kun dang mnyam pa yi/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad ge sar bcas/ /bde zhing yangs pa 'bul lags na/ /ci bde bar ni bzhugs su gsol//'es bzhugs gsol gdan bstab bgyis mthar/ rang gi stan las langs te phyag byed bzhin pas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang rkang bar ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba/ kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas shākya thub pa sras dang slob mar bcas pa'i zhabs kyi pad+ma rnyog pa dang bral ba la yan lag mchog gis btud de phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan bdun bskyar/ 'phags pa'i tshogs de dag bi spyan sngar dngos su bshams pa dang / gzungs dang / rig pa dang / mos pa'i stobs las byung ba'i/me tog dang / bdug spos dang / mar me dang / byugs pa dang / phreng ba dang / phye ma dang / chos gos dang / sadugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / bla re dang / sil snyan dang rdza rnga/ dung dang rnga bo che la sogs 106

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7dgongs te phyi ma'i mu mthar sku tshe'i 'du byed rnams byin gyis brlab tu kasol/ deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa kadan 'dzoms pa'i spyan sngar phyag mchod phul zhing bsod nams kyi phung po gsum mngon par 'du bgyis pa sogs la brten nas/ bdag gi skye ba nas skye ba/ tshe rabs kyi phreng ba kun tu snying rje chen po yongs su mi nyams pa dang / byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i mgon gyis rjes su bzung ba dang mi 'bral ba dang / zab pa dang rgya che ba'i lam gyi rgyun mi gcod cing / byang chub sems dpa'i rdzogs smin sbyang ba'i spyod pa thams cad ring por mi thogs par yongs su rdzogs te/de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang lus mnyam pa dang / ngag mnyam pa dang / ye shes mnyam pa dang / phrin las mnyam par gyur cig /spro na mchod pa man chad kyi yan lag phyi ma drug po'i tshig ris kyang lan gsum rer bskyar/ de nas thugs dam bskul zhing smon lam gdab pa ni/ deng 'dir bdag cag gis rgya' ba sras dang bcas pa gdan 'dzoms pa chen por gyur ba'i spyan sngar/ che ge mo la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po'i mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du gsol zhing mchi na/ 'phags pa'i byin rlabs dang thugs rje tshad med pa mnga' ba rnams kyis/ de de bzhin du 'grub par byin gyis brlab par ci gnang / bdag cag rnams la sngon gyi sdig pa'i las sna tshogs kyi rnam par smin pa yang rung / 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur kyang rung ste/ da ltar gyi 109

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i byin gyis rlabs dang / gzungs rnams kyi mthu stobs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbang du mdzad de/ ji ltar smon pa'i don thams cad 'phral du 'thob par byin gyis rlob par ci gnang / zhes snyim pa'i me tog gis mchodaXcing lan bsum bzla/ de ltar 'phags pa sku gsung thugs kyi spyod pa ma dag pa mi mnga' ba rnams kyi bden pa dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis/ deng bdag cag gis legs par bshams shing brgyan ba'i gnas 'dir/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba chos kyi dbyings kyi snying bo'i tshigs su bcad pa'i gzungs dang chos kyi sku'i mchod rten 'di dag byin gyis rlob par mdzad de/ bdag sogs 'gro ba mang po'i don dpag tu med pa mdzad par gyur cig chos kyi sku'i mchod rten la gzungs sngags kyi rgyal mo'i yig 'bru gser gyi phreng ba bzhin du gnas pa dang / 'phabs pa rnams kyi sku las 'od 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab/ des 'phags pa thams cad sems can gyi don la bskul zhing ngan song gi gnas thams cad byi ngas te sems can thams cad mtho ris dang thar ba'i go 'phang la 'jug par gyur cig /'od zer des bdag cag rnams la khyab pas 'gro don dpag med sgrub nus pa'i mthu thob ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang sku gsung thugs mtshungs par gyur cig /yang 'od zer de dag gcig tu 'dus 13

pod/ 7 rdo grubaX'ajigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/kun la khyab cing sems can dbyings mtha' ji srid bar/ /rnam par gnas nas chos kyi rgyal bo rgyal ba rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra las rnam rgyal bas/ /kun nas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor kun tu rnam par mchod pa'i mchod pa kun gyis mnyes gyur cig /me tog dam pa sogs nas/ phyir bsngo'o/ /bsdu na maṇ+ḍal phul ba kho nas kyang rung / ji ltar yang mthar/ deng 'dir bdag cag gis rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa gdan 'dzom par spyan drangs nas/ phyag mchod phul zhing sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can las gleng te gsol ba btab pa la sogs pa'i mthus/ bdag cag la sogasaXpa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub kyi snying bo'i mthar thug gi bar du phyi dang nang gi 'jigs pa dang sdug bsngal mtha' dag zhi zhing bde skyid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi phyag gser gyi kha dog can spyi bor 'jog cing / dran pa ma nyams pa'i rgyud kyis bde bar shi 'phos te sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar pad+ma'i snying bo las rdzus te skye zhing gdams ngab thob nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /phan bde'i rtsa lag bde bar gshegs pa'i dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas shing yi ger 'bri ba dang /mchod pa dang / klog pa dang / sbyin pa la sogs pa'i sgo sna tshogs nas 'jig rten thams cad du dar zhing rgyas pa dang / de 'dzin gyi skyes bu 116
nga smo྾sa du

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ ༄/ /bstan pa'i byung ba cung zad brjod pa bzhugs so/slob dpon rin po ches rje 'bangs rnams kyi brjed byang du man ngag lta phreng mdzad par grags shing / de dus sa rgyan gnyis dang mdo btus/ phar phyin bsdus pa bslab btus/ spyod 'jug rin phreng sosas bstan rim mang bo dang / phal chen sogs shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod du ma la bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa'i kha byang da lta yang glegs bam la 'byar bzhin pa dang / de dag dang mthun pa'i brjed byang sosas bstan bcos kyang mdzad pa mang la/ dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang / de'i legs bshad dbu ma rgyan la brten nas bstan pa'i sgrom bzung bar bsal lo/ /phyis hā shang gis yid la mi byed pa bstan pa na yang bai ro la sob/sa pa'i sngon gyi rje 'bangs chen po rnams kyis than mthong ba ltar mdzad de/ kā ma la spyan drangs nas bstan pa dag rber mdzad du bcus pa'i skabs su/ jo bos bod du bstan pa la byi dor bya ba'i slad du lam sgron mdzad pa'i dod ni sgom rim gsum dang rnam par mi rtos pa'i gzungs 'grel sogs yin pas/ lta phreng gi thun mong lam rim yang de dag gi 'gros su bshad par bya'o/ /sna nam ye shes sde'i lhag mthong gi 120

bstan pa'i byung ba cung zad brjod pa/ pod/ 7—྾4 — ྾ 4྾྾ gsar rnying yang don mi gcig ste/ snga ma ni 'dul ba'i bstan pa la ltos nas 'jog cing phyi ma gsang sbags la ltos te 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag gang yang glang dar mas bstan pa la rked nyag ches chen po btod pa'i dbang gis so sor bye ba byung ngo / /rgyud sde so so'i man ngag rnams phan tshun sre mi rung yang / snga 'gyur dang phyi 'gyur byas pa tsam gyis tsha grang ltar 'dzin dgos par go ba mang bas chos rgyus zhib pa gal che'o/ /'phags yul gyi paṇa grub bod du byon pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos la yang / rgya gar du bzhugs dus dang / bod du brtsams pa gnyis dang / phyi ma la'ang / dang po legs sbyar du brtsams nas gdod bsgyur ba dang / dang po nas bod skad du brtsams pa gnyis yod de/ phyi ma 'di gnyis rtsom gyi rus tshugs ches mi 'dra bar snang ngo / /lhag par skad gsar bcad kyis phogs ma phogs gnyis la gser dngul mdog 'don byas ma byas kyi khyad tsam gda' 'o/ /mchan/ /glang dar mas rgyal bstan bsnub pa'i dbang gis da lha sgyu 'phrul sogs sngon dus bsgyur ba'i rgyud sde rnams kyi man ngag gtsang ma bka' brgyud bar ma chad pa las 'ong ba ci la yod snyam na/de skabs kyang khyim pa gos dkar gyi rten la bsang sngags sgrub pa'i mkhas grub dag ni nang gi de nyid rgyal blon gyis ma rtogs shing / rab byung gi rtags med pas gnod pa ma byung ba ches mang ste/ 'gos lo chen pos/ de ltar 'dul ba'i bstan pa la 'phel 'grib byung mod kyi theg pa 123

pod/ 7྾྾ ྾ ྾྾ ༄/ /brjed tho sna tshogs bzhugs so/ /byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma yin pas/ 'di'i sgo nas rang nyid skal ba mchog ldan du byin gyis brlabs shing / sngar lha dang mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs g.yel zhud du song ba sogs kyang legs par gsos te/ de nas yi dam du bsgyur nas sgrub na bar chad med ceng dngos grub shin tu myur la/ de nas mkha' 'gro'i sgrub pas bogs dbyung bar byed pas/rtsa gsum sgrub thabs kyi gzhung bkod pa'i rim pa'ang legs par gnas so/ /des na dang por bla ma'i sgrub lugs nyid la brtson par bya ste/ras la dang por 'byar rtsi brgyab ste/ gdod tshon chur bcug na ji ltar 'dod par tshon 'dzin du btub pas kha dog bzang po 'byung ba bzhin no/ /de'ang gsang rdzogs las/ sgrub sde chen po brgyad kyi lha'i 'khor lo dngos su mthong mi nus pa'i gdul bya'i don du/ dkyil 'khor kyi bdag po he ru ka brgyad po nyid rig pa 'dzin pa'i gtso bo'i tshul du snang zhes 'byung ste/ bka' so so ba'i rig 'dzin pad+ma gsung gi nā ga dzu na sogs brgyad dang bka' brgyad spyi dril gyi rig 'dzin pad+ma ka ra'i zhabs nyid du bshad do/ /de ni gzhan las/ longs sku dang mchog sprul dngos dang mi mjal ba rnams la/ sangs rgyas rnams slob dpon gyi 131

pod/ 7 do grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ ྾྾lus la zhugs nas rjes su 'dzin par gsungs pas/ slob dpon la rtobs pa mtho dman gyi rim pa mang du yod pa las/ ches mthon po 'ga' zhig gi khyad par ro/ /des na sku'i rnam pa 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku pad+ma gar dbang dang he ru ka sogs kyi rnam par mthong ba'i nus pa ma rnyed pa'i gdul bya mang bor dngos su zhal bstan nas/sasang sngags bla med kho na'i lam nas 'khrid pa'i rdo rje slob dpon mdzad pa'i phyir/ gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med kyis rang nyid kyi sgu lus de ltar ched du byin gyis brlabs pa yin pas/ yi dam gzhan las 'grub thag nye ba ste/ byin rlabs dngos grub khyad par myur 'dod na:rtsa gsum kun 'dus pad+ma nga nyid sgom: 'es ye shes snying bor ro ji skad bshad pa'i gnad kyis skru'i rnam 'gyur 'di'i 'khrungs rabs thams cad kyang rnal 'byor bla med pa'i kun spyod nyag cig gi steng nas song yod pas/ gar mkhan rnga mkhan gyad dang rol mo mkhan/ zhes sogs lta bu'i bzo skye'i sprul skru sazhan dang yang mi mnyam ste/ sprul snyu mchog dman ni rgyud tshod las min gyi/ mdzad spyod kyis phye ba'i phyir ro//bla med kyi sngags pa'i nang nas kyang / satso bor pad+ma'i rigs kyi spub pa po dang / grub chen gyi gzugs su bstan pa'i sku yin te/ bltams dus nas mtshan mkhan rnams kyis de ltar mtshan bsgrags pa dang / mkha' 'gro kun dga' mo la dbang bzhes pa dang / ma ra ti ka dang / o rgyan 1 3 2

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7rang byung gi phug tu sgrub pa mdzad pa'i lo rgyus dang / gter phyogs kun na chos sku 'od mdzad/ longs sku spyan ras gzigs/ sprul sku pad+ma zhes gsungs pa dang / sha dug thugs rje chen por/ gu ru nyid ribs thams cad las pad+ma'i rigs su sgrub na sngon smon gyi dbang bi/sa lhag par myur bar gsungs pa sogs mtha' yas pas shes pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i sku de nyid gling bzhi ba'i 'jig rten 'di nyid kyi rnga yab gling na da lta'ang dngos su bzhugs pa dang / bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang dang / sprub ga/nas/ sku tshab/sku dang phyag zhabs kyi rjes/ tshes bcu'i dus/ gter ston/gter gnas sogs nas/ tha na bod kyi lha 'dre chen po rnams gu ru rin po che rjes dran gyi sgor song 'dus/ pa'i bar du rjes dran gyi mtshan ma bzhag pa dang / rgyud 'bum bsgyur zhus/ jo bo rje/ mi tra/ snying bo'i zhabs sogs sprul ba'i mdzad pa/ bka' nas bkar brgyud pa/ gter brgyud/dab/ snang gi brgyud pa'i rgyun bsam gyis mi langs pa btsugs te/dbang lung man ngag gi lam srol brgyud mar phye ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas bod kyi yul 'di lhag par phyag mtshan du bzhes pa la legs par bsam na/ bod kyi bla ma'i skal ba gu ru nyid: ces pa'i bka' la nges pa ster ro/ /bka' brgyad kyi sgrub chen dus zhag rer byin 'bebs lan drug re dkos par gsungs pa'i byin 'bebs rig 'dzin brgyad dam dgu'i 'bebs chog la byed pa yang ma la ya'i nags kyi dri bsung gi kha 133

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 74—྾4྾ ྾'bru gsum gyi sgrom du bcug par 'gro'o/ /sgyu 'phrul gyi 'bru sasum go bko'i skabs su/ thams cad ma lus sku gsung thugs/ /sku gsung thugs kyis kun la khyab/ /ces dang / gsang rdzogs ma hā sgom khog tu/ oṃ snang ba sku yi dkyil 'khor du/ āḥsgra grag gsung gi/ hūṃ dran rtog thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du dag pa'i rgya rtags su sgom par bshad pa la shin tu 'grigs pa yin no/ /ko cha dang srung 'khor gyi ting nge 'dzin 'di rnams spyir dus thams cad dang / khyad par du thun mtshams dang / de las kyang srod dus sogs la sgom/ gnas gsum gyi go cha 'dis lus nad mtshon dug gsum sogs las skyob pa dang / ngag byad du chud pa sogs las srung ba dang / bzlas brjod kyi nus pa skyed pa dang / smra ba gsal ba dang / tshig btsan par byed pa dang / ngag gis rang gzhan la phan thobs pa dang / kun gyi yid du 'ong zhing mthun pa'i ngag 'thon pa dang /yid rmongs pa dang / smyo 'thib/ brjed ngas/ phyin ci los gi rtog ngan sosas las srung ba dang / ting nge 'dzin brtan pa dang / sbobs pa'i stobs sam gzi brjid mi chom pa skyed pa sogs mtha' med pa 'phrul rung ngo / /de'ang yi ge de dang de'i 'od zer gyis lus thams cad bkang bas tha mal gyi snang zhen lab rjes dang bcas pa myun khung du nyi zer zhugs pa ltar dab par dmigs par bya'o/ /bzhin lag rnam can gyi go cha'i lha med kyang / go cha'i lha med mi dgos te/ 'bru gsum de rdo 139

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7las tshos/sa ngo mtshar ba gsungs shing / de nyid bsdus pa dang / rdo rje snying bo rgyan las pad+ma'i rigs kyi dngos grub rab 'byams thams cad pad+ma la brten nas sgrub tshul rab 'byams bstan to/ /de la pad dkar gyi de nyid slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i rnam snang mngon byang gi 'grel ba ltar bkral na/ 'grel ba der/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sadan pad dkar 'chad pa na/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshobs yongs su dag pa'i mtshon byed du bshad kyang / gtso che ba'i dbang du btang na/rnam snang gi gdan gyi skabs pad dkar bsod nams kyi tshogs su gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bsod nams kyi tshogs su bshad pa 'di bdan kho na'i min pa ni/ yo gar/ ji ltar pad+ma dmar bo 'di/ /zhes sogs dang bshad tshul mi 'dra ba'i dogs spong mdzad pa dang / rta mgrin gyi rgyan gyi pad+ma la yang de ltar ba/sungs pas shes so/ /sadan gyi thad du/ sa bcu dang phyin drug gi grangs tshad kyis sor bcu drug par bya bar bshad pa sosas slob lam skabs dang sbyar mod/ de kho na min par de'i rgyu mthun las byung ba sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bsod nams la yang bya ste/ spyan ras gzigs 'di longs sku yin par rgyud de'i bsdus don du/ phyab/ na pad+mo'i lus 'dra ba/ /zhes sogs rgyud tshig sgas bsgrubs shing dkyil 'khor rim pa nang ma la 'god pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis shes la/ pad+ma dang no rje sogs thukas mi zad pa bkod pa'i rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor du bsdus 141

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7 ba ma ba ba ma ba ba ba btsang ma kho nar skye ste/ 'grel ba der pad dkar bsod nams kyi tshogs tsam la ma sbyar bar bsod nams kyi tshosas yongs su dag pa dang sbyar ba'ang de ltar yin te/ yongs su dag pa ma smos na dkar po'i don ma tshang ngo / /yo ga las pad+ma dmar bor bshad pa dang 'gal spong skabs/shes rab kyis chos thams cad shin du dag par rtogs pa'i mtshon byed du dkar bor bstan ces pa tsam las mi gsal yang / 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang sngags ni/ las kyi bye brag dag las dkar/ zhes pa'i 'grel bar/ sor rtog ye shes kyi rang bzhin yin pas spyan ras gzigs kyi lha sngags sogs dkar bor bshad de/ rgyud 'dir pad gdan sogs dkar bo gang byung du rnam par dag pa'i mtshon byed ces bshad kyang / sor rtog ye shes la sbyar ba ni lha 'di'i sgos chos te/ de'i kong du'ang / spyan ras gzigs sor rtob ye shes kyi ngo bo nyid dang /ston pa rnam snang nyid chos dbyings ye shes/ phyag rdor bya grub ye shes sogs su bshad pas so/ /pad+ma chu dang 'grogs pas ches yid du 'ong ba'i lang tsho rgyas par 'gyur gyi chu'i nyes pas cung zad kyang mi gos pa ni de'i ma 'dres pa ste/ de bzhin du theb mchog bsod nams kyi tshogs rnams 'khor ba'i rnyoka pa thams cad kyi nang du spyod kyang de dag gis bag tsam yang mi gos shing / slar la kun tu bzang po'i gzi mdangs 'bar bar 'gyur ba no thabs mkhas kyi che ba ste/ ches ya mtshan pa'o/ /1 13

brjed tho sna tshobs/ pob/ 74 ྾྾྾tsu mtshan thugs kyi gsang ba'i mtshan mar bshad pas/ thugs ye shes chos sku'i phyogs kyi yon tan dang sbyor ba 'thad do/ /'dir 'o na rnam sna nga yang pad+ma'i rigs yin nam zhes pa'i dogs pa'ang bcad par bya'o// /pad+ma'i mdzes sdug gis skye dgu'i dga' ba skyed pa'i de nyid ni dngos zin de das tu mi gsal yang / de nyid snang chen las/ rab dga' de nyid don ni mdzes pa'i de kho na nyid de/ rang bzhin gyis dab pa'i don la de skad ces bya'o/ /rdo rje pad+mo zhes bya ba ni bcom ldan 'das kyi pad+mo'i phyag rgya la bya'o/ /rab dasa' byed ces bya ba ni/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i chos nyid kyi ye shes kyis sems can rnams shin tu sbyong bar 'di sems dbang du gyur pa mthar son pa'i so ra rtog gis rang rgyud la shin sbyang gi dga' bde phul byung 'dren pa'i don du bshad dgos/ mchan/ mdzad pas na rab dga' byed do/ /zhes bshad pas dpag na/ dab cing dge ba ni 'dir mdzes pa'i don dang / de 'dra ba'i dpal gyis 'gro ba thams cad kyi yid du 'ong zhing / sems kyi rnyob pa dang bar byed la/ zang zing med pa'i dga' ba dpe las 'das pas rgyud tshim par byed pa zhes bshad du rung ngam snyam/ gzhan yang rnam snang mngon byang las/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad dang / de'i sras blo ldan rnams kyi gdan/ pad+ma yid las byung ba'i mchog /bkra shis 'jig rten rnams kyis bsngas/sa/ zhes bkra shis pa dang / kun gyis balngags pa'i yon tan gsungs shing phyag / du

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pob/ 7ma skyong ba'i rigs kyi phyag mtshan kyi bshad par/ snying rje chen po'i rlan de nyid bsod nams kyi tshogs dag pa'i pad+ma dkar bo dang 'brel na sems can thams cad dga' bar byed nus zhes bshad pa la nges pa thob bo/ /yo ba/ las rnam par snang mdzad pad+ma'i de nyid kyi rnam par thugs rtse gcig tu mdzad pa las 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi gzugs 'dzin par gyur bar dang / de slob lam du pad+ma'i de nyid bsgoms pa las 'khrungs pa'i phyir pad+ma skyes zhes brjod par gsungs pa ltar gtso bor pad+ma'i de nyid las grub pas na pad+ma'i rigs sam skye gnas par 'jog pa ni 'dra'am snyam/ de'ang pad+ma'i rang ldog gi de nyid las mang du bsgom na/ de dang rjes su mthun pa'i 'jig rten gsum dbang du 'gyur ba sogs shas cher 'thob cing / dkar ba'i de nyid kyi steng nas bsgo ma pa gtso bor byas na dran pa dang shes rab 'phel ba dang / tshe rabs thams cad du 'khor ba'i rtog pa dang mi 'dre ba la sogs pa shas cher 'thob bo/ /srong btsan gyis mdzad pa'i bstod par/ phyag g.yon pad+ma dkar bo bsnams/ /'gro drug gnas su don mdzad kyang / /'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos rtags/ /rje ye sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa'ang 'di dag gi don bsnyu lta bur snang / yo sa/ra sangs rgyas rnams kyis pad+ma phyin nas rdo rje spyan nam spyan ras gzigs zhes ming rdo rje'i cod pan btags te dbang bskur bar 117

brjed tho sna tshorgas/ pod/ 7pa'i don te/ srin dug shor ma la sren sman mi thebs pa'am mi zug par dar zhud 'jen pa lhar song ba la sman 'dred pa dang dred par 'jog chog pa lta bur mngon/ de la rkyen gang gis g.yel zhud du gyur ba yin yang gtor tshogs dang bskang bshags kyis gso bar chos dbang gi srid pa'i sa/ter khyim las bshad de/ don du bdag gnas yo byad la 'byar rtsi rgyags pa gal che zhing / 'byar rtsi yang tshogs sasogs yin pa dang / de 'byar rtsir 'gro ba ras gzhi'i dri ma sbyong ba lta ba'i sdis sbyang ༄la ltos par dgongs pa ste/ byur dang mi shis pa sbyong ba'i cho ga gzhan rnams kyang gal che ba 'dra'o/ /sgom bzlas kyis dngos grub mthong chos la 'grub pa ni dag pa'i snang zhen 'grus pa dang rgyun mi 'chad par boms pa'i mthu yin par bsam gtan phyi ma'i 'grel bar gsungs shing / gzhan du gtsub shing ngal gso zhing gtsub pas me mi 'byung ba'i dpes gsungs pa dang / gzhan du g.yengs bas sems kyis ni/ /bskal bar bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byin/ /zhes gsungs te/ dkyus gcig la byas pa min pa'i bsnyen pas bsnyen pa'i go mi chod pa dang / g.yeng bzhin bzlas pa'ang de dang 'dra ba dang / thun mtshams su'ang dran 'dzin chen po bsten nas spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor las mi 'da' ba byed dgos pa kun de'i gnad kyis yin no/ /bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi chings lnga las/ chos lo legs pa'i snye ma 153

nga nga nga/ nga rdo grub 'jigs med bang tram̐ng nga 1 nga /྾—nga 4 4—mthong ba'am du chung me tog gi tshal du sleb pa ltar gang byas na drag gam gang nyams su blang na drag gam snyam nas 'dam res kyi ngang du mi tshe bud pa ma tshor ba 'byung srid pas: de ltar ma yin par rang nyams dang bstun par chos gang dad pa zhig gi phu thag bcad de spang len thang slod re dogs gnyis 'dzin med par rtse gcig tu nyams su blang :de ltar bskyed rdzogs la sogs bang yin gcig la brtan pa thob phan chad chos thams cad kyi dgongs pa lon nas gcig shes kun la mkhas par 'gyur ro:zhes dang /pad+ma'i gsang sngags lam rim gyi rang 'grel las kyang 'di kho na bzhin nan tan du gdams so/ /'di ni skyabs rje gter chen bla ma rnam pa gnyis kas yang dang yang du gdams par mdzad cing / sngon gyi mkhas grub chen po rnams kyi spyi lusas gal bo cher snang ngo / /rang gi yi dam gyi lha dang gdams ngag la gnyis 'dzin mi bya bar rnam pa thams cad kyis thams cad du blo hril gyis gtod pa ni srog lhar gces so//sems nyid ngal bso rtsa ba'i jin las sa/ de bzhin gshegs pa nga nga thams cad kyi: snying po yi ge brgya ba yang : thun mtshams rnams su nye bar bzla: sgrib dag nus pa mchog tu 'gyur: zhes gsungs shing /gzhan du mar yang yig brgyas chad lhag gi nyes pa zhi ba dang / byin rlabs brtan par byed par gsungs pas thun mtshams su bzla ba 164

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma zhing rnying ba la lhod pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na gter chos gsar ba rnams la mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ngad pa ma yal ba'i chos zhes gcigs cher 'dzin te/ chos dbang gter byon mkha' ri'i zhus lan du'ang / bod 'dir thugs gter lnga dang / gter chen brgya rtsa/ gter phran bye ba sbas par gsungs nas/ de tsam du mang ba sbed pa'i rgyu mtshan bod kyi rgyal khams gsar ngas che ba'i phyir ro zhes bshad/ snyigs ma'i gdul bya brtson 'grus dang shes rab dman pa rnams la slob dpon rin po che nyid bka' drin zla med par byed do/ /gter dpe las chos bsgyur dus rtog pa gzhan gyis gtan nas bar ma chod pa dgos te/ de chod na des phar bcos phog pa'i nyams kyi 'char cha dang / bla ma mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs kyis tshur gtad pa'i snang ba gang yin 'byed mi nus par song nas tshig don la bslad skyon zhugs 'gro bas/ gter chos de la lhad zhugs ma zhugs gter ston rang bis kyang nges dka' ba lta bur yod ces gsung rgyun du 'byung ste/ chos rgyal rin chen gling ba'i gter chos sogs la'ang lhad can yod par mkha' 'gro yang tig las gsungs pa de 'dra la dgongs kyi rdzun lab zer ba min no/ /'di la ni nang ting nge 'dzin shin tu brtan pa dang / phyi bla ma mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs smin tshabs che ba dgos te/ bter ston brgyud pa'i gsang tshig gcig go/ /des na gter gsar gyi nang nas kyang bde ba chen po'i rnal 156

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7'byor las rung mthar son pa rlabs po che'i gter ston gyi chos la gtso bor bya dgos so/ /gter gsar dus kyi lo tog brje ba ltar brgyud mar 'byung ba'i sgo nas gu ru bka' drin che bar byed pa'i tshul da dung bshad na/ ring brgyud rnams snod min la 'phel bas bka' 'chal ba dang / dam sel gyis bar bcad pa dang / gzu lum rang bzo'i lhad skyon zhugs pa dang / brgyud pa la 'dre sogs bar chad 'jug pa'i srol dod pa dang / bar skabs su brgyud 'dzin brtson 'grus chung bas legs par ma bsgrub pa'i nyes pas bsgrub 'bras thob pa ma byung nas yun ring song ba la sogs rgyu mtshan mang po zhig gis dngos grub shin tu 'grub par dka' ba'i dus na gter brgyud gsar ba la brten nas gsang sngags sgrub sla bar mdzad cing / de'ang mi thog re gnyis la de 'dra byung ba tsam min par ma 'ongs phyi ma phyi ma'i dus mtha'i bar du tshul des gsang sngags kyi bstan pa gso ba'i phrin las rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba la bsams na dus ngan snyigs las cher snyigs 'di lta bur mtha' 'khob kyi yul du skyes pa'i sngags kyi gdul bya rnams la ma ltar brtse ba'i mgon po 'di dang mnyam pa sa zhig rnyed de/ ngam shod rdor ༄sems kha byang las/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: gdong dmar bod kyi rgyal khams su: mdo sngags chos kyi sgron me sbar: nyon mongs dug lnga'i nun pa bsal: ma 'ongs skye bo byol nyog pas: gzu lum ras 167

pod/ 7 rdogrub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ shes pa rnams kyang mthun rkyen no/ /bstan pa nyid gsal bar mdzad tshul ni/ zhi 'tsho dang / bla chen po/ dpal ldan a ti sha rnams kyang gu ru 'di nyid yin par bka' gdams glegs bam du 'byung la/ der/ sprul ba gcig ni mdo khams smad du 'gro/ zhes pa rje btsun tsong kha bar grags te/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen chos rgyan sobs kyis kyang bshad do/ /des na de dag gis bstan pa spyir bskyangs pa'i mdzad pa rnams kyang 'di'i mdzad par nges shing / sku'i rnam 'gyur 'di'i dbang du na/ lam rim du/ pad+ma saṃ bha bas bstan pa'i srol btsugs/ zhes te/jo bo'i rnam thar na/ slob dpon pad+mas mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas rdzu 'phrul gyis blang bar mngon/ zhes dang / de dus kyi bstan pa 'dra ba rgya gar na'ang dka'/ zhes pa ltar sngags rgyud khyad par can mang po spyan drangs shing / bsgyur zhus mdzad/sgyu 'phrul dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/bka' brgyad la sogs pa'i chos 'khor bskor te rgyud sde rab 'byams la mkhas pa dang / dngos grub brnyes pa'i skyes mchog bai ro dang nam snyeng rma lo sogs bgrang bar dka' ba'i bstan 'dzin bskrun cing bstan pa'i rgyun bzhag /gter brgyud kyis sngags bstan brgyud mar gso ba'i zhal bzhes bstsal ba ltar bden 'bras mngon sum du bstan/de srid du gu ru nyid kyi gdul bya'i 'phro skyong zhing phrin las kyi rgyun gso ba'i chos kyi rgyal tshab re'ang rgyun mi 'chad du 'byung ba yin no/ /de'i 160

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7phyir sa paṇa gyis/ brtul zhugs grub pa pad+ma saṃ bha ba/ /snyigs ma'i dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de la dgongs nas dpal ldan zhi 'tshos/ pad+ma saṃ bha ba zhes bya ba 'dzam bu'i gling na che ba'i rigs sngags mkhan zhig yod/ de spyan drangs na chos rgyal nyid dang smon lam gcig pas don 'grub par 'gyur zhes khri srong la lung bstan no/ /lar gu ru zhi ba byang chub ster ba dang / drag po bar chad 'dul ba la bsngags/dang po 'di la gter phyogs su za hor ma shas che bas/ de'i rgyu mtshan bshad na/ bka' gdams glegs bam las bla ma dri ma med pa rgya gan du grub thob lnga bcur grags tshul gyi thad na/ thams cad kyang nyan thos kyi cha byad kho nar ston no/ /zhes pa ltar/ chos bos gsol ba ni dkyus ma'i cha byad yin te/ snga nas rab byung gi chas su bzhugs pas so/ /gsang phod ber 'dung pad zha noms ni za ho ra'i rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin gyis rang gi zhwa kos gsar ba che rtags su phul ba'i dus kyi sku chas so/ /de'ang slob dpon rin po che 'dzam gling yul dbas kyi mi'i skye bo bgrang ༄bar dka' ba'i mdun du mthun snang la sngags kyi jeg pa rgya cher bshad par gsol ba 'debs pa po'i thog ma ni rgyal chen gtsug lag 'dzin yin la/ des gang gi tshe gsol ba btab pa ni/ yul der sngasas kyi kun spyod dang 'brel ba'i rdzu 'phrul chen po bstan pa na'o/ /tshul ji ltar btab na/ dpag tshad du mar khyab pa'i mi'i khrom tshogs kyi dbus su za 161

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/skal ldan grangs med la dgongs pa gtad cing / bde ba chen po'i lam dbang rim gnyis bcas bstan nas 'chi med kyi go 'phang la sbyar ba ni mnyam bzhag bum thod kyi'o/ /zhal zhi 'dzum khros pa'i nyams su bshad pa'ang 'dis bshad nus/ pad zhwa'i skabs/ pad zhwa gang yin za hor ma'i chas su byed dgos pa ni min te/ pad+ma kha 'bus kyi lo rgyus sogs kyis shes so/ /des na gu ru za hor ma yin min kun la pad zhwa lhub chen sogs pad zhwa re gsol ba ni/ zhwa byas kyang don du pad+ma'i rnam pa'i cod pan 'chang ba ste/ pad+ma'i rigs su ston pa'o/ /bsnyen mtshams skabs/ sngon du dkon mchog la mchod pa/ sdis ltung spyi dang khyad par nyams chags bshags sbyangs/ gsung rab sgrogs pa/ sats+tsha gdab pa/ srog bslu ba/ lam 'phrang 'chos pa cha gsum dang chu gtor sogs gtor ma'i rnal 'byor gyis mtshon dge ba'i dpung ci 'grub bsgrub par byas na rgyud 'byongs shing bar chad mi 'jug pa dang /dngos grub myur du 'thob par gsungs/ ma grub kyang chad skyon du mi 'gyur/ de nas gnas byi dor bya stan 'og tu 'bras sam sa dkar pos g.yung drung g.yas bskor 'bri/ ku sha'i gding ba bkram/ sngar sngon 'gro'i bsags sbyang ma song ba'am song yang kha gso'i tshul du byed na/dus bzang bo'i dgong mo bdag bskyed phyag rgya gcig pa'i rnal 'byor bzlas pa'i bar gyi mthar/ bsdu ldang byas te/ phyogs skyong sde brgyad gzhi 164

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7ra pad+ma gsung gi slob dpon la/ thabs la mkhas pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / bzlas brjod la rtag tu dga' zhing brtson pa dang / spyod lam thams cad du seng ge ltar spyod pa dang / glu gar rol mo rnams la dga' zhing / mchod pa'i bye brag la mkhas pa dang / lha dang bla ma'i bka' bzhin du byed pa las mi 'da' ba dang / spun la sa/dung zhing sems can la 'dud pa dgos pa dang / de'i slob ma la yang / 'gro ba'i sems mi dbyung ba dang / glu gar rol mo sna tshogs la brtson zhing mkhas pa sogs dgos par nges par 'byung ba phyi ma'i rgyud las gsungs so/ /thugs srog jiḥ yig gi don ni/ de nyid bsdus pa'i dum bu gsum pa las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje chos kyi dam tshig las byung ba'i byin gyis brlab/ pad+mo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhubs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi dam tshig ces bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying bo 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /dīḥde nas de phyung ma thag tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas pad+ma lha bu'i 'od zer kha dog dang gzugs dang rtags dang spyod lam dang 'od rnam pa du ma byung ste/ 'jig ten gyi khams thams cad du 'dod chags la sogs pa rnam par dag pa dang / chos nyid kyi ye shes yang dag par sbyangs nas yang slar log ste 'phags pa spyan ras 167

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i bsung 'bum/ bar /bam —gzisas kyi dbang po'i thukas kar zhugs so/ /zhes gsungs te/ snying bo 'di la de pa thams cad kyi chos kyi dam tshis ces sasungs pa'i chos ni pad+ma'i rigs rnams te/ rang bzhin dag pa'i chos ma/khyen pa'i sher phyin gyi ngo bo nyid yin pas so/ /dam tshig ni rgyu'i don te/ rigs de sprul pa'i rgyu yin pas so/ /de pa thams cad kyi snying bo zhes pa ni thugs ka'i sems dpa'i rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid yin pas so/ /de byung ma thag tu sogs kyis ni bhāḥzhes bya ba'i snying bo 'dis pad+ma'i rigs thams cad sprul tshul dang / sprul nas rang gi rigs dang mthun pa'i mdzad pa mdzad tshul rnams ston te kun snying ltar byas so/ /dpal mchob las kyang / de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ngo bo nyid dag pa'i chos nyid thob pa yang chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid spyan ras sazisas dbang phyug gi ye shes kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di gsungs te/ 'dod chags thams cad rnam par dag pa nyid kyis 'jig rten na zhe sdang thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /dri ma thams cad rnam par dag pa nyid kyis 'jig rten na sdis pa thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /chos thams cad rnam par dag pas 'jig rten na sems can thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /shes pa thams cad rnam par dag pas 'jig rten na thes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnam par das par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa nas/ de 168

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug don gyi gnas 'di nyid yang rgya cher ston cing bzhin rab tu 'dzum danul te pad+ma'i 'dab ma kha 'byed pas 'dod chags la sogs pa'i dri mas mi gos pa la lta zhing / 'gro ba thams cad kyi phyir pad+ma'i gzugs sna tshogs zhes bya ba'i snying po 'di gsungs so/ /bhāḥ de nas 'di gsungs pa tsam gyis pad+ma chen po de las de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa'i gzugs thams cad bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dang 'dra ba'i pad+mas mtshan pa'i gzugs can nges par byung nas bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rim pa dang po'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshul du bzhugs par gyur to/ /zhes gsungs te/ don gyi gnas 'di nyid ces pa ni/ 'dod chags rnam par dag pa sogs bong gi gzhung tshan bzhis bstan pa rnams te/ yang rgya cher ston cing zhes pa ni dīḥzhes bya ba'i yi ge sprul ba'i sgo nas slar yang ston par mdzad pa'o/ /'gro ba thams cad ni pad+ma'i rigs rnams te/ de yongs su rdzogs par skyed pa'i phyir snying bo 'aza gcig 'di gsungs pa'o/ /pad+ma'i sazags ra /nge /de :de/nge dpe ra sna tshobs pa zhes pa ni snying bo yi jiḥzhes pa 'a — nga ngo zhes dpal mchog 'grel chen las so/ /pad+ma'i gzugs sna tshogs zhes bya ba'i snying bo zhes pa 'di la (kun snying gi mchan/)sher dum gyi 'grel bar/'gro ba thams cad kyi gzugs su snang bas na gzugs sna tshogs dang /169

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7drung (do ha grong )'khyil ba gsum gyi zhal gdams dang / ye shes 'od mchog gi bshad tshul gzhan du ltos/ yig drug gi sbags don la/ oṃ a u ma gsum gyis sku gsung thugs gsum mtshon la/ de gsum gcig tu sbyar ba'i oṃ yig gis rdo rje gsum dbyer med pa'i go 'phang mtshon te/sngags don de ltar dran nas brjod pas mchog sprul zhing bsod nams len pa'i phyir nor bu 'dzin pa zhes rdo rje rtse mor ro/ /de nas ni/ rdo rje gur gyi le'u bco lnga par yig drug 'di nad thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i sngags su gsungs pa'i 'grel bar lha'i rigs kyi blo gros chen pos/ma ṇi zhes bya ba ni shin tu rin thang med pa'i nor bu dang 'dra ba'i so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /ci ste ye shes so sor rtog pa yin na rtog pa dang bcas par mi 'gyur ram zhe na/ pad+ma zhes bya ba smos te ji ltar pad+ma 'dams kyis ma gos pa ltar ye shes de rtog pa'i skyon gyis bos pa med do zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de nyid kyi phyir hūṃ phaṭa ces bya ba smos te/hūṃ zhes bya ba ni gzung ba dang 'dzin pas stong ba'i yid do/ /phaṭa ces bya ba ni rnam par rtog pa 'dral ba'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ sor rtob/ ye shes nor bu'i rgyal po dang 'dra tshul ni/ mdo rgyan las/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni/ /shes bya kun la rtag mi thogs/ /ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs rnams kyi/ /gter dang 'dra ba kho na yin/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams su ni/ /'byor ba thams cad ston mdzad pa/ /je tshom 171

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsunga'abum/ra ma thams cad gcod byed pa'i/ /chos chen char ni rab tu 'bebs/ /zhes 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi sa la brten nas bshad do/ /ye shes de so sor rtog pa yin na/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes su mi 'thad do zhe na/ pad+ma 'dam las skyes kyang chu zhag dang nya lcib sogs 'dam gyi nyes pa rnams kyis ma sbags pa ltar/ ye shes de ming tshig yi be'i rnam pa can gyi rtog pa yongs su gyur pa las skyes kyang / phyin ci log gi cha thams cad log pa'i phyir gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i rtog pa gtan min zhes pa ste/rtog pa ni mi gsal ba ste/ 'dam gyis sbags pa'i nag nog tu 'gyur ba dang 'dra'o/ /ye shes 'di ni sor rtog yin yang shes bya thams cad mngon sum du balha ba la bzang zhing shin tu gsal ba'i yon tan gyes mdzesapa'am/ 'khrul ba'i bag chags kyi gnyid ma lusapa sad pas shin tu rgyas shing kha bye bas na pad+ma lta bur bshad ces 'chad dam brtags/ mchan/ sangs rgyas la zhen rig gi rtog pa katan med kyang / tha snyad byed pa'i blo rig yod dgos te/ so rig bzhis shes pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gnyis snang gi 'khrul ba'i rab rib mtha' dag dang bral ba'i so sor rtog pa'i spyan shin tu gsal ba yin zhes hūṃ gis bstan to/ /'di ltar na sor rtog ye shes gcig po de gdul bya'i bsam pa rdzogs par mdzad pa'i cha nas nor bu dang / de nyid bdul bya'i bsam pa tha dad pa dang / de la ji ltar 'tshams pa'i chos kyi longs spyod sna tshosas pa thams cad ma 'dzing bar 'byed pa'i sor rtog yin yang / rtog pa'i skyon gyis ma gos par mi 17 2

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7 'gal ba'i cha nas pad+ma ste gnyis kar 'jog par gsal lo/ /da dung go bde bar bshad na/ sor rtog ye shes ni rnam par rtog pa med pa'i phyir dang / 'gro ba'i re ba skong ba'i mthu phul du byung ba'i phyir ma ṇi ste nor bu'i rgyal po'o/ /de rnam rtog med par mi 'thad de/ sor rtog yin pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ de rtog pa las skyes kyang / rtog pa'i dri mas ma lhad par skyes te/ pad+ma 'dam las skyes kyang 'dam gyi nyes pas ma gos par skye ba bzhin no/ /der ma zad sor rtog de nyid kyi mthus gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba'i g.yeng ba'i gnas ngan len gyi cha ma lus pa 'joms shing 'gob pas na hūṃ zhes so/ /bde chen shes rab snying rje mchog /ces pa'i sgrub thabs sa dpal mi tra dzo kis ni/ oṃ ma ṇi hūṃ/ shes rab chen po dri ma med//༄rnam par shes kun mtshan nyid de/ /ma skyes mi gnas 'gag pa med/ /gdod nas rnam grol mngon sum pa/ /oṃ ā trī pad+me hūṃ/ snying rje chen po lhun gyis grub/ /dmigs pa kun gyi mtshan nyid de/ /mi phyed mi 'gyur 'bral ba med/ /skyo med re ba rnam spangs pa'o/ /zhes bshad de/ ma ṇi ni shes rab kyi phar phyin te rnam rtog med cing / mthu bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /pad+ma ni snying rje chen po ste/ 'dam rdzab lta ba'i 'khor ba la brten nas sam dmigs nas skye ba dang / sems can thams cad dga' bar byed ba'i phyir ro/ /de'ang byang sems kyi mnyam bzhag tu ni snying rjes zin pa'i shes rab mngon gyur du 'jug ste spang bya dngos su 17 3

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7ba phyin stobs rgyas par 'gyur te/ des na rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid ces ri mo mkhan du mas 'khor sgyur gyi gzugs gcig 'dri ba'i dpes mdo dang rgyud bla mar bshad pa'i rigs pas mtshan nyid yongs su rdzosas pa'i sher phyin kyi rtogs pa rnyed pa ni tshobs mtha' yas pa la ltos pas tshogs de dag ni de'i don du gsungs so/ /rkang ba gnyis pa gnyis kyi don ni/ ma ṇir 'jog rgyu'i shes rab de shes pa rnam par dag pa rang don phun tshogs zab pa ye shes chos sku'i ngo bo nyid dang /pad+mer 'gro rgyu'i snying rje de dmigs pa'am shes bya rnam par dag pa gzhan don phun tshogs rgya che ba gzugs sku'i mtshan nyid dam 'jog/ byed yin pa ste/ de ltar na sngar phyag mtshan thad du brjod pa ltar byas kyang 'grigs pa yod/ de'ang theg chen gnyis kyi thun mong ltar yin la/da dung bya rgyud pa'i zab dang rgya che'i lam gnyis sgrub tshul nas/ sngags bla med pa'i shes pa 'od gsal dang / shes bya ye shes kyi sku sgrub lugs kyi bar so sor sbyar nas bshad na rlabs che'o/ pad+ma zhes bya rgyu la/ pad+me zhes sbyar ba ni bod pa'i don te/ nor bu pad+ma zhes spyan ras gzigs lanye ba'i sgo nas bod pa'i don yin pas 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud rang la nye ba lta bu yod par bsgom la bzla zhes rgyal dbang dge 'dun rgya mtshos bshad/ yang sgrub thabs de nyid las/ rnal 'byor rgyal po shes rab thabs/ /rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor bla na med/ /dpal ldan pha rol phyin drug dngos/ /cho ga'i dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/176

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba ma ra ba yangagasang sngags rgyal bo yi be/ drug /lugs 'byung ba dang lugs ldob las/ /rgyud drug 'gog dang lam drug sbyong / /'bras bu druka la rab sbyor nyid/ /de bzhin rgyud drug skyed pa dang / /lam drug la ni sbyor ba dang / /'bras bu drug ni mngon du bya/ /gzi brjid drug pa zhes bshad do/ /zhes yi ge drug po pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi ngo bo nyid dang / 'gro ba drug sbyong byed sobs su gsungs te/ 'di ni srong btsan bka' 'bum dang bka' gdams glegs bam sogs su'ang bshad do/ /srong btsan bka' 'bum na gzhan yang rdo rje dang rin po che la sosas pa rigs lnga risas thams cad bsdus pa dang bcas pa'i drug gi ngo bor sbyor tshul dang / ye shes lnga lhan skyes ye shes dang drug la sbyar ba dang / skru gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga'i byin rlabs so sor 'bebs pa/ byin rlabs thams cad thogs med du 'byung ba dang bcas pa'i drug la sbyar ba dang / dug lnga nyon mongs spyi dang drug sbyong byed du sbyar ba/ 'byung ba lnga so so dang /thams cad 'dus pa ste drug la sbyar ba sogs ches mang du gsungs shing /phyin drug dang sbyor tshul la yang oṃ sbyin pa nas hūṃ shes rab kyi ra go rim bzhin du sbyar ba dang / oṃ shes rab/ ma bsam gtan/ ṇi tshul khrims/pad brtson 'grus/ me sbyin pa/hūṃ bzod pa dang sbyar te bstan pa sogs yod de de nyid du blta bar bya'o/ /lhan skyes rol bas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs su/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying bo rtosas pa'i sngabs kyi 176

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7rgyal po yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'di mtshan ma med pa'i sbyor bas balha zhing bzlas pa bya'o/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ zhes sogs rgya gzhung rnams las yig drug kho na 'byung yang / gter phyogs su yig bdun mang la de'i rgyu mtshan yang / byang gter las/ phyi ni srog sbas zhi ba'i tshul: yi ge drug pa rdo rje sgra: zhes pa nas/ gsang ba srog gi mtha' rten can: snyigs ma'i dus su srog mthar rten: zhes gsungs te/ spyir yig drug rang yang thugs srog bskul ba'i sngags las ma 'das mod/ 'on kyang skul byed yig drug dang / bskul bya srog yig gnyis ka dngos su sbrel nas bzlas na thugs rje gnad nas basbul ba la lhag par no bas sngags 'grub par dka' ba'i dus su 'di gtso bor bzung zhes pa yin nam dpyod/ /de nyid snang chen dang dpal mchog 'grel bar/ sems can gti mug shas che ba rnams sbyong byed du shes rab kyi phar phyin 'jig rten dbang bo'i dkyil 'khor du sprul bar gsungs pa dang /rang bzhin dag pa'i chos la sor rtog ye shes kyi spyan kyis gzigs pa'i cha nas spyan ras gzigs su brjod tshul dang / sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo dang don zhags sogs mang bor sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgos lhar bsngags pa dang / rnam snang mngon byang dang yo ga/ dang bla med rgyud kun tu sor rtog ye shes kyiXlha mthar thag tu bshad cing ye shes de sngon ༄chos bstan pa'i rgyu las byung ba dang / chos kyi longs spyod rgyas pa'i byed 177

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 74྾ ྾rje chen po nyid kyi steng nas brjod pa dang / spyod 'jug tu bdag gces 'dzin goms pa'i dbang gis rang la mi snyan pa chungangu'ang mi bzod pa ltar/ brtse ba goms pa'i shugs rgyas pa na gzhan gyi mi bde ba phra mo yang mi bzod pa'i dper rje btsun 'di'i rnam thar drangs te/ de bas ji lhar sogs nas/ mtshan yang byin gyis brlabs/ ces pa'i bar ro/ /snying rje pad dkar las spyan ras gzigs zhes pa'i mtshan 'di yang snying rje chen po'i yon tan gyi sgo nas sngon gyi sangs rgyas kyis btags par gsungs pa dang / lag na rdo rje dbang bskur gyi gleng gzhir sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyis rje btsun la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rje chen po'i stobs kyi rdo rje pad+ma'i mchog gi snying bo byin nas gzhi dang snying bo me tog gi rgyan bkod pa'i zhing 'di lus kyi sprin rnams kyis bkang nas snang bar byed du btang bar bsungs pa dang /de nyid bsdus par bdag cag gi ston pa rnam snang nyid snying rje'i nyams kyis 'dul ba'i sems can gdul phyir 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi skur bstan par 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor kyi thad du gsungs pa dang / spyan ras gzigs zhes pa'i sgra bshad kyang sor rtog ye shes kyi spyan gyis rang bzhin dag pa'i chos la rtag tu gzigs pa dang / thugs rje chen po'i spyan gyis 'jig rten thams cad la gzigs pa lhur len pa'i phyogs nas bshad tshul gnyis de nyid snang chen dang / ko sa la'i rgyan/ dpal mchog 'grel chen rnam snang mngon byang gi 'grel ba rnams 179

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7gnas ngan len gyi cha thams cad rgyun mtha'i rdor ting gis bcom nas/de'i rnam grol lam la sgar yang snying rje chen po mngon byur du 'byung ste/de ni stong nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa sogs lung rtogs kyi yon tan rnam pa thams cad pa'i mtshan nyid can du skye'o/ /dngos grub kyi snying bo de ltar ngos zin nas de nyid rgya gang che nas bsgrub dgos kyi/ bzhan du dper na bla ma mkhas grub chen po dang mjal yang skar ma'i dpyad lta bu'i don dman pa zhig las ci yang ma dris na gdams pa'i mchog rnams zur tsam yang mi thob pa dang 'dra'o/ /spyir yang sgo thams cad nas snying rje la mang du gnas par bya ba ni spyan ras gzigs kyi sngags pa'i khyad par gyi dam tshig yin par phyag stong spyan stong gi mdo dang /rgyal bo bka' 'bum/ kun bzang thugs gter sogs las nan tan du gsungs te/ de la brtson na 'phags pa dang brtul zhugs gcig la gnas par 'gyur bas 'phags pa dgyes de'ang spyir snying rje sgom pa tsam gyis mi chog gi/ de 'phags pa dgyes pas ched du dmigs nas sgom pa zhig dgos te/ 'di'i dam tshig khyad par bar 'gro lugs shes pa'i steng nas so/ /mchan/ pa'i dka' thub kyi nor can te/ rjes 'dzin gyi gnad ches chen po'o/ /ha rlung / ra gtum mo/ a bde ba/ i don dam/ ha longs sku/ ra sprul sku/ a i sbyar ba chos sku'o/ /de ltar na rlung gis gtum mo bskul bas bde stong gi ye shes skyes pa la brten nas sku gsum gyi go 'phang la sbyor zhes pa tshe sgrub ye shes 'od 181

brjed tho sna tshobs/ za da/ 7— cad yum don skyong ba'i rnam 'gyur dang rtsal sbyong yin gsung / yum don gyi rtogs pas bdud bzhi gcod tshul la/ bye na mang du yod kyang /mdor dril na/ /bdud thams cad snyem byed kyi bdud la 'du/ snyem byed ces pa snyam du sems par byed pa ste rnam rtog des na 'dzin zhen gyi rnam rtog nyid snyem byed kyi bdud du 'jog dga' sdug re dogs sogs kyi rnam rtog ci lta bu byung yang de'i rjes mi gcod/ cho 'phrul/ ltas ngan/rmi lam/ 'dod yon longs spyod sogs skyid sdug gi yul rkyen gang dang phrad kyang rtsis gdab mi bya bar shes rgya bskyed/ khong lhod de chos nyid kyi ngang la glod nas bzhag pas rang grol du song ste/ blo bde 'bol/ nyams dga' yal/ bag dro 'ur 'gro ba ni snyem byed kyi bdud gcad lugs dang chod lugs yin/ yul gang gi thog tu gcod kyang gcad rgyu dngos ni snyem byed kho na ste/ zhe sdang pho gdon/ 'dod chags mo gdon/ gti mug klu gdon sogs thams cad de'i bye brag ko/ /phaṭa kyi don yang snyem byed bcad/ snyem med kyi rig pa hur phyungs te dbyings la sre ba'o/ /lta ba rtogs kyang spyod yul thams cad dang ma bsres na yul rkyen drag po byung tshe 'jigs sar skyel mas bor ba lta bur 'gro/ gnyan sa gcig chod pa lta bu rkyen snang gcig la ro snyom nus kyang / de tsam gyis choka shes byas na rtsal phyogs med du rgyas mi thub pas ro stom gyi nyams len rtag 'grus su sbyong zhing / yul rkyen thams cad la sre ba bal che/ snyem 183

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾— ྾྾ ྾byed kyi bdud drag po rgyu ba'i yul de nyer bcug nas de'i thog nyid du snyem thag bcad nas dbyings rig gi rtosas goms gdeng du 'gyur ba'i phyir gnyan sa gcod pa yin/ der 'dre lhong ba ni dbyings rig sre ba'i sher phyin gyi rnal 'byor zab mo'i gzi brjid mi bzod nas yin gyi//drag gcod dkos pa'i nges pa med ces 'brub chen no/ /lhong tshad thon dus skrag pa dang dogs pa sogs byung na yengs nas snyem shor ba yin pas de ma thag ngos bzung la snyems sam rnam rtog bcad de dbyings rig bsre ba'i ngang la bzhag /mdze pho dang / dam nyams sogs la bcad pas dbyings rig gi nyams myong dang bar du snyem zhub/sa pas chod shor na sems rmugs 'thib dang / skrang ba/ nad 'go ba sogs yod/ de la gang gis lan pa de nyid dang slor (slar)bsres la snyem dang ma bral bar du nyams su blang bas rang zhir 'gro/ lar thog brdzis kyi bo don/ thag khra sprul du mthong nas skrag tshe thag khra de nyid kyi thog tu phyin nas bltas pas 'jigs skrag de rtsad med khungs med du chod pa ltar/ gang la nyam nga zhing bag tsha ba'i yul rkyen de nyid la thog 'gel btsan 'gyel byas nas yum don bskyang bas sngar nas snang ba sems dang / sems stong bar ngo 'phrod zin pa ltar snang sems mtha' dag dmigs med kyi dbyings su nye bar zhi ba'i 'jigs med kyi gdeng chen thob pa ste/ le lag las/ dper na smig rgyu chur mthong ba/ /thog tu phyin pas chu med 184

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba ba 4ba ba ba ba ma ba ba ྾ma ma ba — babar4 ba ba ba — bab ba ba ma ba las so/ /gcod pas ri khrod gnyan sa dben pa rnams bsten/ grong yul du mi sdod/ tshogs pa mi skyong / ldom bu yang yun ring mi bya ste/ de dag gis sems g.yengs te/ nyams myong shor/ drod tshad yal ba'i nyen che bas so/ /mi ma yin dbang du 'dus pa/ dam la thogs pa/ gdon thul ba sogs ci byung yang dga' brod mi byaXste// de nyid dga' brod kyi bdud ces bya ba'i snyem byed chen po yin pas so/ /gcod pa'i gol sa gsum ni/gcod mo/(sman)'dod yon/ drag sngabs su shor ba rnams te/ dang po ni/sngar ltar gnyan khrod 'grim zhing nyams len bskyangs pas rib pa dwangs snyigs phyed de gsal snang la/ 'dre banod mi gnod dang / nad pa 'tsho 'chi sogs shar te/ bzhan la bzlas pas rno mthong gi rgyus tshor nas mi kun yang yang 'drir 'ong / de la g.yeng bas nyams rtosas yal 'gro ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bsod nams snyan grags sna tshosas byung bas mgo 'khor te sgom g.yeng bas khyer ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sher phyin gyi nyams myong bskyang ba'i byin rlabs kyis nad pa dang / 'dre can risas la byin rlabs byas pas sar song ste/ yon bdag mang pos bos nas grong kha 'grim pas nyams rtogs 'grib/ byin rlabs yal/ de nas 'dre 'dul drag sngags la re dgos pa 'ong ba'o/ sacod kyi myong ba ches mthon po yin na 'di 'dra'i dosas pa mi dkos sam snyam ste dam pa rgya gar bzhin no/ /gcod pa la gdon bgegs bar chad kyis mi tshukas 186

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4— ྾ ྾r+yā r+yā bdud kyi spyod yul brgal te/ sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul na gnas pa yin pas/ lha 'dre yod kyang ci gnod de/ spyod yul shin tu bskal ba'i phyir te/rmi lam gyi khyes sad dus kyi rje ngar mi 'bebs pa'am/ rgya sar gyi dug sprul bod la mi gnod pa bzhin no/ /zhes bya'o1 /gcod 'di'i yum don skyong lugs/ phar phyin pa'i stong nyid la dmigs pa'i lhag mthong sgrub lugs ni min te/ dpyad sbom rtsal du 'don phyogs ba/tan min pa'i phyir ro/ /sto nga nyid la dmigs pa'i thi gnas sgrub tshul tsam yang min te/ de tsam gyis rgyud yongs su grol mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /gsang sngags phyi ba min te/ bla med thun min gyi lha khros nag dang 'brel ba dang / tshul 'dis 'chi ba 'od gsal ngos zin par nying tshom dang le lab tu bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /bla med spyi 'gros min te/ bskyed rdzogs kyi 'gros spyi ltar brtsi rgyu med pa'i phyir ro/ /rdzogs chen ltar yang min te/ sems rig 'byed pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /sems mi rtog par bzhag pas 'od sasal sgom par 'gro na ha shang yang sdogs rim mkhan po yin par thal lo/ /grub thob kyi lam srol ma nor ba ni yin 'dug pas ji ltar kazung zhes pa rnams ni dogs pa basbang ba'o/ /de'i lan la gzhan tshos ci 'debs ci shes/ rang bi bo tshod ltar na/ sems tshol dus stong nyid kyi lta ba ma nor ba zhig rnyed dgos/ de nas nam mkha' sgo 'byed dus 'bum dang nyi khri sogs nas 188

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs meng bstan nyi'i gsung 'bang/ nga nga nga nga phan chad/ nad gdon sogs kyi me ro gsos pa yin pas zhi bar 'dod kyang ngal ba tsam ste/chu dkrugs pas rnyosas ma dwangs su re ba bzhin no//des na a tsha a na zhes rig pa dang na pa'i bar du sems kyis brda sbyor ba'isgo nas nad gsal 'debs pa dang / cung zad zhi ba na dge sbyor gyis nad la dwangs skyed thon pa yin nam snyam pa sogs rtsal thog shor ba'i 'phrang la gzab dkos so/ /mnyamabazhag gi mthus rtsal rang mal du thim pa'i lam rnyed nas las rlung ye shes kyi khams su das ste/phung po'i zag pa zad cing phra rasas sdug balngal gyi rgya mtsho brgal ba'i tshul ni phyogs 'di'i gzhung chen po rnams las shes par bya'o/ /o rgyan sman gyi bla ma dgyes pa'i rol mor spros so//yig 'bru'i tshul/ zhes pa/ bong du le'u gsum pa bzhi ba'i 'brel ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi mnyam pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin mtshon brjod las 'das kyang de nyid mtshon byed kyi yi ge ming tshig du mar shar nas chos ston pa'i tshul gyis/ /sems nyid skye ba med kyang de nyid rol ba lha'i sku bsung thags su 'char zhes mdzub mos zla ba ston pa ltar byed/༄des mi lo na/yi ge la brjod don mtshon rgyu med kyang / brda dang tha snyad kyi ngor don sna tshogs ston byed du 'char ba ltar/ sems nyid kyi rang bzhin la skye ba med kyang / ming brdas btasas pa'i tha snyad tsam du sku gsung thug kyi rol ba tshad med par sna nga / zhes pa 'di das sang rung 19 2

྾/ 7 rdo grub 'ji 1 dzo s+dzawī tsho 1 44 4྾s+dzawīspyi dang 'di gnyis la thun khyad kyi khyad par che'o/ /'di yang rje nyid kyi bri ji zhi co me bephyag sa lta ba ban bas bslad da par spar du skrun pa da legs 'phel//9

ngo da/ 7྾4 — ྾྾྾྾༄/ /skyid sdug lam 'khyer bzhugs so/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyub la/ /gang zhib rtag tu pha rol bde bas bde 'gyur zhing / /gzhan dag sdub/ bsngal gyur pas mchog tu 'o brgyal ba/ /thus/sa rje chen po'i yon tan shin du basprubs pa gang / /de ni rang gi bde sdug spangs te 'dug pa yin/ /zhes ji skad gsungs pa'i yon tan rjes su dran nas phyag byas te/ dam pa rnams kyi nyer mkho'i lag cha 'jig rten na rin thang dang bral ba skyid sdug lam 'khyer gyi man ngag cha tsam brjod par bya ste/ de la banyis/ sdug bsngal lam du 'khyer tshul dang / skyid pa lam du 'khyer tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis/ kun rdzob dang / don dam la brten pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sems can dang sems can ma yin pa'i 'tshe ba nam byung du sdug bsngal gyi 'du shes 'ba' zhig 'jog pa la blo goms na yul rkyen phra mo res kyang sems kyi zug rngu ches chen po skyed de/ bde sdug gi 'du shes gang la goms pa de 'phel 'gro ba chos nyid yin pas so/ /de ltar rim gyis goms pa'i stobs 'phel te/ ci zhig na gang snang phal cher yid mi bde 'dren pa'i rgyur song nas bde ba'i go skabs ye med pa zhig 'ong / de rang gi blo goms tshul gyis lan yod pa mi shes par phyi rol gyi yul rkyen 196

spyid sduka lam 'khyer/ pod/ 7pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal chung du yang yid mi bde'i tshor ba mi bzad pa bsnan nas shin du bzod dka' ba'o/ /de'ang dper na mdzes ma'i mtshar sdug la rtog bzhin du 'dod chags dgag lo byas kyang ngal ba tsam du zad pa ltar/ sdub/ bsngal gyis gdung ba'i rnam pa la yid shas cher gtad nas bzod sran skyed mi nus pas dbang bo'i sgo sdom pa'i man ngag rnams las 'byung ba ltar/ sdug bsngal de la yid shes kyis mtshan mar mi bzung bar blo rnal du bzhag la rang so gzung ba zhig goms dgos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sdug bsngal la lam gyi grogs su bltas nas dga' ba sgom pa ste/ de'ang sdug bsngal gang byung rang gi blo'i nus pa dang bstun pa'i dge sbyor re dang bsre rgyu med na/ spyir thabs mkhas dang ldan na sdug bsngal la brten nas phan yon 'di dang 'di lta bu 'thob tu yod do zhes pa tsam zhig mang du bsam kyang / nam mkha' dang ni sa gzhi'i bar yang ring / zhes pa ltar song nas dargos pa 'grub dka'o/ /des na re zhig sdug bsngal la brten nas nges 'byung gi bsam pa sbyang ba ni/ ji srid dbang med du 'khor bar 'khyams pa de srid 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal 'byung ba ni mi 'os pa zhig byung ba ma yin gyi 'khor ba'i ngang tshul de lta bu yin no snyam pa dang / re zhig bde 'gro na spyod pa'i sdug bsngal nyi tshe yang 'di ltar bzod par dka' na/ ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal lta ci smos te/ kye ma'o 'khor ba ni gting mtha' med pa'i 197

pob/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/ 4྾ r+yā— ྾ —྾sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho yin no snyam du skyo ba bskyed de/ yid thar ba la phyos/sa par bya'o/ /skyabs 'gro sbyang ba ni/ de ltar tshe rabs brgyud mar 'jigs pa 'di lta bus yang dang yang du nyen pa la mi bslu ba'i skyabs su gyur pa ni dkon mchog ba/sum kho na yin pas cis kyang de kho na la brten par bya zhing / de gsum ci la babs kyang ba/tang bar mi bya'o snyam du nges par byas nas skyabs 'gro sgom pa'o/ /dregs pa bsal ba ni/gong du bshad pa ltar rang la dbang med cing / rtab/ tu sbug bsngal gyi gzhan dbang can las ma 'das pa'i tshul la brten te/ legs tshogs 'joms pa'i dgra bo nga rgyal dang / gzhan khyad du gsod pa'i blo ngan tshar gcad par bya'o/ /sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ sdub bsngal 'di lta bu dang /'di bas ches che ba dpas tu med pa ni sdig pa 'ba' zhig las byung ngo zhes las nges pa dang / 'phel che ba dang / ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad pa dang / byas pa chud mi za ba bzhi'i sgo nas lesas par bsam la/ de'i phyir sbug bsngal mi 'dod na de'i rgyu mi dge ba spong dbos so snyam du sngar bsags stobs bzhis bshags shing / phyi ma bsdam pa la 'bad do/ /dge ba la dga' ba ni/ sdug bsngal log pa'i bde ba la dga' na de'i rgyu dge ba la 'bad dgos so snyam du rgyas par bsam la sgo du ma nas dge ba'i phyogs ci 'phel bya'o/ /snying rje la slob pa ni/ bdag bzhin du sems can gzhan yang sdug bsngal de lta bu dang / de las ches che bas 98

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾྾ ྾'char lugs ltar ma yin par/ ming tsam gyi gsog tu lta bas zil gyis mnan par bya ste/ rgyas par ma brjod do/ /gnyis pa la'ang gnyis kyi/kun rdzob la brten pa ni/ bde ba dang bde ba'i yul rkyen byung ba'i tshe de'i dbang du shor na kheng dregs dang / rgyags pa dang / le lo sogs 'phel nas lam la bar du gcod par byed de/ pha dam pas/ mi rnams skyid la khyag chung / sdug la khyag che/ gsungs pa ltar 'di'i dbang du mi 'gro ba dka'o/ /de'i phyir dngos po de dag mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal ba'i rnam par sgo du ma nas bltas la skyo shas chen po bskyed de yid bas med las bzlog pa la 'bad cing / yang 'di snyam du/ de ltar srid pa'i bde 'byor thams cad mnog chung la nyes dmigs mang po dang 'brel ba yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang 'ga' zhig la yon tan yod de/ ston pas sdug bsngal gyis rang dbang nyams par byas pa'i mis byang chub sgrub pa ni ches dka' zhing / bde bar gnas pas byang chub sgrub pa ni ches sla bar gsungs te/ bdag 'di ltar skyid kyi ngang nas chos sgrub tu yod pa ni bsod nams che ba yin gyis/ dus 'dir ci nas kyang bde skyid 'dis chos nyo zhing / chos las kyang bde skyid brgyud mar 'byung ba'i tshul gyis chos dang bde ba gnyis phan tshun grogs su 'gro ba la sbyang bar bya ste/ gzhan du na shing gi snod du btung ba bskol ba ltar dang po gang yin de nyid tha ma'i gnas skabs su 'gyur ro snyam du bsgrim la 204

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾r+yā྾ ྾྾ r+yāb྾ ྾dpal la rol ba yin te/ bka' gdams rin po ches/ skyid kyi kha gnon/sdug gi mjug sdud/ gcig pur 'dug na skyo grogs byed/ na na nad g.yog byed/ ces gsungs pa dang tshul mtshungs so/ /dper na gser mgar gyis gser me la bsreg nas dri ma sbyang / chus yang yang bkrus nas mnyen par byed pa ltar/ sems kyang skyid pa lam khyer gyis gdung bar byas/ sdug bsngal lam khyer gyis dang bar byas na lus sems las su rung ba'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rnams bde blag tu 'grub la/legs tshosas kyi rtsa ba tshul khrims phun sum tshogs par byed pa'i man ngag la'ang 'di rang zab par go ste/ sprud pa la ma chags pas rab du byung ba'i tshul khrims khyad par can gyi rten gzhi byed cing / sdug bsngal la mi 'jigs pas tshul khrims de yongs su dag par byed pa'i phyir te/sbyin pa tshul khrims kyi rten dang / bzod pa tshul khrims dag byed du gsungs pas shes so/ /da lta 'di ltar sbyangs pas lam mthon por sleb pa na/ de yis chos shesarab kun sgyu ma lta bu dang / /skye ba skyed mos tshal snying rje 'gro ltar rtogs nas/ /'byor ba'i dus dang rgud pa'i dus na'ang 'di/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal dag gis 'jigs pa med/ /ces pa ltar 'byung ba yin no/ /ston pa'i rnam thar dang sbyar na/ byang chub ma brnyes gong du 'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal srid rtswa ltar spangs pa dang / ne+e rañja 206

྾ skyidasdugalam 'khyer/ pod/ 7྾ nar dka' spyad drag po la ci mi snyam par bzhugs pas rang don bdud rtsi rtogs pa la skyid sdug ro stom dgos par bstan la/ byang chub brnyes nas 'og min gyi bar gyi lha dang mi'i dbang bo rnams kyis zhabs spyi bor blangs shing bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur bstabs pa dang / bram ze bha ra rnya dzas spyo ba brgyas spyos pa dang / zam ze'i ba mo dregs mas mi tshangs spyod kyis skur ba btab pa dang / rgyal ༄po mes byin gyi yul du zla ba gsum du rta chas kyi nas rul pa gsol ba sogs la thugs mtho dman du 'gyur ba med par ri rab rlung gis mi sgul ba lta bur bzhugs pas sems can gyi don byed pa la ro stoms dgos par bstan to/ /'di jo bo bka' gdams pa/ sdug na skad ngan mi 'don zhing / skyid na skyo shas che ba/ zhes pa'i rnam thar can rnams kyis 'chad rgyu zhig yin/ bdag 'dras bshad na rang gi lces kyang khrel lam snyam pa de red kyang / rang nyid chos brgyad ro snyom la bag chags 'jog phyir dmigs nas sprang rgan bstan nyis bya mang gi nags su bris pa'o//207

nga nga nga/ nga nga nga rdo grub 'jigasang nga nga nga nyi'i gsung 'bum / nga nga nga rtsal rdzogs pa grub pa mchog gi dbang po 'jigs med phrin las 'od zer yin la/rje btsan 'di'i gdan sa ni/rong ston pad+ma bde chen gling ༄pa'i sater lung bzhin/ shugs chen 'gro don lhun grub/ brag chen yar lung pad+ma bkod/ gtsang chen dngos grub dpal 'bar gling dang gsum du byung ba las/da lta ni phyi ma gnyis tsam gnas pa ste/de'ang rje rang gi gsung na/ nga'i sgrub sde 'di 'khos ka la bltas na/ phyug po'i lha sa mal tsam las med de/ rnying bstan gyi rtsa ba gnas pas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma zams sprin bzhin 'du bar 'dug ces sasungs pa ltar/ stong ldir gyi 'ur mi che yang / da lha'i bar du snying bo'i bstan 'dzin bar ma chad par byon pa zhig yin pas/ de dag gi rjes su skyes pa'i rang re rnams kyis kyang brgyud pa'i bla mi 'tshong tsam re cis kyang dbos par 'dug rung / mi bsam rang bsam mthun mi mthun sna tshogs shis yong bar snang ba/ de bzhin byed tshe dam pa gong ma'i phyag rjes chud zos su 'gro bas/ gal che nges kyi bca' tho rags pa tsam 'god par bya ste/ de la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spong klog gnyis kyis 'dzin dgos pa la/ ming bstan pa la zhugs par btags nas yig ngo shes pa tsam nas dbyar ston gyi nam zla thams cad grong chog la zad/ dgun dpyid kyi zla ba byung tshe sgye kha dang rkyal kha'i gnyer ba la btang na/ khang gog sto nga pa sha stag gis shākya seng ge'i bstan pa mi zin cing / ban+de'i pha khang gtsug lag gi 2/0

nga ba/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ rnyed dka' nas bzung sems bskyed bar gyi khrid rim la go ba cung zad chags pa dang / sngon 'gro'i nyams len 'bum lnga'i bsags sbyang dang bcas pa ba/nad smin gtong / de nas rab rtsa ba gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub dang de ltar ma grub na'ang rigs 'dus dang 'gro 'dul sdug bsngal rang grol gang rung la bsnyen pa byed rgyu sogs sgrub sde ming don mi 'dzol ba'i thabs tshul la 'bad/ 5 de rnams gtso bor dgun bca' byed tshul yin/ dus rgyun du yang bla rnam dang / rtsa sasum gsol ka chags med dang / byang sems kyi rtsa ltung dang sngags kyi rtsa ltung sdom tshig blo la bzung nas nyin re bzhin bsngo bgrang dang bcas kha ton du bzung ba gal che ste/ mnga' ris paṇa chen dang kun macan bla ma sogs kyi phyag bzhes kyang yin/ 6 ban+des skya chas lhon pa lar yang bstan pa'i mig ltos la shin tu banod cing / khyad par du 'tshogs gral dang dgon pa'i nang du khyim pa'i chas 'jus pa mang po mthong na gdol spyod kyi skye bos kyang khrel ba dang / bstan ba la mi gus pa'i chag sgo chen po'i gzhir 'gyur bas/ rgyun par slag skya dang rke rags sngon dmar 'chang ba/ gos brdze bcing byed pa/ dgra dogs med pa'i sar yang gri thung dngashang lang 'dogs pa sogs gtan nas mi byed/ 8tshogs gral du skyes pa bud med nyal po byed pa'i gtam sogs khyem pa sun 'byin gyi kun spyod ngan pa'i risas la mi 'jug cing / gal srid 'jug mkhan byung na rgan 21 2

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7pa rnams nas bstan pa'i la rgyar bsams te gleng dran thongs/ 8 dge 'dun pas dmar chog dang / btsun pas khe spogs chen po dang khyad par bshas tshong byed pa/ dgon khang du ser khyim 'dzin pa sogs sangs rgyas kyi bla 'tshong zhing rgyal ba'i bstan pa la than skyel ba/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi rkang 'dren cing / lha dkar phyogs skyong bas mthong na dmod 'debs pa'i spyod ngan rnams reg phung gi dug bzhin ring bo bas kyang ches ring bor sgongs/ 9 me dang thab kha bud shing gi tshob/sa pa rnams ya ma bral na g.yos bskol yong ste/ so sor byas na mi yong ba ltar dgon pa'i spyi chus brtan mi brtan thams cad dge 'dun gyi thags blo mthan mi mthan 'di la rtsa ba thag 'dug pas chos 11 da chen dang da 11mthun — bya ba — chung gang la yang bzang po zur ban dang / ngan pa mgo rgyal du mi 'gro bar blo sems gcig dril dgos pa bcas/ 10 dke bcu'i grangs ldan gyi rtsa tshig nye 'khon med par sman pa drang srong ri ji'i dkyil 'khor lha bu 'di nyid gsungardo rje pad+ma saṃ bha ba dngos dang dbyer mi phyed pa'i rig 'dzin gyi slob dpon chen po 'jamadapal chos kyi bshes gnyen zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba'i mang thos da ri tra'ajigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma phrin las kun tu khyab pa'i dpal gyis lhag bsam bzang bos bris pa mtsho skyes rgyal ba gnyis pa'i phrin las kyi grogs su gyur ba rtsa gsum rgya mtshos dge bas byin gyis rlobs shig gu//ra / /sangs rgyas 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba can sras byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan rin po 213

pob/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾྾྾ —྾ ྾r+yā—4rnams rtogs par khong du chud pas na ji snyed pa rig pa/ zab mo stong ba dang rgya che ba rten 'byung gi tshul gdod nas ro gcig par shes shing rtogs pas nang ye shes rig pa/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa kun btags dang lhan skyes kyi phyogs ci rigs pa rnam par zad de kun sbyor gyi rgyu ba gting nas chad pas chags sgrib las grol ba/ shes bya'i sgrib pa phra ba dang rags pa'i tshogs ji ltar rigs pa gnyen po ye shes kyi rdo rjes nges par bcom pas thogs sgrib las grol ba/ de'ang nyan rang dgra bcom man chad kyis thogs sgrib spang ba dgra bcom pa kanyis ka'i cha las rnam grol min pa med la/ gnyis rnam grol bas kyang 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa spang ba tsam zhis las/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gyis shes sgrib skor dgu'i bye bras spang ba ni med de/ nam zhig na de dag kyang theg chen gyi sa bcur zhugs pa'i tshe gdod sa dang po nas bzung shes bya'i sgrib pa phra rags bcu sgong ba yin no/ /rang don lhur len pa spangs te sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi nges pa la zhubs pas na dman sgrib las grol ba/ 'phags pa ye shes nam mkha' ltar chags pa med pa'i spyod ༷ yul can chos rnams kyi gnas lugs dang mthun par zhugs pa ji lta ba rig pa sogs yon tan gsum ldan/ ye shes de dag nyid kyis chos dbyings smra bsam brjod med yang dag par rtogs pa'i gnad kyis 218

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ —྾྾྾ ྾ can yin pa dang / chos thams cad rang bzhin mnyam pa'i gnad kyis bdag med rtogs pa tshad mar grub cing / bden zhen ni rtsa ba mi brtan pa'i lob shes su grub bo/ /bdag med mapho pa de'ang nan tan du thabs dang bcas te bslab na 'dod 'jigs goms pa'i snang ba bzhin du blo snga ma snga mas phyi ma phyi ma nus pa mthu can du byed cing blo'i rang bzhin tshad med pa nam mkha' ltar mtha' yas pa'i tshul du mngon par snang ba 'grub par 'gyur zhing / sgrib pa ma lus pa yongs su srab pa dang / rab tu byang ba dang / shin tu zad pa'i mthar thug par grub bo/ /de tsa na mapho pa de nyid thob mar sgom pa'i tshogs sbyor gyi lam dang /bar du bsal snang thon pa 'phags pa slob pa'i lam dang / de nyid mthar phyin pa thams cad mapho pa ste/ bar ba chos dkon mchog 'ba' zhig pa dang / phyi ma sangs rgyas dang chos su grub bo/ /marga pa des srid rtsa spangs pa'i 'gog bden 'phags pa slob lam pa'i thugs rgyud na bzhugs pa chos dkon mchog kho na ba dang / de mthar phyin pa chos dang sangs rgyas dkon mchog gnyis ka yin pa ngo bo nyid sbu'o/ /mapho pa de dang 'gog bden de dag rgyud ldan kyi gang zag yod pas/dge 'dun dkon mchog kho na ba slob pa 'phags pa dang / nyan rang mi slob lam pa gnyis/ sangs rgyas dang dke 'dun gnyis ka ba sangs rgyas 'phags pa dang bcas yod par grub bo/ /don 'di rgya cher rnam 222

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7las dang nyon mongs pa las ma byung na ni/ rgyu med pa'i dngos por yod par smra ba/ du ba me la mi ltos par skye bar khas blang ba lta bur 'gro la de rang gi mthun pa'i rgyu las byung na ni/ rgyu de tshe snga ma'i skabs kyi las dang nyon mongs las gzhan du mi 'thad cing / de lta de ltar tshe snga ma dang / de'i yang snga ma sogs la sbyar nas yar ded du dpyad pa na skye shi'i 'khor ba 'di la thog ma'i ya mtha' 'jog rgyu zhig gtan nas mi srid par 'grub la/ de 'grub na skye shi'i phreng ba de dag gi skabs kyi pha ma dang spun zla mdza' bshes sogs kyi ya mtha' yang mi srid pa kho na ste/de ltar thog ma med pa'i dus nas ma bu'i brtse ba la koms pa'i dbang gis/ 'jig rten na blun pa'i mthar thug phyugs rnams kyang rang gi bu la byams pa dang / gso skyong bya ba'i thabs shes pa la sogs pa sus kyang ma bslab par ngang gis 'ong ba yin te/ skyes rabs las/ blo yi mthu stobs nus pa med pa dang / /dbang po rnams kyang drun pa'i rang bzhin can/ /byung ma thag tu sus kyang ma bslab par/ /kha zas gzhan la sprul bar byed pa 'dis/ /skye ba gzhan la boms par byas par grub/ /ces gsungs/ de yang tshe 'di'i pha ma dang spun zla la sogs pa kho nas nye du dang mdza' bshes bskyar mar byas pa tsam min par/ nam mkha'i mthas gtug pa'i sems can thams cad re re nas de ltar 'khor lo bskor ba bzhin du gyar pa'i tshul/ sa'i dngos gzhir mdor drangs pa ༄ 237

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs medabastan nyi'i gsung 'bum/r+yā྾ ྾ las/ yun ring bor 'das pa na sems can gang o kyi pha'am ma'am/phu nu'am/ sring mo'am/ mkhan po'am/ slob dpon nam/ bla ma'am/ bla ma'i gnas lta bu ma gyur ba de ni ngas mthong bar dka'o/ /zhes gsungs thing / dkon brtsegs kyi le'u bcu gnyis pa dang / drag shul can gyis zhus pa dang / dkon mchog sprin sogs mdo sde gzhan mtha' yas par yang de dang 'dra bar gsung / rigs pas dpyad na yang dgra gnyen bar ma sogs ni sngon gyi las bsags tshul gyi khyad par las so sor byung ba kho na yin la/ las de gsog tshul yang / da lta rang re rnams kyis sems can re re la dmigs nas kyang skabs 'gar ni chasas pa la sogs pas bskyed pa'i gnyen du 'gyur ba'i las dang / skabs la lar ni zhe sdang sogs kyis bskyed pa'i dgrar 'gyur ba'i las sna tshogs zhig lo dang zla ba re re'i khongs su yang go rim ma nges par kasog pa myong bas grub pas/ de dang mthun par 'bras bu grub pa'i tshe yang da lta dgra bor gyur pa'i sems can gcig kyang res 'ga' nye du dang dus gzhan dang gzhan du mdza' bshes brtse dung can du 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis dbyar dgun bzhin du brje bar nus pa yod de/ tshul 'dis mtha' yas pa'i sems can re re nas rang gi spun zla dang / tsha bo sogs gnyen bshes kyi khyad par gang du baspub kyang 'grub la/ sher phyin 'dum pa las kyang sems can thams cad phar 'du shes pa dang / spun 238
