pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/—ma zhes gsungs/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang / sems can kho rang tsho'i res la babs tshe/ khong tsho'i nus tshod kyis phan 'di ma btags bya ba dang /gnod pa 'di las ma bskyab bya ba med pas/ da ltar rang re rnams kyang byang chub gsum gang 'dod kyang bsgrub tu yod pa'i banas skabs su ched du bya ba bzhan don sgrub pa'i thabs la mi brtson na/ de dag gi re lhos su la 'cha'/ de dag sgro la ba'i res kyang gzhan su la 'bab snyam du sgo du ma dang / 'bad pa du mas legs par bsam/ ji skad bshad pa'i tshul kyis mar shes pa dang / drin dran pa dang / drin du gzo ba ste gsum po go rim bzhin du sbyang bas sems can yid du 'ong ba'i rnam pa can gyi blo ngang ngam shusas kyis skye ba na/ slar yang sems can gyi sdug basbal spyi dang bye brag dmyal ba ba rnams mtshon cha dang nad la sogs pa phyi dang nang gi 'tshe ba las byung ba'i sdug bsngal shugs drag la rgyun ring zhing bar mtshams med par 'byung ba rnams kyis mnar ba dang / de bzhin du yi dwags rnams kyang bkres skom dang tsha grang dang ngal dub la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs pas gzir zhing dud 'gro rnams sacig gis gcig za ba dang bkol spyod kyis 'tshe ba sogs dang mi rnams tshe thung zhing longs spyod nyams pa dang / 'dod lha rnams gzhan gyis tshar bcad pa dang / spa kong ba dang 'chi 'pho ltung ba sogs kyis nyam nga zhing srid rtse man chad kyi 'khor ba mtha' dag 'du byed kyi snyug 2 2

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7ma ma ba ma ra ma byang chub tu ma bsngos na lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor la smon pa tsam gyis rnam smin nyung ngur zad de/ mdo las/ mang po yangaXnyung ngur rigs par bya ste/ kun mkhyen du ma bsngos pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /de'ang gang bsngo na dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge rtsa mtha' dag /gang du bsngo na mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub 'thob cing phan pa dang bde ba'i rtsa laka rgyal bstan sde snod rin po che rnams dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du sanas par bya ba'i phyir bsngo ba nyid/ snying rje pad+ma dkar po'i mdo las/ sbyin pa 'dis bdag dbang bo'i gnas min tshangs pa'i 'jig rten 'bras bu mi 'dod na/ /rlung gi shusas ltar mgyogs shing g.yo ba rgyal po'i srid kyi dpal lta smos ci dgos/ /bdag gis gus pa chen pos sbyin pa 'di yi 'bras bu gang yin de yis ni/ /sems la dbang byed mtshungs med byang chub thob cing sems can rnams kyang sprol gyur cig /ces dang / spyod 'jug las/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur bste dang //bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig/ces so// gnas skabs su yang gang na 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyang mdzad phrin yar zla ltar 'phel zhing dge 'dun gyi 'dus pa rgya mtsho mtha' dag tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang / shes rab dri ma med pa la dbang 'byor zhing / yang das pa'i lam la banas 261

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4pa dang thugs mthun par bya ba'i phyir bsngo ba yang / de nyid las/mkhas pa rnams ni bkur ba dang //bsod stom dag kyang rnyed par shog/rgyud ni yongs su dag pa dang / /phyogs rnams kun du grags par shog /ces dang / rtas tu dge 'dun mthun pa dang / /dge 'dun don yang 'grub par shog /ces so/ /gzhan yang 'gro ba thams cad byang chub snying po ma thob kyi bar du bde ldan zhing sogs das pa'i zhing du skyes nas rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la slob pa'i ched du bsngo ba la sogs pa ste/ de dag kyang 'khor bsum bden med du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa ni gal che ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can/ /de yi byed pa mchog yin no/ /de ni mi dmigs rnam pa can/ /phyin ce ma log mtshan nyid do/ /ces so/ /de ltar bsngo ba la dgos pa ci yod ce na/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa las/ ji lta ra chu thigs rgya mtsho che nang lhung / /rgya mtsho ma skam bar du de mi 'dzad/ /de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dase ba yang //byang chub ma thob bar du de mi zad/ /ces so/ /de dag bis theg chen lam gyi snying bo khyad par gsum gyi rnam bzhag bsdus te gleng zin to/ /ces pa'ang sdom brtson gyi dge slong dam chos 'od zer gyis bskul ba ltar 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan du 'bod pas sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni nye sanas shākya'i ba tsun pa blo gros bzang ngo sa 'byis pa'o/ /dge'o/ /༄ / /rje btsun bla ma dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang 26 2

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir byang chub lam gyi rim pa la 'jug pa la/ thog mar lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis ji ltar khrid pa'i rim pa bzhin du bstan pa la blo sbyang tshul gnyis yod/ dang po lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten tshal ni/ bsten bya dge ba'i bshes gnyen ༄gyi mtshan nyid/ de bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas ji ltar bsten tshul/ de bsten pa'i phan yon ma bsten pa'i nyes dmigs dang bcas pa'i sgo nas bshad pa yin/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis ji ltar khrid pa'i rim pa bzhin du bstan pa ltar blo sbyang tshul de la dal ba'i rten la snying bo len par bskul ba dang / snying po ji ltar len pa'i tshul dngos bshad pa gnyis yod/ dang po dal ba'i rten la snying bo len par bskul ba ni/dal 'byor rnyed dka' sgom tshul gyis bstan/ snying po ji ltar len pa'i tshul dngos bshad pa de la/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam spyi'i rnam bzhag dang /bye brag so so'i lam gyi rnam bzhag bshad pa gnyis yod/ dang po de la skyes khu gsum gyi lam gyi grangs nges/ go rim/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam du bshad pa'i dgos pa/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi go don dang bzhi yod/dang po ni lar sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byung ba'i dgos pa ni sems can gyi don du yin la/ sems can gyi don la mngon mtho dang nges legs gnyis su grangs nges/ de'i phyir na de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan 263

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med brnyan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4ba r+yā ba4྾r+yā ྾pa rin po che yang gnas skabs mngon mtho dang mthar thug nges lesas sgrub pa'i thabs tshul gnyis su grangs nges/ de yang gnas skabs mngon mtho sgrub pa'i thabs tshul du gsungs pa'i chos skor rnams ni skyes du chung ngu'i lam gyi chos skor dang / chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i lam gyi chos skor ci rigs su ma 'dus pa med ni red/ nges legs la thar ba dang thams cad mapho pa gnyis las/ thar ba tsam sgrub pa'i thabs tshul du sasungs pa'i chos skor rnams ni/ skyes bu 'bring bi lam gyi chos skor dang 'bring dang thun mong ba'i lam gyi chos skor ci rigs su ma 'dus pa med pa yin/ thams cad mapho pa sprub pa'i thabs tshul du gsungs pa'i chos skor rnams ni skyes bu chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi chos skor du ma 'dus pa med ni red/ de'i phyir na de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa yongs rdzogs mdo hril gyis dril na skyes bu gsum gyi lam du grangs nges pa yin/ gnyis pa skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi bo rim ni/ dang po skyes bu chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i lam la blo sbyang /de nas skyes bu 'bring dang thun mong ba'i lam la blo sbyang / de nas skyes bu chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lam la blo sbyang ba ste/ rgo rim de ltar byas nas sgom dgos pa ma satogs/ dang po skyes bu chung 'bring dang thun mong gi lam la blo ma sbyang bar skyes bu chen po'i lam sgom du med pa yin ni red/ de'i rgyu mtshan skyes bu chen po'i lam gyi srog shing ngam 264

gtam tshogs/ za da/ 7— ྾ ྾ — 4 ྾྾4 rtsa ba lta bu ni snying rje chen po yin pas/ snying rje de ni sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las bdag gcig pus bsgral bar bya'o snyam pa'i blo gcig yin la/ blo de ni lar dang po rang nyid 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshul la bsam kyang 'jigs shing skrag pa'i blo cung zad kyang mi skye ba zhig la blo de gtan nas skye mi srid pa yin pa'i phyir na/ 'azing dang thun mong pa'i lam la blo sbyang dgos/ de yang 'khor ba mtha' dab sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du mthong nas de las thar 'dod kyi blo shugs drag skye ba la rang nyid ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshul bsam kyang ba spu g.yo ba tsam gyi 'jigs shing skrag pa'i blo yang med na 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du mthong nas de las thar 'dod kyi blo de skye sa med pas na skyes bu chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i lam la sngon du blo sbyang dgos ni red/ de ltar skyes bu gsum gyi lam yang go rim 'di ltar sgom dgos kyi/ de las gzhan du 'chol bar sgom na lam rgyud la skye mi srid pas/ go rim 'di kho na ltar sgom dbos ni yin gsung / gsum pa skyes bu gsum gyi lam du phye ba'i dgos pa ni/spyir rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du mgon po klu sgrub la sogs pa'i shing rta chen po dag gis ni mngon mtho dang nges legs sgrub pa'i thabs tshul dpag tu med pa gsungs kyang / bstan pa yongs rdzobs skyes bu gsum gyi lam du dril te/ de kho na la rtsal tu bton te 'chad pa cher ma mdzad/266

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7ba ma bstan na/ de'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho lta bu blor mi shong zhing / de la skur ba 'debs pa sogs don ma yin pa chen po 'byung bas na de la skyes bu chung 'bring dang thun mong gi lam nas khrid na/ de chung ngu dang 'bring gi lam gang gi skal ba can yin na yang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i lam der slob pa ma gtogs/ nyams 'ob tu mi tshud pa'i lam rnams la ma bslab kyang chob pas de don ma yin pa las zlog par 'gyur bas na/ blo 'bring la'ang phan che bas na blo rabaX'abring tha ma la phan che ba'i dgos pa zhes brjod ni yin/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal zhi ba'i dgos pa ni/ skyes bu chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i lam ni 'di'o/ /skyes bu 'bring dang thun mong ba'i lam ni 'di'o/ /skyes bu chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lam ni 'di'o/ /zhes bshad pa na/ rang bi rgyud na skyes du chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i lam tsam yang med bzhin du skyes khu chen po'i lam gyi yon tan yang yod do snyam pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal zhi ba'i dbos pa yod ni red/ bzhi ba skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi go don ni dper na skyes bu chung ngus tshe phyi ma'i 'khor ba'i phun tshogs kho na don banyer gyi blo dang / 'bring gis rang gcib pu zhi bde don gnyer gyi blo skyed pa lta bu ni/ skyes bu chen po'i lam gyi spang bya yin pas de dang thun mong min la/ 'dir gang yin na/ ngan song gsum gyi snyub bsngal la 'jigs shing skrag ste/ de las thar 'dod kyi blo skyed pa dang / 'khor ba 267

gtam tshogs/ pong/ 7྾ ྾྾྾ ྾྾྾gnyer gyi blo skyed pa dang / de bskyed nas thar ba'i lam dngos la ji ltar slob pa'i tshul gnyis yod/ dang po thar ba don gnyer gyi blo skyed pa la1 sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung bden pa la bsams te 'khor ba las nges par 'byung 'dod kyi blo skyed pa dang / rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi tshul bsams te 'khor ba las nges par 'byung 'dod kyi blo skyed pa gnyis yod/ de'i dang po la/ sdug bden 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs la bsams te 'khor ba dang 'bral dgos tshul dang / kun 'byung 'khor ba'i 'jug rim la bsams te 'khor ba dang 'bral nus tshul gnyis bsams pa'i sgo nas thar ba don gnyer gyi blo mtshan nyid tshang ba rang gi rgyud la skyed dgos ni red/ gnyis pa de bskyed nas thar ba'i lam dngos la ji ltar slob pa'i tshul la/ sems rnam par g.yeng ba med par byed pa lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ sems mnyam par ma bzhag pa mnyam par bzhag par byed pa lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ sems rnam par ma grol ba grol bar byed pa lhag pa shes rab kyi basbab pa dang sa/sum yod/ de'i nang nas ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab kyi bslab pa gnyis ni skyes bu 'bring gi lam rang dba' bar 'khrid pa'i skabs yin na skabs 'dir 'chad dgos na yang 'dir skyes bu chen po'i lam gyi sngon 'gror bshad pa'i skabs yin pas skyes bu chen po'i rang gi thun mong ma yin pa lam pha rol du phyin pa drus la slob pa'i 259

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/skabs su phar phyin rjes ma gnyis la slob par 'gyur bas na skabs 'dir de gnyis 'chad par mi mdzad la/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa tsam zhig dam pa gong ma dag gis 'dir 'chad par mdzad ni red/gsum pa skyes bu chen po'i lam gyi rnam bzhag bshad pa de la sems bskyed kyi phan yon bsam pa/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed tshul/ de bskyed nas spyod pa la ji ltar slob tshul dang gsum yod/ dang po sems bskyed kyi phan yon bsam pa de la/ jeg pa chen po'i yon tan dran zhing de'i 'jug sgo byang chub kyi sems nyag gcis yin pa'i tshul bsam pa dang /de las gzhan pa'i sems bskyed kyi phan yon bsam pa dang gnyis yod/gnyis pa byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i tshul la/ sems bskyed nyid ji ltar bsgom tshul dang / de brtan par bya ba'i ched du smon sems cho ga'i sgo nas ji ltar bzung ba'i tshul gnyis yod/ dang po la rgyal ba'i yum gyi dgongs pa slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra bo mi dang / ka ma shi la sogs kyis bkral ba ltar rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun ldan kye sgo nas byang chub kyi sems sgom tshul dang / sangs rgyas phal chen gyi dgongs pa slob dpon chen po zhi ba lha sogs kyis bkral ba lhar bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i sgo nas byang chub kyi sems sgom tshul zhig dang gnyis yod/ gnyis pa de brtan par bya ba'i ched du smon sems cho ga'i sgo nas ji ltar bzung ba'i tshul bshad pa de la/ dang po ma thob pa thob par byed pa'i thabs 260

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7ba ma ma dang / thob zin mi nyams par bsrung ba'i thabs/ nyams na phyir bcos pa'i thabs dang gsum yod/ dang po la gang las blang ba'i yul/ gang gis len pa'iXrten/ tshul ji ltar len pa'i cho ga sbyor dngos rjes gsum dang bcas pa yod la/ cho ga'i dngos sazhi ni/ byang chub snying bo'i bar du rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sems mi gtong ngo snyam pa'i sems bskyed dam bca' ba'i lcags kyu gnyis pas rang dbang du byed tshul de yin ni red/ gnyis pa thob zin mi nyams par bsrung ba'i thabs la/ skye ba 'dir sems bskyed mi nyams par gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i rgyu la bslab pa dang / skye ba gzhan du sems bskyed mi brjed pa'i rgyu la basbab pa gnyis yod/ dang po la sems bskyed la spro shugs 'phel ba'i phyir/dus drug tu sems bskyed kyi phan yon dran pa/ sems de nyid 'phel ba'i phyir dus drug tu byang chub kyi sems sbyang ba/ gang gi don du sems bskyed pa'i sems can blos mi gtong ba dang / sems bskyed kong 'phel du 'gro ba'i phyir tshogs sgo du ma nas gsogs pa dang bzhi yod/skye ba sazhan du sems bskyed mi brjed pa'i rgyu la bslab pa ni/ mchod 'os bslu ba dang / 'alhod med la 'alhod pa skyed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' la sku ba 'debs pa/ sems can la g.yo sgyu byed pa ste nag po'i chos bzhi'i gnyen po srog gi phyir du yang shes bzhin du rdzun mi smra ba la sogs pa'i dkar po'i chos bzhi la nan tan byed pa de yin/26/

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jirgas medabastan nyi'i gsu nga 'bum/r+yā྾ ྾ ྾྾—྾ ྾nyams na phyir bcos pa'i thabs ni/ sems bskyed satong ba dang / sems can blos 'dor ba gnyis gang byung kyang / sems bskyed gzhi nas bzung dgos ni red/ de las gzhan pa'i nyes pa rnams byung yang sems bskyed kyi gtong rgyu min pa dang / byang sdom ma blang ba'i gong yin pas ltung bar mi 'gyur na'ang / bar ma khas blang ba dang 'ab/la ba'i nyes spyod du 'gyur bas na gnyen po stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags sdom byed dbos ni red/ bsum pa sems bskyed nas spyod pa la ji ltar slob ba 'i tshul bshad pa de la/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la slob 'dod sbyang ba/ de 'byongs nas byang sdom cho ga'i sgo nas ji ltar bzung tshul/de bzung nas spyod pa la bslab pa'i rim pa dngos dang gsum yod/ dang po la/ sems tsam bskyed kyang rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa la ma bslab na rdzobs byang thob mi spid pa'i tshul dang de yang spyod pa nor ba las mi 'byung ba rwaX'athen pa las 'o ma mi 'byung ba lta bu dang / thabs shes ya bral lta bu'i spyod pa ma tshang ba las mi 'byung ba sa bon chu lud la sogs pa'i rkyen gcig ma tshang kyang myu gu bskyed mi nus pa lta bu'i tshul la bsam ste tshang la ma nor ba'i rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la slob 'dod thrur sbyang / bye brag byang sdom gyi skabs kyi bslab bya'i gnas phra raṭa thams cad la re re'i kha nas dmigs phugs te slob 'dod khyad par can skyed pa de nyid yin ni red/ de 'byongs nas byang sdom ji ltar bzung ba'i 26 2

gtam tshogs/ po ba/ 7྾ba ma ma ྾—ma bam 44tshul ni/ shing rta chen po gnyis kyi lugs srol gnyis la gang las blang ba'i yul slob dpon gyi khyad par/ gang gi len pa'i rten gyi khyad par/tshul ji ltar len pa'i cho ga'i khyad par/ blang nas bslab bya'i rkang grangs kyi khyad par sogs mang du yod par dpal ldan sa skya parnyi ta la sogs pa'i mkhas pa chen po dag gis bzhed ni red/ dke ba'i bshes gnyen sha ra ba la sogs pa'i mkhas pa ma/nga pos ni shing rta chen po gnyis kyi lugs la de 'dra'i rnam dbye mi bzhed par srol chen po sanyis gcig tu bsres pa'i rnam bzhag mdzad ni red/ ba/sum pa de bzung nas spyod pa la bslab pa'i rim pa dngos de la/ rang rgyud smin byed phar phyin drug la slob tshul dang gzhan rgyud smin byed bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la slob tshul gnyis yod/ dang po la phar phyin drug gi grangs nges/ bo rim/phyin drug dngos la slob tshul dang gsum yod/ dang po ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ mngon mtho la ltos pa'i grangs nges/ rang gzhan gyi don thams cad sgrub pa la ltos pa'i grangs nges/ gzhan don rnam pa thams cad la ltos pa'i grangs nges/ theg chen thams cad sdud pa la ltos ba'i grangs nges/ thabs kyi rnam pa thams cad pa la ltos pa'i grangs nges/ bslab pa gsum la ltos pa'i grangs nges te grangs nges kyi sgo drug yod par gsung ni red/ go rim la/ skye ba'i go rim/ dman mchos gi go rim/ raṭa phra'i go rim dang gsum yod/ de ltar phyin drug gi grangs dang go rim la 263

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7྾ ྾ ྾4 slob dgos ni red/ de yang sdom pa dang dam tshig tshul bzhin tu bsrung ba med na/ rgyud sde gang gi lam la zhugs kyang 'bras bu thob pa mi sred ni red/ sdom pa dang dam tshig tshul bzhin du bsrung ba yod na de las gzhan pa'i lam la brtson pa cher bskyed ma nus na'ang phar phyin theg pa'i lam gyis bskal chen grangs med pa sogs su sgrub dgos rgyu'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de/ skye ba bcu drug tshun la nges par 'grub par gsung ni red/ lam dngos la slob tshul ni/ bya spyod rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsum la dang po mtshan bcas dang / de nas mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor la brten nas thun mong gi dngos grub sngon du bsgrub/ de la brten nas mchog gi dngos grub sprub dgos/ de ltar thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa la ma ltos par mchog gi dngos grub sgrub mi nus ni red/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi skabs su gdul bya rin bo che lta bu'i gang zas yin na/ de'i thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa la ma lhos par yang / rim gnyis kyi nol 'byor la brten nas snyigs dus kyi tshe thung du gcig la zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang sgrub par byed ni red/ de las gzhan pa'i tsan dan lta bu la sogs pa'i gdul bya phal ba rnams kyi nang na dang po thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrubs te de la brten nas mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'ang yod ni yin gsung ni red lags/ de lhar sa gsum gyi rin po che gcika pu byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i sdom rags pa zhig /rje bla ma bka' drin mtshungs med ya bhā 267

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ya'i zhal snga nas mdun 'khod 'ga' zhig la brtse bas gdams pa bzhin de dag gis zin thor btab pa ltar ha lam pa'i zhu dag byas nas gsung 'bum gral du bzhag pa'o/ /༄/ /byang chu sems dpa'i rgyan gzungs kyi rin po che mi zad ba'i mjod ces bya ba/'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang du bdud rtsi'i gtong ba don sa/nyer rnams/ /rin chen chos kyi 'byor ba kun 'grub pa'i/ /gzungs rgya la yon tan phung po legs brnyes pa/ /'jam dbyangs sprol mdzad 'phags ma la btud nas/ /rang nyid dge ba rgya chen goms phyir dang / /skal mnyam gzhan la'ang don mang spel slad du//theg mchog gzungs kyi rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i tshul/ /mdo sde'i rjes 'brangs ji ltar nus bzhin bsdu/ /gang jis gang la ci yi phyir 'jug dang / /thabs gang zhika gis ji ltar 'jug pa dang / /zhugs nas don thob rang gi ngo bo yis/ /brtan pa rnams kyi gzungs 'di shes par bya/ /'jigs rung sdug bsngal stong gis gtses pa yi/ /srid pa'i chu mtshor bying ba'i rang nyams la/ /bsam shing skyo bas rab drangs mdzangs pa rnams/ /dang por yid ni zhi la ldang bar 'gyur/ /zhi ba de yi lam tshul mgon med 'gror/ /rtag tu mngon phyogs ji bzhin nyid gsung ba'i/ /bde gathegs nyi ma 'jig rten kun gyi blar/ /gcis pu snang la dang ba'i mig 'bur g.yo/ /'khor tshe pha mtha' yas pa'i sems can kun/ /bdag 268

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7ra ma bag rab brkyang / /sangs rgyas gsung rab 'od kyis ljon pa'i chab/ /drang ltar 'gro ba dman rnams mtho ris 'jug /bsam gtan gnas dang thos sgrosas bse ru dang / /byang chub mnyam pa med shul kun nas ston/ /gzungs ldan dpa' bo rigs pa'i mar me ni/ /mang bor spro bas 'jig rten brgyan byed de/ /de tshe de la lha mi mkhas pa kun/ /'di ni 'jig rten sgron mar 'gyur zhes dga'/ /dga' ba de las phun tshogs mi zad pa/ /nges par 'thob byed bsod nams phung sog ste/ /che ba'i bdag nyid rnams la nyon mongs dang / /bcas pa'i yid zhugs pa yang bde byed gsungs/ /phyogs bcur rgyal ba rnams kyis sa/zungs thob la/ /bsngags pa'i phreng ba bzang zhing mang ba dang / /phul byung dpe yi rgyan dang ldan sogs kyis/ /sems can dpag med theg mchog spro bar mdzad//mdor na dam chos ma lus 'dzin pa'i sgo/ /gzungs yin bde bar gshegs pa'i chos 'dzin pa/ /rgyal sras bslab kun 'du ba'i sdom yin phyir/ /de yi yon tan pha mtha' thug pa med/ /pha rol phyin min sems bskyed dgos mi rdzogs/ /chung rim ma bskyed gong ma mi 'thob phyir/ /brtan pa gzungs la ngoms pa mi skye zhing / /dman zhing phra ba la yang brnyas mi sems/ /de ltar yid ches mang du rnyed pa na/ /gzungs de skyed la 'dun pa yangs shing brtan/ /'dun pa'i dbang gis bskal ba brgya stong du/ /mi skyo brtson 'grus go cha sra ba 'byung / /byang chub sems dpa'i 271

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigasamed bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/brjod par bya dang byed du snang ba'i gzhi/ /mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med tshul shes nas/ yi ge'i brda la kun tu brtags tsam zhes/ /'jug pa drang don mdo rjes 'brangs rnams bzhed/ /lubs der chos bdag med pa mi bzhed dang / /bzhed la gzungs sgrub gtso bor gnod med kyi/ /blo dbang las min brjod bya rjod byed dag /'gog la brten bzhed shing rta che srol gzhan/ /ji ltar shing tog khar bcang ma bcas dang / /bcas dag ro bro tshor la khyad yod bzhin/ /brjod pa spyi tsam so sor de nyid don/ /dmigs pas mthu rtul ba dang rdon por 'gyur/ /rnam grangs du mas don dang tshig dag la/ /sbyang ba lhur len nyi che'i mthu can gyi/ /yid sa/zhung rgal nas ring por 'gro 'gyar phyir/ /gzangs kyi sgo la yi ge mang /nge ra ba ra byed por brjod/ /a sogs ma mo/ grangs ram brda sprod —/ /gzhung las rnam bzhag gzhad mdzad don dbang phyir/ /bstan bya ston dang nyan la rnam rtog pa'i/ /gnyen por 'bru brgyad sgo mtha' yas gsungs bzhin/ /skyes bu phung min phung las tha dad min/ /de la phung po'am phung la de brten min/ /phung dang skyes bu ngo bo nyid ldan min/ /de phyir skyes bu rang bzhin las mi 'thad/ /khams dang de yi yan lag das kyang ni/ /gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin bral ba yin/ /de bzhin dngos rnams bdag dang gzhan las sam/ /gnyis las ma yin rgyu med 'byung ba'ang min/ /yod pa'am med pa gang zhig skye 'gyur zhes/ /brtags kyang dngos po skye 276

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7ba 'ga' mi rnyed/ /gang tshe rang gi ngo bo mi mthong ba/ /de tshe de dag gzhan gyis bcos mar shes/ /rtog pas bcos ma rang bzhin stong ba'i tshul/ /gcig 'di rang gi gzhi las mang po ste/ /re re'ang cha la brten nas mang 'dogs phyir/ /yi ge'i phreng bar tshul mang spros nas bshad/ /sgra don sre la goms pa'i ngor byas nas/ /don las rjod byed nus pa tha dad du/ /dmigs par 'gyur te snyan dngags phreng ba la/ /sgeg dang dpa' ba la sogs nyams mthong bzhin/ /tshul 'dis de nyid don ston yi ge rnams/ /phur ba'i tshig gsungs bzod la spros pa yi/ /g.yeng ba bsdus pa'i shan phyir de yi phyir/ /dran pa 'byar ba yongs su mi 'phrogs yin/ /slu ba'i chos 'bigs gnyis su bgyir med pa'i/ /brjod byas rab brling zongs pa rtsa sacod phyir/ /rdo rje'i tshig yin de slad rgyal po yi/ /phyag rgya bzhin du yi ge'i tshogs nang brjid/ /shin tu rgyas pa'i stong nyid sngar bslab rnams/ /yig 'bru re rer nges pa'i tshig res kyang / chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor kun mthong ste/ /chos gcig sating mthong kun kyang thal ler snang / /dang po'i yi be tshig don de de yi/ /mtshan mar 'gyur phyir gzungs kyi phyag rgyar brjod/ /de yang mtshan mar byas nas nges pa'i tshig /yid byed blo yis don mngon brjod las 'gyur/ /ci 'dra'i rim goms de kho na bzhin du/ /'don pa mthong bas dbus mtha' mtshan ma min/ /mtshan mar bzung ba gsal brtan bul 277

5n+d+ra྾/ shā྾nga 4 sdu grub 'jing bye1 nga hūṃ hūṃ1 nga ༵ nga ༵4/ ba44—4'bum las sgar/ /gcig la 'arngug pa'i lam srang drang po yin/ /yi ge'i sgron ma sacig btegs 'byams klas pa'i/ /de nyid dbye ba dran yul gsal byed phyir/ /thams cad snang ba'o spebs pa zab mo'i gter/ /skye ba'i sbo'i phyir sa bon tshig ces bya/ /ming bang sngon du nges don la 'jub pa'i/ /yi se mi 'gro yod min kun nas sgo/ /thams cad rjes songagazungs dang brjod pa kun/ /sangs rgyas sasung bstan pa yang de ltar bshad/ /gzungs kyi rnam grangs dmigs ngas rgyas 'gyur phyir/ /sgo tshul mtha' yas zhes kyang bzhed pa yin/ /phyogs 'dis rnam pa'i rjes su 'jus/ la sosas/ /mdo yi tha snya da bzhan yang bshad par bya/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rgyan gzungs kyi rin po che mi zad pa'i mdzod 'as/bzod pa'i kazungs sprub tshul bye brag tu bshad pa'i banas te rim par phye ba gsum pa'o//rang mthus bzung ba yun ring chud mi za/ /mthu de shas che bas na gzungs su brjod/ /de yi rang bzhin dran pa gsal ba dang /brtan pa'i blo yin bsam gtan la sogs kyang / rgya cher dbye ba 'jig rten 'das le dang / /gzungs kyi rgyal bo'i mdo sogs sde snod las/ /bka' bang mdor bsnyus chos dang don dang ni/ /gsang sngasas bzod 'thob byed pa'i sazungs bzhir bshad/ /shin tu rgyas gzhung rnams kyang ji lta bur//thos pa'i tshul las lhag chad mi 'gyur zhing //rim pa mi nyams nge 280

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7chags pa'i blo/ /'bral ba'ang chags pa grub la med/6 /gnyen pos chags pa'i rgyun bkag na/ /chags pa chags par ma grub nyid/ /chags pa snang bzhin stong ba ste/ /rang bzhin med par gsal ba yin/7 /pa ni don dam zab mo'i sgo/ /chos kyi dbyings la don dam brjod/ /snang 'di bden par grub gyur na/ /don dam bden pa gtan med 'gyur/8 /'on kyang rten 'byung stong de'i phyir/ /don dam rigs pas grub pa yin/ /stong ba'ang rang mtshan ma grub mod/ /tha snyad tsam du bzhag pa nyid/9 /bden dngos kun rdzob tu'ang med/ /de phyir don dam yod ces bya/ /yang dag tu ni bden grub la/ /ltos nas ma bzhag don dam ci/ 10 /tsa ni 'chi 'pho med pa'i sgo/ /srog 'gaṭa pa la shi bar brjod/ /ci ste srog dbang gcig yin na/ /rgan dang gzhon pa ga la rung / 11 /srog dbang skad cig rang bzhin na/ /rdzun par grub pa ma yin nam/ /gang la srog ni yod min pa/ /de la de 'gag ci phyir yod/ 12 /ris mthun gnas pa ldog las gzhan/ /shi ba dngos med yin pa'i phyir/ /rang gi ngo bo tha snyad du'ang / /med par smra la bdag mi 'jigs/ 13 /na ni ming dang bral ba'i sgo/ /ming ni mnyam pa nyid la med/ /ming dang don la cha med na/ /brjod bya rjod byed mi srid 'gyur/14 /gal te de dag cha yod na/ /phan tshun ltos te bzhab par zad/ /brjod 'dod rtog las ming skye na/ /'dzin pas bzhag las ci zhig yod/ 15 /ming don blo yis ma bzhag na// 285

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7sgo drug dngos dang / de bsgom pa'i yon tan gnyis/ dang po la drug las/a'i sgo bshad pa la/ mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad sanyis/ dang po a ni sobs/ gnyis pa la bdag skye gzhan skye gnyis skye rgyu med las skye ba dgag pa/ mtha' gzhan pa'i skye ba dgag pa ste lnga las/ dang po bdag las sogs/ gnyis pa bzhan las sogs/ gsum pa gnyis las sogs/bzhi pa rgyu med sogs/ lnga pa de das sogs/ ra'i sgo bshad pa la mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ dang po ra ni sogs/ gnyis pa la/ chags pa rang nyid dgag pa dang / spang gnyen dgag pa dang / chags pa bden med du bstan pa dngos dang gsum/ dang po chags zin sogs/ gnyis pa yang dag sogs/ gsum pa chags pa sogs/ pa'i sgo bshad pa la/ bstan bshad gnyis/ dang po pa ni sogs/ gnyis pa la/ don dam nyid sgrub pa dang / de'ang blos bzhag par bstan pa dang / rang gi ngo bos stong par bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po snang 'di sogs/ gnyis pa stong ba'ang sogs/ gsum pa yang dag sogs/ tsa'i sgo bshad pa la/ bstan bshad gnyis/ dang po tsa ni sogs/ banyis pa la shi ba ngos bzung ba dang / srob dbang don dam par dgag pa dang / de ma grub pas srog 'gag pa ma grub pa dang / shi ba dngos med tha snyad du'ang med par bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po srog 'gag sogs/ gnyis pa ci ste sogs/ gsum pa gang la sogs/ bzhi ba ris mthun sobs/ na'i sgo bshad pa la/ bstan bshad 287

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med brnya na nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾྾ 4— 4྾ banyis/ dang po na ni sogs/ gnyis pa la/ ming don gcig tha dad du ma grub par bstan pa dang / ming don rtog btags su bstan pa/ ming don gyi chos nyid bstan pa dang gsum dang po ming dang sogs/ ba/nyis pa brjod 'dod sogs/ gsum pa rtog btags sogs/ dhī'i sgo bshad pa la/mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po dhī ni sogs/ gnyis pa la spyir bshad pa dang / bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni chos rab sogs/ kanyis pa la ji lta ba mapho pa dang / ji snyed pa gzibs pa bstan pa gnyis/ dang po rdul med sogs/ sanyis pa 'on kyang sogs/gnyis pa de'i yon tan bshad pa/ gnas 'di sogs/ mjug gi don la rtsom pa po'i ming bstan pa/ rtsom pa'i rgyu mtshan bstan pa dang / dbe ba bsngo ba/ brtsam pa'i gnas bstan pa ste sasum/ dang po cung zad sobs/sanyis pa/ byis pa sogs/ bzhi ba zhes pa'ang sogs so/ /zhes pa 'di yar lungapad+ma bkod rtsa gsum mkha' 'gro'i gling nas skad cig yid tsam lajis pa'o/ /༄/ /spyod 'jug dka' gnas gsal byed be+eḍūr+ya dbang po'i me long ba'ugs/'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur ba la phyas 'tshal lo/ /rab 'byams zhing gi rgyal ba rgya mapho mapho rab ni/ /zur phud lnga ba'i gzhon tshul gar gyis rnam rol ba/ /smra ba'i nyin byed 'jam mgon bla ma'i chu skyes zhabs/ /mi ldog mi phyed rtse gcig dang bas gtsug gis mchod/ /blo 288

pod/ 7 rdogrub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ na nyid la tshad mar song ba ma yin par thal/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/mig dang rna ba sna yang tshad ma min/ /lce dang lus dang yid kyang tshad min te/ /gal te dbang po 'di dag tshad yin na/ /'phags pa'i lam gyis su la ci zhig bya/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin du tshur mthong gis rtogs na 'phags lam gyis dkos pa med par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs la/ mkhas pa chen po thogs med ni/ 'jig rten na de dag grags pa tsam yin gyi tshad mas ni ma grub bo/ /zhes legs par bstan to//yang / gal te don dam mya ngan 'das/ /'khor ba kun rdzob de lta na/ /sangs rgyas kyang ni 'khor 'gyur bas/ /byang chub spyod pas ci zhig bya/ /zhes pa la/ myang 'das la rang bzhin rnam dag dang glo bur rnam dag gi myang 'das gnyis phye ma nus na/ lan mi jebs pas/ 'di ltar 'grel dgos te/ da lta sems can rnams kyang rang bzhin myang 'das yin te/de rnams don dam par bden med yin pa'i phyir te/ 'di ni chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin yin par/ shing rta chen po klu sgrub kyis/ rten cing 'brel 'byung ma gtogs pa'i/ /chos rnams yod pa ma yin no/ /de phyir stong nyid ma gtogs pa/ /chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pa'i phyir/ de lhar yin kyang sgyu ma ltar 'gro ba rnams srid par 'khor ba yang / mdo las/ /srid pa'i 'gro ba rmi lam bzhin du 'khor/ /zhes so/ /de'i gnas tshul mngon du 'gyur ba'i phyir/292

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7ma phyin drug yi lam sgyu ma ltar nyams su blangs pas/ sgyu ma lha bu'i rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs ldog tu bzlog ste/ sgyu ma lta bu'i 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur te/ dper na sgyu ma'i rta glang gi rang bzhin ma grub kyang de ltar snang ba de de'i rgyu rkyen rdzas sngags rgyun chad na de dag mi 'byung ba bzhin no/ /gal te rang rig yod min na/ /rnam shes dran par ji ltar 'gyur/ /gzhan myong ba dang 'brel ba las/ /dran 'gyur byi ba'i dug bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ rje tsong kha ba yab sras ni/ spyir dpal ldan grags pa la sogs sems tsam pa rnams kyi lugs la/ gang zag gi rgyud kyi sngo 'dzin mig shes de'i yul sngon po nam bzung ba dang dus mnyam du/sngo 'dzin mig shes nyams su myong ba'i rang rig des kyang sngo 'dzin mig shes nyams su myong bar 'dod la/ de'i sgrub byed kyang / myong ba'i rtags su yul can dran la/ myong ba la rang myong bzhan myong gnyis las/ gzhan pyong la gnyis te/ mig shes gnyis yod dam/ mig shes kyi skad cig dang pos yul sngon po bzung / de'i skad cig phyi mas de 'dzin nam/ dang po ltar na mdo las/ sems can rnams kyi rgyud ni re re ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal lo/ /gnyis pa ltar na/ gang zag de'i mig shes skad cig snga mas sngon po mthong la/ skad cig phyi ma de long bar thal lo /de'i phyir de ni rang myong yin no/ /zhes bzhed/ de'i lan/ dpe'i sgo nas 'debs te/ dug can byi bas rmugs pa lha bu ni/ mig shes kyi sngon po 293

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7 —ba ma bab —ba ba ser skya'i mig gis kyang mi mthong ba/ rdul nun snying stobs sasum cha mnyam pa'o/ /chen po'am blo zhes pa me long ngo gnyis pa lta bu/ phyi'i sgra sogs kyi rnam 'gyur dang nang skyes bu'i gzugs brnyan 'char ba'o/ /nga rgyal ni/ rnam 'gyur/ snying stobs/ mun pa can gyi nga rgyal te gsum mo//dang po las/ de tsam lnga 'byung ngo / /de las ni 'byung lnga 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa las/ ngag dang / lag pa dang / rkang ba dang / 'phongs dang /'dom ste lus dbang lnga dang / mig rna/ sna/ lce/ pags pa'i dbang po ste blo dbang lnga dang / yid dbang rnams 'byung / gsum pas ni de dag bi grogs byed do/ /de rnams kyang mu bzhir 'du ste/ ji skad du/ gtso bo byed yin bya ba min/ /chen po sogs bdun bya ba byed/ /bcu drug po ni bya ba yin/ /skyes bu bya min byed pa min/ /zhes pa ltar yin te bo sba/ yang nyer bsum kun rdzob dang / gtso bdag banyis don dam du 'dod do/ /de dag shes pas grol bar smra ste/ ral ba'am spyi bo'i cod pan sogs/ /cha lugs gang gis gnas kyang rung / /de tsam nyi shu lnga shes na/ /grol 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces so/ /de ltar rtosas nas lam bsgom pas mngon shes 'grub ste/ des gtso bo la bltas pas/ de skyengs nas rnam 'gyur rnams bsdus pa dang / skyes bu yan gar bar gnas pa la thar bar 'dod do/ /gnyis pa dbang phyug pa ni/ skye bo shes pa yod pa ma yin te/ bdag gi bde sdug bdag la rang dbang med/ /dbang phyug gis 2 96

pod1 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba bab 4 4 ba ba ba ྾ — bab —ba bab ba sheb 4ba 4bab ba —btang yang na g.yang sa'am/ /mtho ris dag tu 'gro ba kho nar 'gyur/ /'es pa ltar/ 'gro ba'i bde sbug dang legs nyes bzang ngan thams cad dbang phyub gis byas par grags shing / de'ang / bram ze 'dod la bram ze dang / /rgyal ribs 'dod la rgyal rigs dang / /nor rnams 'dod la nor rnams kyi/ /mchod sbyin dam pa yang dag brtsam/ /zhes pa ltar/ mchod sbyin legs na mtho ris dang / nyes na ngan 'gror 'gro bar khas 'ches/ /don drus 'dod pa ni 'di'i lugs kyi grub mtha' ste/ dbu ma rgyan las/ /rdzas dang yon tan las dang spyi/ /bye brag 'du ba rnam pa drub /ces so/ /de la rdzas ni/ bdag /dus/ phyogs/ yid/ nam mkha'/ sa chu re/ rlung ste dgu las/ rtag rdzas ni dang po lnga dang / mi rtag pa'i rdzas ni phyi ma bzhi yin no/ /yon tan ni/ sgra nam mkha'i yon tan/ dri sa'i1/ ro chu'i/ reg bya rlung gi/ kha dog me'i yon tan no/ /las ni lnga ste/ 'degs 'jog brkyang bskums 'gro ba'o/ /spyi ni chen po dang nyi tshe ba gnyis so/ /bye brag ni/ 'dre bar mi byed pa'i chos so/ /'du ba ni 'gogs pa'i sgo nas tha mi dad par gnas pa'o/ /khyab 'jug pa ni/ rig byed bzhi smra ste/skye bo dba' bar byed pa snyan ngag /rang sde rgyal bar byed pa srid bsrung /'di phyi'i don 'grub par byed pa mchod sbyin/ mchog sgrub byed nges brjod rnams so/ /rgyal ba pa ni/ tshig gi don dgu 'dod de/ gang zhe na/srog dang / zag pa dang / sdom pa dang / nges par rga ba dang / 'chi ba 296

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7ba ྾ ྾྾ ྾dang / las dang / sdig pa dang / bsod nams dang / thar ba'o/ /'di das ni/ shing sems can yin pa'i rtags su 'dab ma bcad na 'khum pa dang / lpags bshus na skam pa sogs dang / thar ba mdob dbyibs can yin par/ ji skad du/ kha ba rgya spos me tog dang / /ba zho ba mo/ mu tig mdog /gdugs dkar bzung ba'i dbyibs 'dra ba/ /thar ba yin par rgyal bas bshad/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa ni/ phur bu pa ste/ 'dis ni tshe snga phyi med la chos thams cad rgyu med yin no/ /zhes 'dzer te/ 'di skad du/pad+ma'i se sar su yis byas/ /rma bya'i ri mo su yis bris/ /tsher ma rnon po su yis brdar/ /thams cad rgyu med ngo bos byung / /zhes so/ /de rnams la tarka sde lnga zhes bya'o/ /'gog tshul ni gzhung na gsal lo/ /yang dbu ma'i gtan tshigs lnga ston te/ dang po gcig du bral gyi gtan tshigs ni/ don du snang ba 'di chos can/ dngos po dang dngos med kyi mtha' dang bral te/ gcig dang du ma gang du'ang ma grub pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rdo rje gzegs ma'i gtan tshigs ni/ snang bzhin pa 'di dag chos can/ don dam par bden med yin par thal/ bdag gzhan gang las kyang mi skye la rgyu med kyang ma yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yod med skye 'bos/ ni/ snang ba'i dngos po 'di dag chos can/ rang bzhin dngos med yin par thal/ngo bo yod med gang du'ang ma grub cing skye ba dang bral ba'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa don byed 'gog pa ni/ shes byar snang tsam chos can/ dngos por 297

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7ba ༷ bcad kyi sdug bsngal bsal nas ma smin pa smin pa dang / smin par grol bar bya'o zhes thugs bskyed pa ngo mtshar ba dang / de'i ched du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho'i sgo tshad med pa nas yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa'i brtson 'grus kyi 'jug pa ngo mtshar ba dang / shin tu rnam par dag pa'i zhing dang / yang dag par nges pa'i phung bo sha stag tu gyur ba'i 'khor dang / zhing tshad med par rgyas par 'geng ba'i grags pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi che ba mi zad pa'i 'bras bu yon tan ngo mtshar ba ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med kyi rnam par thar ba mdor bstan pa'o/ /de nas gzhung don bde ba can du skye ba'i rgyu bzhi'i skabs//sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang / daphe 'dun rjes su dran pa sgo ma pa satso bor byas pa'i gdams ngag /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med sras dang bcas pa'i sku'i rnam pa la brten nas yang dang yang du yid la byas te gus pa bskyed pa ni/ de na bcom ldan sogs so/ /mos gus phyag la sogs kyi skabs/ gus pa zhes bya ba ni/ yon tan dang yon tan can la bkur ba'i ngo tsha shes pa yin la/ des kun nas bsgangs pa'i lus ngag gi bya ba dang bcas pas phyag 'tshal ba yin no/ /chos sku snang ba mtha' yas zhes pa la/ spyir chos sku la 'bras bu chos sku dang ye shes chos sku gnyis yod pa yin zhing / snga ma spyi dang / phyi ma de'i bye brag yin la/ 'dir bshad pa 'bras bu chos skur 'thad do/ /'bras 299

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i bsung 'bum/—྾ ྾bu chos sku de la dbye na sku bzhi yod pa'i nang tshan 'di sprul sku ste/ nges pa lnga ldan gyi gzugs sku ni ma yin la/ gzugs skru ni yin pa'i phyir ro/ /nges pa lnga ldan min lugs ni dus nges pa 'khor ba ji spid du bzhugs par ston pa'i gzugs skru min pa'i phyir te/ sku pho tshad 'og tu bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /phyag bayas 'od zer las sprul sogs kyi skabs/ spyir 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs nyid de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpab med kyi 'khor du bshad pa dang sprul bar bshad pa sogs bshad tshul du ma yod kyang / don la 'gal ba med do/ /sor phreng bis zhus pa/'i mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs kyis sgyu ma sprul ba ni sems can mang po dag gis mi shes te/ sangs rgyas sgyu ma'i rgyal po'i sku che zhing / /de bzhin gshegs pa thabs kyi slu mnga' 'o/ /zhes bsungs pa ltar sangs rgyas rnams kyi yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir te thams cad mapho pa'i ye shes gcis nyid sku tha dad pa dang / gdung tha dad pa dang / mtshan tha dad du snang ba'i phyir ro/ /'di gzhan 'ga' la'ang mtshungs so/ /stong bsum 'jig rten rab 'byams sogs skabs/ mgon po 'od dpag med kyi mtshan thos pa tsam la'ang bsod nams de tsam du 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ mtshan de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa'i smon lam dang / tshul khrims dang / ting 'dzin dang / mngon par shes pa'i stobs kyis byin gyis rlabs pa'i mthu khyad par can du gyur ba'i phyir dang / de nyan pa 300

pod/ 7 rdo gruba'ajigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rnyogs pa dwangs pa/ srog chags sogs kyi dri ma med pa/ 'thung na mgrin pa la byams pa/ lto ba la nad kyi rgyur mi 'gyur ba'i gnod pa med pa rnams so/ /rin chen sna bdun them skas zhes pa'i rin chen sna bdun ni/gser/ dngul/ shel/ myu tig dmar po/ baiḍūr+ya/ rdo'i snying bo/ spug rnams so// /de'i 'og tu me tog pad+ma zhes pa 'di zlos par mi 'gyur ram/ me tog smos pas chog pa'i phyir zhe na/ me tog yin na pad+ma yin pas khyab pa med de/ ku mud bzhin no/ /de skad du spyod 'jug las/ me tog man+da ra dang pad+ma dang / /zhes sogs bshad pa bzhin te/ pad+ma ni zla 'od kyis kha zum zhing nyi mas 'byed pa/ me tog gi nang na nyi 'od kyis zum nas zla bas 'byed pa'ang yod pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la don chung yang blun po kha cis si/sa g.yar tsha ba'i rtsod pa de lta ba'ang bkod de/ de'i phyir yin ༄no/ / mngon shes lnga dang spyan lnga kun la mnga'/ /zhes pa la/ mngon shes ni/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten pa'i mngon sum gyi blo ma 'khrul ba yin la/ dbye na drug ste/ nam mkhar 'gro ba sos/sa byed pa rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes dang / thag ring thung gi sgra thos pa lha 'i rna ba'i dang / 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sazugs nye ring mthong zhing sems can gyi 'chi 'pho shes shing skye ba shes pa lha'i mig dang / tshe rabs snga ma mngon par dran pa sngon gnas rjes dran gyi dang / pha rol gyi sems shes 308

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7྾ 4྾'di'ang rje btsun bla ma tshwa na'i mtshan can gyi bzhedaskongs su gzhon nu 'jigs med pas gang dran bris pa dge bar gyur cig/maṅga lam/ /༄/ /bde legs snang ba stong brdal bde chen zhing / /'phags tshogs rgya mtshor bcas pa'i snang brnyan gzugs/ /ngo mtshar ri mo'i lam du bkod pa'i tshul/ rjod byed tshig phreng bsar ba bstar la rings/ /de la zhing khams kyi dbus su byang chub kyi shing yal 'dab dang lo ma dang / 'bras bu dang me tog phun sum tshogs pa rin po che'i dril g.yer dang gser gyi skud pa'i 'phyang 'phrul can/ de'i drung na mgon po 'od dpag med seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon na sems dpa' mchog gnyis/ mdun ngos su byang chub sems dpa'i dge slong pags pa gser ltar dri ma med cing dul ba'i ngang tshul can shin tu mang po/ gtso bo'i mdun du rjing bu dwangs la gsal ba'i nang na pad+ma'i sdong po kun nas mdzes pa'i steng mchod pa'i rdzas sna tshogs bkod pa bris na mdzes par snang / zhing gi mtha' skor du rin po che'i shing ljon pa rim gsum gyis bskor ba/ nasas tshal gyi nang nas bzhal med khang phyed tsam snang ba dang / rdzogs par snang ba du ma'i nang na mal stan gya nom pa bsngas khra bo can bkram pa la byang chub sems dpa' mang po 'dug pa/ de dag ṅga bar mtshams ci ribs par khrus kyi rdzing bu me tog gis khebs pa gang mang / me tog gi spubs na byang chub sems dpa' 311

n+d+ran+d+ra྾/ shātsu —4྾nga 41 zo~X nga 1 dzon+d+ra hūṃ 1 yu~X zo~X /brtse ྾nga —brdzus te skye ba mang bo lag mthil nas mchod sprin 'byung bzhin snang ba/steng gi bar snang la bde bar gshesas pa'i zhing snang du mar byang chub sems dpa' mang po rdzu 'phrul gyis rgyu zhing lab mjil nas byung ba'i mchod sprin spro ba/ de'i steng gi nam mkharasprin kha dog sna tshogs pa'i spu bas na mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis re tog sga char 'bebs pa dang/rin po che'i phreng ba 'dzin pa dang / spos phor 'dzin pa dang / bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun sbreng ba sosas kyis mdzes par byas na les/sa par mngon lags/ badz+ra nā tha'i dgyes skong du/ gang dran ca le co ler bris/ /rnam dpyod zhib mos legs dpyad na//mdo sde'i dgongs par 'di nye'o//nga //skal bzang skye dgu'i legs byas ras gzhi'i ngos//phul byung bde chen zhing gi ri mo'i dpal/ /smon lam pir gyis bris pa'i 'od ma/dzad lha/ /mtshan thos ngan 'gro'i 'jigs 'phrog de la'adud/ /bde chen zhing thang 'dri tshul dbus su byang chub kyi shing dbyibs legs shing lo 'azas re tog gi mdog sna tshogs su bkra ba rin po che dang dril bu g.yer kha'i dra ba sokas rgyan sna tshogs 'phyang ba'i drung du bzhal med khang yangs shing bkod legs pa'i dbus na 'od dpag med mdzes shing brjid chags la zhi ba'i sku can seng ge'i khri la bzhubs pa spyi 'gro ltar dang / de'i g.yas g.yon du sras kyi thu bo gnyis sku mdog dkar po phyag g.yas gnyis kyis gtso bo la rnga yab dkar po g.yob cing g.yon 31 2

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7ba ba ma ba gnyis pad+ma dkar po bsnam pa'i 'jib rten dbang phyug sga pad+ma kha gyes pa dang / mthu chen thob kyi kha 'bus kyi rnam pa can/ phyi khyams rin po che'i ra ba nyams dga' ba'i nang 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang kun tu bzang po sogs byang sems 'khor sgyur chas can dang / gzhon nu rab byung gi cha byad ci rigs pa/ de'i phyi rol du gzhi mnyam zhing tha gru yangs pa'i ne'u sing mdangs dga' bar gser 'od dang ldan pa'i pad+ma chen po dag dang / 'khor lo dang nor bu dang rin po che'i mgul rgyan dang / rna cha gdu bu dkar po sogs lha dang mi'i yo byad mang pos gang ba'i mtha' khrus kyi rdzing bu rin po che'i so phag ka ba ka sgrog sgrom leb rnams ji lhar rigs pa'i ra ba can gyi nye 'dabs na byang sems khrus kyi rtse ba dang lha'i chu bya rtse 'jos rgyags pa dang / rdzing ra'i phyi nas spos kyi shing phran skyes pa'i bar bar na me tog gi sdong bo mang pos bskor ba/ de 'dra ba'i khrus kyi rdzing bu gnyis sam gsum bris pa dag na tsan+dan dang a ka ru la sogs pa'i ljon shing rigs mi gcig pa du mas khebs pa/ shing de dag las lha rdzas kyi gos dang rin po che'i do shal nyis sprags dang chig rkyang la sogs pa'i rgyan gyi khyad par du ma 'phyang bas mdzes pa/ de dag rnams su rgyal ba'i sras po pad+ma las brdzus te 'byung ba dang / chos bgro ba dang bsam gtan byed pa sogs kyi rnam pa mang nyung 'tsham par bkod/ sa gzhi phyi mtha' ri bo'i bkod pa brag 313

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7pa'i don can yin par rdo rje rtse mo la sogs pa nas bshad na'ang /'di'i skabs sa ni oṃ aXhūṃ gsam po rdo rje gsam gyi snying bo la bshad dang sgyu ba da dngadagos pas/ oṃ gyi mtshan don ni/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku rdo rje ste/ lar sangs rgyas gzugs kyi sku thams cad kyang sku rdo rje yin mod/ gtso bor ni ye shes kyi rlung dbyings su 'khyil ba zhes bya ba/ bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi rten dag pa rlung gi cha bde ba chen po gnyug ma'i sems dang ngo bo gcig pa de nyid stobs su gyur ba'am nar son te/sngags bla med thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs kyi lus phra rags gsum du bye ba'i rags pa phyi nang gi lus gnyis dang / phra ba'i lus kyi nang tshan stong ba gsum gyi bzhon pa'i rlung gi khams mtha' das shin tu rnam par dag pa'i dbyings su rang zhi ba na sanyug ma'i rlung snang stong sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i phyag rgyar bzhengs pa la 'pho chen 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sbu zhes 'dogs pa yin la/ de nyid ni rang bzhin theg mchog rgyal bo'i lugs kyi sku rdo rje mthar thug pa'i 'jog tshul yin te/ bla med kyi rgyud gzhan na'ang tshe 'dir sgyu ma'i sku grub pa rnams tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya ba nges par gsungs shing / de'i tshe rags lus shul du bzhag ste snying ka'i ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba zhig 'tshang rgya ba min par ma zad bskyed rdzogs gang bsgom kyang rags pa'i lus dam tshig sems dpa' sprul sku lam byed du bsgom pa'i grub don lus rags pa'i rdzas rgyun kyang sangs 3)7

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7lugs mngon du gyur pa dag pa rab kyi mthar phyin pas rtag tu skye med spros pa dang bral ba'i de kho na nyid du mnyam par ma bzhag pa med pa'i rig stong ka nas dag pa la glo bur rnam dag gi yon tan yongs rdzogs su grub pa'am mngon du byas pa ni stobs bcu mi 'jigs bzhi la sobs pa sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i yon tan rab 'byams dang mi phyed pas na rdo rje'i sgra zhugs pa'o/ /de ltar na de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi rdo rje gsum gyi yon tan ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag thams cad rgyal dbang pad+ma ka ra'i gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin du rtsal rdzobs pa yin no zhes bstan pa ste/ da dung spyir mdo sngasas thun mong gi lugs/ bye brag gsang sngags bla med kyi lugs/ khyad par rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i zab gnad gzhan lta ci smos te/ blun phrug bdag gcig pos bshad kyang glegs bam gyi phung po chen por 'gyur pa tsam yod kyang sngar bshad ltar btsun phrus nged rang gi na tshod du long ba rnams dang rgan po byis pa'i ngang tshul can rnams la lde mig tsam zhib bzhag pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ badz+ra gu ru zhes pa ste/ bod skad du/ rdo rje'i bla ma zhes bsgyur rgyu yin no/ /de'ang yab sras mjal ba las/ dpa' bo chen po thabs mkhas che/ /sems can yongs su smin mdzad phyir/ /bye ba phrag brgyar rgyal nga nyid/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bstan gyur kyang / /da dung yang ni 'dren pa khyod/ /sangs rgyas 3 9

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7skyes pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs chen po dang lhan cig bde stong dga' chen rdo rje'i ting 'dzin gyi rol mo cir yang spel ba'i mthu la brten nas/sngags bla med kyi sbyor lam chos mchog dka' ba med par mngon du mdzad de/ za hor rgyal bo gtsug lag 'dzin dang o rgyan rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti gnyis kyi khab tu gshegs pa'i tshe sku zhugs la bzhen par brtsam pa'i tshe/ tsan+dan til mar gyis sbags pa'i me lce'ang bsil ba'i chu klung du bsgyur te/ yid las byung ba'i me tog gi sdong bo la bsil bsil phrum phrum ltar bstan pa la sogs pa bla med kyi sbyor lam chos mchog grub pa'i lag rjes su byung ba ste/ phar phyin theg pa thun mong gi lugs la'ang srid pa tha ma ba ni bdag nyid kyis kyang mi 'chi la gzhan gyis kyang mi 'chi ba kho nar mngon pa 'og ma nas bshad na bla med kyi chos mchog rten der rdo rje 'dzin pa'i 'pho med zang 'jug bi sku 'grub par nges zung ba ra zung da pa rnams la phya nang ka 'byung ba las gyur ba' gnad pa mtha' dag gis mi tshugs pa lta ci smos/ de la sogs pa brtul zhugs rdzu 'phrul gyi spyod pa byis pa'i blos gting dpag dka' ba rgya mtsho'i 'jings lta dus rang dang gzhan gyi don rlabs po che bsgrubs nas/ slar yang mi 'gyur lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dang chos rnams kyi de kho na nyid la gnyis snang gi mtshan ma shin tu phra ba'ang nye bar zhi ba'i rnam kun mchog ldan gyiXshes rab zab mo gnyis ro gcig ngo bo dbyer med du gyur ba'i don 321

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med ḍistan nyi'i ngasang 'ab/ nga dam 'od gsal ba'i grub pa mngon du mdzad pa'i phyir/ bal yul yang le shod du tshogs kyi spyod pa'i nye rgyu yang bsten nas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub mngon du bsgrubs te/ lam mchog yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshe dbang rig 'dzin du grab/sa pa sngags bla med kyi mthong lam thob pa yin te/ gsol 'debs rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub gnas der thob/ /ces gsungs shing / phyag rgya chen po'i mchog gi dngos grub ni sngags bla med du lam de nyid kyi dbang du byas pa'i mthong lam yin par kun mang rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pas bshad do/ /de ltar mchog grub nas kyang ye shes chen po de nyid durtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i mthu las sgom spang gi dri ma snang gsum phra ba'i bag chags dang bcas pa rnam par bcom ste/ mi slob pa'i lam mthar phyin lhun grub rig 'dzin gyis la bzhugs shing / rnga yab sprul ba'i grong khyer du da lta'ang 'chi med sayung drung lta bu'i bzub/sa skur lhun gyis grub cing / bod khams bstan 'gro'i dpal mabon du 'khon 'jam dbyangs bdun rgyud dang / jo 'brom rnam gnyis/ bsil ljongs shing rta rnam gsum la sogs pa rdo rje'i bla ma sngags rigs grub pa'i ded dpon tshad med pa'i rnam rol rgyun mi chad pa yin no/ /mdor na bla ma'i skad dod gu ru ste/ gu ṇa zhes pa yon tan gyi skad dod dang/ ru lci ba'i don can yin pas/ slob dpon chen po thugs yon tan gyis 32 2

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7nga pa thams cad kyang bshad ma thag pa 'dra ba sha stag yin pas de'i sgo nas pad+ma zhes 'dogs rgyu yin na 'phags bod kyi grub chen mtha' dag la pad+ma zhes 'dogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes blun dpyad ma bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod/ lag na rdo rje la sogs pa rnams la'ang snying rje chen po tshad med pa yod mod kyi/ de dab la rnam thar gyi sgo gzhan nas mtshan btags shing / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la yon tan gyi sgo de nyid nas mtshan btags pa bzhin no/ /yang gong gi longs spyod dang byed las de dag min pa'i slob dpon rin po che'i rnam par thar ba tshad med na pad+ma zhes yon tan gyi phyogs 'ga' zhig nas brtsam pa 'di ci ste gsungs zhe na/ lar gong gi longs spyod dang byed las de dag tu sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad 'du tshul yang rgya cher bsgrub tu yod mod/ der ma zad lar yon tan thams cad nas ming 'dogs dgos pa'i nges pa'ang med de/ 'jig rten kyi gtam rgyud du'ang khyab 'jug la lha ma yin 'khar ba bsad pa'i che ba ma yin pa de'i yon tan bgrang ba gzhan yang yod de/ de lta na'ang khyab 'jug 'khar ba'i dgra zer ba bzhin no/ khyab 'jug la 'khar ba'i dgra kho nar ma zad de/ ming gi sgo gzhan yang yod do zhe na/ slob dpon chen po la'ang mtshan brgyad/ 'phrul mtshan nyi shu la sogs pa mtshan gyi sgo tshad med pa yod de kha shags la don chung bar shes nas de tsam mo/ /gnyis 325

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/—྾ ྾྾na gu ṇa ru zhes pa bsdus te gu ru zhes gsungs pa 'dis bstan/ pad+ma ni slob dpon chen po'i mtshan yin pa go sla/ dngos grub zer rgyu de la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub mang po yod kyang / deng sang bi mi bsam chung mo khab mig gang tshod dang ban+tu na na/ rta khyog dang g.yag khyog mang ba/ be'u lug gi 'phel ka che ba/ nya shi god log mi 'ong ba sogs yin par 'dug /hūṃ zhes pa dang sidzhai dngos grub de s+dzawī cig par bskul ba yin/ rgya cher na sngags kyi rgyal bo 'di lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa dang sbyar te bshad na thin tu legs mod kyi re zhib de tsam ste/ gang dran rtsam khub sprug pa ltar 'god pa ba/ti thug bi las ka yin par thos so/ /dkor chog grwar shes nyul ba'i ban gzhon dang / /gto sgrub yu nga rdog btso 'dra'i bla sar tsho/ /sngags don 'di 'dra tsam yang mi mapho na/ /dad zas rnam smin bsam tshe mchi ma bku/ /zhes pa'ang gzhon nu kun bzang 'jigs med lhun grub rang byung gi dpal mo byang grol rnga yab gsar ba'i chun 'phyang can gyisabarjod pa 'dis kyang der snang bya 'grub pa'i bla dwags can rnam par sdud pa la rang dbang 'byor ba'i rgyur gyur cig gu/ /༄/ /bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi mdo chings tshigs bcad du phab pa dad pa'i pad+ma rgyas pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba/gang zhig shar bas thos med dus ring nas/ /bsags pa'i gti mug mun pa'i rdul dengs shing / /legs rgu'i yon tan chu gter rgyas 328

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba sgrub pa yis/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan mthar phyin shog23 /ces pa'ang chos grogasasdom brtson dam pa tshul khrims nor bu nas bshes gnyen bstenatshul gyi mdo chings tshigs bcad du phab pa zhig dgos zhes pa bskul ba ltar sprang spyon 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas shar mar sbyar ba maṅga lam/ /ra / /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid pa'i bde sdug dngos kun sems las byung / /'khrul dang grol ba sanyis char sems kyis byas/ /de phyir rang sems 'dul ba'i man ngag la/ /gcigs su 'dzin pa 'dun ma'i 'gro phyogs bzang / /sems 'dul thabs mchog theg pa che chung dang / /theg chen mdo sngags gsang sngasas phyi nang gi /lta sgo ma spyod pa'i rnam grangs mtha' yas las/ /mthar thug snying bo rdo rje rtse mo yin/ /de yi gnad sasang rgya mtsho ltar zab cing / /mkha' ltar rgya che byis blos dpag dka' yang / /'gag don sems dang rig pa shan phye ste/ /rig pa rkyang 'ded byed pa gcig pur 'dus/ /yul gyis ma bos sems kyis ma bcings shing / /dpyad 'jog thabs kyis gsar du byas min pa/ /spang blang bsal bzhag bral ba'i rang babs kyi/ /shes rig ma bcos thad kar skyong ba gces/ /gang ltar brtags kyang blo yi ri mo ste/ /ci tsam bcos kyang kun rtog spros pa'i gzeb/ /ngos bzung bsam yul las 'das rig pa'i gshis/ /gtad med ngang la 'dzin med lhug par zhog /sna tshogs yul snang sgyu ma'i bslu brid dang / /bzang ngan phra rags rnam 33 2

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7rtog spre'u'i gar/ /ji ltar shar yang glang bo'i lta stangs kyis/ /bor te zang thal rig pa rang so bzung / /de la gad med g.yang med 'phrang dang bral/ /gol shor nor gsum zer ba tshig tu zad/ /rgya yan khyab gdal rig pa'i bde thang nas/ /sku lnga'i sa la mig 'phrul bzhin du sleb/ /chos 'di skal ldan spyi yi nor yin kyang / /lhag par mos gus dam tshig ldan pa dang / /blo brtan brtson 'grus can gyi nor yin phyir/ /brtson pas rtse gcig sgrub la snying stobs skyed/ ces pa'ang chos shulaXbla ma mthu dpal gyi ngor 'jigs med bstan nyis spras rim bzhin dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis bris pa dge/ /༄ / /bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhi gyur thar lam bdud rtsi skyon med pa/ /rnam dka thos bsam sgom pa'i 'jug ngogs mchog /mtshan ldan dam pa'i zhal nas thos na yang / /don bzhin rang gi rgyud la sbyar ba nyung / /thos pas gzhung mang mtha' rgya gcod nus shing / /bshad pa tshig gi lo 'dab mang gyur kyang / /gnad don nyams len gcig la ma dril na/ /gdams ngag stong gi mdo don stor ba lags/ /'on kyang mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod btsun pa'i tshul/ /grub pa'i grags snyan khri dang bye ba brgya/ /dang po thos pa dam pa'i lag rjes su/ /'byung phyir thos pa nor bu'i gter mdzod yin/ /gang zhig shes na thog med dus ring nas/ /goms pa'i nyes spyod sgo mo bcad dka' ba/ /bag yod yon tan sta re non po yis/ /gcod pa'i yu ba mchog gcig thos 333

gtam tshogs/ ngo da/ 7྾ ྾྾tshigs bcad gcig phyir brtson mdzad na/ /gong ma'i sku skyes yin kyang mi 'ong gi /dang po thos pa dam pa'i zhal skyems bzhes/ /stong chen 'jig rten mes po tshangs pas kyang / /gdol spyod spyig ma mkhan las chos mnyan na/ /mthon po'i dpon bla yin yang ci lto ste/ /thos pa skye dgu'i gnyen 'dir spyi bos thud/ /chen por grags pa'i drang srong rgyas pas kyang / /thub la nyi tsher gyur pa'i chos dris na/ /ston chen stobs 'byor dresas pa'i mi chog gis/ /thos pa yon tan tshog/sa mang 'dir zhugs shib /btsan yang sdib pa dpung dang bsdur rgyu med/ /phyug kyang thar ba nyo ru mi btub na/ /dregs ldan rgyal po yin yang mi 'ong gi/ /mang thos mkhas pa'i zhabs rdul byi bos longs mtho yang thos pa gsug 'bul len med cing / /dma' yang thos pa brnyas thabs byed med de/ /dpa' bo gang zhig klog pa'i nan tan can/ /de dag snying la thos mang sog par 'gyur/ /skyob pa'i skyabs su thos pa 'jig rten mig /mthun pa'i yon tan nor brgya'i mchog ster zhing / /mi mthun nyes pa stong gi dgra gsod pa/ /'di la brten na dus kun bslu ba med/ /spyod pa'i khyad nor thos pa rin chen gter/ /rnam grol 'dod dgu'i dga' ston 'dis sbyin te/ /bskal mang goms pa'i mi shes dbul ba yang /'di la brten na rtsa spur me chen bzhin/ /mthun pa'i gnyen bshes thos pa legs dgu'i gnyen/ /ma 'dris mdza' bshes gcig gyur 'di yin te//335

zad/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i bsung 'bum/ba ba ma ma 'byor ba'i dus dang rgud pa'i dus kun tu/ /phan dang bde ba'i gzhi gyur 'di kho na/ /sngar zhig thos pa lung gi ba dan 'dis/ /yang dag ltar snang thang sha gcod mod de/ /da ni ston chen rta thog rnyed bkur 'dis/ /zob po grub brdzu'i dbu 'phang mtho ba lags/ /sngar zhig thos pa rigs pa'i ral gri 'di/ /chos min zhags pa gcod pa'i mtshon cha ste/ /da ni gzu lum bstan sel sde 'khrubs 'dis/ /chos min smra ba shed kyis bkur ba mang / /sngar zhis legs bshad thos pa'i me tog 'dis/ /blo gsal stong gi dus ston byas skad de/ /da ni thos sgog tshig gi sbun pa zhes/ /sgom chen stong gi rna ba rtag tu 'geb/ /sngar zhig thos pa nyams len gter mdzod de/ /dgra bcom khri phrag khri brgya'i gshegs shul nyid/ /da ni thos pa sgom gyi gshed ma ru/ /mthong ba'i rtogs ldan yi dreg pa tsam/ /'dod pa'i khol bo skyed ma bsad pa yang / /rgyal ba'i sde snod mang du thos pa las/ /mnar med dmyal bar dar gyi pho lung tsam/ /song nas 'chi med lha brgyas bsus zhes thos/ /chakas sdang tsher ma'i dbal kyang mi chos pa'i/ /zab drabs nyams len mthon po'iXlta stangs 'di/ /bzhag nas thos pa yon tan rin po che'i/ /gter mdzod dga' ba'i tshal 'dir zhusas na lesas/ /thos pa bdud rtsi'i rdul mang rna ba ru/ /son pa'i bgo skal lag tu thob na yang / /thos don rang gi rgyud dang ma sbyar na/ /tshig tsam snying bor re ba byis pa yin/ /sngon du rang sems chos su 336

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/྾ ྾mda'i 'khrul 'khor lhur blangs pa/ /nor ldan sha ba rog po'i gtsug tu 'bab/10 /dal ba min pa'i brtul zhugs brgya phrag gis/ /snyed dang bkur bste'i khyad nor rab bsags shing / /grags pa'i dung chen srid pa'i khor bus kyang / /nam zhig snang ba med pa'i phyogs su 'gro/ 11 /'du 'tsho ltad mos dga' ba mi 'phel zhing / /rnam g.yeng bzhin ras 'god la mi phyogs par/ /sbyang ba'i yon tan me tog 'dun khang du/ /'jub la rings par rings par chas de mtshar/ 12 /sman gyi nasas tshal ring nas bshams pa bzhin/ /rdo leb khri stan lag pas bkram pa bzhin/ /khu byug bu mos rgyang grus bsu ba bzhin/ /bsam gtan 'dod rnams da ni gshegs re ran/ 13 /dpya khral cod pan 'chang ba'i sa bdab dang / /gla rngan slong mor slong ba'i bran g.yog dang / /dga' gcugs zhags pa skyong ba'i mdza' bshes kyis/ /zhi ba'i nags 'dabs btang ba 'ba' zhig yin/ 14 /bsog bsrung spel ba'i cho gas ma brel zhing / /'khon zhen rtog pa'i khur chen ma bzung bar/ /dben pa'i nags rir ting 'dzin 'byor tshogs can/ /spong ba pa de bde zhing bde ba lag/sa/15 /lhun sbug ri bo lha yul ri 'dra bar/ /dus bzhi'i ri mo bris pa ltar snang bas/ /chos kyi sdom bzhi'i thog mar mtshon bgyid de/ /thar 'dod rnams la dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin/ 16 /mtha' dang dbus med kun khyab gdal ba che/ /'gro 'ong mtshan ma gzhar yang 340

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7dmigs min pa'i/ /dri med mkha' dbyings shin tu zhi ba 'dis/ /mya ngan 'das pa spros kun zhi bar ston/ 17 /spu sdug lha bya bya wang mgrin pa'i shing / khra glag drag shul dgra sta'i drungs phyung ste/ khrag gi skyang nul yang dang yang btab pas/ /srid khams sdug bsngal phung bo mtshon min nam/18 /nags kyi sman ljongs dwangs zhing gtsang ba'i ngogs/ /smig rgyu'i stod g.yoṭa bkab pa bzhin gyur ba'i/ /rten 'byung snang ba snang bzhin stong ngo zhes/ /rtogs par dka' ba'i chos tshul zab mo 'dom/19 /chos kyi sdom bzhi'i brda' thabs 'di 'dra ba/ /zhi ba'i nags sa ༄ltad mor bkram nas sbar/ /bde ba'i tshogs chas bde ba mchog ster ba'i/ /rnal 'byor can la phu dud ri mor byed/20 /lcug ma'i phang phung rnam rgyal lha'i khang bzang / /shing bal gzhon nu'i lhab lhub 'bum g.yo zhing / /ri skyes lha mo'i blos gar rtsen pa na/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug lha dbang bzhin du brjid/ 21 /mar gad zhun mar bzhus 'dra'i nags 'dabs la/ /dri bzhon reg pa 'jam pos 'dzum byin pas/ /bsil bcud bdud rtsi'i bgo skal mchog sbyin te/ /rnga yab de 'dras bsam gtan 'dod rnams mdzes/ 22 /lhod lhod 'dab ma skyod pa'i rkang 'thung dbang / /'bol 'jam shing lo'i reg pa khrag khrig gis/ /gtsug phud yang dang yang du nyer byugs pas/ /bsam gtan sgom la dbugs 'byin byed pa bzhin/ 23 /sprin dkar kha yi zegs ma skyug pa'i chus/ / 341

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7ba ba ༄/ /bden gnyis kyi rnam par bzhag pa don bzang me hog rgyas pa'i ljon shing bzhugs/lha yi lha mchog 'jig rten 'dren pa shākya'i dbang / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ma pham pa/ /thub bstan 'dren pa'i shing rta chen po rnam gnyis sogs/ /bde gshegs slob mar bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig legs par shes gyur na/ /yon tan tshad med dang ldan pa'i/ /bden gnyis rnam par bzhas/ pa ni/ /shin tu bsdus te gsal bar bya/ /de la bden gnyis gtan la phab pa'i phan yon/ bden gnyis ma shes pa'i nyes dmigs/ bden gnyis kyi go rim/bden gnyis gtan la 'beb tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ bden gnyis chos can/ gtan la phab pa la dgos pa yod de/ ka ma shi las/ bden gnyis rnam dbye shes pa dag /thub pa'i bka' la mi rmongs te/ /de dag maXlus tshogs bsags nas/ /phun tshogs pha rol 'gro ba nyid/ /ces bden gnyis shes pas ston pa'i gsung rab la rmongs pa med pa'i shes rab 'thob cing de la brten nas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa la 'gro bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bden gnyis chos can/ khyod ma shes pa la nyes skyon yod de/ dpal ldan zla bas/ kun rdzob bden pa thabs su gyur ba dang / /don dam bden pa thabs byung gyur ba ste/ /bden gnyis rnam 3 43

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾྾ ྾dbye gang gis mi shes pa/ /de ni rnam rtog log pa'i lam ngan zhugs/ /zhes bden gnyis ma shes pas bde bar gshebs pa'i gsung rab la rmongs pa la sogs pa dang chabs cig tu gnas par gsungs pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/ bden gnyis chos can/ lo la go rim yod de/ zhi ba lhas/brtags pa'i dngos la ma reg par/ /de yi dngos med 'dzin ma yin/ /zhes bya ba sogs gsung ba ltar kun rdzob bden pa'i mtshan gzhi nges par byas rjes/ de nyid blo gnod med la snang ba'i dbang gis bzhas tsam ma yin par yul rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i sdod lugs kyis grub pas stong ba'i don dam bden pa nges par byas te/ de'i rjes su kun rdzob bden pa nges dgos pa'i phyir/ bzhi ba la/ bden gnyis kyi dbye sazhi/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sgra don/ gcig tha dad brtags pa/gtan la 'beb byed kyi rigs pa/ de ltar nyams su blang ba'i lag rjes kyi rim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bden gnyis chos can/ lo la dbye gzhi yod de/ shes bya tsam yin pa'i phyir/ sanyis pa ni/ kun rdzob bden pa chos can/ lo la mtshan nyid yod de/ tha snyad dpyod byed kyi tshad mas rnyed don gang zhig /tha snyad dpyod byed kyi tshad ma rang nyid la tha snyad dpyod byed kyi tshad mar song ba de yin pa'i phyir/ don dam bden pa chos can/po la mtshan nyid yod de/ mthar thug dpyod byed kyi tshad mas rnyed don gang zhig /mthar thug dpyod byed kyi tshad ma rang nyid la mthar 34 4

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7thug dpyod byed kyi tshad mar song ba de yin pa'i phyir/ de yang sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mthar thug dpyod byed kyi blo chos can/ tha snyad dpyod byed kyi tshad ma yin par thal/ khyod rnam mkhyen yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod kyi kun rdzob bden pa gnyis sna nga dang bcas pa'i tshul gyis rtogs par thal/ de tha snyad dpyod byed kyi blo yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na rigs so/ /de chos can/ khyod kun rdzob rang nyid la tha snyad dpyod byed kyi tshad mar song bar thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ khyod kyi gzhal bya kun rdzob bden pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags ma grub zer na/ de chos can/ der thal/ khyod tha snya da dpyod byed kyi blo yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na dam bca' snga ma dang 'gal lo/ /gsum paXni/ bden gnyis chos can/ khyod la dbye ba yod de/ kun rdzob bden pa dang don dam bden pa gnyis po de yin pa'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ spyod 'jug las/ kun rdzob dang ni don dam ste/ /'di ni bden pa gnyis su 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ dang po chos can/ khyod la dbye ba yod de/ yang log gi kun rdzob gnyis yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/der thal/ bden gnyis las/ snang du 'dra yang don byed dag /nus pa'i phyir dang mi nus phyir/ /yang dag yang dag ma yin pa'i/ /kun rdzob kyi ni dbye ba byas/ /zhes rang snang ba'i blo la snang ba ltar don byed nus mi nus gnyis su gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa chos can/ khyod la dbye ba 31 6

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga ma dbos shing / gsum pa 'dod na cha bcas ma yin pa'i sa/zhi grub zhig khas len dgos pas dam bca' thabs rdugs yin no/ /bdun pa ni/bden gnyis chos can/ khyod nyams su blang ba la dgos pa yod de/ dadu ma chen po'i don glu'i lam nas drang bar/ gzung 'dzin sna tshogs 'di a ma'i 'dzum bag /skye 'chi 'pho 'gyur 'di a ma'i rdzun tshig /ces pa ltar chos thams cad bden med du rtogs pa la sobs pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/ 'di ltar rtsom po'ang blo gros mthu/ /ches cher dman pas 'gal 'khru' dris/ /gos gyur nongs pa ci mchis pa/ /dam pa rnams kyis bzod par mdzod/ /'dir 'bad dge ba chu 'dzin gzhon nu'i dpal yon las/ /phan dang bde ba'i gru char chen po'i rgyun 'byung ste/ /ris med 'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing du rnam mkhyen gyi/ /'bras bzang rdzogs nas don gnyis lhun grub 'byung bar shog /bden gnyis kyi rnam par bzhag pa don bzang me tog rgyas pa'i ljon shing zhes bya ba rmongs pa'i blo mnga' byis pa 'jigs med pas o rgyan gyi paṇ+ḍi ta pad+ma saṃ bha bas byin gyis rlabs pa'i tshes bcu'i dus chen porasbyar ba rdzogs so/ /dge'o/ /༄/ /mchod pa'i gtam shīn tu nyung ngu me hog gi sgrom zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam 'phrul mi zad pas/ /rgyal dang de sras dgyes pa skong mdzad pa//'jam dpal dpa' bo'i rnam thar rjes dran zhing / /gang 348

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7zhabs phyag gis mchod nas gtam 'di spro/ /de la 'di skad du/ blo ldan gang zhig 'phral dang yun du dge leg phun sum tshosas pa don du gnyer ba de dag gis ni yon gyi gnas chen po bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas la mchod pa rnam pa du mas bste bstang du byas la bsod nams ches mang po bsags dgos pas 'dir de'i tshul nyung ngur bshad pa la/mchod pa'i zhing bstan pa/ mchod pa'i rdzas bshad pa/ mchod pa'i tshul brjod pa/ mchod pa'i phan yon smos pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni//mchod pa zhes bya ba yon gyi gnas la yon stob pa yin zhing / yon gyi gnas su 'os pa dang mi 'os pa yon tan dang ldan pa dang mi ldan pas phye ste/ de'i phyir rgyal ba sras bcas ni yon yongs sa sbyong ba ste/ sbyin ༄bdag gis bsod nams kyi zhing du dmigs te phul ba don mthun du 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ de dag la yon tan phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir bsngags 'os bsngags bstod las/ khyod dang 'dra ba'i zhing dag ni/ /'jig rten gsum na ma mchis te/ khyod ni yon gnas rnams kyi mchog /gral gtsang mdzad pas gtsang ma lags/ /zhes gsungs/ de dag tshogs kyi zhing du spyan drangs pa bzhin du 'byon par yang nges te/ 'byon pa'i gegs med pa'i phyir ro/ /spyan drangs par mi mkhyen pa'am/ mkhyen kyang yon gnas la mi brtse ba'am/ mkhyen cing brtse bar gyur kyang 'byon pa'i mthu med pa rnams dang bral la/ mkhyen 349

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jikas med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾྾ ྾pa'i ye shes/ mi dmigs pa'i thugs rje/ thogs pa med pa'i mthu rlabs po mnga' ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ dngos su bshams pa'i mchod rdzas rang gi lus dang longs spyod gya noms pa rnams dang / yid las byung ba'i lha'i me tog marnya ra ba dang / pa ra shi ka dang / dong ka chen po dang /me tog sna ma la sogs pa dang / bdug sbos dam pa glang bo'i snying bo/ a ka ru nag po dang / tsan+dan sa mchog dang / tsan+dan sa steng dam pa la sogs pa dang / sgron ma 'bar ba nyi ma dang zla ba lta bu'i 'od zer can rnam pa du ma dag dang / rnga pa ṭa ha dang dung dkar dang / mkhar rnga dang gim pa la dang / rgyud mang la sogs pa rol mo'i bye brag sna tshosas pa nam mkha' rab 'byams kyi po rgyas par 'geng bar bsam de yang me tog gcig pu nyid kyang bla bre dang / rgyal mtshan dang / rkon bu dang / sil mar bkram pa la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad mngon par 'phrul te rgyal ba rnams la mchod de/ dkon mchog ta la las/ me tos phal cher me tog bla bre dang / /me tog kod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste/me tog sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /ces so/ /gsum pa ni/ dngos bshams kyi mchod rdzas rnams kyang / log 'tshos sbags pa ma yin pa dang / ser sna dang brnyas thabs la sogs pa med pa/ gnas khang byi dor bya zhing chags chags gdab pa dang / yo byad la gtsang sbra 'don pa sngon du song nas/ sbos 360

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ — ྾ ྾pa'i dbang gis bskal pa khrag khrig mang por bsod nams kyi mthu 'phel bar 'gyur te/ mdo sangs rgyas kyi yon tan balngags pa las/gang dag ston pa bde bshegs la/ /mchod pa chung ngu byed pa yang / /lha mi'i bde ba kun bgrod nas/ /'chi med dam pa mchog thob 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ de'i phyir legs par 'dod rnams tshul 'di la brtson par bya'o/ /gtam 'di byis pa rang lo bco brgyad pa/ /'jisas med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ngas/ /bco lnga'i dus tshes bzang bor bris pa ste/ /'dis kyangayid can kun la sman gyur cigadage'o/ /dge'o/ dge'o/ /༄/ /rmongs pa'i byes pa rlung bu'i dbang bo bzhin/ /zin pa'i dus med brel do'i rnam g.yeng ba/ /dal med so nam ngal bas bslus mthong nas/ /sos dal nab/sa kyi nang na sanas par smon/ /ci tsam 'grogs kyang de tsam skyon 'bo zhing / /chasas sdang me yis rang gzhan sres byed pa'i/ /byis pa'i grogs po'i rnam thar de shes nas/ /nyams dga' nasas kyi nang na gnas par smon/ /bstod pas mod la khengs pa'i ru mtshon sgreng / /cung zad smad kyang khro ba'i me 'bar ba/ /gdul dka' spyang dka' snyigs ma'i grogs mthong nas/ /dben pa'i gnas na gcig pur gnas par smon/ /bslang na mi ster yib na tshol du 'ong / /lan brgyar 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes nyid gyur kyang / /cung zad rkyen gyis dgra zlar gyur mthong ba'i/ /byis pa'i grogs po mthong nas dben 362

da ba / ba rdo da ba 'ji gab ma ma bad na nga 〈snang ba ba ba /'gro/ /brgya phrag las nyon srad bus bcings mthong nas/ /bzod med snying rje'i gshog rlabs rab bskyod de/ /pheg gsum chos kyi gru sgra sgros gyar cig /de skad dben par bskul ba'i gtam/ /ting 'dzin zhi ba'i ༄shing rta 'di/ /dben pa'i gnas la rab dga' ba'i/ /byis pa rtsed mo can gyis spel//dza yan+tu//nga / /rten 'brel cha yi zla ba bzhin/ /rtogs nas gzhan la 'doms mdzad pa/ /'jam dpal de la phyag byas nas/ /rten 'brel snying bo'i brjod bya 'chad/ /de yang phar phyin jeg pa'i skabs kyi dbu ma dang sbyar na/rnam shes/ming gzugs/ skye mched/ reg pa/tshor ba/ skye ba/rga shi rnams 'du byed dang srid pa las byung la/ de dag ni ma ris pa dang sred len las byung / de gsum kyang yang rga shi la sogs pa las grub ste/rgyu rgyas bsdus dang / 'bras bu rgyas bsdus kyi mtha' rtogs pa'i phyir dang rmongs pa dag bsal ba'i phyir bstan pa de dag gi tshul ni rgyu 'bras bur mi 'pho ba dang / rgyu med par ma yin zhing / rgyu 'bras ltos med kyi tha dad ma yin la/ rgyu chung ngu las kyang 'bras bu chen po 'byung ba ste/ sa bon dang myu gu la sogs pa bzhin no/ /de ltar na gzhan ni ma rig pa la brten pas de nyid bcom na gzhan rnams kyang ldog la/ de nyid ni rtos pa'i dbang las ma yin zhing / don dam pa'i rnam pa'i bdab nyid kyi blos dpyad pas rnyed par yod par 'dzin pa'i phyogs te/364

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba zin na ni de ltar skye zhing 'byung ba med do/ /'di mngon par 'dod pas ni de'i rnam par gnas pa'am/ de nyid kyi grong khyer du yid gzhug pa bya ste/ de ltar byas na rang bzhin gyi sems de'i ngang du gyur te/ de ni 'gyur ba gsum gyi mtshan nyid las grol ba'i mtshan nyid kyi phyir brtan na cig shos 'grib pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar bshad pa'i lung ni bdas nyid de bzhin du gshegs nas rdo rje bde ba chen po mchog gi gnas rnyed pa po don dam pa'i dge sbyong rdo rje 'dzin gyis nges par bstan pa'o/ /de dag bstan pa'i gzhung ni 'di yin te/ ye rnyastso te tu pra bha bā he tudhe ṣān+ta bā ga to tse ba tad te ṣāñca yo ni ro rnya e baṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ /zhes pa'o/ /rten snying zab mo'i tshigs bcad pa/ /shin tu rgyas par gang bshad pa'i/ /bsod nams 'di yis 'jis/ rten 'di/ /'jam dpal khyed dang 'dra bar shog /ces pa'ang gzhon nu kun bzang 'jigs med pas spos thur sor mo bcu gnyis pa zhig zhusas kyis zin pa'i yun la gang dran bris pa dge bar gyur cig /ra / /yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po don bzhin du gtam ston cing / chos bzhin du gdul bya skyong bas dge slong chos smra ba'o/ /zhes grags pa don dang ldan pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang bo'i zhabs kyi pad+mo rnyog pa med pa spyi bos lan brgyar blangs te/skal bzang gi skye bo rnams la sman par bya ba'i phyir dang / 'jig rten 366

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7 na chos kyi rnga bo che rdung zhing grags par bya ba'i phyir dang / rigs pa smra ba rnams la 'bel ba'i gtam gyis phu dud bya ba'i slad du deng tshul gnyis shing rta'i rnam par bzhag pa las 'phros pa'i ngag gi phreng ba zil ba'i thigs pa tsam zhig spel ba la bdag spobs par bgyi'o/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na smra ba po gzhan gyis smra mi nus shing rtogs par mi nus pa'i chos zab mo phra ba sating dpag dka' ba sgro skrur dang bral ba'i don legs par 'doms pa'i seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrog par mdzad de/ ji skad du/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid phra ba phra ba nyid dang / chos rten cing 'brel 'byung phra ba phra ba dag ston zhing khyu mchog glang po che'i gnas su zhal gyis 'ches so/ /de 'a ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pas chos rnams kyi de kho na nyid ston zhe na/ 'di ltar chos chos zhes bya ba ni khams bco brgyad po nyid de/ de rnams las khams bcu bdun lhag ma dang bcas pa ni 'dus byas zhes bya ba ste/ de dag kyang yod pa nyid du mi 'grub ste/ gzugs ni rdul 'dus pa tsam/blo ni gsal zhing rig pa'i rgyun tsam yin la gang 'dus pa med na gzubs med/ gang gsal ba'i rgyun med na blo med par ni 'grub/ gang phyogs kyi cha ma dmigs pas rdul med/ gang skad cig ma'i 'gyur ba med pas blo ma mchis par yang grub bzhin du ci'i phyir rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i chos yod do/ /zhes smra/ 'on te ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed yod do zhe na/367

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7ma ma ba ba ba ba rung ste/ 'dus byas kyi chos 'di dag kyang skad cig ma nyid kyi phyir rgyu rtag pa las 'byung ba ma yin/ rgyu 'bras nges pa nyid kyi phyir rgyu lob pa las 'byung ba ma yin/ rnam par 'gyur ba nyid kyi phyir rgyu med par 'byung ba ma yin gyi rang gi dngos rgyu nus pa thosas med las 'byung ba yin la/ 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams kyang 'dus ma byas yin pa'i shes byar 'jig rten na grags pa bzhin du 'jog ste/ su zhika gis de ltar 'jog na/ 'das pa'i chos dang ma 'ongs pa'i chos dang da lta ba'i chos dang ma byas pa'i chos zhes kun tu tshad mar gyur ba'i blos 'jos go//de 'jog byed kyi tshad ma de'ang yul 'jal ba la mi bslu ba de'i phyir 'jog pas de 'jog pa'ang yul la ltos/ yul de nyid kyang 'dogs byed kyi tshad mas grub pa'i phyir de 'jog pa'ang tshad ma la ltos te/ de'i phyir ma brtags nyams dga' ma brtags nyams dga' zhes brjod do/ /dang po'i gnas tshul de lta bu yin mod kyi tha snyad pa'i blo gnod med kyis kyang dmigs su mi rung ba'i chos rang mtshan du grub pa dus rtag tu yod do zhes log pa'i blos bzhas pa la goms pa'i dbang gis rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis rnams nye ba dang ring ba bzhin du 'di yod pas 'di 'byung zhes rnam par 'jog pas rgyu 'bras su gyur cing / zla ba dang bsil zer bzhin du 'di skyes pas 'di skyes te/ ma ris pa las 'du byed 'du byed las rnam shes rnam shes las ming gzugs/ ming 359

4 gtamatshogs/ ྾pod/ 7byed pa'i/ /mgon po shākya'i tog des dge bar mdzod/1 /bde gshegs nyi ma 'bar ba'i snang ba yis/ dzam bu prik+ṣas mtshan pa'i grong khyer 'di//sum rtsen skyed mo'i tshal las dge byas pas/ /mi 'dul mchob de'i bka' drin slar yang dran/2 /snang nas snang bar 'gro ba'i them skas che//phul byung legs lam stong gi sa/dang bu can/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i lam di thob snyebazang 'a ra 'dzegs nas/ /ma ras grong khyer gas rnams skal ba bzang /3 /gang la brten na nyes pa'i dbul phongs che/ /bsal mdzad dam chos ba mo 'dod 'jo ba/ /blang nas nges legs 'o ma'i dga' ston la/ /spyod pa'i skye bo de dag skal ba bzang /4/zhi bsil dam chos bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar can/ /gang gi yid mkhar lan cig shar bas kyang / /srid pa'i mun rum stug po mthar byed pa/ /de 'dzin blo gsal de dag skal ba bzang / /snying la dam chos bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'khyil zhing /5 /lce las legs bshad snang ba 'bum 'jo la/ /rtag tu dam chos spyod pas mi ngal ba'i/ /blo bzang skye bo de dab skal ba bzang /6 /rmad byung dge ba gsum ldan dam chos mchog /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi yi tshul lusas can/ /snying la mdud rgya bzhin du dam 'chang ba/ /de dab rnams kyi skal ba smad ma 'gyur/ 7 /dam chos lha yi dga' tshal 'di spangs nas/ /snyigs spyod thal phung ngogs su 'gre ldog gar/ /g.yo bas mi ngoms skal ngan skye bo dag /o kyi khong na glo snying med dam ci/8 /tshangs spyod nor 3 61

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ ྾྾ 4 r+yā—྾྾bu'i rgyan chas 'di spangs nas/ /bag med ral gri'i 'khrul 'khor gdengs pa'i rtser/ /dge ba'i srog rtsa 'dral ba'i mi gzhon la/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i snang ba 'char dus dkon/ 9 /skal ba bzang ngo dmaX pa'i lha grogs rnams/ /skal ba ngan no chos med sdig chen sde/ 'dun ma legs so chos bzhin spyod pa'i grogs/ /'dun lugs nyes so chos min sdig spyod tshogs/10 /zhes pa'ang sprang smyon 'jisas med pas so/ /dge'o/ /༄/ /gnyid thun gcig la nyes brgya'i rmi snang can/ /dus ring goms pa'i ma rig gnyid 'thug ni/ /lhag ma med par sad pa'i mapho rab spyan/ /mi zum 'jam mgon lha des shis pa ྾/ /spyir gsang lngags bla med kyi skabs su gnyid dge sbyor du 'gro lusas thun mong ma yin pa yod cing / phar phyin pheg par yang gnyid dang lam gyi gzhi mthun 'byung ba yod mod kyi/ thabs mkhas dang bral ba'i gang zag gis gnyid la mang du bsten pa ni nyes dmigs che zhing sangs rgyas kyis gnang ba yin pas de dgag tshul mdor bsnyus shig brjod par bya ste/de la gnyis/gnyid kyi skyon sems pa dang / bsam nas ji ltar sgrub pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ dpal shān+ta de bas/ mi yi gru la brten nas ni/ /sbug bsngal chu bo che las sgrol/ /gru 'di phyi nas rnyed dka' bas/ /rmongs pa dus su gnyid ma log /ces gsungs pa ltar/ /da lta rang re rnams kyis rnyed pa'i dal 'byor gyi rten 'di 'dra ba ni rgyu dpe grangs gsum gang 362

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7ba stom 'ong na/ /myur du de dag bzlog par bya/ /zhes pa ltar bsgrim nas 'gogs shing phyis mi 'byung ba'i 'phen pa drag po bya ste/ de dag ni gnyid log ma byung gong dang / byung bar rtsom pa na ji ltar bya ba dang /byung ba 'gog pa la yang sbyar ro/ /de lta mod kyi banyid byung tshabs che ba 'gog pa la ni/ langs nas phyogs bzhir 'chas pa dang / rgyu skar la lta ba dang / gdong la chu grang mo 'debs pa sogs spyod lam gyi sgo nas 'gog tshul nyan sa las gsungs pa rnams kyang bsten dbos shing /spyod 'jug le'u bdun par gsung ba'i 'chi ba sems tshul rnams kyang stobs che'o/ /zhes pa'ang dge sbyong dar lo nas bskul ba bzhin 'jigs med bstan nyis skad cig la shar mar bris/ /dge'o/ /ra / /gsang sngags kyi gzhung du 'dod pa'i yon tan rgyan du rol bar gsungs pa'i don cung zad bshad na/ deng sang gi sngags gzugs phal cher ni 'dod pa'i yul 'dod pa'i blo 'dod pa'i 'bras bu dang bcas pa gdod nas ma skyes pa nam mkha' lta bu yin pas 'dod yon la spyad kyang mi kos zhes zer mod/ de lta na sngags pa yin rung min rung chos thams cad rang bzhin bden med du mgo mtshungs pas sems can thams cad 'khrul kyang mi rigs la/ spyad yul dngaXspyod mkhan don dam du med pas tha snyad du med go chod na spyad ces pa'ang mi 'thad de ri bong gi rwas rus sbal gyi spu breg nga bzhin no/ /mi gos 367
