pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾4 ྾ — 4 ྾྾4zhes pa'ang lo la mi 'thad de/ mi gos pa nyid kyang bden med yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na.o rang sga tshig gis rang nyid brlag par zad do/ /lar gos dang mi gos 'khrul dang ma 'khrul thams cad kun rdzob ma brtags nyams das/'i ngor bzhag pa yin gyi don dam par bzhag pa lta ba la yin/ de'i phyir tshib ltar snang ba de 'dras rdo rje 'chang gi bla ma tshongs shig /'o na lo cag ci tshug smra 'e na/ sngags pas ni sangs rgyas kyi sa'i gnas lus longs spyod lam du byed dgos pa yin pas/ 'di na ma dag pa'i chos zhig mi 'jog par snang srid dag pa rab 'byams su bltas te/ don dam rang bzhin rnam dag legs par rtogs shing / tha snyad du dag chen sku dang ye shes su rtogs pa'i phyag rgyas 'dod yon gyi sna nga ba kun la btab pas 'bras bu khyad par can 'byin thing gnas ngan len mi skyed pa nyid de/ sgyu ru ra'i 'bras bu 'o ma dang sba sa pa las ro mngar bor 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /'o na gzugs sogs yul gyi snang ba la spyad pas mi 'ching ngam zhe na/ rnam pa kun tu 'ching ba'ang ma yin la/thams cad du mi 'ching ba'ang ma yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan rnam pa kun tu bzugs snang bas 'khrul na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyang sred par ltung bar thal la/ rnam pa kun tu gzugs la brten nas mi 'ching na gzugs rang bzhin gyis grub par zhen pa'i sems can kho bo lta bu'ang grol ba yin par thal lo/ /de'i phyir yul snang bden grub tu 368

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7 nga lha ba las chags sdang la sogs pa'i nyon mongs kyi tshogs 'byung zhing de las khams gsum du ltung ba yin gyi/ srid rtsa bden 'dzin gyi khams bdag med rtogs pas phyung ba rnams la yul gyis 'ching bar ga la 'gyur/ spyir 'bras bur gyur ba'i chos gang skye ba'i gegs med cing rgyu tshogs kun tshang na mi skye ba'i dbang med pa yin la/ rnal 'byor bas mchog gi ye shes skye ba'i gegs bdag tu sred pa 'gog pa'i thabs la blo'i rtsal sbyong zhing / mthun pa'i rkyen dag mnyam chen po'i dgongs pa dang ldan na 'di dag 'grub par mi 'gyur ba med do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang gnas 'di gang zag chags can dbang bo non po rnams kyi phyir tshul zab mor bstan pa yin no/ /gnad 'di rgyas par de nyid grub pa las rig par bya'o/ /da ni drag po mngon spyod kyi sgrol ba la nyung ngu'i tshul du dpyad par bya ste/ 'di la'ang deng sang gi gto ba dang mthu mkhan phal cher ni 'di skad ces/ dgra bo rnams ni gsad par bya ba yin te/ bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdas po la 'tshe ba'i phyir ro zhes zer zhing bdag dang bdag gi bshes la chags pa kho na snying la bcag ste/ dgra bo ga ge mos sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig byang chub kyi sems bdag la bsgom du ma ster zhes ye shes kyi lha la rdzun lab par 'dug ste/ kho bo'i khye khog tu dran tshod ltar na 'di 'dra ba rdo rje'i jeg par ma tshud pa 'dra ste/ rdo rje'i rbeg pa zhes bya ba de theg pa chen po 369

nga pocad/ 7 rdo nga 'ang gas med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ nga zhig yin/ pheg chen bya ba byang chub kyi sems kyis khyad par du byas pa'i lam yin/ byang chub kyi sems zhes bya ba gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub don gnyer la myong ba thon pa'i sems zhig yin/ de tsa na dgra bo la snying rje chen po'i blo rdul phran tsam yang med bzhin du/ khro ba dang 'tshig pa'i sems kyis srog gcod kyi sgyu thabs brtsam pa tsam zhib yin no/ /bdag nyid kyis thub pa'i bstan pa la bya ba byas pa yang med la/mi dge ba'i las lam gsang sngags su sgro 'dogs pa'i chos spong gi las tshabs po che la cang mi sems par/ dgra mthu chung 'ga' zhig la sdang sems kyis 'dis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshigs so zhes smra ba dgod bro la/ byang chub kyi sems de'ang dgra gnyen thams cad la stom par 'byung ba zhig dgos kyi/ sos dal du lhug lhug por nyal ba tsam byang chub kyi sems ga la yin/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa skul ba'i grogs la sbar khro na cad rang nyid dgrar gyur gyi kho ga la yin/ 'o na gter gzhung mang bor byang chub sems gnyis bsgom pa'i dgra ru lang / zhes bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ de ni dgra bo kho rang gi rgyud kyi zhe sdang la sogs pa'i nyon mongs kyi tshogs kho rang gi rgyud kyi byang chub kyi sems skye ba'i gegs su gyar ba'i phyir rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi thabs ༄mkhas phrin las chen po'i shugs kyis dgra bo'i nyon mongs pa thul cig/ces bskrul ba yin pas 'gal ba lta ga la yod/'o na nyams pa can sgrol 370

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7྾ ྾྾— ྾ ba'i thabs gtan nas mi rigs pa yin nam zhe na/ de ni ma yin te/sdig can tshe ring na yun ring bor log pa'i lam slob pa rnams la snying brtse ba mngon du bzhag ste/ don gyi sems lhag pa'i bden pa dbyer med rtogs pa dang / stong nyid kyi sems rngam pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la banas nas rnal 'byor pa'i tshe lung khrus kyi dgongs pa dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes chen po'i byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden pas nyams pa can bsgral te sgu bzhi'i nus pa rgyud la 'jog cing / mngon mtho dang nges par legs pa'i sa la dbugs 'byin pa zhig med par smra ba ni ma yin no/ /de'ang gdul bya'i rgyud kyi dge tshogs dus su smin pa'am sad par byed la dgra bo'i sha khrag gis dgyes mnyam lha yi dkyil 'khor la tshokas mchod sprin gyi rol mor spel ba dang / chos nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes dang rten 'byung mthong ba'i bden pa rmad du byung ba dang / khrus lung gi dgongs pa zab mo la sogs pa thabs kyi sgo sna tshogs la brten pas/ nyi ma dang chu nang gi nyi gzugs bzhin du nyams pa can la byin rlabs kyi snang ba cir yang 'char ba ni rten cing 'brel 'byung gi mthu nus yin no/ /zhes pa'ang sprang smyona'ajigs med pas sbo gtam cal col du bris pa'o/ /༄/ /na mo gu ru pad+mā ka ra ye/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs 'gro ba'i mgon/ /snyigs ma'i 'gro la thugs rjes rab dgongs mdzad/ /371

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'khum/gangs can bstan 'gro'i gtsug rgyan o rgyan rje/ /mi phyed sgo gsum gus 'dud spyi bos mchod/ /de la 'dir sgyu ma lta bu'i rnal 'byor gyis/ sgyu ma lta bu'i sbyin pa byas na/ sgyu ma lta bu'i tshosas rdzogs par 'gyar ba yin te/ /kye dbye dpe /dedang /kyergyu bsod nams — tshogs la ba na nas 'bras bu sa — tshogs rdzogs par byed pa'i thabs tshegs chung la don che ba phan yon dang ldan pa dus dang rnam pa kun tu/ bsang / chu gtor/ gsur/ lus sbyin sogs sbyin pa rnam bzhi la rtag tu brtson par byed pa'i bang zag de nyid ni/tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib pa dag pa dang khyad par du yang tshe 'dir dam chos byang chub sgrub pa'i 'gal zla mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nyi ma sprin las grol ba bzhin du nye bar zhi zhing mthar thug thun mong ma yin pa rdzobs pa chen po mchos gi dngos grub thob par byed pa'i lam gyi cha lags su nye bar 'gyur ba yin pas 'di la 'bad par rigs so/ /thog mar bsang lta du la mtshon na/ bsang rdzas de yang / rgyu bzang ba/ dngos gtsang ba/ bkod legs pa zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyu los 'tsho dang ser snas ma bslad pa zhig dgos pa yin te/ log pa'i 'tsho ba lnga dang / khyad par ser sna ni yi dwags su skye ba'i rgyu yin te/ mchod pa'i dngos po gang la yang rang gi sha la sacig gcod dgos pa lta bu'i ser sna dang bcas pas ni tshogs rdzogs par 'gyur ba ma yin pas legs par spang dgos/ dngos bzang ba ni rang rgos gang za rgyu'i dngos po de las phud 37 2

za da/ 7 rdo grub 'jisas med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ ba nga ma dngos po/ mchod pa'i yul mi dmigs pa chos dbyings spros mtha' dang bral ba/ ka dag ye grol chen po'i dbyings su 'byams klas par byas la/dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsngo ba dang shis brjodaXkyi tshis/ ci rigs pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /chu gtor dang gsur lus sbyin sogs kyi dmigs pa yang ha lam de dang mtshungs pa yin pa rigs pas 'phrul shes par bya'o/ /smras pa/ ji bzhin rang gi rgyud la mi nges kyang / /mtshungs med dam pa'i zhal rgyun ma nor bar/ /mkhas rloms rang bzos bsre bslad yongs spangs nas/ /chos mthun grogs kyis yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ /bsang gi dmigs pa tshig nyung don 'dus bkod/ /nyes 'gal mchis na spyan ldan tshogs la bshabs/ /dge bas 'di mthong rang gzhan sems can gyi/ /byang chub sgrub pa'i nyer 'tshe kun zhi nas/ /chos mthun bsam pa be/gas med 'grub pa dang / /don sa/nyis yid bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis stsol/ /zhesapa 'di yang dal 'byor don ldan du byed pa 'dzam gling gnas chen kun la lan grangs du mar byon pa'i btsun pa a rtsa nas bsang gi dmigs pa tshig nyung don 'dus 'ig dgos zhes yang yang bslulab la brten nas mdo medakyi sprang po bstan ming bas dben gnas rdo rje brag gi mgul nas bris pa dge'o/dke'o/dbe'o//༄/ /'chi kha ma'i man ngag ni/'chi ran dus kyi sngon nas tshags su tshud dbos te/ de la rim pa mang yang 'dir spros pa bsgyungs la/ 'chi ba la nye ba'i dus su ci ltar 378

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7lta dus gzhan la phan thogs pa dka' yang khyod kyi sku che'i phreng bar theg pa chen po'i bstan pa la bya ba byed pa'i smon lam dang skyabs 'gro 'don rgyu lags//'jigs med pas bris//ma / /smyo 'bogs dang de sel thabs bshad pa sbo ngarjed sha za'i gshed ma bzhugs so/ /bla ma gang zhig 'khrul spong sman pa mchog /lta bas 'khrul ba kun sel zab mo'i blo/ /spyod pas 'gro kun 'khrul pa'i rgyud sbong ba/ /zung 'brel thugs rje'i thugs mnga' de la 'dud/ /ces mchod brjod kyis sngun bsus te/ mdzod las/ g.yeng ba'i sems ni yid sems la/ /skrag gnod ma mnyam mya ngan gyis/ /zhes pa ltar/ don 'di go bder dril na/thru 'bogs dngos bshad pa dang / de sel thabs basbus te bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ spyo 'bogs khams dang 'gro ba du zhig gis bsdus bshad pa dang / shes pa gang gi 'khor na 'byung tshul bshad pa dang / de rang gi ngo bo rgyu tshogs dang bcas pa bshad pa ste gsum las/dang po ni/ khams gong ma gnyis na smyo 'bogs med de/ de dag ni mnyam bzhag gi sa ba yin pa'i phyir nges rtog phyogs gcig tu g.yeng ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'dod khams kho nas bsdus te/ 'dod khams na ni sbyo ba'i rgyu rnams kyang yod la/ kha nang du lta ba'i mnyam bzhag gi sa ba'ang min pa'i phyir ro/ /khams gong ma na spyo ba'i rgyu rnams kyang 381

da da/ 7 rdogrub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i kasung 'asdom /nga nga nga nga med pa yin nam zhe na/ yin te/rnam smin las spyo ba ni rnam smin can mi dge ba las bskyed pa yin zhing / gong ma'i sas bsdus kyi mi dge ba med pa'i phyir dang / de dag dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu brtan pa thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa'i phyir thig sngangs kyis g.yo bar mi nus pa'i phyir dang / mi ma yin 'dod khams pa 'khrugs pa dang ldan pa rnams kyis balha bar yang mi nus pa'i phyir dang / lus thin tu dwangs pa'i khams yin pas 'du 'khrugs med pa'i phyir dang / gong ma'i rgyud de sbug bsngal dang mi 'brel ba'i phyir ro/ /'dod khams kyi nang nas kyang sgra mi snyan pa ma gtogs pa dmyal ba/ yi dwags/ dud 'gro mi/lha ste 'gro ba lnga ka na yod de/ dmyal ba ba'i nang tshan nyi tshe ba'i dmyal ba mo'u 'gal gyi bu'i rnam thar nas bshad pa 'dra ba 'ga' zhig ma gtogs pa thams cad rtag tu sems sdug bsngal kho nas non te re zhig bdag nyid kyang mi dran pa'i phyir rtag tu sbyon pa yin la/ nyi tshe ba de dag kyang thru rung gi rten yin pa dang / 'gro ba gzhan bzhi ni rtab tu thru ba'ang ma yin la/ rten gyi sgo nas dang / sa'i sgo nas smyo mi rung ba'ang min no/ /lus 'phags gling sogs gling gzhan gsum na smyo 'bogs yod cing / de sgra mi snyan pa la mi mtshangs pa ci yin zhe na/ de ni dbe ༄ba'i las kyi rnam smin 'ba' zhig la spyod pa yin pa'i phyir ro zhes bla ma rnams gsung ngo / /lus rten 'dod par gtogs kyang sems rten gong 38 2

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7྾ ྾྾s+dzawī ྾྾r+yām pa yin na thru 'bogs med de/ rgyu mtshan phal cher snga ma bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ spyo ba ni nges rtog 'ba' zhig gis bsdus shing / mdzod las ngo bo nyid kyi rtog pa dang / nges rtog gi rtog pa dang / rjes dran gyi rtog pa ste gsum bshad pa'i/ dang po dbang shes su bshad la/ sanyis pa dang gsum pa yid shes kyis bsdus pa kho nar bshad do/ /des na 'di ni yid shes kyi 'khor 'ba' zhig pa yin zhing / dbang shes dang gzhi mthun med pa nyid de/ gtso bor nges rtog gi shes pa phyogs gcig tu 'phyo zhing g.yeng ba la bya'o/ /'di'i g.yeng ba ni shes pa ya yo phyad phyod du song ba'i don de yin gyi/ nyon mongs pa'i sems kyi sa mang bo ba rnams kyi bye brag tu gyur pa'i rnam g.yeng dang don mi sacig ste/ don gcig na de gnyis yin khyab mnyam dgos shing / de lta na dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi spyo 'bogs kyang nyon mongs can du 'gyur bas/ nyon mongs pa ma spangs pa'i dgra bcom yod par thal ba'i phyiraro/ /'on kyang thru 'bogs kyi g.yeng ba dang / rnam g.yeng ngo bo bcis pa med pa ni gtan min te/ mdzod 'grel du/ de banyis la nu bzhi brtsis pa bzhin no//gsum pa la/ rgyu tshogs dang / dngos bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/spyir lnga ste/ nom smin dang / 'jigs pa dang / gnod pa dang / 'phral rkyen tsam las 'du ba 'khrugs pa dang / mya ngan las gyur ba rnams so/ /de la dang po ni/ smyo byed kyi rig sngags la brten nas gzhan gnod rtsom 383

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i bsung 'bum/pa dang / pha rol bos mi 'dod bzhin du chang ldud pa dang / rtsed mo sogs kyi phyir gzhan la dngangs skrag slong ba dang / shig la sogs pa srog chags g.yang sar 'phen pa dang / nags la me sbar ba la sob/sa pa'i las kyi dbang gis lus kyi 'byung ba rnams thru 'bogs su 'gyur ba'i grogs su 'khrugs pa ste/ bdag 'bras thru 'bogs dang / bdag rkyen las kyi rnam smin du gyur ba'i 'du 'khrugs so/ /gnyis pa ni/mi'am/mi ma yin pa'i sems can dang / sems med phyi rol gyi 'byung ba la sogs pa'i dbang gis byung ba yang rung ste/ skrag dngangs slong ba'i rgyu tshokas la brten nas snying kham dkrugs te sems smyo'o/ /gsum pa ni/yul lha la sogs pa mi ma yin gyi snying la mi 'bab pa'i kun spyod kyi dbang gis/ lha sogs gnod byed de dang des gnad du bsnun pa'i yid kyi 'gyur ba dang / dmod tshig bor ba la sogs pa spyo byed kyi sbyor ba brtsams pa dang / rang gi kun spyod la 'khrugs pa min kyang sbyo byed kyi gdon yi dwags kyi 'gro bas basbus pa 'ab/'a zhig gis gtses pa lta bu'o/ /bzhi ba ni/ thang khrom zos pa lta bu zas dang spyod lam nyes pas/'du ba 'khrugs pa las sbyo ba ste/ gtso bor ni snying la rlung zhugs pa las so/ /lnga ba ni/ bya ba rlabs chen ma grub pa'i sems las dang /grogs po shi ba las sdug 'asngal skyes pa la sogs pa'i mya ngan kyi gzhis snying rlung ldang ba lta bu'o/ /de la dang po ma gtogs pa 'phral gyi rkyen 384

྾ gtamatshogs/ pod/ 7dbang dang / dang po ni gnam gyis bskos pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sbyo ba'i rgyu tshogs lnga bo gang rung gis thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen la brten nas nges rtog phyogs gcig tu 'phyo zhing g.yeng ba de'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/rgyu'i dbang gis dbye ba lnga dang / skye 'phags kyi rgyud kyi dbang gis gnyis su phye'o/ /phyi ma 'di las 'phros pa/ 'jigs pa dang / banod pa dang / ma mnyam pa/ rnam smin las gyur ba dang / mya ngan las gyur ba'i sbyo 'bogs ni 'phags pa rnams la med de/ rim bzhin/ 'tshe ba med pa la sogs pa'i 'jisas pa lnga dang bral ba'i phyir dang / mi ma yin 'khrugs par 'gyur ba'i kun spyod mi mdzes pa mi byed pa'i phyir dang /rnam smin 'di 'dra ba rnams smin nges kyi las rnams byang ba'i phyir dang /'du byed rnams kyi chos nyid rtogs pas mya ngan med pa'i gnas brnyes pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas 'phags pa ma gtogs pa rnams la 'phral gyi mya ngan las gyur ba ni yod do zhes mdzod 'grel du gsungs te/theg dman gyi sde snod kyi dbang du mdzad pa'o/ /gnad 'di dag shes na deng sang rong ba rnams nas dug ldud pa sman du re nas mdza' bshes la chang gi pham phabs sbyin pa dang / srin bu dang / shig sro la sogs pa gang byung du 'phen pa dang / mthu ngan sngags kyi sbyor ba la yon tan du lta ba la sogs pa nyes pa'i sgo mang po zhig gi mtshang rtogs par 'gyur zhing 1 sgom chen smyo ba thos na mi srid pa'i mtshar gnas sa bsam nas ༄385

par 'jing/ rdo grub 'jigs ba da blta na nyib bsung 'ad ma/gang zag dam pa smod pa'i nyes ltung yang 'akog par nus so/ /gnyis pa la/ thun mong du grags pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyo 'bogs zhi bar byed pa'i thabs su gyur ba de'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/rnam smin las smyo ba la ni sman dpyad sogs kyis rang dgar bcos su mi btub pa'i phyir/ bshags pa'i sgo rmad du byung ba stobs bzhi'i rnal 'byor sal che mod/ spyir ni 'di 'dra ba'i rnam smin las gyur ba thob zin pa rnams ni 'chos par shin tu btub dka' bar rtog ge 'bar ba nas mdo lung dang bcas te bshad pas/ las kyi rnam smin gnya' thog tu ma babs pa nas 'chags pa saces so/ /skrag pa'i gzhi las gyur ba la ni/ mi ma yin gyi nyer 'tshe skabs de dang bsdong nas bla'am mdangs phrogs pa las gyur ba'ang yod de/ de ni 'jigs pa dang gnod pa gnyis ka las gyur bar snang yang de'i bdag rkyen gyi gtso bo gnod pa yin pas 'og tu 'chad la/ 'dir de las gzhan pa ni/ dadugs 'byin pa la sogs pa thabs la mkhas pa'i skyes bu dam pa'i man ngag gis 'chos so/ /gnod pa las gyur ba'i nang tshan lha kun spyod ma mdzes pas 'khrugs pa la ni/ mchod gsol dang bzod pa 'bul bas zhi la/ thru byed kyi gdon sogs la ni gdon de dag skred pa'i rig sngags la sogs pas gzhil bar bya zhing / de dag gang la'ang rig sngags 'chang ba'i nus mthus mi thub pa med cing / mdos kyi cho ga la sogs pa thabs gzhan 386

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7nga yang ches mang ngo / /'on kyang deng sang thru 'bogs kyi nang nas kyang 'di nyid mang bar snang zhing / de zhi ba la'ang mdos glud kyi yas 'gyed 'di dar cha che mod/ 'on kyang / mdzo rtswa zan mang yang khal jeg dkon pa'i dpe ltar song bas gto mkhan gto rgyus la mkhas pa dka' bar snang bas/ mdos glud kyi rnam bzhag che long rags pa tsam brjod na/spyir mdos gzhung rnams su/ mdos la rnam grangs ches mang ba bshad kyang / 'dir mkho ba ni bskangs mdos yin la/ bskangs zhes pa bum pa chus bkang bar byed pa la'ang chus dum pa bskangs zhes zer rung bas lha 'dre'i 'dod pa 'geng bar byed pa ste/ mdos kyis bskangs ba la/skong mdos zhes grags/ mdos kho rang ni/ lha 'dre'i mthun rdzas la bya ba rags pa tsam dang /cung zad zhib par btang na/lha 'dre la mthun rdzas spyir yod do cog la'ang mdos mi zer te/ zer na rgog pa ri la skyes pa rnams kyang rang bzhin gyis mdos yin par thal ba'i phyir te/ de mthun rdzas su 'gro ba'i 'dre yod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rig sngags 'chang ba rnams kyis sngags dang / bsam pa'i khyad par gyis bgegs la sogs pa tshim pa'i phyir byin gyiyobarlab pa'am nus mthus bsgyur ba dang / gang bsgyur rgyu'i rdzas de'ang lha 'dre de dang de'i mthun rdzas yin pa'i gzhi mthun cig la bya ba kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje'i dgongs par yang snang ngo / /mdo sde sogs nas mdos yas kyi brda chad dngos su ma 387

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/byung yang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'byor bas gtam nas rgyal ba sras bcas la mchod pa yid sprul tu bya ba yang gsungs shing / de mchod pa dang / 'di sbyin pa tsam yin pa'i khyad par ma gtogs 'dra ba'i phyir dang / der yang ma zad stong gsum rin po che la sogs pas bkang ste sems can rang rang gis gang 'dod bzhin ster ba yang mdo las gsungs/ rig sngags kyi stobs kyis sems can gyi nye bar spyad pa gang yang snang bar byed nus pa yang mdo las mang du gsungs pas/ lha 'dre'i mthun rdzas nam rgyang mda' 'phang la sogs pa rang rang gi 'dod pa'i dngos po ci ltar 'byor ba la/ rig sngags kyi mthus mang du spel nas sbyin pa la mdos gtong zer bas don ni 'dra la/ mkhas pas tshig tsam gyi rjes gcod par mi byed do/ /glud ni/ skyes rabs su/ ngang ba'i rgyal po'i srog glud du/ /bdag nyid mchid kyis 'tshal bar bgyi/ /zhes brda chad kyang dngos su byung la/ 'di'i glud kyi dngos po kho rang bem po yin pa'i phyir smyo 'bogs can sogs nad pa'i tshab tu rung ba'i sha khrag drod dbugs dang / khyad par du lha 'dre la mkho ba'i mdangs sam bla med mod kyi rig sngags kyi mthus lha 'dre'i ngor de dag dngos su yod par snang ba mi 'gal kyang / rig sngags kyi mthus rtsam gong gang zag tu bsgyur chog zer ba min no/ /zhar la 'ong pa'o/ /ma mnyam pa las smyo ba la ni sman pa rnams kyis gso dpyad kyi cho gas zhi bar byed do/ /mya 388

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba —྾ — ྾྾྾4྾྾ dus zin pa re e 'ong blta dgos so/ /spros bshad mkha' lding bshob rlabs shag po min/ /bsdus bshad rkyal ba mchu bcing yig chung 'di/ /kha bshad go ba med pa'i hob rkyal des/ /sto bshad smyo 'bogs kadung sel bdud rtsir sbyar/ /spyo 'bogs sel thabs dang bcas pa bsdus te bshad pa'i yig chunganyung ngu spyo brjed sha za'i gshed ma zhes bya ba gzhon nu kun bzang 'jigs med pas rang lo nyi shu ba'i ston 'bring dmar phyogs kyi dga' ba'i nyin par zhig tu bris pa dge/ /༄/ /nang nas bslab pa rnam dag ma sbyang na/ /ltar snang cha byad bzang yang phan pa dka'/ /spang blang gnas la 'bad pas bag mdzad na/ /bca' lag ra lpags mnab kyang dam pa lags/ /da lta dad zas za ba la bsam nas/ /ka smad kha byang byas tshad bzan sham sprad/ 1bstan pa rtag la gnas snyam bla ma phal/ /lha 'bag gdan la bzhag ltar rgyags pa rgyas/ /grwa bas kha tsam dad pa kha la btags/ /bla mas nga mkhas snyam nas nga rgyal mdzad/ /'chad nyan bya mang nang na bya skad ltar/ /mang mang grags kyang rtsa ba phra bar snang / /ska rags ba bla 'dra yang snal ma tsam/ /grwa sar bcas bzang sprad kyang khrag rkyal tsam/ /blta dga' bkrag mdangs gsal yang sha lpags tsam/ /thams cad rma bya 'dra yang snang brnyan tsam/ /bshad yam kha rlangs 'dra bas kha nang zad/ /bsam gtan nyams la bltas kyang a thang chad/ /bag yang rang sar bsdad na tha mal ba/ /ha ha gang la bltas kyang 'bag 'cham 'dra/ /yang dag lam bzang 390

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7mkhas nam mkha' bris bzhin mi mtshon mod/ /rten 'byung rmi lam lha bu'i snang cha na/ /tshig don ma brtags nyams dba'i rol mor ston/ /yi ge tshig gis pha mthar rnam bzhag mod/ /tshig kyang yi be nyid las brtsams te 'byung / /tshig dang yi ge 'di dag btags pa ste/ /rang bzhin grub pa'i mtshan ma rdul tsam med/ /gang gis yi ge sang zhis nom brjod pa/ /de tshe yi ge gzhan nas 'ong min zhing / /yi ge gang na'ang gnas pa ma mchis mod/ /yi ge sgra brnyan bzhin du de tshe snang / /su zhig yi se'i sgo la dmigs gyur pa/ /de tshe yi ge 'phel med 'grib med de/ /ji ltar me long dag la gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /de ni de yi yid la snang tsam nyid/ /don gang yi ge du mas rnam bshad pa/ /de dag brjod 'dod dbang las ma gtogs pa/ /don dang yi ge gcig min tha dad min/ de dag rang bzhin nyid ces brjod mi bya/ /don dang yi ge sacig na lhun po'i tshig /brjod 'dod mgrin pa'i dbus su ri snang 'gyar/ /de das tha /tshe /da /ri da dpeshākadad nyid na'ang ga 1sa don/ /ston pa go skabs snang ba gas so/ /sgra dang rtog pas rab bzhag yi ge'i sgo/ /brag cha bzhin du ther zug ma mchis mod/ /byis pa smig rgyu'i phung pos ri dwags bzhin/ /don dang yi ges bdag tu rmongs par 'gyur/ /de ltar shes nas mkhas pa blo gros can/ /chags med ye shes mkha' la nyi ma bzhin/ /mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i lta ba rab bcad de/ /rmi lam lha bu'i yi ges rmongs mi 'gyur//de 393

pa / ba dze da ba ba ji ba ba ma nga ba da ba ba ba ba ba nga nga da ma / g.yog la 'jal tshod med pa'i dpya khral ya med/ rje la mgu dus med rung bran la sun dus 'byung ba'i zhabs tob ya med/ khrims la mnar phod yod rung 'bangs la brnag nus med pa'i chad pa ya med/ gshed ma gsod snying che rung btson bu 'chi snying med pa'i rang nyams lha ga pa 'di tsho bsams nas/ sha tsha rang la 'chor ba'i mi 'dra srid na ni/ da bab sdug gi khur bo ri lhar spru bas tho bzhab phyis 'byung phung po'i sems khral nad ltar na bas gleng bslang / sngar bskos las kyi sdug yus mi ro ltar ngam gnag pa bskyed de/ gnam gyis rwa co brdar/ sa yis rnga ma g.yugs/ gnam sa cha lang brdab/ srid pa thob 'og log pa'i dus nam shar rung / rje'i sku tshod 'dzin pa'i thob thang mi dbang yang /bden rdzun rang lam len pa'i spyi lugs de mi dbang don mi 'dug pas/yo drang gi dmigs dang / skyid sdug gi dbang skal thig gis bgo ba'i gleng gzhi zhig slong dbos/ de la mi dpon 'di rigs rnams rang ci 'dod kyi ngang la snang ba byung rgyal du 'jog rgyu yod med/ khong gi yab mes la thob thang dbang tshul/ lha sras kyis rang srid skyong rabs/ skyes bu'i skyon yon yod lugs dang bcas pa zur tsam zhig drang por brjod na/ sana' rabs dang po'i thog ma/ 'di ba'i yab mes chos skyong rgyal dang /chos phyug 'bum la sogs pa rigs ngan ma ning gi sde ba las skyes shing / lus bse dri'i sdong bo ltas ngan gyi sha gzags su grub pas/ ya ༄396

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7ba lo sgyur/ sngon gyi mi rgyud ma 'chugs pa'i rtags su/ sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad rgya khyod yangs pa/ gnam 'khor lo rtsib brgyad tha gru che ba'i phyi snod 'jig rten gyi rnam grangs 'di tsam zhig yod rung / sde 'dis chas sbod bzung nas lo grangs dang mi rabs 'di lon gzhal bar ma nus pa'i dus kyi mthar yang pha gzhis kyi lud khang tsha ro ma 'di min pa'i rem rgyu med pa 'di/ grongakhyer gyi seng ge rnga leng dang / khong rnam pa tsho rigs gtsang ya rabs kyi sde ba nas mched pa'i rten 'brel mi ngaslu ba'i bden pa/ btum na mi thum/ bzung na mi thub/ bsub na mi zub pa'i ngo bo mi 'gyur ba de ka yin/ ha ha/ da de ltar bshad na/ mi thams cad rang yul na che/ sde thams cad rang sa na brjid/ risas thams cad rang thob la gnyan pa ma gtogs/ don yin lugs kyi ngos na dpon 'bangs kyi 'brel ba ma grub mchog dman gyi tha snyad mi srid pa'i ja sig cig yin la/ sgos 'jig tshokas la lta ba'i blo ngan 'di la pha thob kyi 'phru tog ston rgyu/ rang dpung gi ral gri bsdigs rgyu/ ngas byas kyi bzang yus 'dren rgyu/ dbang skal gyi za thang rgyug rgyu sogs sna gcig tsam yang med kyi steng / 'jig rten phal ba tshos/ dgra 'dre gnyis kyi g.yab mo/ ltas ngan stong gi thog ma/ byur chag gi snying rdo brgya dod ma 'di khyim du bcub zon phyi rol du byed zer nas don med kyi stong ༷ 'dang mang po gros su shom pas 'dug ste/ de lta bu min/ tshe thoka ma med 399

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i bsunga'abum/—྾ ྾྾྾྾pa'i dus kyi phung rgan po 'di ni nyes byas kyi tshad la gzhal na/ nam mkha' la bla bre rgyong rgyong / bar snang la 'khor lo sgor skor/ sa gzhi la ko ba rdung rdung du brdung rung sdub snying mi tshim zhing / zhe 'khon phung shul gyi ming skam la yang brjed mi thub pa'i tshod yin/ bdag chad kyis 'jigs pa'i ser sna can dag dpon bzhung bzang phyi thag ring ba'i sku drin 'di min na dmangs rang yul gyi mnga' ris na sdod thabs mi 'ong zer te/ mi glen pa rgyus med pas rang mgo 'khor ba ma gtogs shes bya mi srid dgu srid/ rgyal khams mi dar dgu dar yin pas/ skyid pa'i rgyal khams med nas 'gro sa zad pa ga la yin/ de yang zur tsam bshad na/sdig spyod mya ngam thang 'di'i pha mtha' rdzogs mtshams/ 'dzad med sdug sna mang po'i rgya grong zad mtshams/ bsod nams phyug sde 'bol mo'i sde sne thug mtshams shig na/ lam bdud rtsi'i chu klung g.yas su 'khyil ba'i 'gram ngogs1/ gtsang tshangs spyod sil ma'i spos ngad ldang ba'i sa phyogs/mtho dben pa las skyes pa'i nyams dga' sayang du chags pa'i yulaXgling / ting nge 'dzin gyi nasas tshal phyug la spun pa dang / shin sbyang gi bde ba'i 'khri shing ldem la mnyen pa/ snying rje'i 'bab chu bsil la dang ba dang / byams pa'i me tog dgod la bkra ba/ mngon par shes pa'i rtse sna 'khyugs la mtshar ba sogs ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i bzo bkod zad mi shes pa'i sman ljongs/ srid pa sgyu ma'i khang bzang dang / skye ba skyed mos tshal 100

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7྾ ྾ ྾'das kyi gser yig bka' tham gyi re kha ma nyams pa 'di la gdeng bcas/ btan 'dun gyi snying bo 'chug med cig la rdog pa gtad de/dpa' 'di byas zer rgyu med par/ dpa' skad kyi kha pho che ba tsam ma yin par/ bdud ngo 'jigs can dang lta res/ dgra kha tshan can dang gshe res/ dpa' lag dmar can dang 'ju res byas nas khe pham gyi rang skal mngon sum du long ba zhig la bsam sbyor chig sgril dgos par mthong / rang dang gzhan la dgos nges kyi dgra 'thab 'dun gros su gleng ba sgyu ma'i sgrung rabs zhes bya ba'i gtam nag mdo khams rol chen bco brgyad du grags pa'i ya gyal/ rdo rol gyi cha las yul gyi dge bcu ma tshang ba med pa'i sa'i lte ba/ lha chen rdo rje mgar dmar srid pa'i bde sdug gi bzo khyad mang bo mgar du rdung zhing mtha'i so kha la lha ba'i rdzong zur/ zang yag dmar po brag gdan g.yu klung sga ska rags can la brjid pa'i ke'u tshang nas brag srin 'jigs byed 'bar ma mel tshe byed pa'i gnas rtse/ bsung gi rig 'dzin rta mchog khrag 'thung gnyis pa/ 7dbang chen dgyes rab rdo rje'i zhal snga nas/ gsang chen dngos grub gling gi chos grwa zhes bden tshig grub pa'i gsung byin rlabs kyi me tog sil mar bsnyil ba'i grub pa'i ri ngogs nyams dga' ba nas mi thrun lcags kong da ri dras bris/ maṅga paṃ/ /403

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ /bden bzhi'i rnam bzhag snying por dril ba thar 'dod yongs kyi 'jug ngogs bzhugs/smra ba'i seṅge zur phud lnga ba dang / /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab mi pham bla ma'i zhabs/ /dad pa'i sems kyis spyi bor rab mchod de/ /bden bzhi'i rnam bzhag nyung ngu'i tshig gis spro/ /thar 'dod rnams kyis bslab bya bden pa bzhi'i nang tshan/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i mtshan gzhi bang zhe na/ma dag pa'i sgod dang ma dag pa'i bcud gnyis po'o/ /sdug bsngal bden pa'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ rang rgyu kun 'byung bden pa las skyes pa'i cha nas bzhas pa'i zag bcas kyi spang bya'i rigs su gnas pa'o/ /sdug bsngal gyi ngo bo'i dbye ba gang zhe na/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang / sdug bsngal gyi snyug bsngal dang / khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal rnams so/ /'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gang zhe na/ tshor ba bde ba'o/ /sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal gang zhe na/ tshor ba sbug bsngal ba'o/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gang zhe na/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i nyer len gyi phung po'o/ /sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa'i dbye ba gang zhe na/ mi rtag pa dang / sdus bsngal ba dang / bdag med pa dang / stong pa'o/ /mi rtag pa'i rnam pa gang zhe na/ skad cig ma'o/ /sdug bsngal ba'i rnam pa gang zhe na/ las nyon gyi gzhan dbang du gyur ba'i phung po lnga'o/ /bdag med pa'i rnam pa gang zhe na/ ngo bor gyur pa'i bdag gis stong pa'i de'o/ /stong ba'i rnam pa 404

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7ba gang zhe na/ dbang bsgyur ba'i bdag don gzhan gyis stong ba'i de'o/ /sdug bsngal gyi bden pa ni shes par bya ba ste/ ji ltar rlung ngam mkhris pa'am bad kan nam 'dus pa'i nad byung ba'i mis de shes par bya ba bzhin no/ /kun 'byung bden pa'i mtshan gzhi gang zhe na/ las dang nyon mongs pa'o/ /kun 'byung bden pa'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ rang 'bras sdug bden skyed byed kyi cha nas bzhag pa'i zag bcas kyi spang bya'i rigs su gnas pa'o/ /kun 'byung gi ngo bo'i dbye ba gang zhe na/ dge ba dang / mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan gyi las dang / 'dod chags dang /zhe sdang dang / gti mug ste nyon mongs pa'o/ /kun 'byung gi rnam pa'i dbye ba gang zhe na/ rgyu dang / kun 'byung dang / rab skye dang / rkyen gyi rnam pa'o/ /rgyu gang zhe na/ sdug bsngal gyi rtsa bar gyur pa'i sred pa lta bu'o/ /kun 'byung gi rnam pa gang zhe na/ sbug bsngal yang yang skyed pa'i sred pa lta bu'o/ /rab skye'i rnam pa gang zhe na/ sdug bsngal shugs drag tu skyed pa'i sred pa lta bu'o/ /rkyen gyi rnam pa gang zhe na/ sdug bsngal gyi lhan cig byed pa'i sred pa lta bu'o/ /kun 'byung gi bden pa ni spang bya ste/ ji ltar nad gang yang rung ba'i rgyu spang bya yin pa bzhin no/ /'gog pa'i bden pa'i mtshan gzhi gang zhe na/ sdug kun gnyis kyi bral 'bras lta du'o/ /'argog bden gyi mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ rang rgyu lam bdenaXbasgom stobs kyis thob pa'i bral 'bras so/ /'gog bden gyi ngo bo'i dbye ba 406

〉po cad nga/ 7 cadagrubapa 'jigs med bstananyi'igasupa 'a ma/ nga nga nga yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan dag na re/ 'gog lam gnyis la gzhi mthun yod zer na/ 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos la gzhi mthun yod par thal/ 'bog bden dang lam bden gnyis de yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/de la gzhi mthun med par thal/ rtag mi rtag banyis 'gal ba yin pa'i phyir/ de gnyis 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas yin pa rtags ma grub zer na/ ngo bo nyid sku chos can/ byas par thal te/ 'gog bden 'dus byas ma yin la lam bden 'dus byas ma yin pa gang zhig ngo bo nyid sku 'gog bden yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ stong nyid chos can/ ma rig payin par thal/ rang zhin rnam dag ṅga ngo bo nyid sku sto nga nyid yin pa gang zhig de byas pa yin pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig gis 'akog lam ngo bo gcig pa med zer na/ mthong lam rnam grol lam pa'i rgyud na 'gog bden med par thal/ lam bden dang ngo bo gcib pa'i 'bo/ga bden med pa'i phyir/ kha cig na re/ gzhi grub na bden bzhi gang rung yin pas khyab zer na/ nam mkha' chos can/ bden bzhi gang rung yin par thal/ gzhi grub pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de min par thal/ nga sdug kun gnyis ma yin pa gang zhig 'gog lam gnyis ma yin pa'i phyir/ de dag kyang nor 'khrul gyi dbang du gyur ba las legs par bshad pas dben pa'i nongs tshogs sras bcas rgyal ba'i spyan sngar 'chags so/ /'di las nyer bskrun dge ba'i mthu yis ni/ /mtha' yas 'gro kun rgyal ba'i 408

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7྾ ྾4྾—sa thob ste/ /stobs sogs rnam par byang pa'i yon tan kun/ /bdag gir byed pa'i dpal dang ldan gyur cig /bden bzhi'i rnam bzhag snying bor dril ba thara'adod yongs kyi 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba/ btsun pa ma ti bha dra'ingab gis bskul ba ltar rmongs pa dkon mchog ming bas yar ngo'i tshes bcu gcig gi nyin sbyar ba rdzogs so/ /༄/ /'dir sngags pa rnams kyis rtag tu mi 'bral bar bcings bar bya ba'i rdor dril ni sngags kyi nyams len gyi rim pa rdzogs par mtshon pas don chen po can yin te/ de la rdo rje ni snang phyosas kyi cha mtshon byed yin pas thabs bde ba chen po'i ye shes zhes bya ba sngasas bla med kyi lam gnad mthar thug pa de mtshon byed/ de nyid kyi lto ba zlum pas ye shes de nyid chos nyid stong pa nyid la gnyis snang dang bral bar mnyam par bzhag pa'i ye shes de mtshon zhing / ye shes de nyid lam dus dang 'bras dus kyi khyad par gyi dri ma thams cad dang bral byed dam bral pa'i bdag nyid can yin pa dang nam du'ang ye shes de nyid dri ma'i ngo bo skye mi srid pas/ ye shes de nyid ye shes lnga dang yul gyi chos nyid lnga mtshon pa'i yar mar gyi rtse lnga/ thugs rje chen pos 'khyud pa mtshon pas chu srin gyi kha dang / ye shes de nyid kyis gdul bya'i re ba bskong ba rgyun mi chad pa'i brdar rin po che'i phreng ba dang ldan pa yin la/ gzhan yang ye shes de nyid kyi rtsal du rigs lnga yab yum sems dpa' yab yum dang 'gro 'dul gyi phrin las kyi mdzad pa rnams mtshon 109

par ra / ba da ba ba ba nga gsab da bad na nyib gsung ba da ba /de nyid de'i phan yon yin te/ skyo shas chos kyi mgo bor 'jog pa yin mod/ de gnyis skyo ba zhes pa'i ming du mthun yang don gtan nasaXmi gcig pas ci zer/ 'o na dben par ci zhig dran nas skyo zer/ bde skyid kyi phun tshosas dran nas skyo ba yin mod/ skyid snyug 'byed pa'i blo mig yod na bde ba'i mchog gis skyo nas bde skyid ngan pa la dga' ba gar srid/ 'o na dben pa na bde skyid ci yod/ sems skyid pa yod de/bde ba'i mchog ni sems skyid pa/zhes so/ /nga / /bde skyid bkra shis 'byung ba'i gzhi gcig pu ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yin te/ de 'dzin pa'i dam pa phal cher zad pa dang / skye dgu chos min spyod pa'i dus su lha dang mi rnams rgad cing / lha ma yin rnosogs ngan 'gro'i phyogs rnams stobs 'phel ba — chos nyid yin la/lhag par bod 'bangs rnams kyis gangs ljongs skyob pa'i mgon sacig bla ma o rgyan rin po che dang / lha thugs rje chen po brjed de/ skyabs 'jig rten pa'i 'byung po la 'tshol/ las su mi dge ba kho na byed pa na1bsod nams kyi lde kha smon lam log pas bsgyur ba'i mi nag pho mo dang /ban+de khrims 'chal/ sngags pa dam nyams rnams nas phyogs kyi 'byung po mthu chen du skyes nas lha srin sde brgyad nang 'khrugs slong zhing / mtha' bzhi'i rgya 'dre ma rung ba rnams kyis sna khrid byas te 'gong bo spu na dgu'i dmakas dpung dgun gyi 'tshub ma ltar langs/ dkar phyogs kyi 4/ 2

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7gzhi bdag mang po yul bton nas/ phal cher gnya' mnan nas ldang mi nus pa byas/ sangs rgyas mthong ba'i bstan srung mthu bo che rnams kyang bod 'bangs chos kyi gzi byin dang bral ba'i dbang gis skyob pa'i thabs med par shes nas zangs mdog dpal ri sogs rig pa 'dzin pa'i grong khyer khyad par can rnams su bzhud de/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'di mi med kyi 'brog stong lta bar song ba'i gnas skabs na/ mtha' ༄dbus kyi 'byung po 'dres pa'i rtags su mi rnams kyang mtha' dbus 'dres shing / yul khams phan tshun nang 'chol ba dang / chas spyod 'chol ba sogs 'byung / de'i dus su spyir nad nug 'khrugs rtsod sogs phyi nang gi 'jigs pa rags la mang ba dang / khyad par mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung mang pos lan gcig ma yin par 'joms tshul dus gsum mkhyen pa o rgyan chen po'i gter lung rnams su gsungs shing /de'ang dus 'gyur chen po bcu yong ba'i nang nas deng sang brgyad pa phal cher rdzogs nas dgu ba la nye ba yin/ de bzlog thabs yod kyang bod 'bangs spyi'i las dbang gis byung ba'i sdug bsngal gang zag re re gnyis res bzlog dka'/ mang pos ni sgrub rogs mi byed cing blo mthun rgyu ma red kyang / sprub mkhan byung na/ spyir bsnyen skrub tshad du 'khro ba'i rig sngags 'chang nus ldan rnams kyis g.yul mdos/ sa gnad me btsa'/ gtor bzlog 'gong po ar gtad/ dam sri mnan pa/113

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7྾྾ ྾r+yā—྾4gong du rags pa rgyang nas byed pa ltar thog tu ma babs gong nas sgrub dgos pa yin kyang thal zin der zad/ da dung yang tshad ldan sgrub mkhan mang po spid na khol bu re bde ba la phan nam snyam nas bris pa dge bar gyur cig /༄/ /gsal rgyan gyi dngos zin rnams bkod na/ pha ma sogs la mi gus pa/ de dag gi ngag bcas pa/ gzhan la bsam ngan 'chang ba/yon gnas rnams las phyag dang bsnyen bkur blangs pa/ dad rdzas la spyad pa/ pha rol gyi sdig pa'i spyod pa la yi rang byas pa/ de dag gi dge ba'i chos kyi bar chad byas pa/ gzhan gyis dge ba byas pa la ma rang ba/byams la snying ring byas pa/ byas pa mi gzo ba/ rdzun smras nas bden pa'i rgyu mtshan med par byas pa/ phra ma sogs ngag gi lhag ma gsum/ pha rol gyi grags pa ma yin pa gsal bar byed pa'am bla btsag ma bslab gsar bu'i rgyal sras la brnyas pa/ su la'ang khyad gsod byed pa/ chos dang chos smra ba la brten pa'i sdig pa skor/ zang zing gnas yo sogs la ser sna byed pa/ gzhan mi dang dud 'gro la sogs pa'i gnas yo phrosas pa/ chos la dpe mkhyud byed pa/ su la cis kyang rung ste g.yo sgyu byed pa/rang gi nyes pa gzhan la sgyur ba/ khong khro dang 'khon 'dzin/ phrag dogagazhan gyi dran pa dang shes rab 'khrugs su bcug ste gnod pa byed pa/sgyu ma'i drwa ba dang sems skor sogs khong du chud kyi phrin las rgyas pa'i 415

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ gegs byas pa/ gzhan la 'jigs skrag dang t+pa bkong ba'i sdub bsngal bskyed pa/ mi'am dud 'gro sogs gzhan dag gnas grogs 'khor yo sob/sa sdug pa dang phral ba/ gzhan gyi re thag bcad drung 'dod don la bar chad byas pa rigs ngan gzugs ngan sogs rgas pa nad pa la brnyas pa dang 'phya ba/ pha ma bla ma khrims ldan sogs brnyas shing 'phya ba dang smod pa sems mi bde ba bskyed pa/ gzhan la brdeg 'tshog /pha ma dang khrims ldan dang phongs pa dang nad pa sogs kyi 'tsho ba phrogs pa/gzhan gyi gnas dang yo byad ma rung bar byas pa/ dig lkugs glen gsum sogs 'phyas shing brnyas pa/ chos thun ha cang ring ba dang gzhan kyis klog 'don la tsha 'jun byas pa sogs kyis sun dus chos la 'bral 'dod skyes nyen che bas chos sgrib che ba bshabs dgos/ sku gsung thugs rten mun rdul khrod du 'o brgyal bar byas shing dril sogs kyis bkur bste ma bgyis/ /416

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/—྾ ྾ ྾྾ ྾pas/ sha dum brkus pa'i bzhi las rtsod par gyur te/ des thag pa'i 'phrul 'khor las rdo thog ltar 'beb pa'i sgrobs kyi sbyor ba byas nas 'phang bar brtsams pa na/ khwa ta 'dzur la mkhas shing / gab byang bas ma phog ko /der dge tshul khros nas ru shing mnyen po las gzhu byas te/phyogs bzhir bdas pa dang / bya rog kyang nags nas nags dang / ri'i bseb nas ri'i gseb tu bros so/ /'on kyang de dge tshul khro bo des ma btang bas/ de na re/ ltos shig grong khyer mi dang nags kyi bya/ /shākya'i rab byung chos gos phrag bzar nas//nyes med bya rog nags su rgyu ba la/ /mda' gzhu rna drung bkang ste tho 'tshams pa/ /skyabs las 'jigs pa byung ba'i ngang tshul 'dir/ /ltos dang rmi lam sdig pa brgya yis kyang / /mtshon min ltas 'di rdo yul shar gyur bas/ /phyir bzlog ris sngabs sems pa'i dus la bab/ /ces zer ba dang / dge tshul na re/ rkun po srang nas 'ong ba sa steng srol/ //dben mtho bar snang lam nas chom rkun lhung / /nyam chung sbrang ma spu can lo 'dras kyang / /mthu ldan rkang gnyis mi la 'phrog dus byung / /sna tshogs zas sbyor bshams pa'i tshong 'dus dang / /g.yos khang dpung pa bsgribs pa'i grong khyer rnams/ /bor nas drang srong zhi ba'i gtsug lag khang / /nyams nyes byed pa'i bgesas lo bsad na rung / /byas pa mi gzo brku zhing mang smra mkhan/ /da dung nyes med zer ba'i bzlog thabasaXcan/ /lo 'dra'i bya than mthong na mda' 1/8

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba lce shin tu tsha ba 'byung / /khyod kyis rkus dang phyi sa za ba dag /rigs kyi kun spyod yin zhes bdag nyid sgrogs/ /mtshang 'bru 'dod pa'i bzhad gad mkhan rnams kyang / /de las thu ba ci zhig smra bar 'gyur/ /drun po rigs sun 'byin pas cher rlom khyod/ /mkhas pa'i nye 'khor 'dug tu sa la dbang / /gnod byed bsam gtan tsher ma khyod med na/ /sdom brtson nags na mda' gzhu ci ste 'dzin/ /ston pas bya rog skred pa dge tshul la/ /gnang bkas nga rang shes kyi kha rog sdod/ /khyod kyi nyes pa bzlog dka' 'di gzibs nas/ /blo bzang 'char kas pha rol sa/non pa mdzad/ /phyi sa za ba khyod kyi bshang sgo la/ /nga 'dra —ldag pa rmi lam rmi zer na'ang / /de la pho nya mde'u'i lce rnon can/ /lan smra ma btang btang stoms 'jog re dkon/ /zer nas mda' gcig 'phang ba dang / /bya rog gis mgo bo smad tsam byas pas steng nas shur gyis song ngo / /yang gcig 'phang ba bya rog mgrin pa bsrang ste dgyed tsam byas pas/ rkang ba'i bar nas mjug sgro la reg tsam byas te rgyab phyogs kyi sa la zug go/de nas bya rog nam mkha' la 'phur te/ bya'i khyu chen po zhig lho phyogs kyi nam mkha' nas byang phyogs kyi mkha' la lding zhing 'gro ba'i nang du zhugs nas/ kha phyir bltas te dge tshul mi dka' bar bya ba'i phyir 'di skad ces/ sprin gyi rlabs lda nga gnam sngon chu gter nang / /rgod pa'i sgra sgrogs 'dab bzang tshong ba'i khyu/ /rlung gi bzings la zhon nas 'gro ba 430

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7nga ba ni/ /bza' shing nags su rab dga' rnyed par gyur/ /ces smras te song ngo / /dge tshul ni khā ta 'phur ba'i phyi bzhin steng du blta zhing mda' gzhu thogs te/ kye ma kyi hud/ ngas sngon nas sgyu rtsal zhig ma bslab zer zhing khros pa'i shugs kyis sdod mi bzod par ri'i ngos phan tshun kun tu brgyugs so/ /de phyin chad bya rog nam mthong ba na ni mda'i 'phru' 'phen cing / mi mthong ba'i dus su ni rdo skyog 'phangs pa'i sgra 'brug chen banam lcags 'bebs pa'i nga ro ltar grags pas nags nas nags su 'jigs pa skyed cing 'gro ste/ de 'phangs pa na ri'i gcong rong shin tu zab cing gting ring ba'i rkyen las brag cha'i sgra snga ma las nyis 'gyur sum 'gyur du che bas ri bo ral ba bzhin du snang ngo / /tshul des nyi ma re re zhing gtses pas khwa ta ches pham par gyur nas/ nam zhig na de rang gi tshang mal yod pa'i ljon shing dang nye ba zhig tu 'dug ste/ mchu sa la sbyar nas snying rje rje ltar snang ba'i ngag tu/ a wa a wa/zhes rdo yul ba'i skad kyis 'o dod bos nas slar yang 'a di skad du/ brtse ba'i pha ma ma gtogs pa/ /sus kyang ma bskyang khwa ta'i bu/ /bdag med nags su spyod pa la/ /rgyu mtshan med pa'i lhod cig byung / /gtsug lag 'jig pa'i chom rkun la'ang / /dge sbyong 'tshe ba ma thos te/ /deng ni sha dum chung ru'i phyir/ /bya rog banas dang bral bar byas/ /ring nas mdza' bo ltar 'dris pa'i/ /ljon pa yan lab rab bzang dang / /mal ‘1 2/

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 74 4 r+yā ྾gi yul 'khor nas thon te/ gzhan gyi yul du dman zhing dman pa'i yid kyis rlung gis dus pa'i shing lo bzhin 'khyams shing 'dug ste/bdag gis dge tshul ngan pa de la 'jig rten pha rol du yang khon 'dzin spang bar mi nus so snyam mo/ /yang bsam pa la/ bcig pu snying las chung bas bde/ /dbul po 'du 'god nyung bas bde/ /yul med rang dbang thob pas bde/ /mnga' bran 'gro 'ong sla bas bde/ /de'i phyir da ni dge tshul gtum po des bdag la ci yang byar med kyis/bdag gis khon lan glan pa'i dus ni 'di yin no snyam nas/ de nangs re bzhin dge tshul gtsug lag khang du kha ton dang bsam satan byed cing 'dug pa'i dus su glags rnyed par shes te/ dus der chung ma dang bcas par lhags pa dang / gtsug lag khang pa'i phyi rol du phyugs kyi sha tsho zhing zhim pa zas kyi ched du gzhan las nyos pa dag thas pa'i gdang la brgyus te/ nyi ma la bzhag pa mthong ste/ ji tsam 'dod par zos shing sha'i lhag ma la bya thal btang nas song ngo / /tshul des yang dang yang du tho brtsams pa la/ dus ring zhib lon pa dang dge tshul gyis tshor nas shug pa'i mda' gzhu mal drung du blangs te bya ra byed do/ //de nas yang nangs snga zhig na bya rog sngar bzhin 'ong nas sha mang du zos pa dang /dge tshul gyis sgra'i mtshan ma las shes te/ skyil mo krung myur ba myur bar bshig nas mda' gzhu thogs shing song ba las/ bya ros/ ni ches sgrin pa 23

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jibs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾྾྾ —྾྾— yin pas tshor nas nye 'khor gyi shing zhib gi rtser 'phur te 'dug/ go /dge tshul phyi rol tu thon pa dang / bya rog na re/ byon pa legs so nags kyi spong ba pa/ /yang dag 'job las bzhengs ma thag pa lo/ /lo kyi rjes thob spyod pa'i tshul 'di yis/ /mnyam bzhag spyod yul shin tu zhi bar rtobs/ /nyin bzhin bya tshosas gtses nas nangs bar dus/ /byams dang mi 'tshe ston pa'i gtsug lag rnams/ /kha ton byed oṃ rang gi lce la yang / /ngo tshar mi sems gdong lhags shin tu 'thug /bsam btan mal du tshangs pa'i rgyal ltar zhi/ /thang dang khyams na srin po'i 'khor ltar khro/ /bden bral 'dod dgur bsgyur pa'i gzugs can lta'i/ /rnal 'byor spyod lo ring mo zhig nas mthong / /zhes smras pas/ des skyag zan lo kyi gdams ngag gis kho bo zhi bar 'gyur snyam mam/ lo kyis satsus lab khang gi nyer spyad rgya chen po nyams par byas pa mi dran nam/tshod mi shes pa'i blun po lo sdod cig ces mda' gzhu bkang ste bdas so/ /der bya rog mo gtsug lag khang gi rgyab phyogs nas byung ste/ bya tha' 'thor zhing / 'di snyed phyugs rnams lo kyis su las brkus/ /spong ba'i nags su sha 'di gang nas byung / /bas mthar 'di 'dra'i las kyis dregs pa za/ /sadams pas zhi bar ma 'gyur de re bden/ /zer nas sanyis ka nam mkha' la kya kyur rtse zhing song ngo / /de'i tshe gtum spyod nyi ma dpal zhes pa bdol ba'i risas las yi ge klog pa'i slob dpon du 124

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7ba gyur pa zhig gtsug lag khang de'i phyogs gcig na 'dug go /des dge tshul dang bya rog de ltar 'gras pa thos nas dge tshul gyi drung du phyin te smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod gtsu lag khang na klog pa dang spong bas dus 'da' ba dang / bya rog nags kyi nang du grong 'dabs nas gzhan gyis bor ba rnyed pa za zhing 'dug pa gnyis ci zhib la rtsod/ de lta mod kyi khyod cag rgyu mtshan chung ngu'i phyir du rtsod cing 'dug go zhes thos kyi de kho bos zhi bar bya na/ slan chad zhi ba'i nags su rtsod pa'i me ma spor cig khyod kyis legs par soms shis dang / /grags pa mi sdug du ba'i rgyal mtshan can/ /rtsod pa'i bud shing la ni 'jus zin na/ /khyod kyi khro ba'i me lce ma zhi 'di/ /gang la gnas de zhib mos bsam par gyis/ /su 'grobs yid la mthun par byed pa'i mi/ /mang pos bkur ba 'jig rten rig pa dang / /mi 'tshes legs gyur chos kyi lugs yin na/ /blo gros gsal ba khyod lta su zhig rtsod/ /de phyir yid kyi sdug bsngal drag po'i dug/'phrog byed gzu bo'i ngag gis sman byed pa/ /khyed la bsam pa dbe ba'i tshul bsam nas/ /nad gso'i sbyor ba 'bras med mi 'gyur byos/ /dase tshul gyis lan smras pa/ grogs po khyod kho bo la sman par 'dod paXni bden mod kyi/ bdag cag btsug lag khang gcig na bgo skal gcig la spyod pa yin pas/ phan tshun bsam pa bzang ba la ngo mtshar du bya ba yang med do/ /'on kyang kho bo ni/ rtsod dang 'du 'dzis 'jigs nas 126

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4 — 'bros par rtsom pa gdol ba'i slob dpon gyis mthong nas/ mkhas pa bden par smra bas mgu/ blun po ngo bstod byas na mgu/ zhes bya ba yin pas/ 'di la ngo bstod dang 'brel ba'i gtam zhig bya'o snyam nas smras pa/ dus la lta zhing tshang nas dus su 'byung / /'jig rten shes pas kun la yid ma rton/ /bag dang ldan phyir rang spyod legs bsrung ba'i/ /'dab chags mkhas lo nags kyi thig le yin/ /'on kyang bdag la ni lo 'jigs par bya mi dgos te/ 'di ltar bdag gis rgyus bsnyad par bya na/ bdag ni gdol ba nyi ma dpal/ /bas mtha'i gtsug lag khang na gnas/ /deng ni lo dang bzang po'i blo'i/ /rtsod pa sbum phyir 'dir 'ongs so/ /tshig de thos nas bya rog kyang cung zad bag phebs par gyur te smras pa/ gang na yid kyi tsher ma de gnas pa'i/ /gtsus lag khang pa'i gtam la bdag mi spro/ /'on kyang bdag cag rigs dang rjes mthun pas/ /gdol ba zhes bya'i sgra 'di rna bar snyan/ /bdag ni 'dab bzang bum pa'i spyi gtsug ste/ /shing thog bre yis gzhal ba du ma dang / /yal ga'i lag pa 'brel ba'i shing chen dang / /'khri shing mang po'i khyim la dbang bar gyur/ /de nas dge tshul bzang po'i blo gros la/ /'thab mo spel ba'i blo gros skyes gyur nas/ /kho bo sgren mo lag stong 'phyan pa yi/ /thes pa'i rnam 'phrul 'di 'dra 'di dag sprul/ /bzang po'i blo mnga' dase/ spyod zhi ba yi/ /bzang dang zhi ba'i mdzad pa 'di yin na/ /zla bas 428

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7ba gdungs bskyed sngon med rgud pa 'di/ /ji lta bur na khyod kyis sel bar 'gyur/ /gdol bas smras pa/ yid ni phyi rol la bltas nas/ /gzhan skyon tshol na mkhas pa ste/ /de ltar nang la mngon phyogs nas/ /bdag nyid dpyod la zhugs tshe min/ /ji ltar khyod la smra ba'i rgyus/ /gzhan ni mu cor smrar shes te/ /de khyod rang nyid kyis ni bdag /snyan dgu smra la mkhas par sems/ /dge tshul na re zas kyi drin lan du/ /rku bas gnod byed bya rog mi srun pa/ /kho nas nongs zer khyod ni 'di lta bur/ /rang gis nongs pa'i gtam tsam yod mi snang / /bzhin bzang de'i phyir khyod kyang blo gzu por gnas nas bdag nyid bsam par bya ste/ kho bo'i ngal ba'ang 'bras bu dang bcas par bya'o/ /zhes bsgos nas song ngo / /dus gzhan zhig na sos ka'i dus ston la bab pa'i tshe/ shags kyi rgyal pham nyan pa'i bya rnams bsdus shing / bya rog dang dge tshul gnyis kyang bos te/ gdol bas smras pa/ shing rnams lag pa me tog khur bus dud/ /bya tshogs rtse bas dregs pa'i ca co yis/ /phyogs kyi mdzes ma sos ka'i chang 'thung bas/ /myos pa'i glu len lta bur dus 'di dga'/ /brtan g.yo mtha' das dpyid kyi bu mo dang / /lhan cig kun dga'i bdud rtsi 'thung ba na/ /rtsod pas rang gi bde ba 'joms byed pa'i/ /khyod kyi las 'dis dgos pa ci zhig 'thob/ /gang gis khyed cag yun ring na gyur pa'i/ /'khon chen dug de bdag dang cang shes kyi/ /bya brgya 'dus pa'i mdun 429

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ ྾4r+yālding gnyis riṭa pa ga la mtshungs/ mtshungs su chug kyang ngas lo la mi zas kyi bgo bsha' byas pa'i drin lan du sngar chom rkun byas pas ma tshim par/ da dung gathog bzang gis ka shi'i rgyal po la ji ltar byas pa de ma grub pas snying na'am/ bum pa'i mgo na re/ 'char ka dang bya rog gzhan gyi yul du 'phrad pa dang / kho bo rang yul na sdod pa glo bur pa'i skye bos bskrad pa gnyis kyang ga la mtshungs/ khyod kho bo'i yul du 'dug nas sa rin zas kyis bcal ba la drin ci zhig dran par bya/ khyod kyi ma bstab pa'i sha dum bdag bis khyer ba yang yul bdag gis dpya khral blangs pa yin pas ci zhig nongs par 'gyur/ 'on kyang kho bo rang gi yul na nyes pa med bzhin bskrad pas lo kho na shin tu nongs can no//bzang blo na re/ gling 'di la 'dzam gling mi yi yul zhes 'jig rten na shes kyis mtho ris gnyis pa bya yi yul zhes su yis zer/ de'i phyir lo ni rtab tu sazhan yul na gnas pa yin na sa rin dang dpya khral yang ji ltar dbang bar 'gyur/ der yang ma zad de/ lo mi yul na banas pa de srid du rngon pa rnams kyi ri dwags dang khyim bdag rnams kyi phyugs ltar mi'i longs spyod kho na yin pas brdung ba dang bskrad pa yang mi nyid dbang ngo / /dum pa'i mgo na re/ sa gzhi 'byung po 'dzin ma 'di la gangs rtse'i seng ge nas khung gi phyi ba'i bar gyi byol song mang po sprang po'i gos la shig ltar 'khrigs nas 'dug ste/ de thams cad gling 'di 132

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ ra / /sprang phyug shags 'gyed/phyug po bu brgya ma zer ba de'i sgor sprang po shib/ slog can zhig byung nas/ nyi ma'i nang du shig 'thu zhing bsdad pas/ phyug pos de la bltas nas khong 'dzum cig shor te/ 'di skad zer/ phyi rol dgra rkun 'ong snyam mi dgos kyang / /nang du shig gi srin pos gson zos byed/ /nyin mtshan bar med thig dang g.yul sprad pas/ /sen mo'i mtshon cha zad de lag yur bud/ /lpags zad lag sor rtse nas khrag 'dzags shing / /sha dri lus mdog nag la snum zhag bral/ /skra rnams shig sro gnyis kyis g.yeng zhing 'gul/ /khyi mang nang du sprang po thang chad bzhin/ /bros pas mi thar rang bi lus las skyes/ /bsad pas mi 'dzad kos kyi phyi nang khyab/ /sprugs pas mi 'bud skra rtsa shig gis bzung / /sgyur ba'i thabs med mi gcig gos gcig rang / /su 'grogs mi rnams shig med shig tshang byed/ /sus mthong mi kun 'go ba'i nad ltar lta/ /mi khyur mi tshud gar song mi yis brnyas/ /hrul bo'i shig slog lus gdon bzhin du 'brang / /dgra yin byas na rang skyes bu dang 'dra/ /gnyen yin byas na lus khrag dron mo 'thung / /'chos na bu ro bskyang na dgra bas sdang / /dgra thabs zin chus gang yang byar mi btub/ /nag po'i thi la sro ma'i 'bru dkar chags/ /436

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7'jam po'i lpags rnams 'brum bu'i phung por song / /sos dal lag pa brel bas gzer zhing ngal/ /dang ba'i bzhin ras shig gi zug rngus sdud//kye ma rnam pa sna tshogs las thabs kyis/ /mi la 'tshe byed 'byung po mngon sum lta'i/ /shig sro gnyis dang rum bsdong shig gi dris/ /yi ga 'chu ba'i sprang po snying re rje/ /zhes smras pa/ sprang po'i mtshang la phog nas lan smras pa/ khyod kyi khyem sgo lam gsum du yis gang / /pha ma'i tshe srog za ba'i lus skyes dgra /tshe mjug sbug la 'khor nga'i gsar byung 'dre/ /de yis drag na nga yang shig gis drag /g.yas nas ngu zhing g.yon nas rgyug 'dre byed/ /'tshig dang dgod dang ku co sna tshogs kyis/ /skad cig bsdad kyang 'phral la sazeng nus pas/ /'dre dmag mngon sum khyem du bab pa bzhin/ /'dug na sprel dmag mang pos gtse zhing spyo/ /za tshe yiXdwaṭa tshogs kyis phor du 'degs/ /nyal yang ngu 'tshig sgra yis gnyid 'phrog pa/ /de 'dra'i byur ngan khyod kyi khyim na mchis/ /che mtho'i mal stan gcin dang rtug pas sbag /gtsang sbyar zas kyi snod rnams dri mar byed/ /gces shing phangs pa'i rdzas mang bcag cing bkrum/ /gos dang gdong gi ngos la mchil ma 'debs/ /zho dang 'o ma mar khu'i tshogs mang po/ /tshang mar thal ba dkrugs pas khyem kun khyab/ /slan chad phyags ma thogs pa brgya yis kyang / /khyim de phyi dor bya bar nus ma yin/ /khang khyim mdzod dang thang rnams lhas su bsgyur/ /mdzod kun dbyig dang 437

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7྾4 ྾྾4྾྾ste lang bas gzhis rdzogs yin/ /bu smad mang po'i gdos thag las/ / 'chor med phyug po snying re rje//zhes smras nas yang bros te song ngo ////༄/ /skya ka khra mo dang gleng mol byas pa/ngas skya ka la 'di byas/ bya skya ka khra mo'i 'dab ma bskyod na/ /shing bal gyi yang khyad ngo re tsha ste/ /thugs rlom sems mthon pos che thang ma mdzad/ /bya spu'i she mong e dran 'dab bzang gi grogs po/ /byas pas/ kho na re/ o 'jam dar skyid po'i mal nang nyal tshe/ /phyug po s+dzawī gces phrug 'dra la khad de/ /thugs rkyal pa phus gter shag po ma mdzad/ /ram pa'i zhal zas e dran 'jigs med kyi bstan rgyam/ ngas kho la/ sha zos na zhim pa'i tshang ra tshil rkyal/ /sku khog tu slebs dus mnog po yod de/ /zas srog dang bsdos nas 'tshang khra (kha)ma mdzad/ /gyang zhal ba e gzigs su spu sdug gi grogs po/ /byas pas/ khos nga la/ nor bsags na 'phel ba'i dngul sgrom rgyab khal/ /mdzod khang na bzhugs dus zhal ngo dro ste/ srog 'ben la bzhag nas ldom bu ma mdzad/ /gung phyi'i zas thang e gzigs 'jigs med kyi bstan rgyam/ /ngas kho la yang / mchu gzan la rno ba kha mchu'i gzhi ma/ /'byon lam nas kha twa'i ru sna bsham 'dug /bya 'ol ba ser po'i lad mo ma mdzad/ /sku shugs rang tshod e zin 439

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ ྾mkha' lding gi grogs po/ /byas pas/ nga la khos/ blo rig pa'i rnam 'phrul byur ngan gyi sna 'dren/ /snyigs dus kyi sems can ko long dam 'dus /khong sngon rabs mkhas pa'i lad mo ma mdzad/ /rnam dpyod rang tshod e zin 'jigs med kyi bstan rgyam/ /yang ngas kho la/ zas hab thob mdzad pa bya brgya'i chos nyid/ /sadung ma dang dral phyam khang pa'i shing cha/ /shing khang pa'i logs la spu 'thor ma mdzad/ /gzigs tshad kha zas e red gshog bzang gi grogs po/ /byas pas/ khos nga rang la/ gto tshogs gral 'grims pa gto bla'i chos nyid/ /dkon mchog la phul ba dkor gyi gnyan shos/ /rten mchod chas spyan gzibs nga'i yin ma mdzad/ /zangs zhun lto bas e thub 'jigs med kyi bstan rgyam/ /ngas kho la/ mtshan zla ba bkam 'dra'i gzugs su mdzes kyang / /ngan skyug gi zhal zas dri ngad de mnam pas/ /shing jo dar yu ba dril phyis ma mdzad/ /gsung rab bkur ste e yin 'phur 'gro yi grogs po/ /byas pas/ khos nga la/ sazan ngur smrig na bza' mtshan sprin las lhas kyang / /ldan grol gyi bslab bya gu yangs la bzhag nas/ /'khor slob ma sdud pa'i bshes gnyen ma mdzad/ /bstan 'dzin rnam thar e red 'jigs med kyi bstan rgyam/ /zer bas ngas kho la/ a cang ku re yin mod 'dab bzang gzhon nu/ /rtse sgros gnam 'phang gcod pa mkha' lding gi khyad chos/ /sdig zas sha la rngam pa sngon las kyi rgyu mthun/ /bden rigs lo la yod do bden smra 4‘10

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7yi skya ka /byas pas khos kyang nga la/ bden bden nga la yod na byol song rang min mod/ /a cang snyigs mar spyod pa'i rang rtags 'di min na/ /bden smra'i drang srong mchog cig sangs rgyas rang yin te/ /sna la ma ser po can tsho'i res mo la babs yod//zer nas 'phur song / zhes pa'ang ngas bris so//ha ha// //༄/ /ya la the le'i rnam bshad/bla ma ngab gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi zad sbobs pa'i 'byung gnas lhag pa'i lha/ /'jam mgon snying bi nyi ma la btud nas/ / gnad zab tshig gi rnam par gzhag pa ni/ /rnam bzhi'i rnam bshad shin tu bsdus te bya/ /a zhes bya ba dgag pa'i sgra yin te/ /gang la zhe na ma rabs skye bo'i tshig /gang zhig ce na dam pa'i legs bshad dag /gang phyir zhe na don med don log phyir/ /ji ltar lus can dag gi mkhris pa'i ro/ /de la mngar ba'i ro ni yod ma yin/ /de bzhin ma rabs blun po rnams kyi ngag /de la rnam gzhag bzang po yod ma yin/ /de phyir shin tu ma rabs rnams kyi tshig /mkhas pa rnams kyis dgas par bya ba ste/ /legs cha med dang spang bya yin pas na/ /a zhes gzur sa/nas rnams kyis spid 'dir bsgrags/ /kha zhes bya ba btam gyi sgo yin te/ /skyes bu tha shal rnams kyi kha nyid ni/ /'dor 'os smad par bya ba'i ngag mang po/ / 4111

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jisas med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ ྾ r+yā ྾྾'byung ba'i gzhi zhes mkhas pas rtogs par bya/ /ji ltar rdul nyog khrod nas 'ong ba'i chu/ /kun tu rnyog mas dkrug pa yin zhes bya/ /de bzhin ma rabs kha nas 'ong ba'i tshig /kun tu nyes pas dkrug pa kho nar zad/ /ma rabs kha la dgag byar bstan shugs las/ /kha yi brjod pa slong ba'i yid dang ni/ /kha dang mtshungs pa'i lus kyi spyod pa'ang / /de yis mtshon nas spang byar bstan pa yin/ /the le zhes pa sdug bsngal sgra yin te/ /ma rabs yid kyis ma rabs tshig brjod cing / /ma rabs spyod pa rtag tu spyod byed na/ /de ni rtag tu duḥkhas 'debs par 'gyur/ /'di na gang la skye bo rnams kyis ni/ /blod cing phyar ka gtong ba la sogs pa/ /'di kun ma rabs spyod las 'byung ba ste/ /'di bzhin tshe rabs sazhan du'ang je le le/ /ji ltar lus ni gang na 'gro gyur ba/ /de na de yi grib ma rjes su 'gro/ /de bzhin ma rabs gang du song gyur kyang / /sdus bsngal the le mi bzad rjes su 'gro/ /de phyir tshig 'di rnams kyi brjod bya ni/ /ma rabs spongs zhes dngos su bstan pa dang / /ya rabs bsgrub ces shugs la bstan pas na/ /mi chos 'dod pas don 'di rtogs par kyis//a kha the le'i rnam par bshad pa 'di/ /rdo rje'i mched po kun bzang 'jigs med kyi/ /bzhed pa ji bzhin gzhon nu 'jigs med pas/ /gang dran lhug par brjod pa maṅga lo// //‘14 2

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7'brel bsgrigs pa sogs kyi bka' drin mdzad/ de nas brtsis pa'i gdung rabs lnga ba la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs lha khri lde gtsub brtan gyi sras su mi'i gzhon nu lha'i mtshan rtags dang ldan par 'khrungs nas/ gnam lha babs kyi rgyal po/ sa lhun grub kyi mnga' bdagakhri srong lde'u btsan yin zhes sus kyang mtshan ma gsol bar nyid kyi zhal gyis bzhes pas de ltar yongs su grags/ sku gzhon nu'i dus yab mes kyi yig tshang gzigs pas chos kyi thugs 'dun byung ste/ bdud blon gyi bar chad dang sde dmangs kyi 'then 'khyer sosas thabs mkhas mdzad pa'i 'phrul gyis rang zhir btang / sba sang shi ta sogs pho nyar mngag ste rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul na nyi ma ltar rtsod med du grags pa'i paṇa chen byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tsho spyan drangs/ chos mngon pa dang mdo sde'i gnas la thugs sbyangs shing bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma la sogs pa'i bstan bcos kyang mdzad/ thugs dam gtsus lag khang bzhengs pa'i sa 'dul bar zhus pas bod kyi lha 'dre gdug rtsub che bas ngas 'dul mi nus/ deng sang rgya gar yul na pad+ma saṃ bha ba zhes bya ba 'dzam bu'i gling na che ba'i rig sngags 'chang ba zhig yod/ de spyan drangs na rgyal po nyid dang sngon gyi smon lam gcig pas gdan 'drong zhing thugs bzhed 'grub par 'gyur zhes lung bstan pa ltar sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms sogs spyan 'dren gyi bang mir brdzangs te gsol ba 4‘17

pod1 7 rdo grub 'jigasamed bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/btab pa ltar o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa bod yul gyi dbus su phyag phebs/ bstan ma bcu gnyis dang gnyan chen sde bzhi sogs lha srin mthu bo che rnams dam 'og tu bcub cing bstan pa srung ba'i gnyen du bskos/ de'i stobs kyis 'byung bo pha mo'i sde rnams kung dpon btson mas da du bzung bas 'bangs 'khu mi nus pa lta bur song ste sa gzhi btul/ sde brgyad bran du bkol nas bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang lha 'dre mi gsum gyis brtsigs pas brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra bar ya mtshan che la tshar skyen par lhun gyis grub/ bod la phan pa'i lo paṇa mang po lung bstan nas dam pa'i chos bsgyur zhus 'chad nyan gyi grwa btsugs/jo bo rje lha cig gis kyang bsam yas kyi rgya dpe rnams gzigs nas 'di na da lta rgya gar na mi bzhugs pa'i bka' bstan mang po snang / de dus kyi bstan pa dar ba 'dra ba rgya gar na'ang dka'/ bod kyi rā dza bo rnyi sa twa zhes phyag thal mo sbyar nas bsngags brjod mdzad/ mkhan chen zhi ba 'tshos sad mi mi bdun sogs rab tu byung ste 'dul 'dzin gyi sde btsugs/ rgyal pos bod kyi khyim pa thams cad dkon mchog la mchod pa byed pa'i khrims bcas shing bon lugs byar mi gnang ba'i lung bsgrags/ khyad par du gnas phun sum tshogs pa chos 'khor gsum dang sgrub gnas rnam gsum sogs bkra shis byin rlabs 'byung ba'i gnas chen mang por/ dus phun sum tshogs pa chos rgyal mchod yon gsum gyi 418

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigasamed bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sngags gsar rnying gi chos thams cad la gsan bsam ris med du mdzad cing / rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mngon sum du gdams pa'i bdud rtsi bsrung/ mgon po bir wa ba dngos dang mjal nas gsang sngags kyi bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol te grub pa'i sa mthor gshegs/ slob ma mchog thob pa gsum/ bzod pa thob pa bdun sogs rgya cher byung ba las sku'i sras rje btsun rtse mo sku mched brgyud 'dzin gyi thu bor gyur/ rje btsun sku mched kyi gcung dpal chen 'od po'i sras su 'jam dbyangs ngur smrig 'chang ba'i rnam par rol ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bltams/ byis pa'i dus nas rig gnas thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i shes rab kyi gter grol zhing /'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge'i ye shes kyi skus mngon sum dubyin gyis brlabs pas shes bya'i rgya mapa'i pha rol du phyin/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shri bha dra las bsnyen par rdzogs te 'dul 'dzin mkhas pa yongs kyi mchog tu gyur/ mu stegs kyi mkhas pa 'phrog byed dga' bo 'khor bcas dri ma med pa'i rigs pas tshar bcad de rgyal bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan bsgreng bas dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta zhes snyan par grags pa'i rnga bo che 'dzam gling gi sa g.yo ba tsam du ldir/ sku che'i smad la gong ma hor gyi rgyal po'i dpung gis bod la gnod du nye ba gzigs nas de 'dul ba'i phyir rgya nag tu phebs/ rgya nas/ gi rgyal pos tshod bsam pa'i phyir sgyu 452

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7—ma mkhan la grong khyer ba'i gshang gci'i phung por gzhal med khang bkod pas mdzes pa sprul du bcug nas der spyan drangs pa na rten 'brel snying pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i me tog gtor nas nang du byon pas phyir bsdu ma nus par byang phyoṭa sprul pa sde'i lha khang zhes dus phyis kyang yod pa sogs ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul gyi spyod pas rgyal po 'khor bcas dad par byas te bde ba can du gshegs/ dbon chos rgyal 'phags pa gong ma'i bla mar gyur te rdzu 'phrul dang chos bstan pa'i sgo nas rgyal bo'i mdzad pa legs lam du bsgyur bas mnga' 'bangs skyid cing bstan pa dar ba'i gzhi rtsa btsugs/ bod kyi dge 'dun rnams chos dang zang zing gi char gyis tshim par mdzad/ de gong bod du rig gnas kyi srol ka cher ma dar ba las chos rje khu dbon 'di gnyis kyis sgra dang snyan dngags sdeb sbyor mngon brjod zlos gar gyi gzhung mang po bsgyur zhing / rgya cher dar ba'i bdag rkyen mdzad pas lhag par yang rin po che sna tshogs kyi yul gling chen po lta bur gyur/ de'i rjes su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan sogs gdung brgyud dang / gzhan yang g.yag rong rnam gnyis/ ngor rdzong rnam gnyis/ go shāka rnam gnyis/ tshar chen yab sras sogs skyes chen mang du byon nas rang lugs bshad sgrub kyi rgyun bzung zhing / ngor/na len+d+ra/ rtaXnag thub bstan rnam rgyal/ mnyan yod bya rgod gshongs 463

pod/ 7 rdo gruba'ajigs med bstan nyi'i gaspung 'bum/r+yā྾྾྾ ྾྾sobs chos sde grags pa can mang du btab// gzhan yang lho brag mar ba lo tsā rgya gar du byon te/ dpal na ro ba sogs paṇa grub kyi bla ma mang du bsten/ slar bod yul du bstan pa bskyangs pa'i slob ma ka ba bzhi las sgrub brgyud kyi bka' babs mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rjes spyir grub thob kyi bu slob mang du bton pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa mnyam med sgam po ba zla 'od sazhon nu'i bka' brgyud la/ phag gru/ dus marga/ zhang tshal ba/ 'ba' rom bka' brgyud de che bzhi/ gdan sa bka' brgyud dang lnga/ 'bri gung / 'brug pa/ stag lung / khro phu ba sogs bka' brgyud chung brgyad/ de dab re re la yang grub brnyes rnal 'byor pa'i sde dpag tu med pa dbyar dus kyi chu bo ltar 'phel te dpal ldan 'brug pa kho na'i bka' brgyud kyis kyang bya rgod po'i nyin lam bco brgyad khyab par grags/ des mtshon nas bod dbus gtsang gi ljongs su bstan pa dar ba'i tshul rgyas par brjod kyis mi long yang zur tsam bshad pa yin la/mdo khams kyi yul na che ba shar phyoṭa 'bri klung gi rgyud 'di ni sngon chen po gling gi dus nas sa skya pa'i bstan pa gtso bor mchod pa'i srol dar zhing / rjes la sde dge chos rgyal chen po rim byon rnams kyang gdung brgyud gong ma 'gar chen ye shes bzang po'i dus nas rje btsun sa skya pa'i nang 'khor yin pa dang / phyis su'ang dpal e waṃ pa'i mkhan 45 4

btam tshogs/ pod/ 7— ྾ —྾྾4brgyudaXkyi phreng ba rdams dang mchod yon nyi zla zung 'brel du gyur pa sogs kyi rten 'brel las dpal ldan sa ngor rnam gnyis rigs bdag tu 'dzin pa sha stag byung la/ sde dge bo thar kyi dus su pho brang gi sa gzhi dang por 'dul ba dang / rgyal srid la mnga' gsol ba'i byed po grub chen thang stong rgyal po yin cing / phyis su gter ston 'ja' tshon snying pos sde dge grub thob kun dga' rgya mtsho la zan kyi sdig pa ra tsa'i gzugs shig bcos nas gnang ste/ 'di yi dam gu ru drag po'i phyag mtshan yin/ o rang gi thel rtags la 'di thob/ sa stod rnams sa skya dang / sa smad rnams rnying ma pas zungs dang rgyal srid phyi na gas med pa dang nang na srub med pa 'ong zhes lung bstan pa ltar byung ba sogs kyis gsang sngags rnying ma ba rnams kyang mchod gnas kyi phud du bkur/sde dge sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sku ring la bka' brgyud bstan 'dzin yongs kyi gtsug rgyan kun ma.o si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas a lo re 'khrungs pa dbus phyogs kyi gdan sar ma phul bar dpal spung gi chos grwa btab nas der bzhugs su gsol ba nas bzung ste si tu'i sku phreng rnams gtsug gi nor bur bsten pas sgrub brgyud shaṃ tshang gi yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mtshungs bral du gyur/ byang rgyud rdza chu kha na ri bo dke ldan pa'i mtshan nyid kyi chos grwa'ang 'ga' zhig yod de mdor na gangs ri'i khrod kyi ris med pa'i rgyal bstan mtha' dag gru bzhir skyong zhing /466

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7—྾ ྾྾ ྾rgyan bsam gtan chos gling bi gdan sa btab ste slob ma bskyangs pas tshogs pa stong phyed lnga brgya tsam 'dus shing / nag shod srin rdzong / zhe chen bstan gnyis dar rgyas gling / rgya rong rtag brtan sprub sde sogs yan lag gi chos sde che phra mang por 'phel/ mkhas grub kyi bu slob bya khyu 'phur ba tsam thon pas mdo khams sdogs chen pa zhes dbus gtsang khams bsum du grags shing / mtshan don gyis gung kheb pa byung / de rnams la kaḥrdzogs dpal gsum zhes mdo khams kyi yul 'di'i gsang sngags rnying ma ba'i chos sde thams cad kyi rtsa bar da lta'i bar bo/nga 'phel du bzhugs pa de yas gtam dam pa chos kyi lo rgyus rags rim tsam lags/mas gtam la'ang steng na rje'i gdung rabs/ 'og na 'bangs kyi mi rabs/ stong sde spid pa'i chags tshul dang gsum las dang po'i dbang du btang na/ 'jig rten thog mar chags nas yun ring ma song ba'i dus su mi la phongs phyug dang longs spyod la gsog 'jog med cing /dpon g.yog gi tha snyad med de bsam gtan lha gnas dang cha 'dra ba'i bde skyid chen pos 'tsho yang / bskal pa mar 'grib pas bsod nams rim gyis phri ste 'byung ba dwangs ma'i zas rnams nub/ skye bo rnams 'bras sā lu'i zhing la spyod pa'i skabs su lo tog la gsog 'jog dran zhing nga ja kyi ris su bcad de phan tshun mi mthun par rtsod pa na rgyal 469

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/po la snga ba mang pos bkur ba byung ste/ drang po'i gzhung lam bzung /longs spyod chos bzhin bgos/ rtsod pa'i zug rngu phyungs pas drin lan du drus/ cha'i dpya thang gis mchod/ mi la mtho dman phye ste rje dang 'bangs su bzhag dbang rje la gtad de skyid sdug shes su 'jug pa'i srol dod/ de'i bu brgyud la 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po lnga sogs nas shākya'i rgyal po zas gtsang ma mched bzhi'i bar du rgyal po dang rgyal risas 'bum phrag lhag pa'i gdung rabs mu tig phreng baXstar la brgyus pa lhar byung / rgyal po zas gtsang gi sras bcom ldan 'das dang mdzes dga' bo gnyis/ bcom ldan 'das khab na bzhugs dus kyi sras sgra sa/can zin te/ 'di yan chad kyis mang pos bkur ba'i rgyud dngos rdzogs par gsungs/ gzhan yang ma ga rnya dang / ko sa la dang / ko sham+bha'i rgyal po'i rigs dang / li tsi bi'i rigs sogs grags pa can gyi rgyal po'i rigs mang / de'i rjes nyi ma'i rigs las 'dzam bu gling gi rgyal po mya ngan med dang snying po'i thig le dang seng ge lnga ba sogs dang /tsan+d+ra'i rigs kyi rgyal rabs mang po sngon dus su byung zhing / phyis rgyal po'i grub thob go pā la dang de ba pā la dang chos rgyal mya ngan med la sazi byin 'gran pa rgyal po chen po rnyarma pā la'i rigs kyi rgyal po mang du mched pas mtshon/ bsod nams las shugs kyis yangs pa'i sa chen po la dbang bsgyur zhing / mnga' thang longs spyod kyis dkon mchog gi 460

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7lags/'bangs mi'i gnas tshul gyi dbang du byas na/ stod rgya gar gyi yul rnams skal ba bzang po'i grong khyer yin pas mi'i mchog dang longs spyod kyi rtse mo 'byung / sde mang la 'byor ba che/ gtsug lag gi gzhung dang sgyu rtsal gyi rnam grangs mang / tshong 'dus kyi ltad mo dang bzo sanas kyi 'phrul mod/ mi rigs bzhi'i rnam dbye gsal/ mtho dman gyi khyad spyod pas dbye/ phyug po las mkhas pa bkur/ zong las rig pa brin/ zhib la brtags dpyad rno/ sngon gyi drang srong phyi rjes ring bor bzigs pa mang du byon pas bya bzhag thams cad la bstan bcos yod/ las dang bya ba ci byed bstan bcos dbang por 'jog pas dus bzang gi lugs srol mi 'gyur/ pha mes kyi rigs chos gzhung srong bas gna' bo'i lag rjes mi nub cing mi'i go rim mi 'chol/ mgo nag mi la chags snga zhing 'dzam gling yul dbus na gnas pas sde mang nang nas phud du brtsi ba de lags/ /bod kha ba can 'di dang po mi min 'dre'i rgyal khams su yod pa las/ thugs rje chen po'i dge bsnyen 'phags pa sprel sgom dang / sgrol ma'i sprul pa brag srin mo 'dus te/ rigs drug nas 'phos pa'i las can gyi 'gro ba drug sras su bskyed pa las mang por 'phel nas blo ldan rang bzhin bzang ba rnams pha'i rigs dang / kashis ngan spyod pa gyong 466

nga pong / rdo grub 'jibs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ mo bas rnyed sla/ mi la mkhas pa mang / ya rabs kyi lugs srol shes/ mi chos la shes sgo yangs/ lha chos la go ba bzang / rig gnas la rnam dpyod zhib/ spyod pa khrims lugs dang mthun/ yon tan can gyi rgyal khams su byung ba las/ lho rong gi bye brag gdung rgya mkhar sras po'i rdzong 'og sde ku se rgyal mo tsho drug de'i nang sases ku se smad pa'i mi rigs/kha chos 'don la mkhas pa/ lag yig rigs la byang ba/ blo rig pa la goms pa/sde dge chos rgyal rim byon rnams kyi bzhed srol skyong ba/ khyung bo g.yu khri sobs sngon gyi bzo bo 'phrul gyi rnam dpyod can rnams kyi las rgyun 'dzin pa/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog gi bstan srog mi nub pa'i srog shing 'dzugs pa/ rten bzhengs la byas pa che bas rje'i thugs su 'thad pa/ longs spyod bzo gnas kyis 'grub pas rkun jag gi srol ngan nyung ba/ rtsal 'gran yon tan la byed pas lo bcu'i byis pa yan chad bslab shes mkhan por 'gro ba/ e yul rig pa'i 'byung kanas lta bu'i mi sde ste 'og na 'bangs kyi mi rabs zhes bya//yul sde'i chags tshul ltar bshad na/ 'jig rten dang por chags dus 'byung bzhi'i khams ra las ri rab rin chen bzhi'i rang bzhin dang / 'bring las gser gyi ri bdun gser 'ba' zhig las brtsams pa gnyis mtho ris lha'i yul du byung / khams tha ma sa rdul las gling bzhi mi'i yul du grub ste/ khams rab dang 'dres pa'i rten 'brel las 68

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7ba rin po che'i 'byung khungs mang bar byung / gling bzhi'i nang nas lho gling nam mkha' sngon po'i kheb 'og longs spyod 'dzam bu prik+ṣa'i shing tog mtshor lhung ba ba/ser du 'gyur ba'i cha las 'dzam du'i gling du ming btags/ gling 'dir bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong 'byon pas gling gzhan las khyad par 'phags/ /de la yul chen yul phran grangs kyis mi chod pa yod pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul na bhang ba la dang o ṭi bi sha dang kha che sogs re re bzhin mi khyim 'bum phrag mang po dang bcas pa dang / 'phags yul dngos la mi gtogs kyang de'i phyogs su bsnyu ba gser gling dang sing ga la'i gling sogs bgrang dka' ba yod kyang gtso bor gyur ba ni wa ra ṇa si/ yangs pa can/ mnyan yod/ gnas bcas/tsam pa ka rgyal po'i khab ste yul dbus kyi grong khyer chen po drug tu grags/ de dag gi dbus na ston pa mngon par byang chub pa'i sanas rdo rje gdan byang chub shing gis brgyan pa dang / nub o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling na rang byung te ru ka'i lha khang sogs ngo mtshar can mang po dang /dpal 'byor longs spyod kyi khyad par lha yul la 'gran pa yod/ /de las byang gi phyogs na gnas pa bod kha ba can gyi yul gru ri thams cad gangs kyis g.yoṭa pa/ chu thams cad bsil la dwangs pa/ sngo thams cad sman du skye ba/ ri brag la sprul ba'i rang byon 'byon pa/ tshad 469

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstananyi'i gsung 'bum/——4 ྾4s+dzawī྾྾pa'i dbal chung ba/ ba/dus pa'i srob chags nyung ba/ dus bzhi'i rnam 'gyur gsal ba/ yul bkod sna tshogs su bkra ba ste/ stod mnga' ris zhang zhung / bru sha pu rang sogs skor gsum la dbye ba dgu rjing rgo tshul dang / bar dadus gcang gnyis kyi dbus na dbu ru dang g.yo ru gnyis/gtsang na g.yas ru dang ru lag gnyis te ru bzhi yur ba'i tshul/ smad mdo khams tsha ba sga nga / spo 'bor sgang / 'bri rdza zal mo sgang sogs sgang drug gi khongs su chud pa zhing gi tshul te/ de dag la lha gcig chu'i pad+mas sa'i dpyad gzigs pas srin mo gan rkyal du nyal ba'i dbyibs su 'dug nas de'i kha gnon du bzhengs pa'i mtha' 'dul/ yang 'dul/ru gnon gyi lha khang bzhi gsum bcu gnyis dang / dbus na lha ldan dga' bzhi 'phrul gyi lha khang ngam/ dpal ra sa 'phrul snang gi satsus lag khang / 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i bden sto bas kyis rgya mtsho bsub pa'i steng na chags shing / rdzu 'phrul sprul ba'i bzo bos dngos su bzhengs pa/ rten gtso jo shāka rnam gsum dang 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha brgyad sogs sangs rgyas sprul ba'i sku dngos dang khyad par med pa mang po bzhugs pas/ dga' ldan lha yul na yang ngo mtshar gyi gleng gzhir ༷ byed pa/ rgya phibs kyi dbu rtse mthong bas kyang rgyud la byin rlabs 'jug pa dang / de'i lho rgyud g.yo ru'i sa cha na dpal bsam yas/ steng khang rgya gar/ bar khang li yul/ 'og khang rgya nag gi lugs su bzhengs pa'i 170

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7lugs gsum mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang / gling bzhi/gling phran/ yak+ṣa ltag 'ogajo mo gling gsum dang bcas pa/ rten gtso byang chub chen po sogs sku gsung thugs rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs shing / mkhan slob chos gsum zhal 'dzoms nas sa rab tu gnas pa'i me tog 'thor bas nyi 'og gi rgyal khams na byin rlabs che ba/ mthong thos kyi 'brel ba thob tshad phyir mi ldog pa'i skal ldan du byed pa/ de sogs rten gsum dang gtsug lag khang gi rnam grangs mtha' yas pa yod/ gzhan yang stod mnga' ris na gangs brag nyi shu/ bar dbus gtsang na sgrub gnas nyer gcig smad mdo khams na gnas chen nyer gcig gangs chen bzhi/ grags pa'i mtsho chen bzhi/ sbas yul rgyal po gsum/ lung lnga/ gling drug yul phran brgya rtsa sogs yod/ stod smad kyi lho rgyud thams cad dro la 'bru smin/ yul gyi dge bcu tshang zhing sa'i btsan barming 'dzom/ mkhar khang dang rmos zhing 'brel bar khyab/ byang rgyud thams cad bsil la dkar bcud 'phel/ spyod yul khyod yangs shing /phyogs bzhi'i mgron lam bde/ sbra khyim dang phyugs 'brog sbrel mas 'dzin/ sang yang sa'i dpyad bzang dgu 'dzoms/ grub thob kyi sadan sa dang dgon gnas mang pos brgyan pa ste/ rong 'brog sbra dang chon thag gi tshul/ dgon grong gos dang gong ba'i tshul du chags/ /rang yul ku se lung ba la dper brjod na/ sngon slob dpon bai ro 171

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gaspung 'bum/ba ma tsa na khams rgyal mo rong nas byon dus ku se 'phags lung thang zhes paraXyi ge 'bri ba'i phyag smyug lhung ba las gser gyi ljang bu skyes pa'i shul du phyis dgon gnas btab pa la deng sang yang gser ljang dgon du grags te/ yul 'dir yi ge'i rig pa la mkhas pa mang du 'byung ba de'i byin rlabs kyis yin par gleng / gzhan yang rmugs sang gi gnas na bya khyung rang byon gyi ltad mo dang / rmu ba chos nyid rdo rje zer ba'i grub thob chen po cig gi sprub gnas rmu phug sogs dang / rong btsan kha ba dkar po'i gnas las tu grags pa sgam bu gnas/ rje grub thob chen pos byin gyis brlabs par grags pa'i rdo zam ya mtshan che ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan rtasas mang pos khyad par du mtshon te/ mdor na bsil ldan gangs ris bskor ba'i yul 'di sngon rgyal ba nyid kyis 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug la bkas gtad pas thugs rje chen po'i rnam 'phrul rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung zhing / mdo rgyud thams cad kyi snying po'i zab donaXyi ge drug tu basbus nas gdul bya'i snying la rgyas btab pas byis pa lo sasum gyi dus nas ma ṇi pad+me rang shes su 'ong ba'i ngo mtshar can/ ri'i rgyal po ta la dang rnam dbyer ma mchis pa'i zhing mchog khyad par can yin pas de'i yon tan dang lo rgyus mtha' dag brjod par dka' yang da dung ma 'ongs pa'i gnas ska sa kun tu bkra shis dga' ston dang 'brel bar yang yang gleng ba'i rten 'brel 172

ngo ra/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ —྾ —ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ——ba ba ba ba —ba —ba —ba — ba ra ba ba ྾phyobs 'di'i bstan pa la sdang ba'i yul bdas lha srin sto bas po che rnams dam 'os tu btsud/ lha mi'i bsod nams kyi zhing du chos gzhi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ bsta na rtsa rab byung dang sasang sngasas 'dzin pa'i sde btsusas/ skal lda na gyi 'gro ba smin grol la bkod/ skal med la thar ba'i sa bon bzhag ste rgyal ba'i mdzad pa bsgrubs pas rma rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa sogs sprul pa'i lo paṇa chen po rnams kyang sku drin che/ de rnams kyi mdzad pa'i 'phro bskyangs te/ nyan bshad sgom sgrub kyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa bzung zhing / rnyed bkur dpung stobs kyis chos kyi dbu 'phang mtho bar byas te/ sangs can phan bde'i sros mkhar gzhi brling bar mdzad pas sa dge bka' rnying yi bstan 'dzin dam pa rnams dang / gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang ba dang / sde dge chos rgyal rim byon rnams kyang sku drin che/ mngon mtho rten bzang byin nas dkon pa brgya dang dka' ba stong bis gces par bskyangs pa'i drin chen pha ma dang / sa gdan thog gcig tu 'gros/sa te/ skyid na mthun sbyor legs spel/ sdug na sems gso skyo grogs/ skrag na skyel ma ra ma da'/steng gi skyibs/ 'gab kyi skyor byas pas phu nu nye mja' rnams kyang drin che/ de thams cad kyi drin las sngon nas kha sang gi bar du dang/la gyi nyi ma snum la bag dro ba yang dang yang du shar ba yin 'a / /tshul de bzhin du/ (sasar tshes gnam lo rgyal po'i 'dzum zhal thog 171

gtam tshosas/ po da/ 7—྾ ———nga bang —nga nga ྾ 4nga nga nga nga ba — nga 4—྾—ba—ba————mar mjong ba'i)dus bzang 'dir yang yul mi thams cad bsod nams dga' ston gyi las la 'dus te/ bde la yangs pa'i gdan bting // 'grig/sa la ring ba'i gral bsgrigs/ dkar dmar gyi zas sna g.yos su byas/ ja chang sga ston mo skyem du sbyar/ drang srong mgron 'gyed pa lta bu'i lha mchod mi mchod yul dus dang 'tshams par spel zhing /srid zhi'i dge legs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas dkon mchog sasum dang / dkon mchog mchod pa'i sbyin bdag bstan pa dar ba'i yul gling dang bcas ba'i lo rgyus la khog/ bcol te/ chos dang bkra shis kyi btam snyan la 'brel chags shing skabs su babs pa bgyis nas/ phun tshogs chos lda na kyi bde ba'i dga' ston rgya che la rgyun ring bar 'byung ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa legs lam du 'grigs nas/ lha bde/ klu zhi/lo legs/ 'bru 'phel/ mi phyusas skyid dar 'dzom/ dmab 'khrug dang nad yams med/ rje'i mnga' thang 'phel/ mi sde nang mthun/ yul khams chos la spyod/ thub pa'i bstan pa dar/ bstan 'dzin gyi sku tshe ring / dge 'dun gyi sde 'phel// phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du bkra shis rdzosas ldan gyi 'byor char bzhin 'bab pa'i rten 'brel smon lam zhu//blo chung sbyang ba dman la gtam sgo dog /gzhon dus mi khyur ma song bab nas bsdad1 /rgas dus yod tshad zos nas nyal zhing gnyid/ /bdab 'dras lugs gnyis gtam gzhung ji ltar 'chad/ /'on kyang ban bun 476
