pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ 0—4—4ba — ma — ba ྾ba bab ba ——ba—ba4ba4 —྾—4—4—4—rnam rtog spra ba'i me/ /bskul tshig spud pas bus nas cher mched de/ /sna tshogs dbyibs su gyur ba'i me lce 'dis/ /phyogs kun bkra shis snang bas 'gengs gyur cib /ces pa'ang rkos mkhan rgya mtsho nas lo gsar dga' ston sogs dang 'brel ba'i gtam lab snyan ngag gi brdas ma bsgribs pa'i shin tu kha gsal ba zhig phris zhes bskul ba'i ngo ma bzlos bar rdo ba bstan nyis smras rim bzhin blo gsal chos kyi grags pas yi ger bris pa dge bar gyur cig /lo gas ra dang ma 'brel na rtags(zla khrim)bar blangasaXpas chog bla ma'i 'u nga 'don pa'i tshul du mi khya bar/ skad cha dkyus ma lab la ba byas nas dal la tshig 'bru gsal bar bshad/ sngon nas byang cha thon par byas te sgra lo ga mi zer zhing /snga phyi'i gcod mtshams mi nor b.raXbya'o//476

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7྾ ྾྾ r+yā྾྾྾—༄/ /dpal ldan bla ma la mos shing dang ba'i blo gros las byung ba'i rdol thabs kyi ca cos bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa tsan+dan nags rlung zhes bya ba bathugs so/ /dpal ldan bla ma la mos shing dang ba'i blo gros las byung ba'i rdol thabs kyi ca cos bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa tsan+dan nags rlung /gtsang 'jam mtshan dpe'i sku dang tshang dbyangs gsung / /zab yangs mapho brtso'i thugs la dbang 'byor zhing / /thabs mkhas mdzad pa'i roche ba marje po yis//'brel tshad thar bder 'khrid la gsol ba 'debs/1 /pad+ma ltar hūṃs ye shes rang 'od gsal/ /mdo sngags chos kyi snang bas sa gsumi 'gengs/ /lus can spyi ding lteg pare snyigasi ma'i 'gro'i/ /gling dang skyob par gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ 2 /'od gsal chos sku'i dbyings lasaṃ sprul pa'i sprin/ /gdul ('dir ldeb gtsug chadarte thon pa'i 'gro 'di ma bzung 4ra/ /gting med gnas su bying na mi rung zhes/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis bsam bzhin skye ba bzung / 12 /chen po'i las kyi gdos su bcug pa dang / /kun kyis brnyas pa'i rigs ngan rgyud dag tu/ /sprin rum zla ltar snang ba 'gyed dka' bas/ /dbus ma'i rigs su 1177

za da/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4྾ r+yā—྾྾ 'khrungs la gsol ba 'debs/ 13 /zla tshes gzhon nu lta bu'i na tshod nas/ /yi ge 'bri klog skar nag rtsis rib dang / /gso ba rig pa'i bzhung lugs kun sbyangs pas/ /mkhas pa'i phul du son la gsol ba 'debs/14 /byis pa'i 'khor nang rtsed mo'i 'chad nyan dang 1 /rgan rabs gzigs tshe rig pa ci shes rmed/ /rol rtsed zhar du'ang chos la bsnyen bkur mdzad/ /gzhon nu'i spyod mchog bstan la gsol ba 'debs/ 15brda sprod ka swa gnyis dang tsan+d+ra ba/ /go don ri mor bcas pa la byang ste//ngag tshig brjod pa gtsang ba'i mchog tu gyur/ /smra mkhas pa ṇi ba/nyis par gsol ba 'debs/ 16 /snyan ngag lho shar lam gnyis so so dang / /thun mong sgra don rgyan rnams byang bar ma.o/ /thrat+ta dzā ti ngo mtshar rtogs byed bcas/ /sdeb sbyor rgya mtsho brgal la gsol ba 'debs/ 17 /dpal ldan 'chi med seng ge'i mngon brjod sazhung / /rdzogs par thugs chud sdeb legs rnar snyan pa'i/ /tshig sbyor phreng bas mkhas pa'i tshogs dbus su/ /kun dga'i dus ston spel la gsol ba 'debs/ 18 /sku gzugs mchod rten dkyil 'khor bris 'bur kyi/ /thig tshad mi 'dra'i khyad par mang ma.o cing / /grasas dang ma grabs bzo gnas gzhan gyi yang / /rnam grangs dpag yas gzisas la gsol ba 'debs/19 /sa skya ngor dang na len dra sogs su/ /rig gnas mkhas pa'i dam pa mang btud cing / /gang du bzhugs kyang sna tshogs rig pa mkhan/ /du 478

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7— ——ba ——ma ba ba ba b.rab —ma —ba ba ma ba —bab —ba—ba—ba— ——ba sasum layi rtser sbyin la bsol ba 'debs/ 60 /bskyed rim nyid la'ang rags phra'i rim pa yis/ /slob pa'i tshul dang bskyed chos tha dad dang / /rgyas bsdus mi 'dra'i khyad par bsam yas par/ /dpang gyur sngasas shes btso bor gsol ba 'debs/ 61 /rgyud don zab lam snying po'i bcud basbus pa/ /lam 'bras chos drub/ lusas banyis phyag rgya che/ /sdug bsngal zhi byed la sogs sgrub brgyud kyi/ /shing rta'i srol mang 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ 62 /dngang basbur phyir dang rab 'byams las kyi phyir/ /dkyil 'khor mang po'i bsnyen pa yongs rdzogs shing / /'od sasal bsam mi khyab kyi ting 'dzin mthus/ /skal bzang smin gro' mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ 63 /rlung sems mi shigs thig le'i dbyings su bsdams/ /pho nya sasum gyi longs spyod dbang du gyur/ /brtan g.yo'i dngos kun dpyid kyi bde bar 'bar/ /brtul zhugs sadeng chen thob la gsol ba 'debs/64/in+d+ra bhu ti dpal ldan sa ra ha/ /lha hi pa dang ye shes zhabs la sobs/ /grub mchog mang pos mngon sum byin brlabs shing / /rgyal tshab skyes bur bsngabs la sasol ba 'debs/ 65 /bstan pa kun la mkhas kyang gdul bya'i ngor/ /rang rang mos pa ji bzhin phyogs re ston/ /su la ji ltar gdam sa pas phan btags kyang / /ma mngon sbas tshul spyod la gsol ba 'debs/ 66 /de nyid bcu shes rgyud sde'i las tshogs dang / /thun mong grub chen sgrub pa'i cho ga'i sgo / /pha 186

za ra nya rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i bsung 'bum/4— 0—ba——— 4— ba —4——bab—————4she —sheb —— — —ba0ma/tha' yas pas lus can re ba kun/ /yid bzhin skong bar nus la sasol ba 'debs/ 67 /khyad par rgyal bas lung bstan lha btsan po// khri srong lde'u btsan bsod nams tshong zong bis/ /nyos pa'i bsang rgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i mdzod/ /kun gyi mnga' bdab gcib pur gsol ba 'debs/ 68 /khyu mchog khyu yi thog mar 'gro ba bzhin/ /phyobs 'dir rdo rje jeg pa'i gsung rab kyi/ /dang por dbu brnyes rgyud sde'i ma lta bu/ /gsang sngags rnying mar mkhyen la sasol ba 'debs/ 69 /'phasas yul gsang sngags bstan pa rdzogs ldan dus/ /'dzam gling che ba'i ris sngasas 'chang rgyal gtsos/ /skal ldan mchob si 'bor la pham phab tu/ /phogs pa'i khyad chos bzigs la sasol ba 'debs/ 70 /yo ga sasum gyi srog 'dzin rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /bka' babs chu bo zam/ bzhi yongs tshang ba'i/ /phrin las rgyun ring snying po'i rgyud chen gyi// /bshad rgyun ngoms par bzhes la gsol ba 'debs/ 71 /de che sazhi rgyud kanyug ma'i rdo rje sems/ /thabs grol lam rgyud zab mos nyer bskul bas/ /sgrib bral 'bras du'i rgyud du yongs sad pa'i/ /gsang don chu gter brgal la gsol ba 'debs/ 72 /gsang ba'i dzeg pa lam mchog rnam bkod dang / /lha ba'i phreng ba la sobs rig 'dzin gyi/ /man ngag rgun chang btung bas cher myos te/ /mkhyen rtosas gzi brjid 'bar laXgasol ba 'debs/ 73 /shangs mdor dpal chen dgyes pa'i sgra ༷ 18()

za nga/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/——ba——ba——bab ———4ba4—bab—4— bab——4 —————4mchos la gsol ba 'debs/ 80 /rab 'bar bange chen me yis chos kyi dbyings/ /snang ba gcis gyur gdod ma'i te ru kar/ /bzhengs pas shes bya'i 'khor lo mtha' dag gis/ /srob snyingaXdus gcig phul la gsol ba 'debs/ 81 /snod bcud rnam das bdud rtsi'i ting 'dzin dang / /myong grol sbyin pas grangs me da 'gro ba'i rgyud/ 1khrag 'thung dpa' bo'i gdung du byin rlabs pa'i/ /gdul thabs bsam mi/ khyab la bsol ba 'debs/ 82 /srung zlog gsad dang sgrib sbyong khrus chob dang / /rdo rje'i tshe sgrub rten gsum lhag gnas sogs/ //tshar gcod rjes 'dzin phrin las sgo mang gis/ /bstan 'gro'i don chen mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/83 /sku che'i phreng bar gdul bya dpag med la/ /dbang bsgur phyas this sku bzhi'i sa bon btab/ /kun kyang ring por mi thogs byang chub che'i/ /snye phung g.yur du 'khrigs la sasol ba 'debs/ 84 /rtsol bcas pheg pa 'a sa 'das sangs rgyas sar/ /mig 'phrul bzhin du 'gro ba'i zab khyad can/ /myur lam rdzogs pa chen po'i man ngag la/ /dbang 'byor grub nga1'i tshogs rjer gsol ba 'debs/ 85 /mkhyen rab sbu can 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis/ /sde gsum k+kong dgu'i bstan pa'i rgyal thabs la/ /gtad rgyas dbang bsgur nyid kyi sasang sasum dang / /mi phyed rdo rjer bsgrubs la gsol ba 'debs/ 86 /spang gnyen zhen pa'i mtha' las grol ba'i gnad/ /chos kun ye shes rol ba dbyings kyi rgyan/ /so 188

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i bsung 'bum/྾ba ra ྾ba ba ma ba ba ma ba ma ma ma ma ba 4 4 4ba ma babab — ྾ —4ba bzhin/ /chos zad dbyings su rig pa rnam grol te/ /rtsol bcas lam gyi 'ching ba sanyid sad kyi/ /rmi lam lta bur dag la gsol ba 'debs/94/dgongs pa gdod ma'i makon por byang chub kyang / /mdzad pa tha mal gdul bya'i ngor bstun nas/ /brda sprod slob dpon byis pa klog 'jug bzhin/ /dpag dka'i rnam 'phrul mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ 95 /chu zad nya bzhin lnga bdo'i tshad pa yis/ /gzir ba'i 'gro mang rdzas chos drag sngags chus/ /bsil mdzad gter ston rgya mtsho'i gdengs can dbus/ /ma dros klu dbang 'dra la gsol ba 'debs/ 96 /bod 'bangs pad+ma'i zab bter la spyod pa/ /gang mchis khri srong rje yi smon 'a ma mthu/ /bgrang yas skyes pa rabs kyi phreng bas kyang / /gter brgyud lha ga par spel la sasol ba 'debs/ 97 /kun mkhyen nga las nu khyod 'dir byung tshe/ /rin chen 'dzin ma 'di yang nu bum las/ /chos nor dam rdzas 'o ma'i rgyun 'bab cing //khyod drung ma bzhin bsnun la gsol ba 'debs/ 98 /ring nas pad 'byung rgyal bas rgyal tshab cher/ /mnga' gsol snyanaXbargyud gtad rgya rdzogs pa'i dbang / /dpe brgyud rgas med bzhusas pa'i sa 'dis byas/ /rtsod med sprul skrur grags la gsol ba 'debs/99 //gtad rgyas 'od gsal dbyings sgrom chos kyis gtams/ /rgya' rnams chos kyi pham phab nyin bzhin stsol/ /mkha' 'gros gsang mdzod sgo rnams rtag tu phye/ /bsam yas chos kyi mdzod la gsol ba 'debs/190

gtam tshogs/ za da/ 7— —ba ba ba—ba 4bam ba ba 4—ba zhe—ba —— —bab — ——ba 4—44100 /ming can ming med bter chen gter phran dang / /rang sater yang gter byung dang 'byung 'gyur kun/ /ye shes me 'o nga ngos la pra phab bzhin/ /sgrib med mngon sum gzigs la saso'1 ba 'debs/ 10 1 / dngos kyis sbas mngon tshul du bton pa dang / /pho nya bkyes dang skyes bzhin 'ong ba sogs/ /brtul zhugs rdzu 'phrul sgo mo sna tshogs kyis/ /gter yis dbang du bsdus la sasol ba 'debs/ 1002 /ya mchan sgyu ma'i sgra lda na brda'i('phrul yig red)rol mtshor/ /rig rtsal 'jig rten mes po rjes chasas pas/ /tshig don lang tsho rab rdzosas zab gter gyi/ /dbyangs can mgron du khus la gsol ba 'debs/ 103 /dus sasum sater sto na yongs kyi chos mdzod kun/ /khyod kyi ngo mtshar bka' babs rnam bdun las/ /gsum pa yang gter nor bu'i sgrom kho nar/ /ma tshang med par rdzogs la ba/sol ba 'debs/ 104 /de slad bla rdzogs thugs gsum sgrub sde('di man gyi ma phyi re zhig ma rnyed)191

nga n+d+ra—tram̐ng ྾——rngo grub 'jigs med bstang nga 1 'bum/ 4nga nga nga can bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag chen ngor gyur ba dag dang / gzhan yang mkhas pa'i khyu mchog mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho/ grub pa'i dbang po gtsang ba byams pa chos 'dzin/ smra ba'i dbang phyug rdo grub bstan pa'i nyi ma/ satsug lag rtsis kyi nyin byed phyag mdzod byams pa sasung rab/ sman rgyal g.yu thog gnyis pa lha rje stag bla nor bu/lo rgyus smra ba'i dbang po gyi lung sras po sku mched/ rtsod rigs smra ba'i seng chen 'gya ba a lags mdo sngags/ sbas nga'i rnal 'byor chen po khra dge slong tshul khrims dar rgyas/ yongs 'dzin chen po 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros/ bstan pa'i nyin byed a rig dase bathes chen mo/ sasang chen bka' babs shar yod grabs pa bzang po/ mdo rgyud smra ba gyang sprul don yod rdo rje/ nges pa don bi pari 4 ḍata sku phyogs shing bza' sku phreng / rtsod bral dus babs kyi sater chen khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa/ rab 'byams gzhung brgya smra ba'i mkhan chen a skong blo bzang rdo za/ pheg mchos smra ba'i nga bka' babs kun bzang bde skyong dbang mo sogs mkhas dbang nor bu'i phreng ba zam ma chad par yul 'dir sku 'khrungs pa'am dus yun ring por bzhugs te mdzad phrinargya cher bskyangs pa dang /dbon gnas dang dge 'dun gyi 'dus sde dag smra ma dkos/ khyem pa 2sbra nag pa dag gi khrod du'ang yig tshang lo rgyus gleng ba'i dase

n+d+ran+d+ra—tram̐྾4—41 tsho ༵mi~X byeng 1 sbyong 1 zo~X—/ ྾྾4྾4—4 rang khyad thon pa'i sa gnas rig sa/nas shul bzhag myur skyob dang dar spel byed pa'i kun slong bis bskul te/ nged las khungs nas 'tshol bsdu sgrig gsumagyi bya ba yun ring spel mthar dpe rnying mi nyung ba zhig lag son byung ba las bdams pa brgyud/ mgo los sa khul mkhas dbang rim byon gyi gsung rtsom bces bsgrisas dpe tshobs〉'e/sa pa zhib bsgrigs nas rim par dpe deb skor zhib par du skrun par rgya che'i klog pa po dag gi gdeng 'jog lesas ngo dang 'brel yod sde khag bi bzengs bstod thob/ rting sku la de dag gi rmang gaji'i steng—(krung go'i grangs nyung mi rika gna' rtsom spyi byang band bsnyus〉lag star byed pa'i go skabs dang bstun te nga tshos rim pa sngar las spags te/ slar yang〈mabo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉kyi par skrun jus gzhi gsar ba zhig bzos nas khul srid sazhung dang 'brel yod mabo khrid la yar zhu byas pas rgyab skyor dang khas len legs par thob par brten da lta jus gzhi dngos su lag star byed pa'i skal ba lebs po thob/de la 'dir(dpe tshobs〉)'di nyid 'tshol sdud dang dag sgrib rtsom sgrig par skrun bcas kyi skor gsal bshad du 'os pa 'ga' thig zhu ba 'di lta ste/1 nga tshos bya ba 'di spel ba la maso log khul u dang / khul

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ ngo da 7ba ba ba ba —bkab ba bar —zlo4dbye྾44——྾4dkab4——dmangs —na/ khul da gzhung 1/ khul rngod rngos bcas 'go da tshan skor che bzhi dang 'brel yod sde khab sga 'ban 'khur ba las grub pa'i ched don 'go khrid tshan chung btsugs thog 'brel yod don bya sang ci'i thad bka' skor snya na seng zhus pa'i dbongs don ltar bsgrubs pa yin la/ ched dmigs bya ba'i jus bzhi yig thos nas khul mi dmangs srid gzhung la zhus te chog mchan thob cing brgyud spel gnang ba dang bstun pa sha stag yin/ dus mtshungs su ma phyi'i yig rnying yod tshad so so'i 'brel yod gnyer bdag dang chos bdag dgon bdag sosas brgyud de tshul ldan lusas mthun sgos 'tshol sbud byas 'ing / khong tshor gros zhu byas te par skrun byed par thugs mthun yid 'thad byung ba yin la// rgyun srol lam ba/sang ba sngabs dang 'brel ba sogs kyi dbang bis bka' dog dgos min dag kyang khong tsho'i dgongs 'dod bka' 'khrol dang bsnyun pa ma satogs nged cag gi lag tu gang son ltar bzu lum sger gcod byas pa gcig kyang med/2 mthun rkyen 'byor ba'i gnas bab 'os/ gsung 'dum gcib la'ang bris dang par ma'i ma phyi ci rnyed cig nye bar bsdus te phan tshun bsdur gshib sgos sang rgyas cos kyi rmang gzhi'i steng gzhan las kha bskangs shing / dmangs khrod du kha 'thor du 6

nga nga —tram̐ rdo grub 'jing nga da bstan nyi'i gsung 'ang nga/ nga nga nga —bzhugs pa'i thor bu dag kyang lag tu ci 'ong bis gsab snan byas yod pas/ so so'i gsung 'bum gang la mtshon na'ang mig snga ltar na da lta'i〈dpe tshogs〉〉'dir 'khod pa kho na kha tshang shos dang rgyas shos su rtsi chog snyam/3 gsung chos go rim sgrig stangs skor la sngon gyi ma phyi gang legs shos su snang ba de'i sgrig stangs sazhir bzhag gi rmang gzhi'i steng bcig 'gyur dang dgos dbang sogs la gzhigs te rtsom sgrig pa nas las babs kyi 'gan dbang spyad de 'os 'tsham gyi skyar sgrig dang slar sdeb kyang byas yod/4 ma phyi phal cher la dpe chod yang yang bgyis la tshad ldan gyi par gzhi med pa sogs kyi dbang gis yi ge mi dag cing / chad lhag shor ba/ bo rim 'chol ba ma yig mi sasal ba sogs cung mang ba la rang blos sprugs pa 'khrul med du snyam pa dag lesas par bcos shing dag par bsgribs la/ dobs sazhir mthong ba du ma zhis sazisas pa yangs thing de phyogs su nang rgyus che ba'i mkhas pa du mar drung bcar bka' 'dri yang yang byas te dogs pa chod pa dag de bzhin du bcos/ re zhig khungs lung mi gsal zhing dpog par dka' ba re zung 'dug pa phyis kyi dpyad bzhir zin bris su bgyis thob 'ol tshod kyis ma bcos shing dpyad yams la ma 6

bsgribs rjes kyi gtam/ pod 7bzheb ba ba —dbye—྾brjob ྾—bsna ྾྾sdub4 4rjo4 'jus par ma — sor 'a sa byas nga / 'ga' —ga la na shas bar 'dod pa'i yi se de zur gyi zla khyem du bkod yod/5 klog bde bar gzhigs te gsung chos bye bras pa phal mo cher mdzad byang sogs las dras te kha byang bkod cing / sa bcad blangs la/ ldeb byang yang bye brag tu bkod yod/6 ba zur 'dob/sa min lta bu sogs yi be skor zhig bi bkol stangs da lta'i dag yig 'ga' zhig dang gcig tu mthun min yod kyang mkhas pa tshad ldan kyi phyag rgyun la thar chasas su yod phyin khungs lung re yod srid la phyis su dag yig zhib dpyod pa dag gi dpyad gzhir nye bar mkho yang srid snyam nas ji bzhin sor 'jog byas/ gzhan yang ma yis tu skabs 'asar mkhas pa bzhan gyi gsung thung ngu tsam re yongs su drangs 'dug pa zhib par dpyad tshe gong 'og gi gsung sang rung re de'i zur rgyan nam sasal 'don ci ribs su song ba sogs 'brel shin tu che bas dgos dbang la bzhigs nas 'dir yang ma yig ltar bkod pa lags/bye brag rdo grub chen rin po che 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma'i bsung 'bum la gsal bshad du zhu dgos pa zhig ni khong la da reb kyi deb bdun po 'dir 'khod pa las gzhan da dung gsung chos mang tsam yod par nges la de ltar du'ang thos mod dus dbang 7

dpe sgrig 'asan 'khur ba/ pad+ma tshul khrims/mdun shog 'char 'god pa/ karma che ring /rdo grub 'jigs rmed bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pod bdun pa/mgo 'o ga khul sana' rtsom byaba'i 'go khrid tshan chung sa/zhung las khang this bsdu sgrib byas/si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun nas bkram/lho nub lcags bzhu sa bshis par 'debs bzo grwas dpar/2003lo'i zla10par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs /2003lo'i zla10par par thengs dang po dpar/par grangs/ 0001nga 300dpe rtas/sa/ 15 8ma7—5409—2739—97( 4deb bdun po larin sgor/ 60 00

〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'tshol spud dag sgrig dpe spun bya ba'i 'go khrid tshan chung gi ming tho/tshan gartso/ pad ma rnam rgyal/tshan gartso gzhon pa/byis tshe ring / rdo rje bkra shis/bstan chos/ 'jigs med/ rdo rje/gces ma/ klu skyabs/ nor sde/khongs mi(ming rim bod yig ka mad ltar bsgrigs pa)klu skyabs/ dge legs/ mgon lha/cin nor bu/ gces ma/ 'ju skal bzang /'jigs med/ bstan chos/ thub bzang /dung gces/ rdo rje/ rdo rje bkra shis/nor sde/ nor bu/ pad ma rnam rgyal/byis tshe ring / tshul khrims/ tshe ring skyabs/
